action_scene.description: Type of user behavior to target. `VIDEO_RELATED` = video interactions. `CREATOR_RELATED` = creator interactions. `HASHTAG_RELATED` = hashtag interactions.

video_user_actions.description: Specific user interactions to target for the chosen `action_scene`. When `action_scene=VIDEO_RELATED`: `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, `SHARED`. When `action_scene=CREATOR_RELATED`: `FOLLOWING`, `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`. When `action_scene=HASHTAG_RELATED`: `VIEW_HASHTAG`. Via TikTok Ads Manager you cannot define this field; defaults are all four for `VIDEO_RELATED` and both for `CREATOR_RELATED`. Via API you can pass any allowed combination.

adgroup_app_profile_page_state.description: Whether to use App Profile Page. `ON` or `OFF`. App Profile Page is not supported in a Dedicated Campaign with optimization goal as in-app event and bid strategy as cost cap. Therefore, you cannot set `ON` when all of the following are true: `ios14_targeting=IOS14_PLUS`, `optimization_goal=IN_APP_EVENT`, and `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Maximum 512 characters; emoji is not allowed.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. In certain scenarios, ad groups targeting `AGE_13_17` in the US, Latin America, the European Economic Area, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada are not allowed (see New age restrictions for ads on TikTok). If you use targeting options that do not support `AGE_13_17` in those regions and you leave `age_groups` unspecified or as `[]`, the field defaults to `["AGE_18_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_44", "AGE_45_54", "AGE_55_100"]`. If your ad group targets `AGE_13_17` in those regions, explicitly specify the exact age groups you want to target.

app_config.description: Required when `sales_destination=WEB_AND_APP` at the campaign level. Details of the app(s) to promote. Maximum size: 2. You can specify an Android app, an iOS app, or both.

app_id.description: Required when `app_config` is specified. App ID of the app to promote.

App ID of the app to promote. Required when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING`, or when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` with `app_promotion_type=APP_INSTALL` or `APP_PREREGISTRATION` and the campaign is not an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign. You cannot use an app that has not activated the SAN module on your MMP.

attribution_event_count.description: Event count (Statistic type) for the ad group, controlling how actions are counted after viewing or clicking. `UNSET` = unset. `EVERY` = count multiple events as separate conversions. `ONCE` = count multiple events as 1 conversion. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. If you omit all four attribution fields, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

audience_ids.description: List of custom audience IDs to include.

audience_rule.description: Rules that specify your audience. Valid only when `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC` or `APP_PROMOTION`. For details, see Audience Rules.

audience_type.description: Required and valid only when the campaign-level `app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING`. Not supported otherwise. App retargeting audience type. `NEW_CUSTOM_AUDIENCE` = retargeting custom audience. To use an empty retargeting custom audience, omit `audience_ids` and `excluded_audience_ids`. To use a non-empty audience, specify `audience_ids` (Include), `excluded_audience_ids` (Exclude), or both — they cannot share the same IDs.

automated_keywords_enabled.description: Valid only when at the campaign level `is_search_campaign=true`. Whether to enable automated keywords (system-generated keywords after ads are added). Default: `false`. Automated keywords in Search Ads Campaigns are allowlist-only.

bid_display_mode.description: Required and must be `CPV` (Cost per One View) when `objective_type=VIDEO_VIEW`. How Cost per View is calculated and measured. Cannot be updated after creation. Not needed when `objective_type` is not `VIDEO_VIEW`. The enum value `CPMV` is deprecated in v1.3.

bid_price.description: Required when `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event` is `CPC`, `CPM`, or `CPV`. Bid price (the average cost per result, used for the Cost Cap bidding strategy). When CBO is enabled at the campaign level, set the same bid value across all ad groups. Must be lower than the campaign-level and ad-group-level budget. See Bidding-Bidding limits for the verification mechanism.

bid_type.description: Bidding strategy that determines how the system manages cost per result, spend, and delivery. Required when Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) is enabled at the campaign level (`budget_optimize_on=true`). For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Bidding Strategy enumeration. For new ad groups under one CBO campaign, this field should match the first ad group.

billing_event.description: Events you want to pay for. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Billing Event enumeration; for the billing event associated with each optimization goal, see Corresponding billing event for an optimization goal.

blocked_pangle_app_ids.description: Pangle app block list IDs. You can obtain an ID from the `app_package_id` field returned by Get Pangle block list. Takes effect only when Pangle placement is selected.

brand_safety_partner.description: Required only when `brand_safety_type=THIRD_PARTY` and `placements=["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]`. Brand safety partner. `IAS` = IAS. `OPEN_SLATE` = the partner is named DoubleVerify on TikTok Ads Manager because it has been acquired by DoubleVerify. Pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions are allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be modified.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Default value: NO_BRAND_SAFETY. Enum values: NO_BRAND_SAFETY (to be deprecated in the next API version): To not use any brand safety solution. Full inventory, which means your ads may appear next to some content featuring mature themes. EXPANDED_INVENTORY: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Expanded inventory means that your ads will appear next to content where most inappropriate content has been removed, and that does not contain mature themes. In the next API version, EXPANDED_INVENTORY will replace NO_BRAND_SAFETY and will be the default brand safety option. STANDARD_INVENTORY: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Standard inventory means that ads will appear next to content that is appropriate for most brands. LIMITED_INVENTORY: Use TikTok's brand safety solution. Limited inventory means that your ads will not appear next to content that contains mature themes. THIRD_PARTY: Use a third-party brand safety solution. You also need to pass a value to the brand_safety_partner field.

budget.description: Ad group budget. Ignored when Campaign Budget Optimization is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true` at the campaign level). For daily budget value ranges by currency, see Currency-Daily budget value range.

budget_mode.description: Ad group budget mode. When Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) is enabled at the campaign level, ad-group `budget_mode` is ignored. When CBO is disabled: `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL` = lifetime budget; `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` = average daily budget over a week (daily costs do not exceed 125% of the average; weekly costs do not exceed average × 7); `BUDGET_MODE_DAY` = daily budget. When `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `PRODUCT_SALES` (Video Shopping Ads only), `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, and you want a non-lifetime budget, use `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`. `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT` is allowlist-only. For `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT`, prefer `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` over `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`. If `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`, then `schedule_type` can be `SCHEDULE_START_END` or `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. If `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, then `schedule_type` must be `SCHEDULE_START_END` (which requires `schedule_end_time`).

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that this ad group belongs to.

carrier_ids.description: Carriers to target. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted location(s). Only carriers with `in_use=true` are valid.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source` is `CATALOG` or `STORE`. Optional when `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. Not supported when `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`. Business Center ID that has permission for the catalog. For catalogs in Business Center, pass the Business Center ID that owns the catalog. Starting June 30th, 2024, when `product_source=STORE`, this field is ignored.

catalog_id.description: Required when `product_source` is `CATALOG` or `STORE`. When `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`, `catalog_id`, `catalog_authorized_bc_id`, `store_id`, and `store_authorized_bc_id` are optional: if you provide a TikTok Shop through these parameters, sales of products in that shop are reported; otherwise sales of products showcased in `identity_id` are reported. When `product_source=CATALOG`, set this to the catalog you want to promote products from. When `product_source=STORE`, set this to the catalog bound to the promoted TikTok Shop. Starting June 30th, 2024, when `product_source=STORE`, `catalog_id` is ignored.

category_exclusion_ids.description: Valid only when at the campaign level `objective_type` is `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `RF_REACH`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`, and at the ad group level `placements=["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]` and `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. Content exclusion category IDs.

click_attribution_window.description: Click-through attribution window for the ad group. `OFF`, `ONE_DAY` = 1-day click, `SEVEN_DAYS` = 7-day click, `FOURTEEN_DAYS` = 14-day click, `TWENTY_EIGHT_DAYS` = 28-day click. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. To manually configure attribution windows, you must pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` simultaneously, and `engaged_view_attribution_window` is optional but, if passed, must be accompanied by both. If you omit `click_attribution_window`, `engaged_view_attribution_window`, `view_attribution_window`, and `attribution_event_count`, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to disable comments on ads on TikTok.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. Allowlist-only. Only supports campaign-level `objective_type` of `REACH` and `VIDEO_VIEWS`. Not supported when `brand_safety_type=THIRD_PARTY`.

conversion_bid_price.description: Required when `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event=OCPM`. Target cost per conversion for oCPM (Optimized Cost per Mille). Must be lower than the campaign-level and ad-group-level budget. See Bidding-Bidding limits for the verification mechanism.

creative_material_mode.description: Creative delivery strategy. `CUSTOM` = custom (default). Automated ads (`creative_material_mode=DYNAMIC`) are deprecated; use Smart Creative ads (`creative_material_mode=CUSTOM`).

custom_conversion_id.description: ID of the Custom Conversion to use. Valid only when all of the following are met: either `pixel_id` or `app_id` is specified; a Custom Conversion has been configured for that `pixel_id`/`app_id`; `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `IN_APP_EVENT`; `optimization_event` is specified and matches the Standard Event associated with the Custom Conversion; and the Custom Conversion's `activity_status` is `ACTIVE` or `NO_RECENT_ACTIVITY`.

dayparting.description: Ad delivery arrangement, a 48 × 7 = 336-character string of `0` and `1`. Each character maps to a 30-minute slot from Monday through Sunday: the first character is 0:01-0:30 Monday, the second is 0:31-1:00 Monday, the last is 23:31-0:00 Sunday. `1` = deliver in that slot; `0` = do not deliver. If unspecified, all-`0`, or all-`1`, full-time delivery is used.

deep_bid_type.description: Bidding strategy for in-app events. Required when CBO is enabled (`budget_optimize_on=true`) and `optimization_goal=VALUE`. `VO_MIN_ROAS` and `VO_HIGHEST_VALUE` are allowlisted. For full details, see the TikTok Marketing API Deep Event Bidding Strategy enumeration. When `secondary_optimization_event` is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`.

deep_funnel_event_source.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status=ON`. Event source type. `PIXEL` = Pixel. `OFFLINE` = Offline Event Set. `CRM` = CRM Event Set.

deep_funnel_event_source_id.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status=ON`. Event Source ID. When `deep_funnel_event_source=PIXEL`, pass a Pixel ID. When `deep_funnel_event_source=OFFLINE`, pass an Offline Event Set ID. When `deep_funnel_event_source=CRM`, pass a CRM Event Set ID.

deep_funnel_optimization_event.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status=ON`. Deep funnel optimization event. For supported Standard Events available for Pixels, Offline Event Sets, and CRM Event Sets, see the "Event name for ad creation" column in Supported Pixel events. Example: `SHOPPING`.

deep_funnel_optimization_status.description: Valid only when `promotion_type=LEAD_GENERATION`. Status of deep funnel optimization, which optimizes upper-funnel events alongside a deeper-funnel secondary event to improve campaign effectiveness. Default: `OFF`. Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is allowlist-only; with Pixel or Offline events it is generally available.

device_model_ids.description: IDs of device models to target. Only active devices (`is_active=true` in the response of `/tool/device_model/`) can be used. `device_model_ids` and `device_price_ranges` cannot be set at the same time.

device_price_ranges.description: Targeting device price range. 10000 means 1000+. Numbers must be multiples of 50. The upper limit you set is increased by 50 to form the actual upper limit (for example, [0, 250] actually means [0, 300] in TikTok Ads Manager).

engaged_view_attribution_window.description: Engaged view-through attribution window (after at least 6 seconds of video). `ONE_DAY` = 1-day engaged view. `SEVEN_DAYS` = 7-day engaged view. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. If passed, must be accompanied by `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window`. If you omit all four attribution fields, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

excluded_audience_ids.description: List of custom audience IDs to exclude.

excluded_custom_actions.description: When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type=LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. Custom actions to use as Exclude conditions for the retargeted audience.

code.description: Custom action used as an Exclude condition. `VIEW_PRODUCT` = viewed the product. `ADD_TO_CART` = added the product to cart. `PURCHASE` = purchased the product.

days.description: Time range used to filter audiences that did not complete the specified action. Value range: [1, 180].

excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Valid only for Pangle placement. Do not specify alongside `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`. IDs of Pangle audiences to exclude; the package's `bind_type` must be `EXCLUDE`.

frequency.description: Together with `frequency_schedule`, controls how often people see your ad (only available for `REACH` ads). Both conditions must hold: `1 <= frequency <= 1000` and `1 <= frequency_schedule <= 30`. For example, `frequency=2` and `frequency_schedule=3` means "show ads no more than twice every 3 days".

frequency_schedule.description: Together with `frequency`, controls how often people see your ad (only available for `REACH` ads). See `frequency` for the valid combinations.

household_income.description: Household income to target. `TOP5` = top 5% of ZIP codes. `TOP10` = top 10% of ZIP codes. `TOP10_25` = top 10%-25% of ZIP codes. `TOP25_50` = top 25%-50% of ZIP codes. Supported only for Auction ad objectives, on TikTok placement, in the US.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type=BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User identity.

identity_id.description: Required only when (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=SHOWCASE`) or `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Required only when (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=SHOWCASE`) or `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. Identity type. `AUTH_CODE` = Authorized Post User. `TT_USER` = TikTok Business Account User. `BC_AUTH_TT` = TikTok account that a Business Center is authorized to access; when used, you must also pass `identity_authorized_bc_id`.

included_custom_actions.description: When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type=LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`. Custom actions to use as Include conditions for the retargeted audience.

code.description: Custom action used as an Include condition. `VIEW_PRODUCT` = viewed the product. `ADD_TO_CART` = added the product to cart. `PURCHASE` = purchased the product.

days.description: Time range used to filter audiences that completed the specified action. Value range: [1, 180].

included_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Valid only for Pangle placement. Do not specify alongside `excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`. IDs of Pangle audiences to include; the package's `bind_type` must be `INCLUDE`.

interest_category_ids.description: IDs of general interest categories to target.

interest_keyword_ids.description: IDs of additional interest categories to target.

ios14_targeting.description: Required and must be `IOS14_PLUS` when the campaign-level `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`. iOS devices to target. `UNSET` = devices with iOS 14.4 or earlier (default for most scenarios). `IOS14_MINUS` = devices earlier than iOS 14.0 (not affected by the iOS 14 privacy update). `IOS14_PLUS` = devices with iOS 14.5 or later, used only for Dedicated Campaigns; each iOS 14 campaign can have up to 2 active ad groups. `ALL` = devices with iOS 14.5 or later, used only for iOS App Retargeting ads and iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads with `product_source=CATALOG` and optimization location App. To target iOS 14.5+ in App Retargeting ads, set this to `ALL` and set `min_ios_version` to `14.5` or later. For iOS App Retargeting ads (`app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING` and `promotion_type=APP_IOS`) and for iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `promotion_type=APP_IOS`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is not `OFF`), `ALL` is used regardless of the value you pass. Once set to `IOS14_PLUS`, this field cannot be updated, and the following must hold: at the ad group level, `app_id` is an iOS App ID (the app's `platform=IOS`), `operating_systems=["IOS"]`, `min_ios_version` is passed and consistent with `ios14_targeting`, `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, or `VALUE`, and `min_android_version`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days` are not specified; at the ad level, `deeplink_type` is not `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`.

is_hfss.description: Whether the promoted content is HFSS (High Fat, Salt, Sugar). Set to `true` if your ad promotes or prominently features an HFSS product or brand. In regulated regions, HFSS ads must only target users 18 or older. You can set `true` only when targeted locations include locations in the UK, Australia, New Zealand, or the European Union. Default: `false`.

is_lhf_compliance.description: Whether the promoted content complies with LHF (Less Healthy Foods) regulations. Setting `true` certifies compliance with the 2024 UK LHF Regulations and other applicable laws for food/drink products advertised in the UK. Default: `false`. Starting January 1st, 2026, when targeting UK locations and `is_hfss=true`, this field is required and must be `true`.

isp_ids.description: Valid only when a country- or region-level location is specified via `location_ids`. IDs of Internet service providers to target. When `isp_ids` is passed, you cannot set the placement to Global App Bundle only (`placements=PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`).

languages.description: Codes of the languages to target. To target all languages, omit the field or pass an empty array.

location_ids.description: You must set `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids` or both. Location IDs to target. Maximum 3,000 (the combined total of `location_ids` and `zipcode_ids` cannot exceed 3,000 per ad group). Overlapping locations are not supported (for example, you cannot target the U.S. and California at the same time). If you target US locations on creation, you can later switch to other US locations but you cannot remove all US locations to target only non-US countries.

message_event_set_id.description: Required when all of the following are true: `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, `optimization_goal=CONVERSATION`, and the instant messaging account in your ad group settings does not match an existing message event set. ID of the message event set used in the Instant Messaging Ad Group. If the chosen IM account does match an existing event set (Messenger via `messaging_app_account_id`, or WhatsApp populated from `phone_region_code`/`phone_region_calling_code`/`phone_number`), this field is ignored and auto-populated. Use `/ctm/message_event_set/get/` and check `matched_event_set` to determine if a unique set already exists; if not, the same call's `message_event_set_list` provides the available sets for ad creation. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

messaging_app_account_id.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER` or `LINE`. Ignored when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP`, `ZALO`, or `IM_URL`. ID of the instant messaging app account. When `messaging_app_type=MESSENGER`, pass the Facebook Page ID. When `messaging_app_type=LINE`, pass the LINE Business ID. When `messaging_app_type=WHATSAPP`, this field is ignored and is set automatically from `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

messaging_app_type.description: Valid only when `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`. Required when `optimization_goal=CONVERSATION`; when `optimization_goal=CLICK`, the default is `IM_URL`. Type of instant messaging app or customized URL. `MESSENGER` requires you to also pass a Facebook Page ID via `messaging_app_account_id`. `WHATSAPP` requires you to also pass `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number` (used to populate the WhatsApp number). `ZALO` requires you to also pass `phone_region_code`, `phone_region_calling_code`, and `phone_number` (used to populate the Zalo number). `LINE` requires you to also pass a LINE Business ID via `messaging_app_account_id`. `IM_URL` is for an Instant Messaging URL. When `optimization_goal=CONVERSATION`, you cannot set this field to `ZALO`, `LINE`, or `IM_URL`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

min_android_version.description: Minimum device Android version. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Minimum Android Version enumeration.

min_ios_version.description: Required when `ios14_targeting` is specified. Minimum iOS version. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Minimum iOS Version enumeration.

network_types.description: Device connection types to target. For enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Connection Type enumeration.

next_day_retention.description: Valid only when `placements` is `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` and `secondary_optimization_event=NEXT_DAY_OPEN`. Day 2 retention ratio. Formula: `next_day_retention = conversion_bid_price / deep_cpa_bid`. Value range: (0, 1]. To use this field, pass `conversion_bid_price`, `deep_cpa_bid`, and `next_day_retention` together such that they satisfy the formula; otherwise unexpected errors may occur.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. Required when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, or when `objective_type=TRAFFIC` and `promotion_type` is `APP_IOS` or `APP_ANDROID`.

operation_status.description: Status of the ad group when created. `ENABLE` = enabled at creation. `DISABLE` = disabled at creation. Default: `ENABLE`. To update status after creation, use `/adgroup/status/update/`.

optimization_event.description: Required when `pixel_id` is specified, or when `pixel_id` is not specified and `optimization_goal` is `IN_APP_EVENT` or `VALUE`. Conversion event. For new ad groups created under one CBO campaign, this field should match the first ad group. When `optimization_goal=PAGE_VISIT`, `optimization_event` is automatically set to `PAGE_VISIT`.

optimization_goal.description: The measurable result to drive with your ads. For the full enum list, see the TikTok Marketing API Optimization Goal enumeration; for CBO support, see Campaign Budget Optimization-Supported optimization goals. For each optimization goal, you must specify a corresponding `billing_event`. To use "Install with in-app event" on Pangle and/or Global App Bundle placements, set `optimization_goal=INSTALL`, specify a valid `secondary_optimization_event`, and only include `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` or `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` (or both) in `placements`. When `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, or `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`, the default is `CLICK`. Starting November 30th, 2024, you can no longer create or copy ad groups using `optimization_goal=INSTALL` with a valid `secondary_optimization_event` on TikTok placement or Automatic Placement when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` (existing such ad groups are unaffected; Pangle-only and Global App Bundle-only configurations are not impacted). `VIDEO_VIEW` is removed in v1.3; for `VIDEO_VIEWS` campaigns prefer `ENGAGED_VIEW` or `ENGAGED_VIEW_FIFTEEN`. For new ad groups under one CBO campaign, this field should match the first ad group.

pacing.description: Pacing mode. `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` = budget allocated evenly within the scheduled time. `PACING_MODE_FAST` = consume budget and produce results as soon as possible. When CBO is on at the campaign level, the setting is ignored and `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` is used. Otherwise this field is required.

phone_number.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `ZALO`. WhatsApp or Zalo phone number. For WhatsApp, use the same number connected to the Messagement Management Tool (MMT). Once set, this field cannot be updated.

phone_region_calling_code.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `ZALO`. Region calling code for the WhatsApp or Zalo phone number, for example `+1`. To obtain matching region codes and calling codes, use `/tool/phone_region_code/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

phone_region_code.description: Required when `messaging_app_type` is `WHATSAPP` or `ZALO`. Region code for the WhatsApp or Zalo phone number, for example `US`. To obtain matching region codes and calling codes, use `/tool/phone_region_code/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

pixel_id.description: Required when `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT` or `VALUE`. Not supported when `optimization_goal` is neither `CONVERT` nor `VALUE`. Pixel ID.

placement_type.description: Placement strategy for where ads are shown. `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` = TikTok's ad system selects the best combination of placements. `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` = manual placement selection. Default: `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`. Cannot be updated after creation. When set to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`, the actual supported placements are reflected in the response `placements` (for example, if only TikTok is supported, the response returns `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`).

placements.description: Required when `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`. Ignored and overwritten by the system when `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`. Apps where you want to deliver your ads. Cannot be updated after creation. Currently supports `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`, and `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`; do not select `PLACEMENT_TOPBUZZ` or `PLACEMENT_HELO` (deprecated). Locations available for `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` are: Brazil, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, and Japan; it does not support `optimization_goal=TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`. Using `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` in Auction Reach is allowlist-only. If `objective_type=REACH` at the campaign level and `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`, you cannot also specify `contextual_tag_ids`. If `objective_type=REACH` and `placements=["PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE"]`, you cannot set `brand_safety_type=THIRD_PARTY`. For Product Sales campaigns (`objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`), only `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is supported.

product_source.description: Required for Video Shopping Ads and Product Shopping Ads. Product source. For Video Shopping Ads, the campaign-level `campaign_product_source` constrains allowed values: if campaign is `CATALOG`, this field must be `CATALOG`; if campaign is `STORE`, this field must be `STORE` or `SHOWCASE`. If `campaign_product_source` is unset and the same campaign already contains both a `CATALOG` ad group and a `STORE`/`SHOWCASE` ad group, you cannot create more ad groups under that campaign — ad groups in the same campaign must use either `CATALOG` only, or some combination of `STORE` and `SHOWCASE`. For Product Shopping Ads, set this field to `STORE`.

promotion_target_type.description: Valid when the campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION`. Promotion type for the Lead Generation objective. `INSTANT_PAGE` = TikTok Instant Form (in-app fast-loading form to collect leads). `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE` = Website Form (your landing page or a TikTok Instant Page that redirects to a website with the form). When `promotion_target_type=EXTERNAL_WEBSITE` and `optimization_goal=CLICK`, do not pass `pixel_id` or `optimization_event`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location). Required when the campaign `objective_type` is not `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`. If `objective_type=ENGAGEMENT`, the only supported value is `EXTERNAL_OR_DISPLAY`. For the full list of enum values, see the TikTok Marketing API Promotion Type enumeration.

promotion_website_type.description: TikTok Instant Page type for the ad group. `UNSET` = do not use TikTok Instant Page. `TIKTOK_NATIVE_PAGE` = use TikTok Instant Page; in this case `pixel_id` is not supported and you must specify a TikTok Instant Page through `page_id` at the ad level. Required when `app_promotion_type=APP_PREREGISTRATION` at the campaign level.

purchase_intention_keyword_ids.description: IDs of purchase-intention categories to target. Do not pass `purchase_intention_keyword_ids` and `interest_keyword_ids` simultaneously, otherwise keyword conflict will occur. Supported only for Auction ads with `objective_type` in {`APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `TRAFFIC`} or `PRODUCT_SALES` with `product_source=CATALOG`, and `placements` must include TikTok (`PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`) or Pangle (`PLACEMENT_PANGLE`).

request_id.description: Optional request identifier that allows duplicate `adgroup_name` values and provides 10-second idempotency. To create ad groups with the same `adgroup_name`, send different `request_id` values; retries with the same `request_id` within 10 seconds succeed only once. This is different from the response `request_id`, which uniquely identifies an HTTP request. Must be the string form of a 64-bit integer, for example `123456789`.

roas_bid.description: Required when `deep_bid_type=VO_MIN_ROAS`. ROAS goal for Value Optimization. Value range: in-app advertising scenarios (`objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `optimization_goal=VALUE`, and `optimization_event=AD_REVENUE_VALUE`) 0.01-10; Product Shopping Ads with TikTok Shop product source (`shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`) 0.01-20; other scenarios 0.01-1,000.

saved_audience_id.description: Saved Audience ID. Supported only when all of the following are met at the campaign level: `special_industries` is not specified (no Housing/Employment/Credit category) and `objective_type` is not `PRODUCT_SALES`; and at the ad group level: TikTok placement is selected (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`); and `auto_targeting_enabled` is not `true`. The advertiser ID associated with the Saved Audience must match the ad group's advertiser ID. When using a Saved Audience, do not concurrently set targeting options (such as `gender`) that are already inside the Saved Audience, or an error will occur. If the Saved Audience's device settings conflict with the ad group's (for example, Saved Audience OS is Android but `ios14_targeting=IOS14_PLUS`, or campaign uses an Android `app_id` while the Saved Audience OS is iOS), an error will occur. If `saved_audience_id` was created with `age_groups` specified, the age restriction rules in New age restrictions for ads on TikTok also apply.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type=SCHEDULE_START_END` or `budget_mode=BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`. Schedule end time (UTC+0), in the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. No later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Schedule start time (UTC+0), in the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time and no later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. `SCHEDULE_START_END` requires both a start time and an end time. `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` requires only a start time, and the end time is automatically set to 10 years later. If `budget_mode=BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, `schedule_type` must be `SCHEDULE_START_END`.

search_keywords.description: Required for Search Ads Campaigns (campaign-level `is_search_campaign=true`). Not supported for non-Search Ads Campaigns. List of search keywords used to match ads with user searches. Maximum 1,000 per ad group.

keyword.description: Required when `search_keywords` is passed. The search keyword. Maximum 80 characters. Must exclude emoji and these characters: `!` `#` `$` `%` `&` `(` `)` `*` `-` `/` `:` `;` `<` `>` `?` `@` `\` `^` `_` `¥` `……`. Search keywords must comply with TikTok's Advertising Terms and Community Guidelines: if all keywords are non-compliant, your campaign will not deliver; if some are rejected, you must remove or replace them via `/adgroup/update/`. To check review results, call `/adgroup/get/` and inspect `audit_status` within the `search_keywords` array.

keyword_bid.description: Required and valid only when `keyword_bid_type=CUSTOM`. Ignored when `keyword_bid_type=FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. Bid price for the keyword + match-type combination. Value range: > 0.

keyword_bid_type.description: Bid type for the keyword + match-type combination. `FOLLOW_ADGROUP` = use the ad group level `bid_price` as the keyword bid. `CUSTOM` = customize the bid via `keyword_bid`. Default: `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. `CUSTOM` is valid only when at the campaign level `objective_type=TRAFFIC` and `is_search_campaign=true`, and at the ad group level `bid_type=BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `bid_price` is specified.

match_type.description: Required when `search_keywords` is passed. Match type for the search keyword. `PRECISE_WORD` = exact match. `PHRASE_WORD` = phrase match (same order). `BROAD_WORD` = broad match (any order).

search_result_enabled.description: Whether to include ads in Search Ads (showing ads to users searching for your business on TikTok). If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`), this field is automatically set to `true` (Automatic Search Placement); you may omit it, or pass `true`/`false`. If `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION` with the campaign's `is_search_campaign=true`, this field is automatically set to `false` and cannot be set to `true` (Search Ads Campaign is incompatible with Automatic Search Placement). Otherwise this field is automatically set to `false` and cannot be set to `true`.

secondary_optimization_event.description: Secondary goal when `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` or `VALUE`. For enum values, see Conversion events - Secondary-goal events. When `secondary_optimization_event` is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`. Starting November 30th, 2024, you can no longer create or copy ad groups using `optimization_goal=INSTALL` with `secondary_optimization_event` on TikTok placement or Automatic Placement when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` (existing such ad groups are unaffected; Pangle-only and Global App Bundle-only configurations are not impacted).

share_disabled.description: Whether to disable sharing ads to third-party platforms. Default: `false`. `true` is valid only when the campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`, and at the ad group level either `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `placements=PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`).

shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days.description: Required when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1` or `LAB2`. Time range (in days) for the targeted action. Allowed values: 1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180.

shopping_ads_retargeting_custom_audience.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is set to `LAB1`, `LAB2`, or `LAB3`, and `audience_ids` is passed. Logical relation between the Video Shopping Ads (VSA) retargeting audience (from `shopping_ads_retargeting_type`) and the custom audience (from `audience_ids`). `OR` = union of the two audiences. `AND` = intersection of the two audiences. If unset, the targeted audience defaults to the intersection. Once set, this field cannot be manually updated to a null value.

shopping_ads_retargeting_type.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=CATALOG`. Retargeting type for shopping ads. `LAB1` = users who viewed products or added to cart but did not purchase. `LAB2` = users who added to cart but did not purchase. `LAB3` = users from a custom combination. `OFF` = no retargeting.

shopping_ads_type.description: Required and valid only when the campaign `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`. Shopping ads type. `VIDEO` = Video Shopping Ads. `LIVE` = Live Shopping Ads. `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` = Product Shopping Ads.

smart_audience_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart audience. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

smart_interest_behavior_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart interests & behaviors. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

spending_power.description: Spending power to target. `ALL` = all users. `HIGH` = high-spending users (typically spend more on TikTok ads than average). Not supported when the campaign `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` or `RF_REACH`. Requires Automatic Placement, or Select Placement with TikTok included (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`, or `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`); does not take effect on Pangle. When `auto_targeting_enabled=true`, this is automatically set to `ALL`.

statistic_type.description: Conversion bid statistic type. `EVERYTIME` (Each Purchase) or `NONE` (Unique Purchase). Suitable values for your app event come from `/app/optimization_event/`.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `store_id` is passed. Business Center ID authorized to access the specified `store_id`.

store_id.description: Required when (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=STORE`) or (`shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`); optional when `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`. TikTok Shop ID.

items.description: The subplacements within TikTok for your ads, allowing you to choose where your ads will appear. Enum value: IN_FEED: In-feed. Ads will be placed in the For You feed and might also be placed in Profile Page and Following feeds. SEARCH_FEED: Search feed. TIKTOK_LITE: TikTok Lite, a streamlined version of TikTok that features a smaller app size and faster video loading speed. The TikTok Lite subplacement is currently available for Japan or South Korea as targeting locations. LEMON8: Lemon8, a community app for lifestyle content, focusing on real-life experiences, tips, guides, and product reviews. By including Lemon8 as a subplacement, your ads will appear in its For You feed, Search feed, and Immersive Video feed. Learn more about Lemon8.

vbo_window.description: Time window of the VBO IAA (Value-Based Optimization for in-app advertising) or VBO IAP (in-app purchase) bidding strategy. `SEVEN_DAYS` = first seven days (day 7). `ZERO_DAY` = current day (day 0). Default: `SEVEN_DAYS`. With Minimum ROAS (Target ROAS), this is the window of the target ROAS value (Day 7 vs Day 0); the system aims to keep average ROAS at or above the target. With Highest Value, this is the Highest Value window type (Day 7 vs Day 0); the system aims to fully spend the budget and maximize result value within the window. VBO IAP and VBO IAA in different scenarios are allowlist-only; in particular, Day 0 or Day 7 bidding for VBO IAP and for VBO IAA in Advanced Dedicated Campaign or Android campaign scenarios are allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

vertical_sensitivity_id.description: Valid only when at the campaign level `objective_type` is `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, and at the ad group level `placements=["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]` and `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. Vertical sensitivity category ID.

video_download_disabled.description: Whether to prevent users from downloading video ads on TikTok. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

view_attribution_window.description: View-through attribution window. `OFF`, `ONE_DAY` = 1-day view, `SEVEN_DAYS` = 7-day view. Allowed values vary by advertising objective. To manually configure attribution windows, pass at least `click_attribution_window` and `view_attribution_window` simultaneously. If you omit all four attribution fields, default settings (if any) are used; check via `/adgroup/get/`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

zipcode_ids.description: You must set `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids` or both. Zip code or postal code IDs to target. Maximum 3,000 (combined with `location_ids` not exceeding 3,000 per ad group). Zip code targeting is supported only for the US; postal code targeting is supported for Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Targeting postal code areas in Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam is allowlist-only. Cannot be used in campaigns that have enabled `special_industries`. Cannot be used in campaigns with `objective_type=RF_REACH`. Only TikTok placement is supported (`placements` must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`). Overlapping locations are not supported. If you target US locations on creation, you can later switch to other US locations but you cannot remove all US locations to target only non-US countries.

operations.name: adgroup_create

operations.description: Gets detailed information for one or more ad groups from `/open_api/v1.3/adgroup/get/`. You can limit returned data with `fields` and filter results by campaign ID, objective, ad group ID, ad group name, creation time, billing event, status, and other supported filters. Deleted ad groups are excluded by default; to include them, set `filtering.primary_status` to `STATUS_DELETE` or use `ADGROUP_STATUS_DELETE` / `ADGROUP_STATUS_CAMPAIGN_DELETE` in `filtering.secondary_status`. If `fields` is omitted, all fields are returned. If `filtering` is omitted, all ad groups under the advertiser are returned.

exclude_field_types_in_response.description: Field types to exclude from the response.

fields.description: List of ad group fields to return. If omitted, all available fields are returned by default.

filtering.description: Filter conditions for selecting ad groups. If omitted, all ad groups under the advertiser are returned. Example: `filtering={"campaign_automation_type":"UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS"}`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs.

buying_types.description: Buying types to filter by. Default value: `["AUCTION", "RESERVATION_RF"]`. `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW` cannot be combined with other values; to filter TopView ads, set this field to `["RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW"]`.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs.

campaign_system_origins.description: Origins of the campaigns the ad groups belong to. Default value: `["TT_ADS_PLATFORM"]`. When filtering Promote ad groups (`PROMOTE`), only these fields can be retrieved: `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `campaign_name`, `adgroup_id`, `adgroup_name`, `create_time`, `budget`, `schedule_type`, `schedule_start_time`, `schedule_end_time`, `operation_status`, and `secondary_status`.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Upper bound of ad group creation time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ad groups created earlier than this time. A time range within 6 months is recommended to avoid affecting task speed and success.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Lower bound of ad group creation time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ad groups created later than this time. A time range within 6 months is recommended to avoid affecting task speed and success.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. If you filter by either `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `CONVERSIONS`, the endpoint returns ad groups for both `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `CONVERSIONS`.

primary_status.description: Primary status. Default is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`, which returns all ad groups except `STATUS_DELETE`. To return all statuses including deleted ad groups, use `STATUS_ALL`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location) to filter by. This filter is different from the `promotion_type` used for ad group creation, though both may appear in this endpoint. It is also supported in synchronous basic reports and synchronous DSA reports.

secondary_status.description: Ad group secondary status. This field is not returned in the sandbox environment because ad groups are not actually delivered there. Valid values depend on the `primary_status` you specify.

split_test_enabled.description: Filter by whether split test is enabled for the ad group. `true` returns only ad groups with split test enabled; `false` returns only ad groups with split test disabled. If omitted, all ad groups are returned.

page.description: Current page number. Default: `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default: `10`. Range: `1`-`1000`. If `filtering.buying_types` is `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW`, the maximum allowed value is `100`.

operations.name: adgroup_get

operations.description: Gets the dynamic quota for the number of active auction ad groups an advertiser can have. If the advertiser is subject to a fixed active ad group quota, the response returns `total_adgroup_quota` = 5000 and `used_adgroup_quota` = 0. If the advertiser is being punished, no active ad groups can be created and both quota values are returned as 0. To check whether an advertiser account is being punished, use `/advertiser/info/` and inspect the returned `status`.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID whose active auction ad group quota you want to query.

operations.name: adgroup_quota_get

operations.description: Gets ad group review information, including approval status, rejection reasons, and suggestions so you can fix rejected ad groups before deployment. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` and `adgroup_ids` are strings and `lang` was added. For Smart+ ad groups with partial or complete review failure (`review_status` in `ad_group_review_map` is `PART_AVAILABLE` or `UNAVAILABLE`), the `ad_id` values in `ad_review_map` are not real ad IDs and cannot be used with `/ad/review_info/` to fetch ad-level review details. Instead, treat each `ad_id` as a material in the Smart+ Campaign, inspect `reject_info` from this `/adgroup/review_info/` response, and then update the Smart+ Campaign via `/campaign/spc/update/`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs to query. Maximum 20 ad group IDs per request.

operations.name: adgroup_review_info_get

operations.description: Creates a Reach & Frequency ad group via `/open_api/v1.3/adgroup/rf/create/`. This endpoint is part of the Reach & Frequency workflow and relies on campaign-level setup described in the Reach & Frequency campaign creation flow. Important usage constraints include: `objective_type` at the campaign level affects valid values for fields such as `promotion_type` and `optimization_goal`; TikTok Pulse scenarios depend on `rf_campaign_type` configured in `/campaign/create/`; some features are allowlist-only, including the 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal for TikTok Pulse ad groups, pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions, and contextual-tag targeting features. The page also documents v1.2 to v1.3 changes, including the endpoint path change from `/v1.2/adgroup/rf/create/` to `/v1.3/adgroup/rf/create/`, renamed parameters, and deprecated/new fields.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Must not exceed 100 characters and must not contain emojis.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. If your targeting locations include Israel or Brazil, `AGE_13_17` cannot be used. In some US scenarios, creating ad groups targeting `AGE_13_17` is not allowed. If you use targeting options that are not supported for age 13-17 in the US and omit `age_groups` or set it to `[]`, an error occurs; explicitly specify the exact age groups you want to target, such as `AGE_18_24`, to avoid errors.

app_id.description: ID of the promoted mobile application.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to target. For an audience to be used in Reach & Frequency ads, its `audience_sub_type` must be `REACH_FREQUENCY` when the audience is created or updated. Lookalike Audience cannot be used in Reach & Frequency ads; otherwise, an error occurs.

brand_safety_partner.description: Brand safety partner for Reach & Frequency ads. Required when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`. Pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions are currently allowlist-only features. Once set, this field cannot be modified. `OPEN_SLATE` is named DoubleVerify in TikTok Ads Manager because the partner has been acquired by DoubleVerify.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type for Reach & Frequency ads. Default value: `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. If set to `THIRD_PARTY`, you must also provide `brand_safety_partner`. `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` uses full inventory and ads may appear next to some content featuring mature themes. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` uses TikTok's brand safety solution with most inappropriate content removed and no mature themes; in the next API version, `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` as the default. `STANDARD_INVENTORY` is appropriate for most brands. `LIMITED_INVENTORY` avoids content containing mature themes. `THIRD_PARTY` uses a third-party brand safety solution. Pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions are currently allowlist-only features. To determine countries and regions where ads can be deployed based on brand safety settings, use `/tool/region/`.

budget.description: Budget. Fill this value based on data returned by the ad inventory estimate API.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign this ad group belongs to.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. A carrier is valid only when its `in_use` field is `true`. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted location(s).

category_exclusion_ids.description: Valid only when `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. Content exclusion category IDs.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to prohibit users from commenting on your ads on TikTok. Default value: `False`.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. Not supported when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`. Not supported when `feed_type` is `TOP_FEED`. If `rf_campaign_type` is `PULSE` in `/campaign/create/`, you must include contextual tags from either the `MAX_PULSE` or `CUSTOM` content lineup types under `PREMIUM` when creating an ad group; `GENERAL` contextual tags are optional. Max Pulse and Category Lineups are available only in specified markets and both features are allowlist only. This field itself is also allowlist-only.

cpv_video_duration.description: Required when `optimization_goal` is `VIDEO_VIEW` or when using the 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal. Target video view duration. For TikTok Pulse campaigns where `rf_campaign_type` is `PULSE` in `/campaign/create/`, use `optimization_goal=REACH` and `cpv_video_duration=SIX_SECONDS` for the 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal.

delivery_mode.description: Enum values: STANDARD: Standard delivery. Your ads will be distributed evenly and are expected to achieve similar traffic size. This value is not available for the 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal with optimization_goal as REACH and cpv_video_duration as SIX_SECONDS. SCHEDULE: Scheduled delivery. Set specific time periods to deliver each ad in. If you use this value, you need to pass the object array schedules at the same time. SEQUENCE: Sequenced delivery. Set a specific sequence to deliver your ads in. If you use this value, you need to pass the field expected_orders at the same time. VIEW_OPTIMIZE: View optimized delivery. Your ads are distributed to maximize view-through rate (VTR), with more impressions allocated to ads predicted to achieve higher VTR. This value is only available for the 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal with optimization_goal as REACH and cpv_video_duration as SIX_SECONDS.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Currently only brand-level model IDs are supported. If this field is specified, `device_price_ranges` must not be specified. Only active devices (`is_active` = `True` in the response of `/tool/device_model/`) can be used to create ads.

device_price_ranges.description: Targeting device price range. Values must be multiples of 50; `10000` means `1000+`. If you set this field, do not specify `device_model_ids`. Important: the upper limit you set is increased by 50 and that new number is used as the actual upper limit for device targeting. For example, if you set and later get `[0, 250]`, it actually means `[0, 300]`.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. For an audience to be used in Reach & Frequency ads, its `audience_sub_type` must be `REACH_FREQUENCY` when the audience is created or updated. Lookalike Audience cannot be used in Reach & Frequency ads; otherwise, an error occurs.

feed_type.description: Feed type option. `STANDARD_FEED` provides larger inventory with normal CPM, while `TOP_FEED` provides limited inventory with higher CPM.

frequency.description: `frequency`, together with `frequency_schedule`, controls how often people see your ad and is available only for `REACH` ads. Example: `frequency` = 2 and `frequency_schedule` = 3 means show ads no more than twice every 3 days. Conditions: `1 ≤ frequency ≤ frequency_schedule`; `1 ≤ frequency_schedule ≤ min(schedule_end_time - schedule_start_time, 30)`; and the resulting frequency cap must not exceed four times a day.

frequency_schedule.description: `frequency_schedule`, together with `frequency`, controls how often people see your ad and is available only for `REACH` ads. See `frequency` for the full constraints.

is_hfss.description: Whether the promoted content is HFSS foods (foods high in fat, salt, or sugar). Note that the European market prohibits promoting HFSS foods to underage users.

location_ids.description: IDs of targeted locations. Locations can be country/region, province, DMA/metropolitan, or city level. Reach & Frequency location targeting supports only a single country or region; if you target multiple locations, they must all be from the same country or region. Supported countries and regions for Reach & Frequency are documented separately.

network_types.description: Device connection types to target. Default value: `unlimited`.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Allowed values: `ANDROID`, `IOS`, `PC`.

optimization_event.description: Conversion event for the ad group. Required when the promoted object is an app with tracking URLs. Supported app events depend on the app; use `/app/external_action/` to retrieve the supported events for your app.

optimization_goal.description: Desired measurable result for the ad group. Must align with campaign-level `objective_type`. For TikTok Pulse ad groups where `rf_campaign_type` is `PULSE` in `/campaign/create/`, if you want the 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal, set `optimization_goal` to `REACH` and `cpv_video_duration` to `SIX_SECONDS`. The 6s view-through rate (View+) optimization goal in TikTok Pulse ad groups is currently an allowlist-only feature.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type that determines what you promote. If campaign-level `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, set this field to `WEBSITE_OR_DISPLAY`. Allowed values: `APP_ANDROID`, `APP_IOS`, `WEBSITE`, `WEBSITE_OR_DISPLAY`.

purchased_impression.description: Impressions to purchase, in units of 1,000. Fill this value based on data returned by the ad inventory estimate API.

purchased_reach.description: Purchased user reach, in units of 1,000. Fill this value based on data returned by the ad inventory estimate API.

request_id.description: Client-supplied request ID used to allow duplicate ad group names and support idempotency so the same create request is not processed twice. This is different from the `request_id` returned in the response, which uniquely identifies the HTTP request. Must be a string representation of a 64-bit integer, for example `"123456789"`.

rf_purchased_type.description: Buying type. `FIXED_SHOW` purchases a fixed amount of impressions, `FIXED_REACH` purchases a fixed user reach, and `FIXED_BUDGET` purchases with a fixed budget.

schedule_end_time.description: Schedule end time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The interval between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time` must not exceed 90 days. The value must be at `YYYY-MM-DD HH:59:59` in the ad delivery time zone. For example, if an advertiser in UTC-5 wants delivery to end on November 10, 2023, set this field to `"2023-11-10 04:59:59"`.

schedule_infos.description: Ad delivery information. When `delivery_mode` is `SEQUENCE`, the number of objects in this array represents the number of ads for which you specify sequence.

expected_orders.description: Required when `delivery_mode` is `SEQUENCE`. Delivery order for an ad within the ad group. To set a fixed sequence for an ad, pass a single number such as `[1]`; `[1]` means the ad is delivered first.

schedules.description: Required when `delivery_mode` is `SCHEDULE`. Scheduled delivery windows for the ad. Ensure the schedule is continuous and covers the full delivery period defined by `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`.

end_time.description: Ad delivery end time, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`.

start_time.description: Ad delivery start time, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`.

schedule_start_time.description: Schedule start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The interval between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time` must not exceed 90 days. The value must be at `YYYY-MM-DD HH:00:00` in the ad delivery time zone. For example, if an advertiser in UTC-5 wants delivery to start on November 1, 2023, set this field to `"2023-11-01 05:00:00"`.

share_disabled.description: Whether sharing to third-party platforms is disabled for ads in this ad group. Default value: `False`.

video_download_disabled.description: Whether users can download your video ads on TikTok. Cannot be updated once created. Default value: `false`.

operations.name: adgroup_rf_create

operations.description: Queries estimated daily cost and frequency distribution for Reach & Frequency ad groups via /open_api/v1.3/adgroup/rf/estimated/info/. If an ad group does not have a valid estimate, no corresponding record is returned. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses string values for `advertiser_id` and string arrays for `adgroup_ids`, and returns `adgroup_id` as a string.

adgroup_ids.description: List of Reach & Frequency ad group IDs to query for estimated daily cost and frequency distribution. If an ad group does not have a valid estimate, no record is returned for that ID.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID for the account whose Reach & Frequency ad groups are being queried.

operations.name: adgroup_rf_estimated_info_get

operations.description: Updates a Reach & Frequency ad group via /open_api/v1.3/adgroup/rf/update/. The target ad group must belong to a campaign whose `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the path from /v1.2/adgroup/rf/update/ to /v1.3/adgroup/rf/update/, renames multiple request parameters, changes `advertiser_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `schedule_id` from number to string, deprecates `estimate_key` and `is_draft`, and adds `contextual_tag_ids`, `brand_safety_type`, and `category_exclusion_ids`. Brand safety updates and contextual targeting are allowlist-only features. Related prerequisite and dependency endpoints referenced by the docs include /campaign/create/ for `rf_campaign_type`, /adgroup/get/ for ad group status and schedule checks, /tool/contextual_tag/get/ for contextual tags, /tool/content_exclusion/get/ for content exclusion categories, and /tool/region/ for regions supported by brand safety settings.

adgroup_id.description: ID of the ad group to modify. The campaign it belongs to must have `objective_type` = `RF_REACH`.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Must not exceed 100 characters or contain emojis.

age_groups.description: Audience age ranges. If your targeted locations include Israel or Brazil, `AGE_13_17` cannot be used. In some US scenarios, targeting age 13-17 is not allowed. If you use targeting options that are not supported for US age 13-17 and omit `age_groups` or set it to `[]`, an error will occur; explicitly specify the exact age groups you want, such as `AGE_18_24`, to avoid errors.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to target. For an audience to be targeted or excluded in R&F ads, its `audience_sub_type` must be `REACH_FREQUENCY` when the audience is created or updated. Lookalike Audience cannot be used in R&F ads, or an error will occur.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY`: use TikTok's brand safety solution with expanded inventory; in the next API version, `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` and be the default option. `STANDARD_INVENTORY`: use TikTok's standard inventory. `LIMITED_INVENTORY`: use TikTok's limited inventory. To get countries and regions your ads can run in for a given brand safety setting, use /tool/region/. Updating Brand Safety settings, including `brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id`, is currently allowlist-only.

budget.description: Budget. Fill this value based on data returned by the ad inventory estimate API.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. A carrier is valid only when its `in_use` field is `true`. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted location(s).

category_exclusion_ids.description: Content exclusion category IDs. This field can be updated only if either: (1) the ad group's `schedule_start_time` has not been reached; or (2) `schedule_start_time` has been reached, but the ad group's `operation_status` is `DISABLE` and cost is 0. Use /adgroup/get/ to retrieve `schedule_start_time` and `operation_status`. Use /tool/content_exclusion/get/ to get valid `excluded_category_list` values. Updating Brand Safety settings, including `brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id`, is currently allowlist-only.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to prohibit users from posting comments on your ads on TikTok.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. Use /tool/contextual_tag/get/ to get available tags. This is an allowlist-only feature. Only supported when the campaign-level `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Not supported when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY` or when `feed_type` is `TOP_FEED`. If `rf_campaign_type` is `PULSE` in /campaign/create/, you must provide contextual tags of `PREMIUM` type, and in that case the ad group's CPM is fixed.

delivery_mode.description: Strategy for sequencing and scheduling ad delivery. `STANDARD`: distribute ads evenly for similar traffic size; not available for the 6-second view-through rate (View+) optimization goal when `optimization_goal` is `REACH` and `cpv_video_duration` is `SIX_SECONDS`. `SCHEDULE`: scheduled delivery; if used, you must pass `schedules`. `SEQUENCE`: sequenced delivery; if used, you must pass `expected_orders`. `VIEW_OPTIMIZE`: maximize view-through rate (VTR); only available for the 6-second view-through rate (View+) optimization goal when `optimization_goal` is `REACH` and `cpv_video_duration` is `SIX_SECONDS`. `OPTIMIZE`: optimized delivery for best performance.

device_model_ids.description: IDs of device models to target. Only brand-level model IDs are currently supported. If this field is specified, `device_price_ranges` must not be specified. Only active devices (`is_active` = `True` in /tool/device_model/) can be used.

device_price_ranges.description: Target device price range. `10000` means 1000+. Values must be multiples of 50. The upper limit you set is increased by 50 and that resulting number is used as the actual upper limit for device targeting; for example, if you set and get `[0, 250]`, it actually means `[0, 300]`. Do not specify this field when `device_model_ids` is specified.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. For an audience to be targeted or excluded in R&F ads, its `audience_sub_type` must be `REACH_FREQUENCY` when the audience is created or updated. Lookalike Audience cannot be used in R&F ads, or an error will occur.

feed_type.description: Feed type. `STANDARD_FEED` refers to large inventory with normal CPM pricing. `TOP_FEED` refers to limited inventory with higher CPM pricing.

frequency.description: Together with `frequency_schedule`, controls how often people see your ad. Only available for `REACH` ads. For example, `frequency` = 2 and `frequency_schedule` = 3 means show ads no more than twice every 3 days. Conditions: `1 ≤ frequency ≤ frequency_schedule`; `1 ≤ frequency_schedule ≤ min(schedule_end_time - schedule_start_time, 30)`; and the resulting frequency cap must not exceed four times per day.

frequency_schedule.description: Together with `frequency`, controls how often people see your ad. Only available for `REACH` ads. See `frequency` for constraints and behavior.

interest_category_ids.description: Interest category IDs. If specified, users who do not match the interest targeting are excluded during delivery. Omit this field if you want to target everyone. Use /tool/target_recommend_tags/ to get recommended interest categories based on targeting regions and industries, and /tool/interest_category/ to get the complete list.

is_hfss.description: Whether the promoted content is HFSS food (high in fat, salt, or sugar). In the European market, HFSS foods cannot be promoted to underage users.

location_ids.description: IDs of targeted locations. A location can be at country or region, province, DMA or metropolitan, or city level. Location targeting supports only a single country or region; if you target multiple locations, they must all be from the same country or region. You can find supported countries and regions in Reach & Frequency.

network_types.description: Target device connection types. Default value: `unlimited`.

purchased_impression.description: Impressions to purchase, in units of 1,000. Fill this value based on data returned by the ad inventory estimate API.

purchased_reach.description: Users reached to purchase, in units of 1,000. Fill this value based on inventory estimation results.

rf_purchased_type.description: Buying type. `FIXED_SHOW`: purchase a fixed amount of impressions. `FIXED_REACH`: purchase a fixed number of users reached. `FIXED_BUDGE`: purchase with a fixed budget.

schedule_end_time.description: Schedule end time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The interval between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time` must not exceed 90 days. The value must be at `YYYY-MM-DD HH:59:59` for the time zone where the ad will be delivered; for example, for a UTC-5 advertiser ending delivery on November 10, 2023, set `2023-11-10 04:59:59`.

schedule_infos.description: Ad delivery information. When `delivery_mode` is `SEQUENCE`, the number of objects in this array represents the number of ads for which you specify the sequence.

expected_orders.description: Required when `delivery_mode` is `SEQUENCE`. Delivery order for an ad within the ad group. To set a fixed sequence for each ad, pass a single number such as `[1]`; `[1]` means the ad is delivered first.

schedules.description: Required when `delivery_mode` is `SCHEDULE`. Scheduled delivery details for the ad. The schedule must be continuous and cover the entire delivery period defined by `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`.

end_time.description: Ad delivery end time, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`.

start_time.description: Ad delivery start time, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`.

schedule_start_time.description: Schedule start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The interval between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time` must not exceed 90 days. The value must be at `YYYY-MM-DD HH:00:00` for the time zone where the ad will be delivered; for example, for a UTC-5 advertiser delivering from November 1, 2023, set `2023-11-01 05:00:00`.

share_disabled.description: Whether sharing to third-party platforms is disabled for ads in this ad group.

operations.name: adgroup_rf_update

operations.description: Enables, disables, or deletes ad groups through `/open_api/v1.3/adgroup/status/update/`. Use it to resume delivery, pause delivery, or delete ad groups. Ad groups in Dedicated Campaigns cannot be deleted with this endpoint; delete the campaign instead. The operation status of a deleted ad group, or an ad group in a deleted campaign, cannot be modified. You can check campaign or ad group `operation_status` with `/campaign/get/` or `/adgroup/get/`.

adgroup_ids.description: IDs of the ad groups to operate on. Size range: 1-20.

allow_partial_success.description: Whether to allow partial success when operating on multiple ad groups. Default is `false`. If `true`, some specified ad groups may succeed while ineligible ad groups are filtered out.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the ad groups. `DISABLE` pauses delivery, `ENABLE` resumes delivery, and `DELETE` deletes the ad group. The status of deleted ad groups, or ad groups in deleted campaigns, cannot be modified. `ENABLE` and `DISABLE` are not supported for R&F ad groups.

operations.name: adgroup_status_update

operations.description: Updates an ad group via `POST /open_api/v1.3/adgroup/update/`. Not all ad group settings are editable after creation (for example, placement). This endpoint uses full-replacement update mode, not incremental update: even if you update only one field, you must resubmit all required data fields or you may overwrite existing values. Exceptions explicitly called out by the docs include `share_disabled`, `zipcode_ids`, and `purchase_intention_keyword_ids`, which support incremental updates. If `special_industries` is set at the campaign level, the ad group must still satisfy the targeting requirements for special ad categories. The docs also note feature gating and immutability for specific capabilities, including allowlist-only features such as deep funnel optimization with CRM events, automated keywords in Search Ads Campaigns, contextual targeting, some postal-code targeting markets, and Brand Safety updates.

action_category_ids.description: IDs of video interaction categories, creator interaction categories, hashtags, or hashtag bundles used with the selected behavior targeting. Search or list them with `/targeting/search/` (recommended), `/tool/action_category/`, or `/tool/hashtag/recommend/`; recommendations are also available from `/tool/targeting_category/recommend/`.

action_period.description: Time period to include behaviors from. Supported values are `0`, `7`, and `15`. If `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `0` is used regardless of the value passed. `0` means no definite time frame.

video_user_actions.description: Specific user interactions to target, depending on `action_scene`. If `action_scene=VIDEO_RELATED`, allowed values are `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, `SHARED`. If `action_scene=CREATOR_RELATED`, allowed values are `FOLLOWING`, `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`. If `action_scene=HASHTAG_RELATED`, the allowed value is `VIEW_HASHTAG`.

adgroup_name.description: Ad group name. Maximum length is 512 characters and emoji are not allowed.

age_groups.description: Age groups to target. In some scenarios, targeting `AGE_13_17` in the U.S., Latin America, the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada is not allowed. If you are affected by these restrictions and leave `age_groups` unset or pass `[]` without setting `exclude_age_under_eighteen=true`, the request will fail. In those restricted scenarios, if you would otherwise leave `age_groups` unset or empty, TikTok recommends also setting `exclude_age_under_eighteen=true` to avoid errors.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to include. Use `/dmp/custom_audience/list/` to obtain valid IDs.

audience_rule.description: Audience rules. Valid when `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC` or `APP_PROMOTION`.

audience_type.description: Required and valid only when campaign-level `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING`; not supported otherwise. App retargeting audience type. You must use the same setting as when the ad group was created. Supported value is `NEW_CUSTOM_AUDIENCE`. If you want an empty retargeting custom audience, do not pass `audience_ids` or `excluded_audience_ids`. For a non-empty retargeting custom audience, pass `audience_ids`, `excluded_audience_ids`, or both, but the two lists cannot contain the same IDs.

automated_keywords_enabled.description: Valid only when campaign-level `is_search_campaign` is `true`. Whether to let the system automatically generate keywords after ads are added. Default is `false`. This feature is allowlist-only for Search Ads Campaigns.

bid_price.description: Valid only when `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event` is `CPC`, `CPM`, or `CPV`. Bid price for Cost Cap bidding. When CBO (`budget_optimize_on`) is on, TikTok suggests using the same bid across ad groups in the same campaign. `bid_price` must be lower than both campaign-level and ad-group-level budget.

bid_type.description: Bidding strategy that controls cost management, spending, and delivery. This field cannot be updated when Campaign Budget Optimization (`budget_optimize_on=TRUE`) is enabled.

blocked_pangle_app_ids.description: Pangle app block list IDs. Effective only when Pangle placement is selected. Use the `app_package_id` returned by the Pangle block list endpoint.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Use `/tool/region/` to determine the countries and regions available for the chosen brand safety setting. Updating Brand Safety settings (`brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id`) is allowlist-only. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `PRODUCT_SALES` in Auction ads is also allowlist-only.

budget.description: Advertising budget. Cannot be updated when Campaign Budget Optimization (`budget_optimize_on`) is on. The new budget must be at least 105% of current spend; use reporting endpoints to retrieve the `spend` metric if needed.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. A carrier is valid only when its `in_use` field is `true`, and carriers must be consistent with the targeted locations.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: For catalogs in Business Center, specify the Business Center ID that the catalog belongs to. Starting June 30th, 2024, when `product_source` is `STORE`, this field is ignored on update. If you update an existing ad group where `product_source` is `STORE`, any existing `catalog_authorized_bc_id` will no longer be returned.

category_exclusion_ids.description: Content exclusion category IDs. This field can be updated only if the ad group's `schedule_start_time` has not been reached, or if it has been reached but `operation_status` is `DISABLE` and cost is 0; use `/adgroup/get/` to check those values. Use `/tool/content_exclusion/get/` to retrieve `excluded_category_list`. Updating Brand Safety settings is allowlist-only.

comment_disabled.description: Whether to allow comments on ads in this ad group on TikTok.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. Use `/tool/contextual_tag/get/` to retrieve valid tags. This is an allowlist-only feature. Supported only when campaign `objective_type` is `REACH` or `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and not supported when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`.

conversion_bid_price.description: Valid only when `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `billing_event` is `OCPM`. Target cost per conversion for oCPM. `conversion_bid_price` must be lower than both campaign-level and ad-group-level budget.

dayparting.description: Ad delivery schedule as a 48×7-character string, where each character maps to a 30-minute slot from Monday through Sunday. `1` means deliver and `0` means do not deliver. If omitted, all `0`, or all `1`, delivery is treated as full-time.

deep_bid_type.description: Bidding strategy for in-app events. When `secondary_optimization_event` is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`.

deep_cpa_bid.description: Bid price used after choosing an in-app-event bidding strategy, for example `VO_MIN`.

deep_funnel_event_source.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Event source type for deep funnel optimization. When deep funnel optimization is enabled, you cannot update `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, or `deep_funnel_optimization_event`. `PIXEL` uses a Pixel, `OFFLINE` uses an Offline Event Set, and `CRM` uses a CRM Event Set.

deep_funnel_event_source_id.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Event source ID. If `deep_funnel_event_source` is `PIXEL`, pass a Pixel ID from `/pixel/list/`. If `OFFLINE`, pass an Offline Event Set ID from `/offline/get/`. If `CRM`, pass a CRM Event Set ID from `/crm/list/`. When deep funnel optimization is enabled, you cannot update `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, or `deep_funnel_optimization_event`.
