deep_funnel_optimization_event.description: Required when `deep_funnel_optimization_status` is `ON`. Deep funnel optimization event. Supported values depend on the chosen event source; for Pixels you can also inspect `optimization_event` returned by `/pixel/list/`. Example: `SHOPPING`.

deep_funnel_optimization_status.description: Valid only when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. Controls deep funnel optimization, which optimizes both upper-funnel and deeper-funnel events. If set to `ON`, you must also provide `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, and `deep_funnel_optimization_event`. Default is `OFF`. Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is allowlist-only; Pixel and Offline event sources are generally available.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Use `/tool/device_model/` to retrieve valid IDs and device statuses; only active devices (`is_active=true`) can be used. Do not set this field together with `device_price_ranges`.

device_price_ranges.description: Device price range targeting. Values must be multiples of 50; `10000` means 1000+. Important: the upper limit you set is increased by 50 for the actual applied upper limit shown in Ads Manager. For example, `[0,250]` actually means `[0,300]`.

exclude_age_under_eighteen.description: Whether to exclude users younger than 18. Use only in scenarios where targeting `AGE_13_17` in the U.S., Latin America, the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada is not supported; in other scenarios this field is not supported. Default is `false`. See `age_groups` for the dependency.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. Use `/dmp/custom_audience/list/` to obtain valid IDs.

excluded_custom_actions.description: Custom actions to exclude for filtering shopping-ads retargeting audiences. When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

code.description: Custom action used as an Exclude condition for shopping-ads retargeting.

days.description: Time range used to exclude audiences that did not complete the specified action. Range: 1-180.

excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Pangle audience package IDs to exclude. Valid only for Pangle placement. Obtain `package_id` values from `/pangle_audience_package/get/` with `bind_type=EXCLUDE`. Do not pass this field together with `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`.

frequency.description: Used with `frequency_schedule` to control how often people see the ad. Available only for `REACH` ads. Both must satisfy `1 <= frequency <= 1000` and `1 <= frequency_schedule <= 30`. Example: `frequency=2` and `frequency_schedule=3` means show ads no more than twice every 3 days.

frequency_schedule.description: Used with `frequency` to control ad frequency. Available only for `REACH` ads.

household_income.description: Household income targeting. Not supported in Reach & Frequency ads and works only on TikTok placement in the U.S.

included_custom_actions.description: Custom actions to include for filtering shopping-ads retargeting audiences. When `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB3`, you must pass either `included_custom_actions` or `excluded_custom_actions`.

code.description: Custom action used as an Include condition for shopping-ads retargeting.

days.description: Time range used to include audiences that completed the specified action. Range: 1-180.

included_pangle_audience_package_ids.description: Pangle audience package IDs to include. Valid only for Pangle placement. Obtain `package_id` values from `/pangle_audience_package/get/` with `bind_type=INCLUDE`. Do not pass this field together with `excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`.

interest_category_ids.description: General interest category IDs for audience targeting. Search or list them with `/targeting/search/` (recommended) or `/tool/interest_category/`; get recommendations by industry with `/tool/targeting_category/recommend/`.

interest_keyword_ids.description: Additional interest category IDs for audience targeting. Search them with `/targeting/search/` (recommended) or `/tool/interest_keyword/recommend/`.

ios14_targeting.description: Required and must be `IOS14_PLUS` when campaign-level `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`. iOS targeting mode. `UNSET` targets iOS 14.4 or earlier. `IOS14_MINUS` targets versions earlier than iOS 14.0. `IOS14_PLUS` targets iOS 14.5+ and is supported only for Dedicated Campaigns; once set to `IOS14_PLUS`, this field cannot be updated. `ALL` targets iOS 14.5+ and is supported only for iOS App Retargeting ads and iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads with catalog product source and app optimization. If targeting iOS 14.5+ in App Retargeting ads, set `ios14_targeting=ALL` and `min_ios_version` to `14.5` or later, otherwise the request fails. For iOS App Retargeting ads (`app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING` and `promotion_type=APP_IOS`) and iOS retargeting Video Shopping Ads (`shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `promotion_type=APP_IOS`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is not `OFF`), `ALL` is used regardless of the value passed. In other cases the default is `UNSET`. Once set to `IOS14_PLUS`, these requirements must be met: `app_id` must be an iOS app ID from `/app/list/`, `operating_systems` must be `["IOS"]`, `min_ios_version` must be provided and consistent, `optimization_goal` must be `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, or `VALUE`, `min_android_version`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type`, and `shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days` must not be specified, and at the ad level `deeplink_type` must not be `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`.

is_hfss.description: Whether the promoted content is HFSS (High Fat, Salt, Sugar). If the ad promotes or prominently features an HFSS product or brand, set this to `true`. In regulated regions, HFSS ads must target only users age 18+. You can set this field to `true` when targeting locations include the UK, Australia, New Zealand, or the European Union. This setting can only be updated from `false` to `true`, not the reverse.

is_lhf_compliance.description: Whether the promoted content complies with LHF (Less Healthy Foods) regulations. Setting this to `true` confirms that any food or drink products advertised in the UK comply with the 2024 Less Healthy Foods Regulations and other applicable laws. Starting January 1st, 2026, if targeted locations include the UK and `is_hfss` is `true`, this field is required and must be `true`.

isp_ids.description: Internet service provider IDs to target. Valid only when you also provide a valid country- or region-level `location_ids` value. Use `/tool/targeting/list/` to get ISP IDs for a location. When `isp_ids` is set, `placements` cannot be only `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`.

languages.description: Language codes to target. If omitted or empty, language targeting is not limited. Retrieve valid codes from `/tool/language/`.

location_ids.description: Location IDs to target. You must provide `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. Maximum 3,000 combined IDs across `location_ids`, zip codes, and postal codes per ad group. Use `/tool/targeting/search/` or `/tool/region/` to find valid locations. Overlapping locations are not supported (for example, the U.S. and California together). If the ad group originally targeted U.S. locations via `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you can update to other U.S. locations but cannot remove all U.S. locations and target only non-U.S. countries. If `TIKTOK_LITE` is included in `tiktok_subplacements`, you cannot update the ad group to exclude Japan and South Korea. To remove all location IDs, set `location_ids` to `[]` and simultaneously provide `zipcode_ids`, because targeted locations remain mandatory.

min_ios_version.description: Required when `ios14_targeting` is specified. Minimum iOS version; it must also be consistent with `ios14_targeting` when required.

next_day_retention.description: Day-2 retention ratio. Valid only when `placements` is `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` and `secondary_optimization_event` is `NEXT_DAY_OPEN`. Formula: `next_day_retention = conversion_bid_price / deep_cpa_bid`. Range is `(0,1]`. If you use this field, pass `conversion_bid_price`, `deep_bid_type`, and `next_day_retention` together and make sure the values satisfy the formula, or unexpected errors may occur.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. Required when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, or when campaign `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC` and campaign `promotion_type` is `APP_IOS` or `APP_ANDROID`.

pacing.description: Pacing mode. `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` spreads budget evenly across the schedule; `PACING_MODE_FAST` spends as quickly as possible. When CBO (`budget_optimize_on`) is on, this setting is ignored and becomes `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`; otherwise this field is required.

purchase_intention_keyword_ids.description: Purchase intention category IDs for targeting audiences interested in purchases related to a content category. Use `/targeting/search/` to obtain valid IDs. This field supports incremental updates.

roas_bid.description: Required when `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`. ROAS goal for Value Optimization. Range is `0.01-10` for in-app advertising with `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `optimization_goal=VALUE`, and `optimization_event=AD_REVENUE_VALUE`; `0.01-20` for Product Shopping Ads with `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source=STORE`; otherwise `0.01-1000`.

saved_audience_id.description: Saved Audience ID. Supported only when campaign `special_industries` for Housing, Employment, or Credit is not set, campaign `objective_type` is not `PRODUCT_SALES`, TikTok placement is selected (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`), and `auto_targeting_enabled` is not `true`. Create the Saved Audience first with `/dmp/saved_audience/create/`; its advertiser must match this ad group's `advertiser_id`. Do not pass `saved_audience_id` together with targeting options already contained in that Saved Audience (for example `gender`), or the request will fail. Device settings in the Saved Audience must also be compatible with the ad group; for example, an Android Saved Audience conflicts with `ios14_targeting=IOS14_PLUS`, and an iOS Saved Audience conflicts with Android app promotion setups. If troubleshooting a conflict, use `/dmp/saved_audience/list/` to inspect the Saved Audience. If the Saved Audience was created with `age_groups`, the same age restriction rules still apply here.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. End time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. It cannot be later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is passed. Start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. It can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but not later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`. This field cannot be updated if the ad group's current `schedule_start_time` is earlier than now.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. If `SCHEDULE_START_END`, you must provide both `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`. If `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`, provide only `schedule_start_time` and the end time is automatically set to 10 years later.

search_keywords.description: Valid only in Search Ads Campaigns. List of search keywords used to match ads with user search terms. Maximum 1,000 items per ad group. To verify that the campaign is a Search Ads Campaign, call `/campaign/get/` and check `is_search_campaign`. If search keywords or targeted locations are updated, the keywords will go through review again.

keyword.description: When `search_keywords` is provided, you must include at least one `keyword` with its corresponding `match_type`. Search keyword text. Maximum length is 80 characters. Emoji and these special characters are not allowed: `!` `#` `$` `%` `&` `(` `)` `*` `-` `/` `:` `;` `<` `>` `?` `@` `\\` `^` `_` `¥` `……`. To check keyword review results, call `/adgroup/get/` and inspect `search_keywords[].audit_status`. If all keywords are non-compliant, the campaign will not deliver. If some keywords are rejected, remove or replace them with `/adgroup/update/` and approved keywords can continue delivering.

keyword_bid.description: Required and valid only when `keyword_bid_type` is `CUSTOM`; ignored when `keyword_bid_type` is `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. Bid price for the keyword and match type combination. Must be greater than 0.

keyword_bid_type.description: Bid type for the keyword + match type pair. Default is `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`. If `FOLLOW_ADGROUP`, the keyword uses ad group-level `bid_price`. If `CUSTOM`, you must provide `keyword_bid`. `CUSTOM` is valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC`, campaign `is_search_campaign` is `true`, ad group `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`, and ad group `bid_price` is specified.

match_type.description: When `search_keywords` is provided, you must include at least one `keyword` with its corresponding `match_type`. Match type for the keyword: `PRECISE_WORD` for exact match, `PHRASE_WORD` for phrase match in the same order, or `BROAD_WORD` for broad match.

search_result_enabled.description: Whether to include ads in Search Ads so they can show when users search for your business on TikTok. You can use this field only when: campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS` with `is_search_campaign=false`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`; if `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, `promotion_type` must be `LEAD_GENERATION`; and placement is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` included in `placements`. This field can be used to update the value from `false` to `true` only under those conditions. If `is_search_campaign` is `true`, you cannot update it from `false` to `true`.

secondary_optimization_event.description: Secondary goal when `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` or `VALUE`. When this field is specified, you must also pass `deep_bid_type`.

share_disabled.description: Whether to disable sharing of ads in this ad group to third-party platforms. `true` is valid only when all of these are met: campaign `objective_type` is one of `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`; and placement is either `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` set to `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. This field supports incremental updates.

shopping_ads_retargeting_actions_days.description: Valid time range for the audience action to retarget. Required when `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1` or `LAB2`. Allowed values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `7`, `14`, `30`, `60`, `90`, `180`.

shopping_ads_retargeting_custom_audience.description: Valid only when all are true: `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, `product_source=CATALOG`, `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is `LAB1`, `LAB2`, or `LAB3`, and `audience_ids` is provided. Controls the logical relation between the Video Shopping Ads retargeting audience and the custom audience in `audience_ids`: `OR` combines them, `AND` intersects them. If the custom audience is later removed, this field is automatically reset to null.

shopping_ads_retargeting_type.description: Valid when `shopping_ads_type` is `VIDEO` and `product_source` is `CATALOG`. Shopping ads retargeting type: `LAB1` retargets users who viewed products or added to cart but did not purchase, `LAB2` retargets users who added to cart but did not purchase, `LAB3` uses custom combinations, and `OFF` disables retargeting.

smart_interest_behavior_enabled.description: Whether to enable Smart interests & behaviors.

spending_power.description: Spending power targeting. `HIGH` targets users who typically spend more on TikTok ads than average users. Not supported when campaign `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` or `RF_REACH`. Requires TikTok placement via `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`; if Pangle is also selected, spending power does not take effect on Pangle. When `auto_targeting_enabled=true`, `spending_power` is automatically set to `ALL`.

vertical_sensitivity_id.description: Vertical sensitivity category ID. This field can be updated only if the ad group's `schedule_start_time` has not been reached, or if it has been reached but `operation_status` is `DISABLE` and cost is 0; use `/adgroup/get/` to check those values. Use `/tool/content_exclusion/get/` to retrieve `vertical_sensitivity_list`. Updating Brand Safety settings is allowlist-only.

zipcode_ids.description: Zip code IDs or postal code IDs to target. You must provide `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. Maximum 3,000 combined IDs across `location_ids`, zip codes, and postal codes per ad group. Obtain zip/postal IDs from `/tool/targeting/search/` using `geo_id` where `geo_type=ZIP_CODE`. Supported for U.S. zip codes and for postal codes in Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam; Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam postal-code targeting is allowlist-only. Not supported when campaign `special_industries` is enabled, when campaign `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, or when TikTok placement is not included in `placements`. Overlapping locations are not supported. If the ad group originally targeted U.S. locations via `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you can update to other U.S. locations but cannot remove all U.S. locations and target only non-U.S. countries. To remove all zip/postal IDs, set `zipcode_ids` to `[]` and simultaneously provide `location_ids`. This field supports incremental updates.

operations.name: adgroup_update

operations.description: Gets the balance of ad accounts in a Business Center and, for ad accounts owned by the Business Center in auto-allocation mode, their budget information. Only ad accounts for which the Business Center has administrator permissions are returned. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform payment-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; member access can be configured with /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/. Reservation ad accounts cannot use monthly budget, daily budget, or custom budget for Balance Sharing. Multiple Payment Portfolios for one client is an allowlist-only feature.

fields.description: List of additional response fields to return. Supported values: `budget_remaining`, `budget_frequency_restriction`, `budget_amount_restriction`, `min_transferable_amount`, `max_transferable_amount`, and `balance_info`. If omitted, all standard information is returned by default except `budget_remaining`, `budget_frequency_restriction`, `min_transferable_amount`, `max_transferable_amount`, and `balance_info`. To retrieve these additional fields together with other fields, set `fields` to `["budget_remaining", "budget_frequency_restriction", "budget_amount_restriction", "min_transferable_amount", "max_transferable_amount", "balance_info"]` and set `page_size` to `1`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions.

advertiser_status.description: Filter by ad account display status.

keyword.description: Keyword used to search by ad account name or ad account ID.

payment_portfolio_id.description: Valid only when the multiple Payment Portfolios feature is enabled. Filters results by Payment Portfolio ID. This feature is allowlist-only. If specified, the balance information in the response is for the ad account linked to this `payment_portfolio_id`.

page.description: Page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Page size. Default is `10`. Supported range: `1` to `50`. Set `page_size` to `1` when requesting the additional fields `budget_remaining`, `budget_frequency_restriction`, `budget_amount_restriction`, `min_transferable_amount`, `max_transferable_amount`, and `balance_info` together with other fields.

operations.name: advertiser_balance_get

operations.description: Retrieves details for one or more advertiser ad accounts from `/open_api/v1.3/advertiser/info/`. To add a partner and assign ad accounts to that partner, use `/bc/partner/add/`, set `asset_type` to `ADVERTISER`, and pass advertiser IDs in `asset_ids`. Advertiser IDs can be obtained from `/oauth2/advertiser/get/`.

advertiser_ids.description: List of advertiser IDs to query.

fields.description: List of account fields to return. If omitted, all information is returned by default except `company_name_editable`, `can_use_custom_identity`, and `ads_only_mode`. Supported values: `telephone_number`, `contacter`, `currency`, `cellphone_number`, `timezone`, `advertiser_id`, `role`, `company`, `status`, `description`, `rejection_reason`, `address`, `name`, `language`, `industry`, `license_no`, `email`, `license_url`, `country`, `balance`, `create_time`, `display_timezone`, `owner_bc_id`, `company_name_editable`, `can_use_custom_identity`, and `ads_only_mode`. If you include `company_name_editable`, `can_use_custom_identity`, or `ads_only_mode`, the response will include only that requested special field or fields plus `advertiser_id`; all other requested values are ignored.

operations.name: advertiser_info_get

operations.description: Gets ad account transaction records in a Business Center. Only returns records for ad accounts that the Business Center has administrator rights over. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform payment-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/ to configure or update member access settings.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. You can only get transaction records for ad accounts under a Business Center whose `type` is not `NORMAL`; use /bc/get/ and check `type` in the response.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for transaction records.

end_date.description: Transaction search end date in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD` such as `2020-11-12`. If omitted, defaults to the current day. Must be within one year after `start_date`.

funds_type.description: Fund types to filter by. Allowed values: `FUNDS_TYPE_CASH` (cash), `FUNDS_TYPE_GRANT` (coupon/voucher). If omitted, both fund types are selected by default.

keyword.description: Search keyword for ad account name or ad account ID.

start_date.description: Transaction search start date in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD` such as `2020-10-12`. If omitted, defaults to 90 days ago.

summary_by_account.description: Whether to summarize results by account. `false` means no summary; `true` means summary. Default is `false`.

transfer_type.description: Billing type. Accepted values: `TRANS_TYPE_TRANSFER` (transfer), `TRANS_TYPE_TAX` (tax), `TRANS_TYPE_COST` (consumption), `TRANS_TYPE_PAYMENT` (payment). Default is `TRANS_TYPE_TRANSFER`. When `transfer_type` is `TRANS_TYPE_TAX` or `TRANS_TYPE_COST`, `funds_type` in the response will be `null` because those billing types do not involve fund type settings.

page.description: Page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `10`. Allowed range: 1 to 50.

operations.name: advertiser_transaction_get

operations.description: Updates ad accounts created in Business Centers via /open_api/v1.3/advertiser/update/. You can update non-budget settings for a single ad account by passing `advertiser_id`, or update budget settings for one or more ad accounts owned by a Business Center in auto-allocation mode by passing `bc_id`. Incremental budget updates are supported. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center; for budget updates and budget-consumption resets, the caller must have Finance Manager permission (`finance_role` = `MANAGER`). Idempotency for incremental budget updates using `request_id` is currently an allowlist-only feature. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the endpoint path to `/v1.3/advertiser/update/`, changes `advertiser_id` from number to string, renames `need_submit_task` to `need_submit_certificate`, and adds `budget_update_type` and `request_id`.

address.description: Business address shown on receipts. Length: 1-1,024 characters.

advertiser_budgets.description: Required when `bc_id` is passed. Budget settings for one or more ad accounts. Maximum size: 50 when `budget_update_type` is `UPDATE` or `RESET`; 1 when `budget_update_type` is `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE` or `ONE_CLICK_SET`. Each ad account's monthly, daily, and custom budget can be updated up to 20 times per calendar day.

advertiser_id.description: Required when `advertiser_budgets` is passed. Ad account ID. The ad account must belong to the specified `bc_id`.

budget.description: Required when `budget_mode` is `MONTHLY_BUDGET`, `DAILY_BUDGET`, or `CUSTOM_BUDGET`. When `budget_update_type` is `UPDATE` or `RESET`, this is the ad account budget amount with up to two decimal places: it is ignored if `budget_mode=UNLIMITED`, and otherwise represents the monthly, daily, or one-time custom budget based on `budget_mode`. When `budget_update_type` is `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE`, this is the budget change amount: use a positive number such as `100` to add budget and a negative number such as `-10` to deduct budget. When `budget_update_type` is `ONE_CLICK_SET`, this field is ignored. If `budget_mode` is `MONTHLY_BUDGET`, `DAILY_BUDGET`, or `CUSTOM_BUDGET`, the value must be at least 105% of the corresponding monthly, daily, or one-time spend.

budget_mode.description: Budget mode of the ad account. Valid only when `budget_update_type` is `UPDATE`, `RESET`, or `ONE_CLICK_SET`; not supported when `budget_update_type` is `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE`. Enum values: `UNLIMITED` means no account budget limit; `MONTHLY_BUDGET` consumes BC credit balance within a monthly budget; `DAILY_BUDGET` consumes BC credit balance within a daily budget; `CUSTOM_BUDGET` consumes BC credit balance within a one-time custom budget. Default when `budget_update_type` is `UPDATE`: `MONTHLY_BUDGET`. When `budget_update_type=RESET`, only accounts with `budget_mode=CUSTOM_BUDGET` can be reset, but if `budget_mode` is passed in the request it will be ignored. Reservation ad accounts cannot use `MONTHLY_BUDGET`, `DAILY_BUDGET`, or `CUSTOM_BUDGET` for Balance Sharing. If you do not customize the budget mode, the default mode for each ad account is `UNLIMITED`.

advertiser_id.description: Either `advertiser_id` or `bc_id` must be set. Use `advertiser_id` to update non-budget settings for a single ad account. Do not use this top-level field for budget updates of one or more accounts; for those, pass `bc_id` and provide each account's `advertiser_id` inside `advertiser_budgets`. Ad account ID.

bc_id.description: Either `advertiser_id` or `bc_id` must be set. Use `bc_id` to update the budget for one or more ad accounts. Only ad accounts under the specified `bc_id` can be updated. Only users with Finance Manager permission (`finance_role` is `MANAGER`) can update account budgets and reset budget consumption.

budget_update_type.description: Type of budget change. Valid only when `bc_id` is passed and not supported when top-level `advertiser_id` is passed. Enum values: `UPDATE` updates budget mode and budget amount; when set to `UPDATE`, provide `advertiser_id` in each `advertiser_budgets` item, provide `budget`, and optionally `budget_mode`. `RESET` resets budget consumption to 0; only ad accounts with `budget_mode=CUSTOM_BUDGET` can be reset, and when set to `RESET`, only `advertiser_id` inside `advertiser_budgets` is required while `budget_mode` and `budget`, if passed, are ignored. `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE` adds to or deducts from the current ad account budget; when used, `request_id` is valid and should be passed for idempotency, and `budget_mode` in `advertiser_budgets` is not supported. `ONE_CLICK_SET` sets the ad account budget to the minimum amount; you do not need to specify `budget` in `advertiser_budgets`. Default: `UPDATE`. `UPDATE` and `RESET` are supported only for Auction ad accounts.

company.description: Company name. Before updating this field, call `/advertiser/info/` with `fields` set to `["company_name_editable"]`. If `company_name_editable` is `true`, you can update the company name through this field; if `false`, you must contact your TikTok representative. If you update this field, set `need_submit_certificate=true` to submit the new certificate information for review.

license_image_id.description: Image ID (`image_id`) of the business license. If you update this field, set `need_submit_certificate=true` to submit the new certificate information for review.

license_no.description: Business license number. Supported only for ad accounts registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Brazil, or Mexico. If you update this field, set `need_submit_certificate=true` to submit the new certificate information for review.

need_submit_certificate.description: Whether to submit updated certificate images/information for review. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Set this field to `true` only when you update any of these fields: `company`, `promotion_link`, `license_no`, `license_image_id`, or `qualification_images`. If none of those fields change, omit this parameter to avoid re-triggering the certificate review process.

promotion_link.description: Promotion link. Maximum length: 255 characters. If you update this field, set `need_submit_certificate=true` to submit the new certificate information for review.

qualification_images.description: Additional business certificates. If you update this field, set `need_submit_certificate=true` to submit the new certificate information for review.

image_id.description: Image ID of the business certificate.

request_id.description: Valid only when `budget_update_type` is `INCREMENTAL_UPDATE`. Client-supplied idempotency key used to prevent submitting the same incremental budget update twice; if you retry with the same request ID, only one request will succeed. This is different from the response `request_id`, which identifies the HTTP request. The value should be a 32-bit string, and idempotency is guaranteed for a 30-minute window. This is an allowlist-only feature for incremental ad account budget updates.

tax_map.description: Billing and invoicing tax numbers. The accepted keys depend on country; for example, France uses `vat` and Brazil uses `tax_id`.

operations.name: advertiser_update

operations.description: Lists all TikTok ad accounts (advertisers) the current access token is authorized to manage, returning each account's advertiser_id and name. Call this first (no parameters needed) whenever you need an advertiser_id but the user hasn't provided one.
operations.name: auth_advertiser_get

operations.description: Creates a mobile app in Events API at `/v1.3/app/create/`. The created app can be used to create ads. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. This page also notes v1.2 to v1.3 changes: endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/app/create/` to `/v1.3/app/create/`, request parameter `partner_id` was renamed to `partner`, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and response `app_id` changed from number to string.

partner.description: Third-party tracking partner. If `partner` is `Adjust`, `tracking_url` is required. `tracking_url` is also required when SAN (Self-Attributing Network) is not enabled for the selected partner. Allowed values: `AdBrix`, `Adjust`, `AppLink`, `AppsFlyer`, `DoubleClick`, `FlashTalking`, `Kochava`, `Other`, `ServingsSys`, `Singular`, `Tenjin`, `TlnkIo`.

tracking_url.description: Third-party tracking partner monitoring links. Required only if `partner` is `Adjust`, or if SAN (Self-Attributing Network) is not enabled for the selected `partner`.

click_url.description: Click monitoring link provided by your monitoring partner.

impression_url.description: Default impression monitoring link generated by your monitoring partner.

operations.name: app_create

operations.description: Retrieves details for an app in Events API. Endpoint: /v1.3/app/info/. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms (https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id` and `app_id` request types from number to string, changes response field `is_skan_allowed` to `skan_allowed`, changes related ID response types from number to string, and adds `self_attribution_enabled` and `advanced_dedicated_campaign_allowed` in the response.

app_id.description: App ID.

operations.name: app_info_get

operations.description: Returns the list of apps under the specified advertiser account from `/open_api/v1.3/app/list/`. You can optionally filter the result by app platform IDs. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms at https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. This page also notes v1.2 to v1.3 changes: the endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/app/list/` to `/v1.3/app/list/`, request parameter types for `advertiser_id` and `app_platform_ids` changed from number to string, and the response renamed `is_skan_allowed` to `skan_allowed` and added `self_attribution_enabled` and `advanced_dedicated_campaign_allowed`.

app_platform_ids.description: Optional list of app platform IDs used to filter the returned apps.

operations.name: app_list_get

operations.description: Gets app optimization/conversion event information for an app via `/v1.3/app/optimization_event/`. This endpoint returns the available app conversion events based on the advertiser, app, objective, optimization goal, placement settings, and SKAN usage. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms (https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. This page also notes the v1.2 to v1.3 migration: the path changed from `/v1.2/app/external_action/` to `/v1.3/app/optimization_event/`, `is_dedicated` became `is_skan`, `optimize_goal` became `optimization_goal`, and `advertiser_id` and `app_id` changed from number to string.

app_id.description: Your App ID, obtained after successfully creating your app.

app_promotion_type.description: App promotion type. Required when `objective` is `APP_PROMOTION`. `APP_INSTALL` can be used in an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign, while `APP_RETARGETING` cannot be used.

available_only.description: Whether to return only available conversion events. Defaults to `true`, which returns only available conversion events.

is_skan.description: Whether the app is using SKAN features.

objective.description: Advertising objective. Required with `app_promotion_type` when `objective` is `APP_PROMOTION`.

placement.description: Apps where you want to deliver ads. Required when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, and ignored when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`. Currently supported values include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`, and `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`. Do not use `PLACEMENT_TOPBUZZ` or `PLACEMENT_HELO`, because they are deprecated. For Product Sales campaigns (`objective_type` = `PRODUCT_SALES`), only `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is supported.

placement_type.description: Placement strategy that decides where ads are shown. `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` means automatic placement. `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` means select placement manually and requires `placement`. Defaults to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`.

operations.name: app_optimization_event_get

operations.description: Retrieves app retargeting optimization events for a specified app. The returned events can be used to define Audience Rules; see https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739566532187138. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms at https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. Version note: v1.2 used /v1.2/app/external_action/retargeting/, while v1.3 uses /v1.3/app/optimization_event/retargeting/. In v1.3, both advertiser_id and app_id are strings, and the response field name changed from external_actions to optimization_events.

app_id.description: App ID for the app whose retargeting optimization events you want to retrieve. Obtain this ID after successfully creating your app.

operations.name: app_optimization_event_retargeting_get

operations.description: Updates a mobile app in Events API. You can modify app details such as download links and third-party tracking links. In v1.3, use `/open_api/v1.3/app/update/`; `partner` replaces `partner_id`, and both `advertiser_id` and `app_id` are strings in v1.3. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms at https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok.

app_id.description: Application ID.

download_url.description: Application download link. When updating `download_url`, you must also provide `platform`.

enable_retargeting.description: Whether to enable retargeting attribution. Note: currently, regardless of the value specified, this setting does not take effect for the app through this API. To enable retargeting attribution for your app, use Events Manager.

partner.description: Third-party tracking partner for the app. If the app's `partner` is `Adjust`, `tracking_url` is required. `tracking_url` is also required when SAN (Self-Attributing Network) is not enabled on the app's partner.

tracking_url.description: Third-party tracking partner monitoring links. Required when `partner` is `Adjust`, or when SAN (Self-Attributing Network) is not enabled on the app's `partner`.

click_url.description: Click monitoring link provided by your monitoring partner.

impression_url.description: Display impression monitoring link generated by your monitoring partner.

operations.name: app_update

operations.description: Gets potential audience insight details for an advertiser from /open_api/v1.3/audience/insight/info/. You must send either `locations` or `custom_audience_id`. If `custom_audience_id` is provided, `selected_audience` and `locations` cannot be used. Use `dimensions` to choose which audience insight dimension to return; currently only one dimension can be requested per API call.

custom_audience_id.description: Pass either `locations` or `custom_audience_id`. When `custom_audience_id` is specified, `selected_audience` and `locations` cannot be used, or the request fails. The custom audience ID must belong to the specified advertiser.

dimensions.description: Controls which response dimension is returned. Currently only one dimension can be specified per API call.

locations.description: Pass either `locations` or `custom_audience_id`. When `locations` is specified, `custom_audience_id` cannot be used, or the request fails. Maximum 5 items.

location_ids.description: Location IDs for a `locations` entry. If omitted, all location IDs under the specified `country_code` are selected by default. Every ID must belong to the specified country code.

selected_audience.description: Audience filters to analyze. Do not use this field when `custom_audience_id` is specified.

creator_action_category_ids.description: Creator action category IDs to target. In `/tool/action_category/`, use categories where `action_scene` = `CREATOR_RELATED`. In `/tool/targeting_category/recommend/`, use categories where `scene` = `CREATOR_RELATED`.

device_price_ranges.description: Target device price ranges. Values must be multiples of 50. `10000` means 1000+.

gender.description: Genders to target. If omitted, both male and female are targeted by default.

min_android_version.description: Minimum Android version to target. If `min_ios_version` or `min_android_version` is specified, `operating_systems` is required.

min_ios_version.description: Minimum iOS version to target. If `min_ios_version` or `min_android_version` is specified, `operating_systems` is required.

operating_systems.description: Required if `min_ios_version` or `min_android_version` is specified. Specifies device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed. If omitted, both Android and iOS are targeted by default.

top_regions_country_code.description: Required when `dimensions` includes `top_regions` and `locations` is specified. In that case, the response returns sub-regions within the country specified in `locations`.

video_action_category_ids.description: Video action category IDs to target. In `/tool/action_category/`, use categories where `action_scene` = `VIDEO_RELATED`. In `/tool/targeting_category/recommend/`, use categories where `scene` = `VIDEO_RELATED`.

benchmark_custom_audience_id.description: ID of the Custom Audience used as the benchmark audience. This audience must be accessible by the specified `advertiser_id`, or an error will occur.

comparison_custom_audience_ids.description: IDs of the Custom Audiences to compare against the benchmark audience. Maximum 4 items. Each audience ID must be accessible by the specified `advertiser_id`, or an error will occur.

operations.description: Creates or deletes an audience segment through the Streaming API endpoint `/open_api/v1.3/segment/audience/`. Access is allowlist-only: to apply for Streaming API access (formerly Segment API), use the Allowlist Management feature in the Developer Portal and select "Streaming API". Rate limit is 1 QPS per advertiser account. You can have up to 400 audience segments per advertiser account; if this advertiser-level limit is reached, delete existing audiences before creating new ones. Before using this endpoint, review the Streaming API important notes for Multiple Advertisers Associated with a Business Account and Mixed Segments with IDFA/AAID, and follow the identifier normalization guidance at https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1850030360880129.

action.description: Action to perform. `create` creates an audience segment and requires `custom_audience_name`. `delete` deletes an audience segment and requires `delete_audience_id`. If omitted, the default is `create`.

custom_audience_name.description: Name of the audience segment to create. Required when `action` is `create`. Names longer than 70 characters are truncated to 67 characters and appended with `...`.

delete_audience_id.description: Audience ID of the segment to delete. Required when `action` is `delete`.

operations.name: audience_segment_operate

operations.description: Applies a custom audience to, or disconnects a custom audience from, multiple ad groups. This endpoint operates on ad groups under a single advertiser account. When applying an audience, you must also specify whether the audience should be included or excluded. Lookalike Audiences cannot be used with Reach & Frequency ads: an error occurs if `custom_audience_id` is a Lookalike Audience and any `adgroup_ids` are Reach & Frequency ad groups, or if `custom_audience_id` is a Lookalike Audience with the `REACH_FREQUENCY` audience subtype.

action_mode.description: Operation to perform on the audience. `Apply` applies the audience to the specified ad groups and requires `usage_mode` to specify whether the audience is included or excluded. `Disconnect` removes the audience from the specified ad groups and does not require `usage_mode`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs to which the audience will be applied or from which it will be disconnected. `adgroup_ids` and `custom_audience_id` must belong to the same advertiser account, or an error occurs. Lookalike Audiences cannot be used in Reach & Frequency ads: an error occurs if `custom_audience_id` is a Lookalike Audience and any listed ad groups are Reach & Frequency ad groups, or if `custom_audience_id` is a Lookalike Audience with the `REACH_FREQUENCY` audience subtype.

custom_audience_id.description: Custom audience ID to apply or disconnect. Only one custom audience ID can be passed.

usage_mode.description: Whether to include or exclude the audience in the specified ad groups. Required when `action_mode` is `Apply`.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_apply

operations.description: Gets the latest application log for custom audiences from /dmp/custom_audience/apply/log/. This endpoint returns only logs for apply operations (`action_mode` = `Apply`).

custom_audience_ids.description: List of custom audience IDs. The advertiser must be the owner of all `custom_audience_ids`; otherwise, an error occurs. Use the `is_creator` field returned by `/dmp/custom_audience/list/` or `/dmp/custom_audience/get/` to verify ownership.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

timezone.description: Timezone for returned time values. If omitted, UTC is used.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_apply_log_get

operations.description: Creates a custom audience from previously uploaded audience file data. You must first upload one or more files and obtain globally unique `file_path` values, then pass those paths to this endpoint. You can create up to 400 audiences per advertiser account; if the limit is reached, existing audiences must be deleted before creating new ones. Newly created audiences can take up to 48 hours to be analyzed and become active. Use the Get audience details endpoint to check audience status; only available audiences (`is_valid = true`) can be operated on. When an audience expires, it becomes unavailable (`is_valid = false`) and is detached from any active campaign. If a campaign has no targeting settings other than audience targeting, it will be paused. If you pass an incorrect `file_path` during creation, it can be modified later through `/dmp/custom_audience/update/`.

audience_sub_type.description: Audience subtype indicating which ad types can use the audience. `NORMAL` can be used in non-R&F ads. `REACH_FREQUENCY` can only be used in R&F ads. Defaults to `NORMAL` if omitted.

calculate_type.description: Encryption type for the uploaded audience data. This value must match the encryption type used by all files in `file_paths`; otherwise, audience creation can fail or return an invalid audience ID. For allowed enum values, see the Encryption Type enumeration.

file_paths.description: List of uploaded audience file paths. Recommended list size is less than 50 for request stability. Each value must be a `file_path` returned by the Upload audience files endpoint. To append more data files after creation, use `/dmp/custom_audience/update/`.

retention_in_days.description: Number of days to retain the audience. Range: 1 to 365. If provided, the audience expires the specified number of days after creation, and later operations cannot reset the expiration date. If omitted, the expiration date is 365 days from the last time the audience was applied to an active ad group or modified; applying the audience to an active ad group or modifying the audience resets the expiration date.

operations.description: Deletes audiences using /v1.3/dmp/custom_audience/delete/. Compared with v1.2, request parameter data types changed: `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and `custom_audience_ids` changed from number[] to string[].

custom_audience_ids.description: List of audience IDs to delete. You must provide 1 to 100 audience IDs.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_delete

operations.description: Gets details for specified audiences, including current status and modification history. Returns details for both owned and shared audiences; use `is_creator` to determine whether the requesting advertiser owns the audience. You can query up to 100 audiences per request.

custom_audience_ids.description: List of audience IDs to retrieve. Length must be 1 to 100.

history_size.description: Number of audience history records to return for each audience.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_get

operations.description: Gets all audiences for an advertiser, including both owned and shared audiences. Results are paginated, with a maximum page size of 100, and each audience includes basic metadata such as ID, name, type, creation time, and expiration time. Use `is_creator` to determine whether the advertiser owns a returned audience. For more detailed audience information such as current status and modification record, use `/dmp/custom_audience/get/` instead. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, `custom_audience_ids` was added, and response fields were updated including `type` to `audience_type` and `audience_id` to string.

custom_audience_ids.description: List of audience IDs to filter by. Length range: 1-100.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `10`. Valid range: 1-100.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_list_get

operations.description: Creates a lookalike audience for an advertiser using an existing audience under the same advertiser account as the seed audience. Newly created audiences can take up to 48 hours to be analyzed and processed before becoming active. Use /dmp/custom_audience/get/ to check audience status; only audiences with `is_valid` can be operated on. In v1.3, `mobile_os` replaces `system`, `advertiser_id` and `source_audience_id` are strings, `placements` is `string[]`, and `include_source` is boolean.

lookalike_spec.description: Settings for generating the lookalike audience from a seed audience, including the source audience, whether to include the source, device OS, placements, target locations, and audience size.

include_source.description: Whether to include the source audience in the new lookalike audience.

location_ids.description: Location IDs to target for the lookalike audience.

mobile_os.description: Device operating system to use for the lookalike audience. `ALL` covers both `ANDROID` and `IOS`.

placements.description: Apps where you want to deliver ads for this lookalike audience. Supported values include `TikTok`, `TopBuzz & BuzzVideo`, and `Pangle`.

source_audience_id.description: Source (seed) audience ID. The source audience must be an existing audience under the advertiser account, cannot be an existing lookalike audience, and should contain at least 100 users.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_lookalike_create

operations.description: Manually refreshes one or more Lookalike Audiences for the specified advertiser.

custom_audience_ids.description: List of custom audience IDs for the Lookalike Audiences to refresh.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_lookalike_update

operations.description: Creates a custom audience from rule-based inclusion criteria and optional exclusion criteria. Newly created audiences can take up to 48 hours to be analyzed before becoming active. Use /dmp/custom_audience/get/ to check audience status; only available audiences (`is_valid` = `true`) can be operated on. When an audience expires, it becomes unavailable (`is_valid` = `false`) and is detached from active campaigns. If a campaign has no targeting other than audience targeting, the campaign will be paused.

audience_sub_type.description: Audience subtype indicating which ad type can use the audience. `NORMAL` is for non-Reach & Frequency ads. `REACH_FREQUENCY` can only be used in Reach & Frequency ads. Defaults to `NORMAL`.

audience_type.description: Audience type. Determines valid rule inputs such as `event_source_ids`, identity fields, and filter values. `ENGAGEMENT`: engagement audience using ad groups as assets. `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO`: organic engagement audience using public videos; requires `identity_id` and `identity_type`. `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO`: live engagement audience using live videos; requires `identity_id` and `identity_type`. `APP`: app activity audience. `PIXEL`: website traffic audience. `LEAD_GENERATION`: lead generation audience; do not pass `event_source_ids` in rules or an error occurs. `BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`: business account audience. `TIKTOK_SHOP`: shop activity audience. `OFFLINE`: offline activity audience.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Business Center ID associated with a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity. Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. Required when `audience_type` is `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO` or `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO`.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Required when `audience_type` is `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO` or `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO`. If `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, you must also provide `identity_authorized_bc_id`.

is_auto_refresh.description: Whether to enable auto-refresh. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Defaults to `true`. When enabled, the audience automatically refreshes based on the lookback window you set; when disabled, it does not automatically refresh.

retention_in_days.description: Number of days to retain the audience. Range: 1-365. If set, the audience expires this many days after creation and later operations cannot reset the expiration date. If omitted, expiration is 365 days from the last time the audience was applied to an active ad group or modified; applying it to an active ad group or modifying it resets expiration.

rule_spec.description: Audience rule definition, containing a required inclusion rule set and an optional exclusion rule set.

exclusion_rule_set.description: Optional exclusion rules used to remove matching people from the audience.

operator.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Operator between exclusion rules. Only `OR` is supported.

rules.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. List of exclusion rules.

event_source_ids.description: List of event source IDs for the rule. Behavior depends on `audience_type`: `ENGAGEMENT` uses ad group IDs; if omitted, all available event source IDs are used. `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO` uses TikTok post IDs from /identity/video/get/; maximum 10 IDs. `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO` uses live video IDs from /identity/live/get/; maximum 10 IDs. `APP` uses app IDs. `PIXEL` uses pixel IDs. `LEAD_GENERATION` must not include this field or an error occurs; if omitted, all available event source IDs are used. `BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` uses advertiser core user IDs from /user/info/. `TIKTOK_SHOP` uses TikTok Shop IDs from /store/list/. `OFFLINE` uses offline event set IDs from /offline/get/.

filter_set.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Filter set for the exclusion rule.

filters.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Array of action filters and optional parameter filters. Maximum size: 1.

field.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Filter field. Only `EVENT` is supported, which excludes people who performed the specified action within `retention_days`.

operator.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Operator between filter field and value. Only `EQ` is supported.

parameter_filters.description: Optional filters on URL keywords or web event parameters. You can include at most one URL keyword filter (`field` = `URL`) and up to 10 parameter filters where `field` is not `URL`. If provided, these `parameter_filters` are combined with the main action filter (`field`, `operator`, `value`) using AND logic to form the exclusion rule.

field.description: Filter condition. Required when `parameter_filters` in `exclusion_rule_set` is provided. Use `URL` to filter URL keywords, or use Pixel web event parameter fields `CONTENT_TYPE`, `PRICE`, `VALUE`, `CONTENT_ID`, or `CONTENT_CATEGORY` to filter reported web event parameters.

operator.description: Operator between the parameter filter field and its values. Required when `parameter_filters` in `exclusion_rule_set` is provided. If `field` is `URL`, allowed operators are `CONTAINS`, `DOES_NOT_CONTAIN`, and `EQ`. If `field` is not `URL`, allowed operators are `CONTAINS`, `DOES_NOT_CONTAINS`, `EQ`, `IS_LESS_THAN`, `IS_GREATER_THAN`, `IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`, and `IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`.

values.description: Required when `parameter_filters` in `exclusion_rule_set` is provided. List of filter values. Maximum 10 values. Each value can be up to 100 characters. If you specify multiple values, they are combined with OR logic.

value.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Filter value representing the audience action/event.

operator.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Operator between objects in `filters`. Only `OR` is supported. Within each exclusion rule, you can specify only one object in `filters`.

retention_days.description: Required when `exclusion_rule_set` is passed. Audience lookback window for the exclusion rule. If `audience_type` is `BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` and `filter_set.filters[].value` is not `BUSINESS ACCOUNT PROFILE FOLLOW`, `retention_days` must be `7`, `14`, or `30`. If `audience_type` is `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO` or `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO`, `retention_days` must be `7`, `14`, or `30`. Note: to avoid confusion with `retention_in_days`, this field will be renamed in a future API version.

inclusion_rule_set.description: Inclusion rules used to build the audience.

operator.description: Operator between inclusion rules. Only `OR` is supported. If you provide multiple inclusion rules, they are combined with OR logic to broaden the audience.

event_source_ids.description: List of event source IDs for the rule. Required when `audience_type` is not `ENGAGEMENT` or `LEAD_GENERATION`. Behavior depends on `audience_type`: `ENGAGEMENT` uses ad group IDs; if omitted, all available event source IDs are used. `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO` uses TikTok post IDs from /identity/video/get/; maximum 10 IDs. `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO` uses live video IDs from /identity/live/get/; maximum 10 IDs. `APP` uses app IDs. `PIXEL` uses pixel IDs. `LEAD_GENERATION` must not include this field or an error occurs; if omitted, all available event source IDs are used. `BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` uses advertiser core user IDs from /user/info/. `TIKTOK_SHOP` uses TikTok Shop IDs from /store/list/. `OFFLINE` uses offline event set IDs from /offline/get/.

filter_set.description: Filter set for the inclusion rule.

filters.description: Array of action filters and optional parameter filters. Maximum size: 1.

field.description: Filter field. Only `EVENT` is supported, which includes people who performed the specified action within `retention_days`.

operator.description: Operator between filter field and value. Only `EQ` is supported.

parameter_filters.description: Optional filters on URL keywords or web event parameters. You can include at most one URL keyword filter (`field` = `URL`) and up to 10 parameter filters where `field` is not `URL`. If provided, these `parameter_filters` are combined with the main action filter (`field`, `operator`, `value`) using AND logic to form the inclusion rule.

field.description: Filter condition. Required when `parameter_filters` in `inclusion_rule_set` is provided. Use `URL` to filter URL keywords, or use Pixel web event parameter fields `CONTENT_TYPE`, `PRICE`, `VALUE`, `CONTENT_ID`, or `CONTENT_CATEGORY` to filter reported web event parameters.

operator.description: Operator between the parameter filter field and its values. Required when `parameter_filters` in `inclusion_rule_set` is provided. If `field` is `URL`, allowed operators are `CONTAINS`, `DOES_NOT_CONTAIN`, and `EQ`. If `field` is not `URL`, allowed operators are `CONTAINS`, `DOES_NOT_CONTAINS`, `EQ`, `IS_LESS_THAN`, `IS_GREATER_THAN`, `IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`, and `IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO`.

values.description: List of filter values. Required when `parameter_filters` in `inclusion_rule_set` is provided. Maximum 10 values. Each value can be up to 100 characters. If you specify multiple values, they are combined with OR logic.

value.description: Filter value representing the audience action/event.

operator.description: Operator between objects in `filters`. Only `OR` is supported. Within each inclusion rule, you can specify only one object in `filters`.

retention_days.description: Audience lookback window for the rule. If `audience_type` is `BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` and `filter_set.filters[].value` is not `BUSINESS ACCOUNT PROFILE FOLLOW`, `retention_days` must be `7`, `14`, or `30`. If `audience_type` is `ENGAGEMENT_LIVE_VIDEO` or `ENGAGEMENT_ORGANIC_VIDEO`, `retention_days` must be `7`, `14`, or `30`. Note: to avoid confusion with `retention_in_days`, this field will be renamed in a future API version.

operations.description: Stops sharing a custom audience with advertisers using /v1.3/dmp/custom_audience/share/cancel/. In v1.3, the request parameter types for `shared_advertiser_id`, `advertiser_id`, and `custom_audience_id` changed from number to string compared with v1.2.

custom_audience_id.description: ID of the custom audience whose sharing you want to cancel.

shared_advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID to stop sharing the audience with. Set this only when cancelling sharing with advertisers you previously shared the audience with.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_share_cancel

operations.description: Starts sharing audiences with specified ad accounts in the same Business Center via /open_api/v1.3/dmp/custom_audience/share/. Ad account owners, or users with Admin or Operator roles, can share Custom Audiences created from Customer file, Segment, Engagement, App Activity, or Website Traffic, as well as Lookalike Audiences. In v1.3, `custom_audience_ids`, `shared_advertiser_ids`, and `advertiser_id` use string types.

advertiser_id.description: Operator advertiser ID used to perform the share action.

custom_audience_ids.description: IDs of the Custom Audiences to share. Size: 1-10. Audiences must be shareable by this endpoint, including Custom Audiences created from Customer file, Segment, Engagement, App Activity, or Website Traffic.

shared_advertiser_ids.description: Advertiser IDs to share the audiences with. They must belong to the same Business Center as the operator advertiser. Size: 1-10.

operations.description: Gets the sharing log for a custom audience, including the advertiser IDs and advertiser names the audience has been shared with. Endpoint: /open_api/v1.3/dmp/custom_audience/share/log/. In v1.3, both request parameters `advertiser_id` and `custom_audience_id` use string values instead of the number type used in v1.2.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID for the advertiser that owns or is querying the custom audience sharing log.

custom_audience_id.description: The custom audience ID to retrieve sharing log records for.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_share_log_get

operations.description: Updates an audience's name or, for Customer File audiences only, its uploaded audience files through `/open_api/v1.3/dmp/custom_audience/update/`. Customer File audiences support file modifications with `REPLACE`, `APPEND`, and `REMOVE`; Engagement, App Activity, Website Traffic, and Lookalike audiences support name updates only. `REPLACE` replaces all previous data files, `APPEND` adds new data files, and `REMOVE` removes specified data files. An expiring or expired audience cannot be modified and can only be deleted; use `is_expiring` and `expired_time` to determine this. `APPEND`, `REMOVE`, and `REPLACE` fail if the audience size would be less than 1,000 after the operation, and `REMOVE` cannot remove all data files. Quotas and concurrency limits apply at the audience level: up to 24 update operations in any consecutive 24 hours, only one file-based `REPLACE` operation per day, and you must wait for the current operation to complete before retrying; `REPLACE` requests are rejected if another `REPLACE` is still unfinished. The API returns success or error immediately, but file processing is asynchronous with an SLA of 48 hours.

action.description: Modification type for uploaded files. Valid only when `file_paths` is provided. `APPEND` adds only data not already in the original audience file, `REMOVE` removes only data that matches the original file, and `REPLACE` replaces all original audience data. Default: `REPLACE`. `APPEND`, `REMOVE`, and `REPLACE` fail if the audience size would be less than 1,000 after the operation.

audience_sub_type.description: Audience subtype that determines what campaign types the audience can be used for. Allowed value: `REACH_FREQUENCY` to enable use in Reach & Frequency campaigns. You can change the subtype only from `NORMAL` to `REACH_FREQUENCY`, not the reverse. If you update this field, changes to all other request fields are ignored. If the audience is a Lookalike audience, you cannot change `audience_sub_type` to `REACH_FREQUENCY`.

custom_audience_name.description: New audience name. Maximum length: 128 characters. You must provide either `custom_audience_name` or `file_paths`.

file_paths.description: Files to upload when updating a Customer File audience. You must provide either `file_paths` or `custom_audience_name`. Valid only for Customer File audiences. When `file_paths` is provided, you can specify the file modification mode with `action`. Recommended request size: fewer than 50 files per request for stability. Uploaded files must use the same encryption method and type as the audience being updated.

operations.name: dmp_custom_audience_update

operations.description: Creates a Saved Audience for an advertiser account using demographic, audience, interest, action, and device targeting criteria. An advertiser account can have up to 400 Saved Audiences.

actions.description: List of action targeting objects. Within each object, `action_scene`, `action_period`, and `video_user_actions` are required; `action_category_ids` is also required when `actions` is specified and is valid only when TikTok placement is the only placement selected in your ad group.

action_category_ids.description: Required when `actions` is specified, and valid only when TikTok placement is the only placement selected in your ad group. Action category (behavior) or hashtag IDs to target.

action_period.description: Required when `actions` is specified. Time period to include actions from. Allowed values are `0`, `7`, and `15`. If `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `0` is used regardless of the value you pass. `0` means there is no definite timeframe to select actions from.

action_scene.description: Required when `actions` is specified. Indicates where user actions are collected from. Controls the allowed values in `video_user_actions`, and also affects `action_period`: if `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED` or `HASHTAG_RELATED`, `action_period` is treated as `0` regardless of the value passed.

video_user_actions.description: Required when `actions` is specified. Allowed values depend on `action_scene`: if `action_scene` is `VIDEO_RELATED`, use `WATCHED_TO_END`, `LIKED`, `COMMENTED`, or `SHARED`; if `action_scene` is `CREATOR_RELATED`, use `FOLLOWING` or `VIEW_HOMEPAGE`; if `action_scene` is `HASHTAG_RELATED`, use `VIEW_HASHTAG`.

carrier_ids.description: Carrier IDs to target. A carrier is valid only when its `in_use` field is `true`. Carriers must be consistent with the targeted `location_ids`.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Only active devices (`is_active = true`) from `/tool/device_model/` can be used. `device_model_ids` and `device_price_ranges` cannot be set at the same time.

device_price_ranges.description: Device price range to target. Values must be multiples of 50. `10000` means `1000+`. The upper limit you set is increased by 50 and that new number is used as the actual upper limit for targeting. For example, if you set and get `[0, 250]`, it actually means `[0, 300]`.

interest_category_ids.description: Interest category IDs. If specified, users who do not meet the interest target will be excluded during delivery. Omit this field if you want to target everyone.

interest_keyword_ids.description: Interest keyword IDs for audience targeting.

languages.description: Language codes to target. If you do not want to limit languages, pass an empty value or omit this field.

location_ids.description: Location IDs to target. Overlapping targeted locations are not supported; for example, you cannot target the U.S. and the state of California at the same time.

network_types.description: Device connection types to target. Default: `unlimited`.

operating_systems.description: Device operating systems to target. Only one value is allowed.

saved_audience_name.description: Saved Audience name. Maximum 512 characters and cannot contain emoji.

operations.name: dmp_saved_audience_create

operations.description: Deletes Saved Audiences. If a Saved Audience has already been applied to an ad group, it can be deleted only after that ad group has been deleted.

saved_audience_ids.description: IDs of the Saved Audiences to delete. Maximum 100 IDs per request.

operations.name: dmp_saved_audience_delete

operations.description: Gets the details of Saved Audiences associated with an ad account. You can optionally filter the results by specific Saved Audience IDs.

saved_audience_ids.description: Optional list of Saved Audience IDs to retrieve. Maximum size: 100.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID of the ad account whose Pangle block list you want to retrieve.

operations.description: Updates the Pangle block list for an advertiser at `/v1.3/pangle_block_list/update/`. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from `number` to `string` compared with v1.2.

add_app_list.description: Apps to add to the block list. Use iTunes IDs for iOS apps and package names for Android apps. When `clear_old_app=true`, the original block list is cleared first and then these apps are added; when `clear_old_app=false` or omitted, these apps are added based on the existing list.

clear_old_app.description: Whether to clear the original app block list first. Default is `false`. If `false` or omitted, the request deletes apps in `delete_app_list` and adds apps in `add_app_list` based on the existing list. If `true`, the original list is cleared and then apps in `add_app_list` are added.

delete_app_list.description: Apps to delete from the block list. Use iTunes IDs for iOS apps and package names for Android apps. This applies when `clear_old_app=false` or omitted; when `clear_old_app=true`, the original block list is cleared and then only `add_app_list` is applied.

operations.name: pangle_block_list_update

operations.description: Searches targeting categories and hashtags for interests and behaviors from seed keywords, or lists all available categories and hashtag bundles when no seed keywords are provided. Use this endpoint to discover values for interest-, purchase-intention-, and action-based targeting. Returned IDs are used later when creating ad groups via `/adgroup/create/`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions.

special_industries.description: Special ad categories used to filter results. Enum values: `HOUSING`, `EMPLOYMENT`, `CREDIT`. Default is `[]`, which means no special ad category filtering. If you pass multiple values, results include targeting categories or hashtags that support any of the specified categories.

language.description: Language of the seed keywords. Default is `en`. If `sub_targeting_types` includes `HASHTAG_INTERACTION` and `search_keywords` contains one or more non-English keywords, hashtags in multiple languages may still be returned even when `language` is specified, because hashtag search is not restricted to a single language.

search_keywords.description: Seed keywords used to search for targeting categories or hashtags. Maximum 10 keywords, and each keyword can be up to 100 characters. If you pass multiple keywords, `sub_targeting_types` may include only `ADDITIONAL_INTEREST` and `HASHTAG_INTERACTION`. If `sub_targeting_types` includes `HASHTAG_INTERACTION` and you pass `search_keywords`, the endpoint returns only hashtags in `hashtag_interaction.search_result`; hashtag bundle search is not supported. To retrieve hashtag bundles, include `HASHTAG_INTERACTION` in `sub_targeting_types` and omit `search_keywords`.

sub_targeting_types.description: Secondary targeting types. Required when `targeting_type` is `INTEREST_AND_BEHAVIOR` and `search_keywords` contains multiple keywords. Allowed values depend on `search_keywords`: if `search_keywords` is omitted, allowed values are `GENERAL_INTEREST`, `PURCHASE_INTENTION`, `VIDEO_INTERACTION`, `CREATOR_INTERACTION`, `HASHTAG_INTERACTION`, and if omitted the default is `["GENERAL_INTEREST","PURCHASE_INTENTION","VIDEO_INTERACTION","CREATOR_INTERACTION","HASHTAG_INTERACTION"]`; if `search_keywords` contains one keyword, allowed values are `GENERAL_INTEREST`, `ADDITIONAL_INTEREST`, `PURCHASE_INTENTION`, `VIDEO_INTERACTION`, `CREATOR_INTERACTION`, `HASHTAG_INTERACTION`, and if omitted the default is `["GENERAL_INTEREST","ADDITIONAL_INTEREST","PURCHASE_INTENTION","VIDEO_INTERACTION","CREATOR_INTERACTION","HASHTAG_INTERACTION"]`; if `search_keywords` contains more than one keyword, allowed values are only `ADDITIONAL_INTEREST` and `HASHTAG_INTERACTION`, and you must pass this field manually.

targeting_type.description: Primary targeting type. Must be `INTEREST_AND_BEHAVIOR` for this endpoint.

operations.name: targeting_search

operations.description: Retrieves an ad account's Brand Safety Hub settings. These are the default ad account-level first-party brand safety settings, including TikTok Inventory Filter and suitability controls such as Category Exclusion and Vertical Sensitivity.
operations.name: tiktok_inventory_filters_get

operations.description: Sets or updates an ad account's Brand Safety Hub settings, which define default first-party brand safety controls at the account level, including TikTok Inventory Filter and suitability controls such as Category Exclusion and Vertical Sensitivity. If you update brand safety settings, you must submit `brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id` together. Settings configured through this endpoint automatically apply to future Smart+ Campaigns, but do not apply to future regular campaigns created with `/campaign/create/`.

brand_safety_type.description: Inventory filter tier applied to placements in the For You, Following, and Profile Page feeds, and in Search feed where ads appear next to viewed search results. If you want to update the brand safety settings, you must specify `brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id` simultaneously.

category_exclusion_ids.description: List of content category IDs to avoid. Valid only when `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. To obtain valid IDs, call `/tool/content_exclusion/get/` and use the returned `excluded_category_list`. Currently, category exclusion is not available for the Product Sales objective.

cover_all_ad_objectives.description: Whether to apply the brand safety settings (`brand_safety_type`, `category_exclusion_ids`, and `vertical_sensitivity_id`) to all advertising objectives. `true` applies them to all objectives, including Reach, Video Views, Community Interaction, Traffic, App Promotion, Lead Generation, Website Conversions, and Product Sales. `false` applies them only to Reach, Video Views, and Community Interaction. Once set to `true`, this field cannot be updated back to `false`.

vertical_sensitivity_id.description: Vertical category ID used to exclude sensitive vertical-related content. Valid only when `brand_safety_type` is `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`. To obtain valid IDs, call `/tool/content_exclusion/get/` and use the returned `vertical_sensitivity_list`. Vertical sensitivity controls are not available for Traffic, App Promotion, Lead Generation, Website Conversions, and Product Sales objectives.

operations.name: tiktok_inventory_filters_update

operations.description: Gets action category enumeration values (also called behavioral categories). These categories are used for action targeting, which serves ads based on users' recent in-app behaviors. Supported behavior scenes are creator-related actions and video-related actions; accordingly, the `action_scene` values used with `/adgroup/create/` are `CREATOR_RELATED` and `VIDEO_RELATED`. TikTok recommends using the Consolidated Interest and Behavior API at `/targeting/search/` to search for or list targeting categories and hashtags for interests and behaviors.

language.description: Language for category names in the response. Defaults to `en`. Supported values: `en`, `zh`, `ja`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `id`, `it`, `ko`, `ru`, `th`, `tr`, `vi`, `ar`, `pt`, `ms`.

special_industries.description: Special ad categories to filter action categories. Supported values: `HOUSING` (real estate listings, homeowners insurance, mortgage loans, or similar opportunities), `EMPLOYMENT` (job offers, internships, professional certification programs, or similar opportunities), and `CREDIT` (credit card offers, auto loans, long-term financing, or similar opportunities). This field is generally available only to advertisers registered in America or Canada; advertisers not registered in America or Canada that want to target these countries with special ad categories must apply for an additional allowlist.

operations.name: tool_action_category_get

operations.description: Gets the authorization status of your Brand Safety post-bid measurement partner for an advertiser. For Zefr, you must complete setup at https://measurement.zefr.com/tiktok/connect before checking authorization status. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/tool/brand_safety/partner/authorize/status/` and `advertiser_id` is a string; in v1.2, the path was `/v1.2/tools/brand_safety/partner/authentication/` and `advertiser_id` was a number.
operations.name: tool_brand_safety_partner_authorize_status_get

operations.description: Retrieves carrier enumeration values for different countries or locations. Use this endpoint to obtain carrier IDs and HNI (MCC/MNC) IDs that can be used for targeting when creating an ad. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/tools/carrier_v2/ to /v1.3/tool/carrier/, the request parameter `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and response fields changed from `carrier_v2_id`/`value.id` to `carrier_id`/`hni_id`, with `countries` added in v1.3.
operations.name: tool_carrier_get

operations.description: Gets the content exclusion categories and, when eligible, vertical sensitivity categories that can be excluded from appearing next to your ads. Call GET /open_api/v1.3/tool/content_exclusion/get/ with an advertiser ID and supported objective. To retrieve `vertical_sensitivity_list`, `brand_safety_type` must be `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`; if the advertiser is not on the vertical sensitivity allowlist, `vertical_sensitivity_list` is returned as null. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` is also currently allowlist-only and, per the docs, will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` as the default option in the next API version.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type.
