Defaults to `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` means no brand safety solution is used (full inventory, so ads may appear next to some mature-theme content). `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` uses TikTok's brand safety solution so ads appear next to content where most inappropriate content has been removed and that does not contain mature themes; this option is allowlist-only, and the docs state it will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` as the default in the next API version. `STANDARD_INVENTORY` means ads appear next to content appropriate for most brands. `LIMITED_INVENTORY` means ads will not appear next to content containing mature themes. To retrieve `vertical_sensitivity_list`, set this field to `STANDARD_INVENTORY` or `LIMITED_INVENTORY`; if you are not on the vertical sensitivity allowlist, `vertical_sensitivity_list` will be null in the response.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. Only `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT` are supported.

operations.name: tool_content_exclusion_get

operations.description: Gets detailed information for content exclusion categories and vertical sensitivity categories that can be excluded from appearing next to your ads.

category_ids.description: IDs of the content exclusion categories or vertical sensitivity categories to retrieve. Obtain valid `category_id` values from `/tool/content_exclusion/get/`.

operations.name: tool_content_exclusion_info_get

operations.description: Returns contextual tags available for targeting for the specified advertiser, advertising objective, and optional region codes. Contextual targeting is currently an allowlist-only feature; if you need access, contact your TikTok representative. This endpoint also supports brand safety filtering, and some pre-bid first-party Brand Safety solutions for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` objectives in Auction ads, as well as pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions, are allowlist-only.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Defaults to `STANDARD_INVENTORY` if omitted. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` means ads can appear next to content where most inappropriate content has been removed and may still contain some mature themes; in the next API version, `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` and become the default option. `STANDARD_INVENTORY` means ads appear next to content appropriate for most brands. `LIMITED_INVENTORY` means ads will not appear next to content containing mature themes. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety solutions for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` objectives in Auction ads, and pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions, are allowlist-only features.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. Only supports `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `RF_REACH`. If `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, you may also use `rf_campaign_type` to request premium contextual tags for TikTok Pulse campaigns.

region_codes.description: Country or region codes used to filter available contextual tags.

rf_campaign_type.description: Valid only when `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Use this field to set the campaign as a TikTok Pulse campaign so you can get available premium contextual tags. Do not pass this field when `objective_type` is not `RF_REACH`.

operations.name: tool_contextual_tag_get

operations.description: Gets detailed information for contextual tags. You must provide the advertiser ID and one or more contextual tag IDs obtained from /tool/contextual_tag/get/. Contextual targeting is currently an allowlist-only feature; if you are not allowlisted, related results may be unavailable or empty, and you must contact your TikTok representative for access.

contextual_tag_ids.description: List of contextual tag IDs to retrieve. Use contextual tag IDs returned by /tool/contextual_tag/get/.

operations.name: tool_contextual_tag_info_get

operations.description: Returns device model enumeration values for an advertiser from `/open_api/v1.3/tool/device_model/`. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/tools/device_model/` to `/v1.3/tool/device_model/`, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and response fields were renamed from `name` to `device_model_name`, `id` to `device_model_id`, and `children` to `child_device_ids`.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID whose available device model enumeration values are being retrieved.

operations.name: tool_device_model_get

operations.description: Gets targeting hashtag names and availability statuses for the specified hashtag IDs. Endpoint: /v1.3/tool/hashtag/get/. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, `keyword_id` changed to `keyword_ids` with type string[], and `keyword_query_pairs` was removed in v1.3.

keyword_ids.description: List of hashtag keyword IDs to retrieve names and statuses for.

operations.name: tool_hashtag_get

operations.description: Search for targeting hashtags based on seed keywords. The returned hashtag `keyword_id` can be used in the `action_category_ids` field of `/adgroup/create/` to target users who watched TikTok videos with that hashtag; when doing so, you must also set `action_scene` to `HASHTAG_RELATED`. TikTok recommends using the Consolidated Interest and Behavior API `/targeting/search/` to search for or list targeting categories and hashtags for interests and behaviors.

keywords.description: Seed keywords to get recommended hashtags for. If you specify multiple unrelated keywords and set `operator` to `AND`, no recommended hashtags may be returned. Maximum size: 10.

operator.description: Operator applied between values in `keywords`. `AND` generates recommended hashtags based on all specified keywords together. `OR` generates recommended hashtags separately for each individual keyword in `keywords`. Default value: `AND`.

operations.name: tool_hashtag_recommend_search

operations.description: Gets general interest category enumeration values. TikTok recommends using the Consolidated Interest and Behavior API at `/targeting/search/` to search for or list targeting categories and hashtags for interests and behaviors, as it provides a more consolidated and efficient way to access targeting information.

language.description: Language for category names in the response. Default is `en`. Supported values: `en`, `zh`, `ja`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `id`, `it`, `ko`, `ru`, `th`, `tr`, `vi`, `ar`, `pt`, `ms`.

placements.description: Apps where you want to deliver ads. This field only takes effect when `version` = `2`. Available interest categories may differ by placement.

special_industries.description: Special ad categories to filter by. Supported values: `HOUSING` for real estate, homeowners insurance, mortgage loans, or related opportunities; `EMPLOYMENT` for job offers, internships, professional certification programs, or related opportunities; `CREDIT` for credit card offers, auto loans, long-term financing, or related opportunities. This field is generally available only to advertisers registered in America or Canada. Advertisers not registered in America or Canada who want to target those countries with special ad categories must apply for an additional allowlist.

version.description: Version of the interest category dataset to return. `1` = `interest_category`; `2` = `interest_category_v2`. Default is `2`.

operations.name: tool_interest_category_get

operations.description: Gets additional interest categories by ID from /v1.3/tool/interest_keyword/get/. In v1.3, the path changed from /v1.2/tools/interest_keyword/get/ to /v1.3/tool/interest_keyword/get/, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, `id` changed to `keyword_id` as a string, and `filtering` and `audience_type` were added.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the returned additional interest categories.

audience_type.description: Audience type to filter by. `GENERAL_INTEREST` means audiences have a general, long-term interest in a video category. `PURCHASE_INTENTION` means audiences' recent behavior suggests they may buy something related to a content category. Default is `GENERAL_INTEREST`.

keyword_query.description: List of additional interest categories to retrieve. Maximum size: 50.

language.description: Language for the additional interest category. Default is `en`. Supported values: `fr`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ms`, `ar`, `vi`, `en`, `ru`, `es`, `th`, `tr`, `hi`, `zh`, `de`, `ko`.

operations.name: tool_interest_keyword_get

operations.description: Searches for additional interest categories related to one or more seed keywords. You can provide either `keyword` or `keywords`; each seed keyword is used to generate related additional interest categories. Returned `keyword_id` values whose `status` is `EFFECTIVE` can be passed to the `interest_keyword_ids` field in `/adgroup/create/` to target audiences in an ad group. TikTok recommends using the Consolidated Interest and Behavior API at `/targeting/search/` to search for or list targeting categories and hashtags for interests and behaviors.

audience_type.description: Audience type. Default value: `GENERAL_INTEREST`. `GENERAL_INTEREST` means the audience has a general, long-term interest in a video category. `PURCHASE_INTENTION` is deprecated and means the audience's recent behavior suggests they may buy something related to a content category.

keyword.description: Either `keyword` or `keywords` must be set. If both `keywords` and `keyword` are passed, `keyword` is ignored. Provide one seed keyword to search for related additional interest categories.

keywords.description: Either `keywords` or `keyword` must be set. If both `keywords` and `keyword` are passed, `keyword` is ignored. Provide up to 10 seed keywords; each keyword is processed separately to generate corresponding additional interest categories.

language.description: Keyword language. Default value: `en`. Target audience languages are not limited by the keyword language; for example, you can use English categories to target audiences that do not speak English.

limit.description: Number of additional interest categories to return. Default value: 50. Value range: 1-50.

operations.name: tool_interest_keyword_recommend_search

operations.description: Returns recommended interest categories and action categories based on historical performance data in the same industries. Endpoint: /v1.3/tool/targeting_category/recommend/. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/tools/target_recommend_tags/ to /v1.3/tool/targeting_category/recommend/, the request parameter name changed from `region_code` to `region_codes`, and `app_id` changed from number to string.

app_id.description: Mobile app ID for the app you want to promote. Optional, and valid only when promoting a mobile app.

region_codes.description: List of country or region codes, for example ["US", "JP", "KR"].

operations.name: tool_targeting_category_recommend_get

operations.description: Gets details for targeting tags by ID, including location IDs, zip code IDs (US only), postal code IDs (Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam only), and ISP IDs. Use this endpoint instead of /tool/region/ to retrieve zip code or postal code details. This endpoint must be called with POST because URL length limits make GET unsuitable. Supported parameter combinations depend on the targeting tag type: for ZIP/location tags, `scene` must be `GEO`; for ISP tags, `scene` must be `ISP`.

brand_safety_partner.description: Brand safety partner. Required only when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`. Pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions are allowlist-only features.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Valid only when `scene` is `GEO` and `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Default: `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` uses no brand safety solution. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY`, `STANDARD_INVENTORY`, and `LIMITED_INVENTORY` use TikTok brand safety inventory levels. `THIRD_PARTY` uses a third-party brand safety solution and requires `brand_safety_partner`. In the next API version, `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` as the default. To get countries and regions available for your brand safety settings, use /tool/region/. Pre-bid first-party brand safety solutions for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` objectives in Auction ads, and pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions, are allowlist-only features.

objective_type.description: Campaign objective. Required when `scene` is `GEO`. Allowed values: `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `PRODUCT_SALES`.

operating_system.description: Device operating system to target. Valid only when `scene` is `GEO`.

placements.description: Apps where you want to deliver ads. Required when `scene` is `GEO`. If you want information for zip code IDs or postal code IDs to be used for zip/postal code targeting, this field must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type. Required when `scene` is `GEO` and `objective_type` is not `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`. Use this field to specify where you want to promote your products.

scene.description: Targeting type for the specified `targeting_ids`. `GEO` = geographical targeting, including administrative regions and zip/postal codes; `ISP` = internet service provider targeting. Default: `GEO`. Must be `GEO` for zip code, postal code, and location IDs, and `ISP` for ISP IDs.

targeting_ids.description: Targeting tag IDs to look up. You can pass location IDs, zip code IDs, postal code IDs, a combination of location IDs and zip/postal code IDs, or ISP IDs. Max size: 1,000. Obtain location, zip code, and postal code IDs from `geo_id` returned by /tool/targeting/search/ or location IDs from `location_id` returned by /tool/region/. Obtain ISP IDs from `isp_id` returned by /tool/targeting/list/.

operations.name: tool_targeting_info_get

operations.description: Gets targeting tags for Internet Service Provider targeting and returns ISP IDs that can be used for ad audience targeting. This endpoint only supports the `ISP` targeting type. Use the returned ISP IDs in `isp_ids` when calling `/adgroup/create/`, `/adgroup/update/`, or `/ad/audience_size/estimate/`. To retrieve valid country- or region-level locations for the request, use `/tool/region/` and pass location IDs whose returned `level` is `COUNTRY`.

location_ids.description: Location IDs for which to retrieve supported ISP IDs. Maximum size: 1000. You must pass location IDs at the country or region level. To get available locations and IDs based on placement and objective, call `/tool/region/`; valid IDs for this endpoint are those whose returned `level` is `COUNTRY`.

scene.description: Targeting tag type to retrieve. Only `ISP` is supported for Internet Service Provider targeting.

operations.name: tool_targeting_list_get

operations.description: Search location targeting tags by keyword and return location IDs, zip code IDs, or postal code IDs for use in targeting. Returned ZIP/postal code IDs can be passed to `zipcode_ids`, and returned location IDs can be passed to `location_ids`, when calling `/adgroup/create/`, `/adgroup/update/`, or `/ad/audience_size/estimate/`. Both `/tool/region/` and `/tool/targeting/search/` can be used to get location IDs. This endpoint must be called with POST because GET URL length is limited. Targeting postal code areas in Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam is allowlist-only. Targeting newly available countries or regions (Azerbaijan, Bulgaria, Bolivia, Cyprus, Algeria, Estonia, Croatia, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Lithuania, Latvia, Nigeria, Puerto Rico, Paraguay, Serbia, Slovenia, Slovakia) with objective `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, or `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and TikTok placement is allowlist-only, with a separate allowlist required for each country or region. Targeting newly available countries or regions (Azerbaijan, Bulgaria, Bolivia, Cyprus, Algeria, Estonia, Croatia, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Lithuania, Latvia, Puerto Rico, Paraguay, Serbia, Slovenia, Slovakia) with objective `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT` and TikTok placement is also allowlist-only, with a separate allowlist required for each country or region. When targeting those countries or regions with `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, pre-bid third-party Brand Safety is not supported, so `brand_safety_type` cannot be `THIRD_PARTY`.

brand_safety_partner.description: Brand safety partner. Required only when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`. Pre-bid third-party brand safety is allowlist-only.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type. Valid only when `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Default is `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. If set to `THIRD_PARTY`, you must also provide `brand_safety_partner`. `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` means no brand safety solution is used. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY`, `STANDARD_INVENTORY`, and `LIMITED_INVENTORY` use TikTok brand safety filtering with increasing restrictiveness. In the next API version, `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` as the default. To get countries and regions available for your brand safety settings, use `/tool/region/`. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` in Auction ads, and pre-bid third-party Brand Safety, are allowlist-only features.

geo_types.description: Location types used to filter results. Allowed values depend on `search_type`: when `search_type` is `FUZZY_SEARCH`, allowed values are `ZIP_CODE`, `COUNTRY`, `PROVINCE`, `CITY`, `DISTRICT`, and `DMA`; when `search_type` is `BATCH_ZIPCODE_SEARCH`, the only allowed value is `ZIP_CODE`; when `search_type` is `BATCH_REGION_SEARCH`, allowed values are `COUNTRY`, `PROVINCE`, `CITY`, `DISTRICT`, and `DMA`.

keywords.description: Keywords used to search targeting tags. Length limit: 1 when `search_type` is `FUZZY_SEARCH`; up to 1,000 when `search_type` is `BATCH_REGION_SEARCH` or `BATCH_ZIPCODE_SEARCH`. When `search_type` is `BATCH_ZIPCODE_SEARCH`, this field must contain exact zip codes or postal codes. For US zip code targeting, provide 5-digit US ZIP codes. For Canadian postal code targeting, provide the 3-character FSA portion. For Brazil postal code targeting, provide the first 5 digits. For Indonesia and Thailand postal code targeting, provide the 5-digit postal codes. For Vietnam postal code targeting, provide the first 3 digits.

objective_type.description: Campaign objective. Allowed values: `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `PRODUCT_SALES`.

placements.description: Apps where ads will be delivered. If you want to fuzzy search for a zip code ID or postal code ID, this field must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type. Required when `objective_type` is not `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`.

region_codes.description: Country or region codes used to filter results. Required when `search_type` is `BATCH_ZIPCODE_SEARCH` or `BATCH_REGION_SEARCH`, and must be one of `US`, `CA`, `BR`, `ID`, `TH`, or `VN`. Optional when `search_type` is `FUZZY_SEARCH`, in which case you can pass any supported country or region code.

search_type.description: Search mode. `FUZZY_SEARCH` searches for a single location ID, zip code ID, or postal code ID; you can pass only 1 keyword in `keywords`, and up to 100 results are returned. `BATCH_REGION_SEARCH` searches location IDs in batch with fuzzy matching; you can pass up to 1,000 keywords in `keywords`, and up to 5 results per keyword are returned in relevance order. `BATCH_ZIPCODE_SEARCH` searches zip code IDs or postal code IDs in batch with exact matching only; you can pass up to 1,000 keywords in `keywords`, and each keyword returns one result or no result. `BATCH_ZIPCODE_SEARCH` and `BATCH_REGION_SEARCH` are only for searching zip/postal code IDs or location IDs in batch, while `FUZZY_SEARCH` is only for searching a single zip/postal code ID or location ID. Postal code targeting in Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam is allowlist-only.

operations.name: tool_targeting_search

operations.description: Checks an asset's ad-binding quota: how many ads the asset is already bound to and how many additional ads it can still be bound to. Each asset can only be used to create a limited number of ads. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/asset/bind/quota/`; compared with v1.2 `/v1.2/asset/ad/bind_info/`, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string.
operations.name: asset_bind_quota_get

operations.description: Retrieves the budget change history for an ad account within a Business Center. Only Business Center members with the Finance Manager or Finance Analyst role can access this history. To configure or update Finance roles for members, use /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/.

advertiser_id.description: Ad account ID. To obtain accessible ad accounts, use /bc/asset/get/ with `asset_type=ADVERTISER`, and use ad accounts whose returned `advertiser_role` is `ADMIN`, `OPERATOR`, or `ANALYST`.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To obtain accessible Business Centers, use /bc/get/.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the history query.

end_date.description: Query end date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (UTC+0). You must either specify both `start_date` and `end_date` together or omit both. If both are specified, the maximum time range is 365 days. If both are omitted, the last seven days are returned by default. Example: `2025-02-01`.

start_date.description: Query start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (UTC+0). You must either specify both `start_date` and `end_date` together or omit both. If both are specified, the maximum time range is 365 days. If both are omitted, the last seven days are returned by default. Example: `2025-01-01`.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: 1-50. Default: 10.

operations.name: bc_account_budget_changelog_get

operations.description: Retrieves cost records at the ad account and Business Center levels for a specified Business Center. Only members with the Finance Manager or Finance Analyst role can retrieve Business Center cost records; finance roles can be configured or updated with /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/. Cost data typically has up to 10 hours of latency, so responses are immediate but reflect data from approximately 10 hours earlier.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To obtain the list of Business Centers you have access to, use /bc/get/.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the query.

end_date.description: Query end date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, using the ad account time zone. `start_date` and `end_date` must be specified together, or both omitted. If both are specified, the maximum time range is 365 days. If both are omitted, the API returns results for the last 90 days by default.

keyword.description: Search keyword with fuzzy match support. You can search by advertiser ID or advertiser name.

start_date.description: Query start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, using the ad account time zone. `start_date` and `end_date` must be specified together, or both omitted. If both are specified, the maximum time range is 365 days. If both are omitted, the API returns results for the last 90 days by default.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default is 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range is 1 to 50. Default is 10.

operations.name: bc_account_cost_get

operations.description: Retrieves transaction records for a Business Center, its ad accounts, or its Payment Portfolio from /open_api/v1.3/bc/account/transaction/get/. You must have a Finance role on the Business Center (Finance Manager or Finance Analyst). To confirm your Finance permission and obtain accessible Business Centers, call /bc/get/ and check `finance_role`. When `transaction_level` is `ADVERTISER` or omitted, results are for ad accounts; when a Business Center has enabled Payment Portfolio, transactions of ad accounts shared by other Business Centers will not be returned. The docs also reference Payment Portfolio retrieval, though the example uses `PAYMENT_ACCOUNT` while the documented enum is `PAYMENT_PORTFOLIO`.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID whose transaction records you want to retrieve.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the transaction query.

account_ids.description: Valid only when `transaction_level` is `ADVERTISER` or omitted. List of ad account IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs.

account_name.description: Valid only when `transaction_level` is `ADVERTISER` or omitted. Ad account name filter. Fuzzy match is supported.

end_time.description: Query end time, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format using the ad account time zone or Business Center time zone. Together with `start_time`, the maximum query range is 365 days. If both `start_time` and `end_time` are omitted, the endpoint returns transaction records from the last 90 days by default.

owner_of_account.description: Valid only when `transaction_level` is `ADVERTISER` or omitted. Filters by whether the ad account is owned by the current Business Center or shared by another Business Center. Default is `OWNED_BY_CURRENT_BUSINESS_CENTER`. If you set this to `SHARED_BY_OTHER_BUSINESS_CENTER`, you must have Admin access to those ad accounts; confirm via /bc/asset/get/ that the returned `advertiser_role` for the `asset_id` with `asset_type` `ADVERTISER` is `ADMIN`. If your Business Center has more than 200 ad accounts shared by another Business Center, you cannot use `SHARED_BY_OTHER_BUSINESS_CENTER` for this filter; instead, narrow the query with `account_ids` or both `account_ids` and `account_name`.

start_time.description: Query start time, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format using the ad account time zone or Business Center time zone. Together with `end_time`, the maximum query range is 365 days. If both `start_time` and `end_time` are omitted, the endpoint returns transaction records from the last 90 days by default.

page.description: Page number. Default is 1. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of records per page. Default is 10. Allowed range: 1-50.

transaction_level.description: Level at which to retrieve transactions. `BC` returns transactions for the Business Center identified by `bc_id`; `ADVERTISER` returns transactions for ad accounts within `bc_id`; `PAYMENT_PORTFOLIO` returns Payment Portfolio transactions. Default is `ADVERTISER`. If a Business Center has enabled Payment Portfolio, transactions of ad accounts shared by other Business Centers will not be returned.

operations.name: bc_account_transaction_get

operations.description: Retrieves the currency codes and registration-area location codes for ad accounts within a Business Center. Use the returned values as valid inputs for the `registered_area` and `currency_of_account` filter fields in a Business Center report.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To get the list of Business Centers you can access, call `/bc/get/`.

operations.name: bc_advertiser_attribute_get

operations.description: Creates an ad account in a Business Center via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/advertiser/create/`. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center. To create auction ad accounts, set `advertiser_info.type` to `AUCTION`; `DIRECT` Business Centers can create only `AUCTION` ad accounts. If the ad account is registered in the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, France, Brazil, or Mexico, you must first upload business license or other qualification images through `/bc/image/upload/`. For advertisers registered in the Chinese mainland, UnionPay verification may be required; check eligibility with `/bc/advertiser/unionpay_info/check/`. Important: as of September 26, 2024, UnionPay verification has been implemented for ad account creation in Business Centers via `/bc/advertiser/create/` for advertisers registered in the Chinese mainland. Existing API workflows will continue to function until January 8, 2025. Affected developers need to implement the new workflow before January 8, 2025, after which integrations might no longer function correctly. This endpoint does not support creating multiple ad accounts in one request; create them one by one. Each user can create a maximum of 10,000 ad accounts across all Business Centers. Business Centers also have daily and total creation quotas that vary by Business Center type; if you hit quota limits, use `/bc/advertiser/disable/` to disable active ad accounts and free quota. The advertising function must already be open in your location. `tied_to_billing_group` and multiple Payment Portfolios are allowlist-only features.

currency.description: Ad account currency. Must be consistent with the Business Center currency.

name.description: Ad account name. Maximum length: 100 characters.

type.description: Type of ad account to create. Default is `AUCTION`. If the Business Center type is `DIRECT`, only `AUCTION` is allowed.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. Obtain accessible Business Center IDs through `/bc/get/`.

billing_group_id.description: Billing group ID. Valid only when `invoice_group_by` is `ACCOUNT`.

invoice_group_by.description: Invoicing mode. `ACCOUNT` means invoices in the billing group are combined. `ADVERTISER` means invoices in the billing group are handled separately.

invoice_payer.description: Party that pays the invoices. Required when the ad account `registered_area` is `FR` (France).

billing_info.description: Billing information. Required if the ad account registration location or the agency that owns the Business Center is France, Brazil, or Mexico.

tax_field_dict.description: Billing and invoicing tax number fields. Use country-specific keys: `vat` for European countries such as France; `tax_id` for Brazil (required), Mexico (required), United Arab Emirates, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Turkey, Canada, and the United States; `abn` for Australia and New Zealand.

email.description: Contact email. Required if the ad account registration location or the Business Center location is France, Brazil, or Mexico.

name.description: Contact name. Maximum length: 100 characters.

customer_info.description: Business information for the ad account.

company.description: Ad account company name. Maximum length: 255 characters.

budget_info.description: Ad account budget settings. If budget setup fails, ad account creation still succeeds; confirm the final budget result in response field `budget_setup_result`.

budget.description: Budget amount, with up to two decimal places. Required when `budget_mode` is `MONTHLY_BUDGET`, `DAILY_BUDGET`, or `CUSTOM_BUDGET`. If `budget_mode` is `MONTHLY_BUDGET`, provide a monthly budget. If `DAILY_BUDGET`, provide a daily budget. If `CUSTOM_BUDGET`, provide a one-time custom budget.

budget_mode.description: Budget mode for the ad account. Default is `MONTHLY_BUDGET`.

payment_portfolio_id.description: ID of the Payment Portfolio to link to the ad account. Valid when the multiple Payment Portfolios feature is enabled. If portfolio binding fails, ad account creation still succeeds; confirm the binding result in response field `payment_portfolio_binding_result`. Multiple Payment Portfolios for one client is an allowlist-only feature.

qualification_info.description: Qualification information. Required when the Business Center type is `AGENCY` or `SELF_SERVICE_AGENCY`. Do not send this object when the Business Center type is `DIRECT`, or an error will occur. If you provide `qualification_id`, you must not provide any other fields under `qualification_info`.

license_image_id.description: Qualified document image ID. Required for ad accounts registered in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong.

license_no.description: Business license number. Required for ad accounts registered in the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Brazil, or Mexico. If the ad account is registered in the Chinese mainland, UnionPay verification may also be required; check this with `/bc/advertiser/unionpay_info/check/`.

promotion_link.description: Required when the Business Center type is `AGENCY` or `SELF_SERVICE_AGENCY`. Company website URL used as the promotion link. Maximum length: 255 characters.

qualification_id.description: Qualification ID used to reuse qualification information from another ad account. If you pass this field, you cannot pass any other parameters under `qualification_info`.

qualification_image_ids.description: Other qualified document image IDs. Required if the ad account or the Business Center is registered in France, Brazil, or Mexico.

tied_to_billing_group.description: Whether to add the ad account to a billing group. Default is `false`. This is an allowlist-only feature; contact your TikTok representative for access.

operations.name: bc_advertiser_create

operations.description: Disables an ad account in Business Center via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/advertiser/disable/`. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center. Disable an account only when you no longer want to use it: once disabled, the ad account is closed and cannot be restored to normal ("Approved") status. Before calling this endpoint, all of the following must be true: the ad account is owned by the Business Center, is not already disabled or suspended, has no ads being delivered within 3 days, has no unpaid bills, has no unfinished transfers, and if its payment method is Automatic Payment, it has no unbilled cost.

advertiser_ids.description: IDs of the ad accounts in the specified Business Center to disable. Maximum size: 1. If an account is disabled, the ad account balance is transferred to the Business Center that owns the ad account.

operations.name: bc_advertiser_disable

operations.description: Retrieves existing qualifications within a Business Center from `/bc/advertiser/qualification/get/`. The returned `qualification_id` can be reused when creating an ad account by passing it to the `qualification_id` parameter in `/bc/advertiser/create/`. Prerequisites: you must have previously created an ad account with `/bc/advertiser/create/` and included `qualification_info`, because that is what generates a reusable `qualification_id`; if `qualification_info` was not specified during ad account creation, no reusable `qualification_id` will be available. You must also have Admin access to the Business Center.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To obtain Business Center IDs that you have access to, use `/bc/get/`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the qualification list.

verified.description: Whether to filter qualifications by verification status.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Default value: `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: `10`. Valid range: `1`-`100`.

operations.name: bc_advertiser_qualification_get

operations.description: Checks whether UnionPay verification is required for a business license. For ad accounts registered in the Chinese Mainland and belonging to these business types, UnionPay verification must be completed for the associated business license after creating an ad account with the same business license using /bc/advertiser/create/: Sole Proprietorship (Individual industrial and commercial household), Sole Proprietorship Enterprise (Individual), Limited Liability Company (solely owned by a natural person or by a natural person from Hong Kong, Macau, or Taiwan), and Limited Liability Company (invested or controlled by a natural person). If required verification is not completed, the ad account will be rejected during review.
operations.name: bc_advertiser_unionpay_info_check

operations.description: Generates an authorization URL that a Business Center can share with a TikTok account owner to request ad delivery permissions for that TikTok account. After obtaining the URL, generate a QR code from it and share it with the TikTok account owner; when scanned, they can grant the "Existing posts" permission for Spark Ads Pull and the "TikTok posts" permission for Spark Ads Push to the Business Center. Before calling this endpoint, ensure the caller is an Admin of the Business Center. You can verify this with /bc/get/ by confirming the returned `user_role` is `ADMIN`.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. Required. Use /bc/get/ to obtain the list of Business Centers you can access.

is_ads_only_mode.description: Whether to enable the "Show through ads only" permission. When `true`, and after the TikTok account owner approves ad delivery permission, videos published through Spark Ads Push by members assigned to the TikTok account receive paid traffic and are hidden from organic traffic, which prevents members from publishing posts that appear on the TikTok account profile. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

operations.name: bc_asset_account_authorization_get

operations.description: Deletes assets from a Business Center via /v1.3/bc/asset/admin/delete/. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center. Supported asset types are leads and TikTok accounts. In v1.3, `asset_ids` must be sent as `string[]` (v1.2 used `number[]`).

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to delete. Currently, only one ID is allowed. The required ID format depends on `asset_type`: use `library_id` when `asset_type` is `LEAD`, and use the ID of a TikTok account in the Business Center when `asset_type` is `TT_ACCOUNT`.

asset_type.description: Type of asset to delete. Supported values are `LEAD` and `TT_ACCOUNT` (corresponds to `BC_AUTH_TT`). When `asset_type` is `LEAD`, you can delete only a single lead at a time, and once deleted, the lead is moved back to the ad account where it was previously placed.

operations.name: bc_asset_admin_delete

operations.description: Gets additional information about assets in a Business Center for Business Center Admin users. You can also filter results by ad account display status, relation type between the Business Center and the asset, and relation status. Version note: compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `bc_id` from number to string, changes response `asset_id` from number to string, and adds response fields including `advertiser_account_type`, `store_role`, `ad_creation_eligible`, `business_account_roles`, `is_business_verified`, `operating_region_code`, `tt_asset_handle`, and `tt_asset_profile_image`.

asset_type.description: The type of asset to retrieve. Supported values: `ADVERTISER` (ad account), `CATALOG` (catalog), `TIKTOK_SHOP` (TikTok Shop), `PIXEL` (Pixel), `LEAD` (Leads), `TT_ACCOUNT` (TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset; corresponds to identity type `BC_AUTH_TT`), and `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` (TikTok account used for Business Account management, including ads, messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights).

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the asset query.

advertiser_show_status.description: Ad account display status. Valid only when `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`. If omitted, ad accounts of all display statuses are returned.

relation_status.description: The relation status between the Business Center and the asset. Valid only when `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, `PIXEL`, `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`, or `TIKTOK_SHOP`. Supported values: `BOUND` (approved by the owner), `UNBOUND` (previously approved but later cancelled by the owner), `PENDING` (awaiting the owner's approval), and `REJECTED` (rejected by the owner).

relation_type.description: The relation type between the Business Center and the asset. Supported values: `OWNER_BC` (the asset is created and owned by the current Business Center), `OWNER_PARTNER` (the asset is owned by a partner Business Center), and `OWNER_INDIVIDUAL` (the asset is owned by a user).

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Valid range: 1 to 50. Default value: 10.

operations.name: bc_asset_admin_get

operations.description: Links a TikTok account asset to an ad account in a Business Center using /open_api/v1.3/bc/asset/advertiser/assign/. After the link is created, Business Center members who have access to the linked ad account can use the TikTok account for ad delivery across those ad accounts. Before calling this endpoint, you must be an Admin user of the Business Center; verify this with /bc/get/ by confirming the returned `user_role` is `ADMIN`.

advertiser_id.description: ID of the ad account in the same Business Center that the TikTok account will be linked to. Obtain it from /bc/asset/get/ with `asset_type` set to `ADVERTISER`.

asset_id.description: ID of the TikTok account asset in the Business Center. Obtain it from /bc/asset/get/, and the returned asset must match the selected `asset_type` (`TT_ACCOUNT` or `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`).

asset_type.description: Type of TikTok account asset to link. `TT_ACCOUNT` means a TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset. `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` means a TikTok account for Business Account management that can also be used for ad delivery and for managing messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights. Default is `TT_ACCOUNT`.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To get Business Centers you can access, call /bc/get/.

operations.name: bc_asset_advertiser_assign

operations.description: Retrieves the list of ad accounts linked to a TikTok account in a Business Center. Once an ad account is linked to a TikTok account in a Business Center, Business Center members who have access to the linked ad account can use that TikTok account for ad delivery from the ad account.

asset_id.description: ID of a TikTok account in the Business Center. Obtain this by calling /bc/asset/get/ with `asset_type` set to `TT_ACCOUNT` or `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`.

asset_type.description: Type of TikTok account asset. This should match the type of the `asset_id` you provide. `TT_ACCOUNT` is a TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset; ads can run from these accounts. `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` is a TikTok account for Business Account management; ads can run from these accounts, and you can also manage messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights in the TikTok account.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Value range: 1-50. Default value: 10.

operations.name: bc_asset_advertiser_assigned_get

operations.description: Unlinks a TikTok account from an ad account in a Business Center using `/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset/advertiser/unassign/`. After the linkage is removed, Business Center members who have access to the ad account can no longer use that TikTok account for ad delivery from the ad account. Before calling this endpoint, you must be an Admin user of the Business Center; confirm this with `/bc/get/` by checking that `user_role` is `ADMIN`. The TikTok account and ad account must have been previously linked in the same Business Center.

advertiser_id.description: ID of the ad account, within the same Business Center, to unlink the TikTok account from. Use `/bc/asset/advertiser/assigned/` to get ad accounts that are already linked to a TikTok account in the Business Center.

asset_id.description: ID of the TikTok account in the Business Center to unlink from the ad account. Use `/bc/asset/get/` to list TikTok account assets in the Business Center. The value must correspond to the selected `asset_type`, which should be `TT_ACCOUNT` or `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`.

asset_type.description: Type of TikTok account asset to unlink. This field determines which kind of TikTok account `asset_id` must reference. `TT_ACCOUNT` is a TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset; ads can be run from these accounts. `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` is a TikTok account used for Business Account management; ads can be run from these accounts, and you can also manage messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights in the TikTok account.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. Use `/bc/get/` to obtain the list of Business Centers you can access. You must have Admin permission for this Business Center to use this endpoint.

operations.name: bc_asset_advertiser_unassign

operations.description: Assigns a Business Center asset to a TikTok For Business user who already belongs to the same Business Center. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center to call this endpoint. In v1.3, the endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/bc/asset/assign/` to `/v1.3/bc/asset/assign/`, `bc_id`, `user_id`, and `asset_id` changed from number to string, and `store_role` and `business_account_roles` were added.

advertiser_role.description: Required when `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`. Role to assign on the advertiser account, equivalent to Layer 2 of Ad Account Permissions.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset to assign. Its meaning depends on `asset_type`: if `ADVERTISER`, this is the advertiser ID; if `CATALOG`, the catalog ID; if `TIKTOK_SHOP`, the TikTok Shop ID; if `LEAD`, the form library ID; if `TT_ACCOUNT`, the ID of a TikTok account as an ad delivery asset in a Business Center; if `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`, the ID of a TikTok account for Business Account management in a Business Center. For `LEAD`, you can use `/page/library/get/` to obtain form library details and IDs you have access to.

asset_type.description: Type of asset being assigned. Determines the meaning of `asset_id` and which companion role field is required: `ADVERTISER` requires `advertiser_role`; `CATALOG` requires `catalog_role`; `TIKTOK_SHOP` requires `store_role`; `LEAD` requires `form_library_role`; `TT_ACCOUNT` requires `tt_account_roles`; `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` requires `business_account_roles`. `TT_ACCOUNT` is a TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset and corresponds to identity type `BC_AUTH_TT`. `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` is a TikTok account for Business Account management, allowing ads plus management of messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights.

business_account_roles.description: Required only when `asset_type` is `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`. Business Account management permission to assign on the TikTok account. Max size: 1.

catalog_role.description: Required when `asset_type` is `CATALOG`. Business Center user's permission for the catalog.

form_library_role.description: Required when `asset_type` is `LEAD`. Form library role assigned to the user. Currently only `ADMIN` is supported.

store_role.description: Required when `asset_type` is `TIKTOK_SHOP`. Business Center user's permission for the TikTok Shop.

tt_account_roles.description: Required when `asset_type` is `TT_ACCOUNT`. Ad delivery permissions to assign on the TikTok account. `LIVE` is only available in some regions.

user_id.description: ID of the Business Center user to assign the asset to. Obtain this value from the `user_id` returned by `/bc/member/get/`.

operations.name: bc_asset_assign

operations.description: Gets Business Center assets that the authorized user, or a specified user, has access to. Endpoint: /v1.3/bc/asset/get/. In v1.3, `bc_id` changed from number to string, `asset_id` in the response changed from number to string, and `keyword` was added as a request parameter.

asset_type.description: Type of asset to retrieve. Supported values: `ADVERTISER` (ad account), `CATALOG` (catalog), `TIKTOK_SHOP` (TikTok Shop), `PIXEL` (Pixel), `LEAD` (Leads), `TT_ACCOUNT` (TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset; corresponds to identity type `BC_AUTH_TT`), and `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` (TikTok account for Business Account management, including ads, messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights).

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. `user_id` and `user_email` cannot be used at the same time. If you omit all filter values, the system uses as `user_id` the TikTok for Business user ID associated with the authorization code (`auth_code`).

keyword.description: Keyword to search for assets. Not supported when `asset_type` is `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`.

user_email.description: User email to get assets for. Cannot be set together with `user_id`. For users in `PENDING` status, use `user_email`; for users in `BOUND` status, use `user_id` instead. Use `user_email` only when `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER` and the invitation for the user to join the Business Center is still pending. Not supported when `asset_type` is `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`.

user_id.description: User ID to get assets for. Cannot be set together with `user_email`. For users in `BOUND` status, use `user_id`; for users in `PENDING` status, use `user_email` instead. Not supported when `asset_type` is `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: `1`-`50`. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

operations.name: bc_asset_get

operations.description: Creates an Asset Group in a Business Center at `/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset_group/create/`. The caller must be an Admin user of the Business Center.

assets.description: Assets to add to the Asset Group. Maximum 200 items.

asset_id.description: Asset ID. When `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, this value is the advertiser ID.

asset_type.description: Asset type. Currently only `ADVERTISER` is supported. If omitted, `ADVERTISER` is used by default.

members.description: Business Center members to grant access to the Asset Group. Maximum 50 items.

asset_roles.description: Roles to assign to the member by asset type. The key is the asset type and currently must be `ADVERTISER`. The value is the assigned role: `ADVERTISER_ROLE_ADMIN` can manage ad account settings, finances, permissions, campaigns, and performance access; `ADVERTISER_ROLE_OPERATOR` can manage campaigns and view performance; `ADVERTISER_ROLE_ANALYST` can view performance only. Default: `{"ADVERTISER":"ADVERTISER_ROLE_ADMIN"}`.

operations.name: bc_asset_group_create

operations.description: Deletes Asset Groups from your Business Center via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset_group/delete/`. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center to use this endpoint. Deleting an Asset Group removes members' access to the assets in that Asset Group, but does not delete the underlying assets or the members themselves.

asset_group_ids.description: IDs of the Asset Groups to delete. Currently, only one ID is allowed in the array.

operations.name: bc_asset_group_delete

operations.description: Gets the assets or members of an Asset Group in a Business Center. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center to use this endpoint.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions.

keyword.description: Keyword used to filter results. If `query_entity` is `ASSET`, you can use fuzzy search with asset-name-related keywords or exact search with an `asset_id`. If `query_entity` is `MEMBER`, you can use fuzzy search with user-name-related keywords or exact search with a `user_email`.

page.description: Page number. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default value: 10.

query_entity.description: The entity to query. `ASSET` returns assets in the asset group. `MEMBER` returns members in the asset group.

operations.name: bc_asset_group_get

operations.description: Retrieves all Asset Groups in a Business Center. The caller must be an Admin user of the Business Center.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions.

keyword.description: Exact-match keyword filter. You can currently filter only by `asset_group_name` or `asset_group_id` using this field.

page.description: Page number. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10 when omitted.

operations.name: bc_asset_group_list

operations.description: Updates an Asset Group's assets, members, or name via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset_group/update/`. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center to use this endpoint.

action.description: Operation to perform when updating assets or members. Required when `update_entity` is `ASSET` or `MEMBER`.

asset_group_id.description: ID of the Asset Group to update.

asset_group_name.description: New Asset Group name. Required when `update_entity` is `NAME`.

assets.description: List of assets to add or delete. Maximum 200 items. Required when `update_entity` is `ASSET`.

asset_id.description: Asset ID. When `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, this is the advertiser ID.

asset_type.description: Asset type. Currently only `ADVERTISER` is supported. If omitted, `ADVERTISER` is used by default.

members.description: List of members to add or delete. Maximum 50 items. Required when `update_entity` is `MEMBER`.

asset_roles.description: Roles to assign to the member by asset type. Key: asset type, currently only `ADVERTISER`. Value: assigned role: `ADVERTISER_ROLE_ADMIN` can manage ad account settings, finances, permissions, campaigns, and view performance; `ADVERTISER_ROLE_OPERATOR` can manage campaigns and view performance; `ADVERTISER_ROLE_ANALYST` can view performance only. Default: `"ADVERTISER: ADVERTISER_ROLE_ADMIN"`.

update_entity.description: Specifies what to update in the Asset Group. `ASSET` updates assets and requires `action` and `assets`; `MEMBER` updates members and requires `action` and `members`; `NAME` updates the group name and requires `asset_group_name`.

operations.name: bc_asset_group_update

operations.description: Gets the members who have access to a specified Business Center asset. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center to use this endpoint. Endpoint: `/open_api/v1.3/bc/asset/member/get/`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the endpoint path to `/v1.3/bc/asset/member/get/`, changes `bc_id` and `asset_id` request parameter types from number to string, changes `user_id` in the response from number to string, and adds the `business_account_roles` response field.

asset_id.description: Asset ID. Its required value depends on `asset_type`: if `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, this is the advertiser ID; if `CATALOG`, this is the catalog ID; if `LEAD`, this is the form library ID; if `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`, this is the ID of a TikTok account for Business Account management in a Business Center.

asset_type.description: Asset type. Determines the meaning of `asset_id`. Enum values: `ADVERTISER` for an ad account (advertiser account); `CATALOG` for a catalog; `LEAD` for leads; `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` for a TikTok account used for Business Account management, from which you can run ads and manage messages, leads, forms, comments, product links, and insights.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions.

page.description: Current page number.

page_size.description: Page size.

operations.name: bc_asset_member_get

operations.description: Gets the partners that a particular Business Center asset has been shared with. You must be an Admin user of the Business Center to use this endpoint. Endpoint: /v1.3/bc/asset/partner/get/. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses string types for `bc_id` and `asset_id` in the request, and returns `bc_id` as a string.

asset_id.description: Asset ID. When `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, this must be an ad account ID. When `asset_type` is `CATALOG`, this must be a catalog ID.

asset_type.description: Type of asset to query. `ADVERTISER` means the asset in `asset_id` must be an ad account ID. `CATALOG` means the asset in `asset_id` must be a catalog ID.

filtering.description: Optional filtering object for narrowing results by partner name keyword.

keyword.description: Partner name keyword to filter by. Required when `filtering` is provided.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

operations.name: bc_asset_partner_get

operations.description: Revokes a user's access to an asset in a Business Center. You must be a Business Center Admin user to use this endpoint. Endpoint: `/v1.3/bc/asset/unassign/`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses string data types for `bc_id`, `user_id`, and `asset_id`.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset to unassign. The expected ID type depends on `asset_type`: if `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, use the advertiser ID; if `CATALOG`, use the catalog ID; if `LEAD`, use the form library ID; if `TT_ACCOUNT`, use the ID of a TikTok account as an ad delivery asset in a Business Center; if `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT`, use the ID of a TikTok account for Business Account management in a Business Center.

asset_type.description: Type of asset to unassign. This field determines what `asset_id` must contain: `ADVERTISER` means an advertiser account ID; `CATALOG` means a catalog ID; `LEAD` means a form library ID; `TT_ACCOUNT` means the ID of a TikTok account used as an ad delivery asset in a Business Center and corresponds to identity type `BC_AUTH_TT`; `MANAGED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT` means the ID of a TikTok account used for Business Account management.

user_id.description: ID of the Business Center user whose access to the asset will be revoked. Obtain this value from `user_id` returned by `/bc/member/get/`.

operations.name: bc_asset_unassign

operations.description: Gets the balance information for a Business Center. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform payment-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/ to configure or update member access settings.

payment_portfolio_id.description: ID of the Payment Portfolio. To retrieve Payment Portfolios that belong to the same client as the Business Center, use /payment_portfolio/get/.

operations.name: bc_balance_get

operations.description: Gets the list of advertisers bound to a Billing Group. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can use billing group operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can retrieve this list; member access can be configured or updated through /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `billing_group_id` are strings, and returned `advertiser_id` values are also strings.

page.description: Page number. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: 1-50. Defaults to 10 if omitted.

operations.name: bc_billing_group_advertiser_list

operations.description: Creates a Billing Group in a Business Center using /open_api/v1.3/bc/billing_group/create/. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform billing-group operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; member access can be configured or updated via /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/. Starting March 31st, 2024, the Business Center API will no longer support reservation accounts or related billing group creation and management.

advertiser_ids.description: Ad account IDs to include in the billing group. The accounts should match the billing group's advertising type. For Auction ad accounts, add all Auction ad accounts to one Billing Group, except accounts registered in France, Brazil, or Mexico. For Reservation ad accounts, add one Reservation ad account to one Billing Group.

billing_group_emails.description: Email addresses for the billing group.

billing_group_type.description: The advertising type of all ad accounts in the billing group. This setting can not be edited. Enum values: AUCTION, RESERVATION(to be deprecated) Note: Starting March 31st, 2024, we're making all brand relevant campaign management processes fulfilled directly on TikTok Ads Manager. You'll manage all brand campaigns in one place - no more juggling between auction and reservation ads. This means our Business Center API won't support reservation account or related billing group creation and management anymore.

is_primary.description: Whether to set this billing group as the default billing group for the Business Center.

operations.name: bc_billing_group_create

operations.description: Retrieves all Billing Groups in a Business Center via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/billing_group/get/`. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform billing-group-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; member access can be configured or updated with `/bc/member/invite/` and `/bc/member/update/`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the billing groups to return.

billed_to_type.description: Filter by the billed-to party shown on invoices: `ACCOUNT` means invoices are billed to agencies; `ADVERTISER` means invoices are billed to advertisers.

billing_group_id.description: Billing Group ID to filter by.

billing_group_name.description: Billing Group name to filter by.

billing_group_type.description: Filter by the advertising type of all ad accounts in the billing group. This setting cannot be edited.

invoice_group_by.description: Filter by how invoices in the billing group are handled: `ACCOUNT` means invoices in the billing group are combined; `ADVERTISER` means invoices in the billing group are handled separately.

page.description: Page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: `1`-`50`. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

operations.name: bc_billing_group_get

operations.description: Updates the settings of a Business Center billing group at `/open_api/v1.3/bc/billing_group/update/`. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform billing-group operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; member access can be configured with `/bc/member/invite/` and `/bc/member/update/`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the path from `/v1.2/bc/billing_group/update/` to `/v1.3/bc/billing_group/update/`, renames `billing_group_name` to `new_billing_group_name` and `billing_group_emails` to `new_billing_group_emails`, and changes `bc_id`, `billing_group_id`, `add_advertiser_ids`, and `delete_advertiser_ids` from number types to string types.

add_advertiser_ids.description: List of ad account IDs to add to this billing group.

billing_group_id.description: ID of the billing group to edit.

delete_advertiser_ids.description: List of ad account IDs to remove from this billing group.

is_primary.description: Whether to set this billing group as the default billing group for the Business Center.

new_billing_group_emails.description: New list of emails for the billing group. If provided, this field uses full-replacement update mode and overwrites the billing group's existing email list; resubmit the complete list you want to keep.

new_billing_group_name.description: New name for the billing group.

operations.name: bc_billing_group_update

operations.description: Returns the list of Business Centers the authenticated user can access. Call GET /v1.3/bc/get/ with no `bc_id` to return the user's full Business Center list, or pass `bc_id` to return the specified Business Center. Compared with v1.2, the v1.3 endpoint path is `/v1.3/bc/get/`, `bc_id` changed from number to string in the request, the response identifier changed from `id` to `bc_id`, and `verification_status` was added to the response. Many tools require an advertiser_id ; when you need one, you can discover their advertiser_id under a Business Center by using the returned bc_id with bc_asset_get (set asset_type to ADVERTISER ).

bc_id.description: Business Center ID to query. If omitted, the API returns the authenticated user's entire Business Center list by default; if provided, it returns the specified Business Center account.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `10`. Valid range: `1`-`50`.

operations.name: bc_get

operations.description: Gets invoices for a Business Center account. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform invoice-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; member access can be configured with `/bc/member/invite/` and `/bc/member/update/`. In v1.3, the endpoint path changed to `/v1.3/bc/invoice/get/`, and the `bc_id` and `invoice_id` request parameter types changed from number to string.

end_time.description: End time of the invoice issuance range, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format, for example `2024-02-01 00:00:00`. You must specify both `start_time` and `end_time`, or neither.

invoice_types.description: Invoice types to filter by. Valid values are `RECON` (Reconciliation Invoice), `CREDIT` (Credit Invoice), and `AUTO_PAY` (Automatic Payment Invoice). `AUTO_PAY` cannot be used with other invoice types; to filter Automatic Payment Invoices, set `invoice_types` to `["AUTO_PAY"]`.

page.description: Page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Page size. Must be in the range `1`-`50`. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

pay_statuses.description: Payment statuses of the invoices. Valid values are `UNPAID`, `PAID`, `PARTIAL_PAID`, and `NO_NEED` (no need to pay).

start_time.description: Start time of the invoice issuance range, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format, for example `2024-01-01 00:00:00`. You must specify both `start_time` and `end_time`, or neither.

operations.name: bc_invoice_get

operations.description: Creates an asynchronous Business Center invoice download task. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform invoice-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/ to configure or update member access settings. After creating a task, use /bc/invoice/task/get/ to get the Excel file stream for BILLING_REPORT tasks, and /bc/invoice/task/list/ to get download URLs for BILLING_REPORT, INVOICE_LIST, and INVOICE_BATCH tasks.

download_type.description: Type of file to generate. `INVOICE_LIST` returns an invoice list in Excel format, with up to 100 invoices. `INVOICE_BATCH` returns a ZIP file containing uncompressed PDF invoices. `BILLING_REPORT` returns a detailed transaction report in Excel format. After task creation, use /bc/invoice/task/get/ to get the Excel file stream for `BILLING_REPORT`, and use /bc/invoice/task/list/ to get download URLs for `BILLING_REPORT`, `INVOICE_LIST`, and `INVOICE_BATCH` tasks.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the invoice download task.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID filter. Valid only when `download_type` is `INVOICE_LIST` or `INVOICE_BATCH`.

end_time.description: End date for the invoice issue date range, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (UTC+0).

start_time.description: Start date for the invoice issue date range, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (UTC+0).

invoice_id.description: Invoice ID. Required when `download_type` is `BILLING_REPORT`. Optional when `download_type` is `INVOICE_LIST` or `INVOICE_BATCH`, where it can be used as a filter.

operations.name: bc_invoice_task_create

operations.description: Checks whether a `BILLING_REPORT` asynchronous invoice download task has completed for a Business Center. If the task is completed, the response provides the downloadable file stream/URL for the Excel invoice file. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform invoice-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use `/bc/member/invite/` and `/bc/member/update/` to configure or update member access settings. In v1.3, both `bc_id` and `task_id` are strings (v1.2 used numbers).

task_id.description: Asynchronous download task ID for the `BILLING_REPORT` invoice export task. In v1.3 this value is a string; v1.2 used a number.

operations.name: bc_invoice_task_get

operations.description: Gets asynchronous Business Center invoice download tasks of type `BILLING_REPORT`, `INVOICE_LIST`, and `INVOICE_BATCH`. If a task has completed successfully, the response includes a download URL for the file. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform invoice-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use `/bc/member/invite/` and `/bc/member/update/` to configure or update member access settings.

page.description: Page number. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: 1-50. Default value: 10.

operations.name: bc_invoice_task_list

operations.description: Gets the total unpaid amount for a Business Center account. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can use invoice-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/ to configure or update member access. In v1.3, the `bc_id` request parameter type changed from number to string compared with v1.2.

invoice_type.description: Invoice type. Only `RECON` is supported for reconciliation invoices.

operations.name: bc_invoice_unpaid_get

operations.description: Deletes a member from a Business Center or revokes a pending member invitation. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. Endpoint path: /v1.3/bc/member/delete/. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `user_id` are strings.

user_email.description: Required when you want to revoke a member invitation for a user. Use /bc/member/get/ to obtain a valid invited member `user_email` from the returned `user_email` field.

user_id.description: Required when you want to remove an existing member from the Business Center. Use /bc/member/get/ to obtain a valid member `user_id` from the returned `user_id` field.

operations.name: bc_member_delete

operations.description: Gets members in a Business Center. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. If you need the assets assigned to a member, use `/bc/asset/get/` and pass either `user_id` or `user_email`. Version note: in v1.3 the endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/bc/member/get/` to `/v1.3/bc/member/get/`; `bc_id` changed from number to string in the request; and `user_id` changed from number to string in the response.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the member list.

relation_status.description: Filter by the user's relation status with the Business Center. `BOUND` means the request to manage the asset has been approved by the owner. `PENDING` means the request is still pending the owner's approval. `REJECTED` means the request was rejected by the owner.

user_role.description: Filter by the member's basic role in the Business Center. `ADMIN` means the member can manage the Business Center's members and assets. `STANDARD` means the member can only work on assigned ad accounts.

page.description: Current page number.

page_size.description: Page size. Maximum: 20.

operations.name: bc_member_get

operations.description: Invites users to a Business Center and optionally assigns Business Center roles, ad account access, and advanced finance roles. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. For each Business Center, the maximum number of members is 4000, and the maximum number of admins online is 20.

advertiser_role.description: Ad account role assigned to the invited users. Use with `asset_ids` when assigning ad account access. `ADMIN` can manage ad account finances, settings, permissions, create and edit campaigns, and view performance data. `OPERATOR` can manage finances, create and edit campaigns, and view performance data. `ANALYST` can view ads and performance data.

asset_ids.description: List of ad account IDs to assign to the invited users. Max size: 50. To obtain ad accounts within a Business Center, call /bc/asset/get/ with `asset_type` set to `ADVERTISER`.

emails.description: List of user email addresses to invite. Emails that have already been invited are ignored. Max size: 50.

ext_user_role.description: Advanced role settings within the Business Center.

finance_role.description: Finance role within the Business Center. `MANAGER` has full control of finance and payment features. `ANALYST` can view and download financial data.

user_role.description: Basic role within the Business Center. `ADMIN` gives full access to all Business Center features. `STANDARD` limits members to accounts or assets assigned to them.

operations.name: bc_member_invite

operations.description: Updates a Business Center member's user name, basic role, and optional advanced finance role in the Business Center. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. Endpoint: /v1.3/bc/member/update/. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `user_id` are strings; in v1.2 they were numbers.

ext_user_role.description: Optional advanced role settings for the user in the Business Center, in addition to the basic role.

finance_role.description: New finance role of the user. `ANALYST` can view, export, and download payment transaction records for all ad accounts owned or created by the Business Center. `MANAGER` includes all `ANALYST` permissions and can also make payments, top up ad accounts, and modify billing and invoicing contact information for all ad accounts owned or created by the Business Center.

user_id.description: User ID of the Business Center member to update.

user_role.description: New basic role for the user in this Business Center. `ADMIN` can manage the Business Center's members and assets. `STANDARD` can only work on the ad accounts they have been assigned to.

operations.name: bc_member_update

operations.description: Adds a partner Business Center to your Business Center and can optionally share assets that your Business Center owns with that partner. You must be an Admin of the Business Center, and a Business Center can share only assets it owns. Endpoint: `/v1.3/bc/partner/add/`. Version change from v1.2 to v1.3: `bc_id` and `partner_id` changed from number to string, and `asset_ids` changed from number[] to string[].

advertiser_role.description: Valid only when `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`. Specifies the ad account role assigned to the partner Business Center. `ADMIN` can manage ad account finances, settings, and permissions, create and edit ad campaigns, and view performance data. `OPERATOR` can manage finances, create and edit ad campaigns, and view performance data. `ANALYST` can view ads and performance data. If `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER` and this field is omitted, the default is `ANALYST`.

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to share with the partner Business Center. Maximum 50 items.

asset_type.description: Type of asset to share with the partner Business Center. Currently supports `ADVERTISER` for ad accounts.

partner_id.description: ID of the Business Center to add as a partner Business Center.

operations.name: bc_partner_add

operations.description: Cancels sharing of Business Center assets with a partner via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/partner/asset/delete/`. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses string types for `bc_id` and `partner_id`, and `string[]` for `asset_ids`.

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to stop sharing with the partner. The accepted ID type depends on `asset_type`: if `asset_type` is `ADVERTISER`, provide advertiser IDs; if `TT_ACCOUNT`, provide TikTok account IDs in a Business Center; if `TIKTOK_SHOP`, provide TikTok Shop IDs; if `CATALOG`, provide catalog IDs; if `LEAD`, provide form library IDs; if `PIXEL`, provide Pixel IDs. If `asset_type` is `LEAD`, only one form library ID is allowed.

operations.name: bc_partner_asset_delete

operations.description: Gets assets shared between your Business Center and a partner Business Center, including assets you shared with the partner and assets the partner shared with you. You must be a Business Center Admin to use this endpoint. Endpoint: `/v1.3/bc/partner/asset/get/`. In v1.3, `bc_id`, `partner_id`, and returned `asset_id` use string types; compared with v1.2, v1.3 also adds the `advertiser_account_type` response field.

filtering.description: Optional filtering criteria for the asset list.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

share_type.description: Which sharing direction to query: `SHARED` returns assets shared with you by a partner; `SHARING` returns assets that you share with a partner.

operations.name: bc_partner_asset_get

operations.description: Deletes a partner Business Center relationship from a Business Center. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. In v1.3, both `bc_id` and `partner_id` are strings; in v1.2 they were numbers.

partner_id.description: Partner Business Center ID to remove from the specified `bc_id`.

operations.name: bc_partner_delete

operations.description: Gets the list of partners for a Business Center. You must be an Admin of the Business Center to use this endpoint. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/bc/partner/get/` (previously `/v1.2/bc/partner/get/`), the filter parameter changed from `keyword` to `name`, and `bc_id` changed from number to string in both the request and response.

filtering.description: Filter object for partner names. If provided, include `name` to return only partners whose names match the keyword.

name.description: Partner name keyword used within `filtering` to filter the results by partner name.

page.description: Current page number.

page_size.description: Page size.

operations.name: bc_partner_get

operations.description: Gets the list of ad accounts linked to the specified pixel. Endpoint: /v1.3/bc/pixel/link/get/. Version note: compared with v1.2, the path changed from /v1.2/bc/pixel/link/get/ to /v1.3/bc/pixel/link/get/, and the `bc_id` request parameter type changed from number to string.

pixel_code.description: Pixel code for the pixel whose linked ad accounts you want to retrieve.

operations.name: bc_pixel_link_get

operations.description: Links a pixel to ad accounts or unlinks a pixel from ad accounts through `/open_api/v1.3/bc/pixel/link/update/`. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `advertiser_ids` use string types; in v1.2 they were number and number[] respectively.

advertiser_ids.description: List of advertiser IDs whose relationship to the pixel will be updated.

pixel_code.description: Pixel code of the pixel to link or unlink.

relation_status.description: Whether to create or remove the relationship between the pixel and the specified ad accounts: `LINK` links the pixel to the advertisers in `advertiser_ids`; `UNLINK` removes the link.

operations.name: bc_pixel_link_update

operations.description: Transfers a pixel to a Business Center (BC) using POST /open_api/v1.3/bc/pixel/transfer/. To transfer successfully, if the destination is an Agency BC, the request must be made by an admin user of that Agency BC and the ad account originally tied to the pixel must be owned by that Agency BC. If the destination is a Direct BC, that Direct BC must have admin permission for the ad account originally tied to the pixel. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/bc/pixel/transfer/ to /v1.3/bc/pixel/transfer/, and the `bc_id` request parameter type changed from number to string.
