bc_id.description: Required. The BC ID to transfer the pixel to. In v1.3, this value is a string; in v1.2, `bc_id` was a number.

pixel_code.description: Required. The pixel code of the pixel to transfer to the BC.

operations.name: bc_pixel_transfer

operations.description: Retrieves transaction records for a Business Center via `/open_api/v1.3/bc/transaction/get/`. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can perform payment-related operations. Only users with Finance Manager or Finance Analyst permission can manage payments and invoices in a Business Center; use `/bc/member/invite/` and `/bc/member/update/` to configure or update member access settings.

end_date.description: End date for transaction records, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. If omitted, defaults to today.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the transaction query.

funds_type.description: Fund type filter. If omitted, both fund types are returned. Accepted values: `FUNDS_TYPE_CASH` (cash) and `FUNDS_TYPE_GRANT` (non-cash).

page.description: Page number.

page_size.description: Page size. Valid range: 1-50.

start_date.description: Start date for transaction records, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. If omitted, defaults to the date 90 days earlier.

operations.name: bc_transaction_get

operations.description: Processes a Business Center payment transfer: recharge money to or deduct money from an ad account in a Business Center, or increase or decrease the credit balance of a Business Center. Both Agency and Direct Business Centers can use this endpoint. Only users with Finance Manager permission can process a payment; member permissions can be configured with /bc/member/invite/ and /bc/member/update/.

advertiser_id.description: Ad account ID. Required when `transfer_level` is `ADVERTISER` or omitted.

amount_info.description: Details of the amount to process. Valid only when `transfer_level` is `ADVERTISER`. You must specify one of `amount_info`, `cash_amount`, or `grant_amount`. If `amount_info` is provided, top-level `cash_amount` and `grant_amount` are ignored.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. When `transfer_level` is `BC`, this must be the ID of a Business Center that has enabled Monthly Invoicing.

cash_amount.description: Rounded to two decimal places. You must specify one of `amount_info`, `cash_amount`, or `grant_amount`. If Balance Sharing is enabled and `transfer_level` is `ADVERTISER`, this field is not supported. When `transfer_level` is `ADVERTISER` or omitted, this is the cash amount to process. When `transfer_level` is `BC` or omitted, this is the credit amount to process. Value must be > 0. If `transfer_type` is `RECHARGE` and you specify a cash amount for an ad account transfer, a minimum transferable amount applies; get it from `/advertiser/balance/get/` in `min_transferable_amount.cash_amount`.

grant_amount.description: Voucher amount to process, rounded to two decimal places. You must specify one of `amount_info`, `cash_amount`, or `grant_amount`. When `transfer_level` is `BC`, this field is not supported. Value must be > 0.

payment_portfolio_id.description: Payment Portfolio ID. Required if multiple Payment Portfolios belong to the same client as the Business Center specified by `bc_id`.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for the transfer request. Valid only when `transfer_level` is `BC` or `ADVERTISER`. If you retry the same request with the same `request_id`, only one request succeeds. This is different from the response `request_id`, which uniquely identifies the HTTP request. When `transfer_level` is `BC`, the value should be a 32-bit string. When `transfer_level` is `ADVERTISER`, the value should be a 32-bit string and idempotency is guaranteed for a 30-minute window. Idempotency for ad account-level transfers using `request_id` is currently an allowlist-only feature.

transfer_level.description: Transfer level. `ADVERTISER` recharges money to or deducts money from an ad account. `BC` increases or decreases the credit balance of the Business Center; when `transfer_level` is `BC`, you must provide in `bc_id` a Business Center ID with Monthly Invoicing enabled. Default: `ADVERTISER`.

transfer_type.description: How to process the payment. `RECHARGE` recharges money to an ad account or increases the credit balance of a Business Center. `REFUND` deducts money from an ad account or decreases the credit balance of a Business Center.

operations.name: bc_transfer

operations.description: Checks whether each word in a provided list is blocked for the specified advertiser. Endpoint path: /v1.3/blockedword/check/. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and response fields changed from `blocked_word`/`existed` to `word`/`blocked`.

blocked_words.description: List of words to check for blocked status.

operations.name: blockedword_check

operations.description: Adds words to an ad account's blocked word list. Each ad account can have up to 500 blocked words. Endpoint: /v1.3/blockedword/create/. Compared with v1.2, in v1.3 the `advertiser_id` request parameter type changed from number to string.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID for the ad account whose blocked word list you want to update.

blocked_words.description: List of words to add to the blocked word list. The ad account can have up to 500 blocked words total.

operations.name: blockedword_create

operations.description: Deletes one or more words from an advertiser's blocked-word list at /v1.3/blockedword/delete/. After a blocked word is deleted, comments containing that word become public instead of being visible only to the commenter. Compared with v1.2, this v1.3 endpoint changed the path from /v1.2/blockedword/delete/ to /v1.3/blockedword/delete/, and changed `advertiser_id` from number to string.

blocked_words.description: List of blocked words to delete. If you try to delete a word that is not currently on the blocked-word list, the API does not return an error.

operations.name: blockedword_delete

operations.description: Gets the list of blocked words for an ad account from /v1.3/blockedword/list/. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, `page_info` was added as a request parameter, and the response field name changed from `content` to `bw_content`.

page_info.description: Pagination settings for the blocked word list request.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `10`. Valid range: `1` to `500`.

operations.name: blockedword_list_get

operations.description: Checks the status of a blocked word export task. When the task status indicates completion, call /blockedword/task/download/ to download the exported data. In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/blockedword/task/check/ and `advertiser_id` changed from number in v1.2 to string in v1.3.

task_id.description: Task ID of the blocked word export task to check.

operations.name: blockedword_task_check

operations.description: Creates a blocked word export task for an advertiser. After creating the task, use /blockedword/task/check/ to check task status, and when the task completes, use /blockedword/task/download/ to download the exported data. In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/blockedword/task/create/; compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string and `lang` was renamed to `language`.

blocked_words.description: List of blocked words to export. If omitted, all blocked words are exported. Unblocked words included in this field are ignored; if you provide both blocked and unblocked words here, only the blocked words are exported.

lang.description: Language for the headers in the exported data. Defaults to `EN` if omitted.

operations.name: blockedword_task_create

operations.description: Downloads the exported blocked words file after an export task completes. The response is a CSV file. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/blockedword/task/download/` and `advertiser_id` must be sent as a string; in v1.2, the path was `/v1.2/blockedword/task/download/` and `advertiser_id` was a number.

task_id.description: ID of the completed export task whose blocked words CSV file you want to download.

operations.name: blockedword_task_download

operations.description: Replaces an existing blocked word with a new word for the specified advertiser. Endpoint: /v1.3/blockedword/update/. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string.

old_word.description: Existing blocked word to be replaced.

operations.name: blockedword_update

operations.description: Checks the result of an asynchronous campaign copy task created by /campaign/copy/task/create/. TikTok recommends waiting about one minute after creating the task before calling this endpoint. The Asynchronous Campaign Copy API is allowlist-only; contact your TikTok representative for access. Rate limits for this endpoint are 2 queries per second (QPS) and 60 queries per minute (QPM) per developer app, and global rate limits do not apply to this endpoint.

task_id.description: ID of the asynchronous campaign copy task returned by /campaign/copy/task/create/.

operations.name: campaign_copy_task_check

operations.description: Creates an asynchronous task to copy one campaign at a time. After creating the task, use /campaign/copy/task/check/ to check the result. This API is allowlist-only; contact your TikTok representative for access. Rate limits for this endpoint are 1 QPS and 30 QPM per developer app, and global rate limits do not apply. The source campaign cannot be a Smart+ campaign; must have at least one undeleted ad group with at least one undeleted ad; should not exceed 20 undeleted ad groups with up to 50 undeleted ads per ad group; and cannot include ACO ad groups, though Smart Creative ad groups are supported. You cannot copy GMV Max campaigns with customized TikTok posts; check /campaign/gmv_max/info/ and confirm `custom_anchor_video_list` is `[]`. You cannot copy iOS Dedicated Campaigns whose apps have not activated the SAN module on your MMP. Starting September 30, 2024, campaigns containing Playable Ads delivered to TikTok placement can no longer be copied. Only campaigns with objectives `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS` are supported; for `ENGAGEMENT`, ad groups with `promotion_type` = `LIVE_SHOPPING` or `optimization_goal` = `PAGE_VISIT` cannot be copied. If the campaign contains ad groups bound to a split test, only the ad groups are copied; split test groups are not created.

adgroup_list.description: Ignored when `deep_copy_mode` is `DEFAULT` or omitted. Required when `deep_copy_mode` is `CUSTOM`. Customized settings for ad groups in the new campaign. Max size 20.

ad_list.description: Ignored when `deep_copy_mode` is `DEFAULT` or omitted. Required when `deep_copy_mode` is `CUSTOM` and the source `adgroup_id` is a non-ACO, non-Smart Creative ad group. If you do not want to customize the generated ads, pass only `ad_id` in each object. If you do want customization, pass `ad_id` plus the other desired ad fields. Max size 50.

ad_format.description: Ad format. If you want to copy the original ad into a TikTok Standard Carousel ad, this field is required and must be `CAROUSEL_ADS`. If you want to copy a TikTok Standard Carousel ad into a single video or single image ad, this field is also required.

ad_id.description: Required when `ad_list` is passed. ID of the ad to copy; it must belong to `adgroup_id`.

ad_name.description: Name of the new ad. Max length 512 characters; emojis are not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters and each English letter counts as 1. If omitted, defaults to `"COPIED_{{name_of_the_original_ad}}_{{ID_of_the_original_ad}}"`; for example, `"COPIED_FIRST_AD_1234567891234567"`.

ad_text.description: Ad text shown as part of the creative. Max length 100 characters; emojis are not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters and each English letter counts as 1.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Whether to turn on AIGC self-disclosure so the ad is labeled as AI-generated when viewed in full. Default is `NOT_DECLARED`.

creative_auto_enhancement_strategy_list.description: Automatic enhancement strategies to apply in real time during delivery. Default behavior depends on your allowlist status for the feature that enables strategies by default. If allowlisted for specific strategies, the field defaults to those strategies; otherwise it defaults to `[]`. Automatic enhancements are available to all advertisers, but having them turned on by default is a separate allowlist-only feature per enhancement.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. ID of the Business Center associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. If you are not using Spark Ads, `identity_id` with `identity_type` = `CUSTOMIZED_USER` can be used for better ad management.

identity_type.description: Identity type.

image_ids.description: Image IDs used in an ad or as a video cover.

music_id.description: ID of the music to use in a TikTok Carousel Ad.

operation_status.description: Status of the new ad when created. Default is `ENABLE`. To change status later, use /ad/status/update/.

tiktok_item_id.description: ID of the TikTok post to use as a Spark Ad. Pass the `item_id` returned by /tt_video/info/ or /identity/video/get/. By using Spark Ads, you confirm that you have rights to use the music in the video for commercial purposes.

tracking_app_id.description: Application ID used to track offsite app events. Supported for Auction objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `ENGAGEMENT`. If ad-group-level `app_id` is specified and you want to track offsite app events, this value must be the same as that ad-group-level `app_id`; otherwise you may pass any app ID you want to track.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Pixel ID used to track offsite events. Supported for Auction objectives `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `ENGAGEMENT`. If ad-group-level `pixel_id` is specified and you want to use pixel tracking for offsite events, `tracking_pixel_id` must be the same as that ad-group-level `pixel_id`; otherwise you may pass any pixel ID you want to track.

video_id.description: Video ID. If you want to create Spark Ads, you can use either `video_id` or `tiktok_item_id`.

adgroup_id.description: Required when `adgroup_list` is passed. ID of the ad group to copy; it must belong to `campaign_id`. If the source ad group is non-ACO and non-Smart Creative, you must specify `ad_list` in the same object. If the source ad group is Smart Creative, `ad_list` is not required, but you may pass `smart_creative_info` to customize the creatives used for the new ad group. Starting July 19, 2025, ad groups using TikTok Lite subplacement (`TIKTOK_LITE`) can no longer be created or copied. Starting November 30, 2024, you can no longer create or copy ad groups with optimization goal "Install with in-app event" on TikTok placement or Automatic Placement when the campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, the ad group `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` with a valid `secondary_optimization_event`, and `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` = `["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`. Existing such ad groups on TikTok placement are unaffected, and Pangle or Global App Bundle only placements are unaffected. You also cannot copy ad groups whose apps have not activated the SAN module on your MMP.

adgroup_name.description: Name of the new ad group. Max length 512 characters; emojis are not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters and each English letter counts as 1. If omitted, defaults to the original ad group name.

age_groups.description: Targeted age groups for the new ad group. In some cases, targeting `AGE_13_17` is not allowed in the US, Latin America, the European Economic Area, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada. If you use targeting options unsupported for `AGE_13_17` in those regions and omit `age_groups` or set it to `[]`, the field defaults to `["AGE_18_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_44", "AGE_45_54", "AGE_55_100"]`. If the ad group targets `AGE_13_17` in those regions and you would otherwise omit this field or pass `[]`, TikTok recommends explicitly specifying the exact age groups you want to target.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to target for the new ad group.

automated_keywords_enabled.description: Valid only when campaign-level `is_search_campaign` is `true`. Whether to enable automated keywords so the system can generate keywords after ads are added. Supported values are `true` and `false`. Default is `false`. This is an allowlist-only feature for Search Ads Campaigns.

budget.description: Budget for the new ad group.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude for the new ad group.

location_ids.description: Targeted location IDs for the new ad group. Max size 3,000. If both `location_ids` and `zipcode_ids` are provided, the combined total of location IDs, zip code IDs, and postal code IDs cannot exceed 3,000 per ad group. Overlapping targeted locations are not supported, for example targeting both the US and California. If you target US locations through `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you may later update them to other US locations but cannot remove all US locations and target only non-US countries. If you copy an existing ad group with `TIKTOK_LITE` in `tiktok_subplacements`, you cannot exclude Japan and South Korea from the new ad group's `location_ids`.

operation_status.description: Status of the new ad group when created. Default is `ENABLE`. To change status later, use /adgroup/status/update/.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` inside the `adgroup_list` item is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Not supported when `schedule_type` inside the `adgroup_list` item is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. End time (UTC+0) for the new ad group, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`. Cannot be later than `"2038-01-01 00:00:00"`.

schedule_start_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` inside the `adgroup_list` item is provided. Start time (UTC+0) for the new ad group, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`. Can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but not later than `"2028-01-01 00:00:00"`.

schedule_type.description: Required when you want to customize schedule settings for this ad group. When set to `SCHEDULE_START_END`, you must also provide both `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`. When set to `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`, you must provide `schedule_start_time`, and the end time is automatically set to 10 years later.

smart_creative_info.description: Ignored when `deep_copy_mode` is `DEFAULT` or omitted. Optional when `deep_copy_mode` is `CUSTOM` and the source `adgroup_id` is a Smart Creative ad group. Omit this field to generate ads from the same creatives as the original ad group, or pass it to customize the creatives used for the new Smart Creative ad group. Smart Creative is supported only when campaign-level `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`.

call_to_action_list.description: Call-to-action list. Max size 3. For TikTok ads, either this field or `call_to_action_id` must be specified. If both are specified, this field is ignored.

call_to_action.description: Required when `call_to_action_list` is passed. Call-to-action text.

card_list.description: List of creative portfolio IDs. Max size 1.

card_id.description: Creative portfolio ID for one of these types: Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, Display Card, or Download Card.

common_material.description: Common material shared across generated ads.

ad_name.description: Ad name. Max length 512 characters; emojis are not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters and each English letter counts as 1. Set to `""` to auto-generate the name in the format creative name + creation time, for example `adcreative20210111190739`. If you do not specify an ad name here, you cannot later change the name via /ad/aco/update/.

call_to_action_id.description: CTA portfolio ID to use in the ads. If both this field and `call_to_action_list` are specified, `call_to_action_list` is ignored.

creative_authorized.description: Whether to allow some of your ads to be displayed in TikTok for Business Creative Center. Valid only for non-US advertisers. Default is `false`. Can be used only for video ads.

fallback_type.description: Fallback behavior when the audience does not have the app installed. If set to `WEBSITE`, you must also specify `landing_page_urls`. Not applicable for deferred deeplinks.

identity_id.description: Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Identity type.

playable_url.description: Playable material URL. Valid only for Pangle placement. All ads in the same ad group share the same playable material.

click_tracking_urls.description: Click tracking URL from your data partner. Pass only one URL. If the partner ID for the tracked app (`app_id` at ad-group level) is `44` (TikTok Business SDK) or `49` (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field and any provided value is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for that app and the partner ID is not `44` or `49`, you do not need to pass this field because it defaults to the app's configured Click Tracking URL, and updates are not supported. Pangle does not support DCM, Sizmek, or Flashtalking.

impression_tracking_urls.description: Default impression tracking URL from your data partner. Pass only one URL. If the partner ID for the tracked app (`app_id` at ad-group level) is `44` (TikTok Business SDK) or `49` (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field and any provided value is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for that app and the partner ID is not `44` or `49`, you do not need to pass this field because it defaults to the app's configured Default Impression Tracking URL, and updates are not supported.

tracking_app_id.description: App ID used to track offsite app events. Supported for Auction objectives `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `APP_PROMOTION`. If ad-group-level `app_id` is specified and you want to track offsite app events, this value must match that ad-group-level `app_id`; otherwise you may pass any app ID you want to track.

tracking_offline_event_set_ids.description: Offline Event Set IDs to track and measure offline activity from people who see or interact with your ads. Max size 50. This is an allowlist-only feature. If allowlisted, existing auto-tracking Offline Event Sets must be tracked under a newly created ad. If you omit this field, it defaults to all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs under the advertiser account. If you pass this field manually, you must include at least all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs; non-auto-tracking IDs are optional. Supported objectives are `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS`.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Pixel ID used to track offsite events. Supported for Auction objectives `TRAFFIC`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `APP_PROMOTION`. If ad-group-level `pixel_id` is specified and you want to use pixel tracking for offsite events, this value must match that ad-group-level `pixel_id`; otherwise you may pass any pixel ID you want to track.

deeplink.description: Specific in-app location to send users to if they have the app installed.

deeplink_type.description: Deeplink type. Default is `NORMAL`. Deferred deeplinks are not supported in Dedicated Campaigns; if the campaign `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, you cannot set this field to `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`.

display_name_list.description: List of display names. Each item can include only one `app_name` or `landing_page_name`.

app_name.description: App name shown in the ad. If omitted, the App Store name is used. Max length 40 characters.

landing_page_name.description: Display name of the landing page. Max length 40 characters.

landing_page_urls.description: Required when `fallback_type` is `WEBSITE`. List of landing page URLs. Max size 1.

landing_page_url.description: Required when `landing_page_urls` is passed. Landing page URL.

media_info_list.description: Required when `smart_creative_info` is passed. List of media information. Max size 30.

media_info.description: Required when `media_info_list` is passed. Material information.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Whether to turn on AIGC self-disclosure so the ad is labeled as AI-generated when viewed in full. Default is `NOT_DECLARED`.

identity_id.description: Required when `tiktok_item_id` is passed. Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Required when `tiktok_item_id` is passed. Identity type.

image_info.description: Image information. When `video_info` is not included, this is used as image material. When `video_info` is included, this is used as the video cover. Only one picture can be submitted in each `image_info` object.

file_name.description: Image name. Max length 100 characters. If image materials are used, this name is used to form the ad name.

web_uri.description: Required when `image_info` is passed. Image ID. When `video_info` is not included, `image_info` provides the image material. When `video_info` is included, `image_info` is used as the video cover. Only one picture can be submitted in each `image_info` object.

tiktok_item_id.description: TikTok post ID to use as a Spark Ad. Pass the value obtained from /tt_video/info/ or /identity/video/get/. Once you pass `tiktok_item_id`, you do not need to pass `image_info`, `video_info`, or `title_list`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm that you have rights to use the music in the video for commercial purposes.

file_name.description: Video name. Max length 100 characters. If video materials are used, this name is used to form the ad name.

video_id.description: Required when `video_info` is passed. Video ID.

page_list.description: List of page IDs. Max size 3.

page_id.description: Required when `page_list` is passed. Page ID.

title_list.description: List of ad titles shown as part of the creative. Max size 5.

title.description: Required when `title_list` is passed. Ad title (ad text). Must be 12-40 characters and cannot contain emojis. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters and each English letter counts as 1.

zipcode_ids.description: Targeted zip code or postal code IDs for the new ad group. Max size 3,000. If both `location_ids` and `zipcode_ids` are provided, the combined total of location IDs, zip code IDs, and postal code IDs cannot exceed 3,000 per ad group. Valid only for supported geographies: zip codes for the US, and postal codes for Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Postal code targeting in Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam is allowlist-only. You cannot use zip code targeting when the campaign has special ad categories (`special_industries`), cannot use zip code or postal code targeting when `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`, and can use zip/postal code targeting only on TikTok placement, so `placements` must include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Overlapping targeted locations are not supported. If you target US locations through `location_ids` or `zipcode_ids`, you may later update them to other US locations but cannot remove all US locations and target only non-US countries.

budget.description: Budget for the new campaign. If omitted, defaults to the original campaign's budget.

campaign_id.description: ID of the source campaign to copy. You cannot copy GMV Max campaigns with customized TikTok posts; check /campaign/gmv_max/info/ and confirm `custom_anchor_video_list` is `[]`. You cannot copy iOS Dedicated Campaigns whose apps have not activated the SAN module on your MMP. Starting September 30, 2024, campaigns containing Playable Ads delivered to TikTok placement can no longer be copied. Only campaigns with objectives `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS` are supported. For `ENGAGEMENT`, ad groups with `promotion_type` = `LIVE_SHOPPING` or `optimization_goal` = `PAGE_VISIT` cannot be copied. Smart+ campaigns are not supported. The source campaign must have at least one undeleted ad group with at least one undeleted ad, should not exceed 20 undeleted ad groups with up to 50 undeleted ads per ad group, and cannot include ACO ad groups, though Smart Creative ad groups are supported. If the campaign contains ad groups bound to a split test, only the ad groups are copied; split test groups are not created.

campaign_name.description: Name of the new campaign. Max length 512 characters; emojis are not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters and each English letter counts as 1. If omitted, defaults to `"COPIED_{{name_of_the_original_campaign}}"`.

deep_copy_mode.description: Copy mode. Default is `DEFAULT`. `DEFAULT` copies all undeleted ad groups and ads from the original campaign and ignores `adgroup_list`. `CUSTOM` copies only the specified undeleted ad groups and ads, and requires `adgroup_list`. In `CUSTOM`, you can copy at most 20 ad groups and 50 ads per ad group.

is_advanced_dedicated_campaign.description: Whether to enable Advanced Dedicated Campaign for the new campaign. If omitted, the copied campaign inherits this setting from the original campaign. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

operation_status.description: Status of the new campaign when created. Default is `DISABLE`. To change status later, use /campaign/status/update/.

po_number.description: PO (purchase order) number for invoice tracking and reconciliation.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for preventing duplicate submissions. If you retry with the same value within the 10-second cache window, only one request succeeds. After the cache expires, the same value is treated as a new request. This is different from the response `request_id`, which identifies the HTTP request. Must be a string representation of a 64-bit integer, for example `"123456789"`.

rta_id.description: Realtime API (RTA) strategy ID. This is an allowlist-only feature; you must complete RTA onboarding to receive and respond to RTA requests, and available IDs are obtained through your TikTok representative.

sales_destination.description: Required and valid only when `virtual_objective_type` is specified. Sales destination for the new campaign. `APP` requires a product catalog.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when top-level `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Not supported when top-level `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. Shared end time (UTC+0) for all new ad groups, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`. Cannot be later than `"2038-01-01 00:00:00"`.

schedule_start_time.description: Required when top-level `schedule_type` is provided. Shared start time (UTC+0) for all new ad groups, format `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`. Can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but not later than `"2028-01-01 00:00:00"`.

schedule_type.description: Use this only when you want the same schedule for all new ad groups. If you want per-ad-group schedules, specify `schedule_type` inside each `adgroup_list` item instead. When set to `SCHEDULE_START_END`, you must also provide both `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`. When set to `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`, you must provide `schedule_start_time`, and the end time is automatically set to 10 years later.

virtual_objective_type.description: New objective type. Use this field to create the copied campaign with the Sales objective, which combines Website Conversions and Product Sales.

operations.name: campaign_copy_task_create

operations.description:
Creates a campaign at /open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/. Each ad account can have up to 999 campaigns, and a campaign can contain one or more ad groups. Review the v1.2 to v1.3 migration differences before upgrading; v1.3 renames `budget_optimize_switch` to `budget_optimize_on`, `industry_types` to `special_industries`, changes `advertiser_id` from number to string, adds fields such as `app_id`, `campaign_type`, `app_promotion_type`, `campaign_app_profile_page_state`, `rf_campaign_type`, `request_id`, `campaign_product_source`, `postback_window_mode`, `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign`, `rta_id`, `rta_product_selection_enabled`, `disable_skan_campaign`, `catalog_enabled`, `rta_bid_enabled`, `virtual_objective_type`, `sales_destination`, `is_search_campaign`, and `po_number`, and deprecates `budget_optimize_switch`, `bid_type`, `deep_bid_type`, `roas_bid`, and `optimize_goal`. By using this endpoint, you agree to TikTok's Online Data Terms, including the Business Products (Data) Terms and Controller to Controller Data Terms. Allowlist- or eligibility-gated features documented here include App Pre-Registration, Website and App Optimization with `sales_destination=WEB_AND_APP`, Search Ads Campaigns, TikTok Pulse (`rf_campaign_type=PULSE`), Product Sales campaigns, disabling SKAN attribution for Dedicated Campaigns, RTA, certain special-ad-category shopping scenarios, and some CBO / dynamic daily budget cases. Post-creation immutability applies to fields including `is_search_campaign`, `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign`, `disable_skan_campaign`, `rf_campaign_type`, `catalog_enabled`, and `postback_window_mode`. This endpoint also has cross-API prerequisites in some flows: app IDs and advanced dedicated campaign eligibility come from `/app/list/`; campaign status can later be changed with `/campaign/status/update/`; Reach & Frequency Pulse campaigns require compatible ad group configuration in `/adgroup/rf/create/` and `/adgroup/rf/update/`.E-commerce Partner plugin connects e-commerce platforms / website such Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Adobe Real-time CDP, nuvemshop, Tray store，Cafe 24，ECWID_RESELLER  (includes but not limited to these).

app_id.description: Required when `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN` and either `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`, or `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` with `app_promotion_type=APP_INSTALL`. Application ID of the promoted app. You cannot use an app that has not activated the SAN module on your MMP to create iOS Dedicated Campaigns.

app_promotion_type.description: Required when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`. App promotion type. `APP_INSTALL` gets new users to install your app and can be used in an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign. `APP_RETARGETING` re-engages existing users and cannot be used in an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign. `APP_PREREGISTRATION` gets new users to pre-register before launch and also cannot be used in an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign. App Pre-Registration is allowlist-only.

budget.description: Required when `budget_mode` is `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`, `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`, or `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`. Campaign budget.

budget_mode.description: Required when `objective_type` is not `RF_REACH`. When `objective_type=RF_REACH`, only `BUDGET_MODE_INFINITE` is supported. If `budget_optimize_on=true`, supported values are `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`, and `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`. `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` is the average daily budget over a week; daily costs do not exceed 125% of the average daily budget and weekly costs do not exceed average daily budget × 7. When `objective_type` is `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `PRODUCT_SALES` (Video Shopping Ads only), `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, use `BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET` for a non-lifetime budget. Dynamic daily budget for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT` is allowlist-only. If `budget_optimize_on` is not enabled, supported values are `BUDGET_MODE_INFINITE`, `BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL`, and `BUDGET_MODE_DAY`; for non-CBO campaigns, `BUDGET_MODE_DAY` is deprecated for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT`.

budget_optimize_on.description: Whether to enable Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO). Supported value: `true`. CBO for Video Shopping Ads with product source `CATALOG` is allowlist-only.

campaign_app_profile_page_state.description: Whether to use App Profile Page to optimize delivery. Valid only when `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and the campaign is an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign; otherwise an error occurs. Default: `OFF`.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name. Maximum 512 characters. Emoji is not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one character.

campaign_product_source.description: Required when `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`. Product source of the campaign. `CATALOG` uses catalog. `STORE` uses TikTok Shop or TikTok Showcase. Product Sales is allowlist-only. For Video Shopping Ads, this setting determines allowed ad-group `product_source`: if `CATALOG`, ad groups must use `CATALOG`; if `STORE`, ad groups must use `STORE` or `SHOWCASE`.

campaign_type.description: Campaign type. `IOS14_CAMPAIGN` supports `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES` and `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` only when `app_promotion_type=APP_INSTALL`. If `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING` or `APP_PREREGISTRATION`, `campaign_type` can only be `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`. For iOS Dedicated Campaigns with other objectives, use `REGULAR_CAMPAIGN`.

catalog_enabled.description: Whether to use your catalog to automatically advertise relevant products or services. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default: `false`. Set to `true` only for Automotive Ads for Inventory or Automotive Ads for Models. If `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES` and `campaign_product_source=CATALOG`, this field is overwritten to `true`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

disable_skan_campaign.description: Valid only when all of the following are true: `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `app_promotion_type=APP_INSTALL`, `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, and `app_id` is an eligible iOS app whose `/app/list/` result has `advanced_dedicated_campaign_allowed`. `true` disables SKAN attribution, removes Dedicated Campaign quota limits, and enables SAN metrics but not SKAN reporting metrics; for an app eligible for Advanced Dedicated Campaigns, you must enable SKAN attribution or Advanced Dedicated Campaign or both, so you cannot disable SKAN attribution and Advanced Dedicated Campaign simultaneously. `false` enables SKAN attribution, applies Dedicated Campaign quota limits, and enables SKAN metrics; if `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign=true` at the same time, both SAN and SKAN reporting metrics are available. Disabling SKAN attribution for Dedicated Campaigns is allowlist-only. If you are allowlisted for disabling SKAN attribution for Dedicated Campaigns, you cannot set ad-group-level `bid_type` to `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` when `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign=false`, `disable_skan_campaign=false`, and ad-group-level `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` or `IN_APP_EVENT`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

is_advanced_dedicated_campaign.description: Whether the campaign is an Advanced Dedicated Campaign. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default: `false`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

is_search_campaign.description: Whether to create a Search Ads Campaign. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Search Ads Campaigns are allowlist-only. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective.

operation_status.description: Status of the campaign when created. Default: `ENABLE`. For Reach & Frequency campaigns, set `operation_status` to `ENABLE` or omit it; do not set `DISABLE`. To update campaign status after creation, use `/campaign/status/update/`.

po_number.description: PO number for invoice tracking and reconciliation.

postback_window_mode.description: Valid only when `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN` and `operation_status=DISABLE`. You can set this when creating a disabled campaign or when disabling an existing campaign through `/campaign/status/update/`; the recommended practice is to set it when disabling an existing campaign. `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1` secures the first SKAN 4.0 postback (0-2 day attribution window) and releases quota after up to 4 days. `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE2` secures the first two postbacks (3-7 day attribution window) and releases quota after up to 13 days. `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE3` secures all three postbacks (8-35 day attribution window) and releases quota after up to 41 days. Once set, this field cannot be updated. If `operation_status=ENABLE` or is omitted, this field is ignored. If passed when SKAN 4.0 is not enabled for the app in `app_id`, an error occurs. If omitted while `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, `operation_status=DISABLE`, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app, it defaults to `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1`. If SKAN 4.0 is enabled for your app, target iOS 16.1+ devices at the ad group level by setting `min_ios_version` to `16.1` to receive SKAN 4.0 postbacks.

request_id.description: Request ID that lets you create campaigns with duplicate names and provides idempotency. To create campaigns with the same `campaign_name`, send different `request_id` values. If you retry the same request with the same `request_id` within 10 seconds, only one request succeeds. This is different from the response `request_id`, which uniquely identifies an HTTP request. Must be a string representation of a 64-bit integer, for example `123456789`.

rf_campaign_type.description: Use only when `objective_type=RF_REACH`; do not pass this field otherwise. `STANDARD` creates a standard Reach & Frequency campaign. `PULSE` creates a TikTok Pulse campaign and is allowlist-only. This field cannot be updated after creation. If `rf_campaign_type=PULSE`, then `/adgroup/rf/create/` must use `contextual_tag_ids` of `PREMIUM` type, ad group CPM is fixed, `feed_type` in `/adgroup/rf/create/` cannot be `TOP_FEED`, and targeting locations cannot be updated in `/adgroup/rf/update/`.

rta_bid_enabled.description: Whether to use RTA bid. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default: `false`. You can set this to `true` only when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `PRODUCT_SALES`, and `rta_id` is passed. This feature is allowlist-only.

rta_id.description: Realtime API (RTA) ID, the RTA strategy identifier. This feature is allowlist-only and requires onboarding before your system can receive and respond to RTA requests.

rta_product_selection_enabled.description: Whether to use RTA to automatically select products. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default: `false`. You can set this to `true` only when `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES`, `campaign_product_source=CATALOG`, and `rta_id` is passed.

sales_destination.description: Required and valid only when `virtual_objective_type` is specified. Sales destination. `TIKTOK_SHOP` drives sales on TikTok Shop. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales in your app and requires a product catalog. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both website and app; this Website and App Optimization option is allowlist-only.

special_industries.description: Special ad categories. Selecting one certifies compliance with TikTok's special ad category policy and limits ad-group-level targeting options for anti-discrimination compliance. `HOUSING` is for housing-related opportunities. `EMPLOYMENT` is for jobs and related opportunities. `CREDIT` is for credit and financing opportunities. Using special ad categories in Shopping Ads with catalog product source and with non-catalog product source are separate allowlist-only features. This field is generally available to advertisers registered in America or Canada; advertisers not registered there but targeting those countries need an additional allowlist. Once selected for a campaign, special ad categories can be removed, but you cannot change them, and you cannot enable them for an existing campaign if they are currently disabled.

virtual_objective_type.description: New objective type. Use `SALES` to create a campaign with the Sales objective, which combines Website Conversions and Product Sales objectives.

operations.name: campaign_create

operations.description: Gets campaigns for an ad account, with optional filters to return only matching campaigns. Deleted campaigns are excluded by default; to query them, set `primary_status` to `STATUS_DELETE` or `secondary_status` to `CAMPAIGN_STATUS_DELETE`. Promote campaigns have limited retrievable fields when filtered via `campaign_system_origins`. Deprecated GMV Max filters are documented, but to filter GMV Max campaigns you should use `/gmv_max/campaign/get/` instead.

exclude_field_types_in_response.description: Types of fields to omit from the response.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the field names under the response `list` object.

filtering.description: Filters applied to the campaign list. Example: `filtering={"campaign_automation_type":"UPGRADED_SMART_PLUS"}`.

buying_types.description: Filter by buying type. Default value: `["AUCTION", "RESERVATION_RF"]`. `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW` cannot be combined with other values; to filter TopView campaigns, set this field to `["RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW"]`.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Maximum 100 IDs.

campaign_name.description: Filter by campaign name. Fuzzy match is supported.

campaign_product_source.description: Filter by product source. If this field is provided, only campaigns with `objective_type=PRODUCT_SALES` are returned; if `objective_type` is also specified, it must be `PRODUCT_SALES`.

campaign_system_origins.description: Filter by campaign origin. Default value: `["TT_ADS_PLATFORM"]`. If you include `PROMOTE`, Promote campaigns can be returned, but only these fields are retrievable for a Promote campaign: `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `create_time`, `campaign_name`, `operation_status`, and `secondary_status`.

campaign_type.description: Filter by regular campaign or iOS 14 campaign.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Upper bound of campaign creation time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns campaigns created earlier than this time. A time range within 6 months is suggested to avoid affecting task success and speed.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Lower bound of campaign creation time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns campaigns created later than this time. A time range within 6 months is suggested to avoid affecting task success and speed.

creative_campaign_type.description: Filter by whether the campaign is a Smart+, Search Ads, or neither. If omitted, all campaigns are returned.

is_smart_performance_campaign.description: Filter by whether the campaign is an automated campaign type. `true` returns Smart+ Campaigns or Smart Performance Web Campaigns. `false` returns standard campaign types. If omitted, all campaigns are returned.

objective_type.description: Filter by advertising objective. If `campaign_product_source` is provided, this filter can only be `PRODUCT_SALES`.

primary_status.description: Primary status filter. To query deleted campaigns, set this field to `STATUS_DELETE`.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination, the destination where you want to drive sales.

secondary_status.description: Secondary campaign status filter. To query deleted campaigns, set this field to `CAMPAIGN_STATUS_DELETE`. This field is not returned in the sandbox environment because campaigns are not actually delivered. Valid values depend on the `primary_status` you specify.

split_test_enabled.description: Filter by whether split test is enabled. `true` returns only campaigns with split test enabled; `false` returns only campaigns without it. If omitted, all campaigns are returned.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default value: `10`. Valid range: 1 to 1,000.

operations.name: campaign_get

operations.description: Gets quota information for SKAN Dedicated Campaigns by ad network, including campaign quota for an iOS app, ad group quota under a specified SKAN Dedicated Campaign, and ad quota for a specified ad group within a SKAN 4.0 Dedicated Campaign. An iOS app can have up to 15 active SKAN Dedicated Campaigns per ad network, or 25 if the account is allowlist-enabled. Each SKAN Dedicated Campaign can have up to 5 active ad groups. Related quota rules are documented at https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1752256248260610.

adgroup_id.description: ID of an ad group within a SKAN 4.0 Dedicated Campaign. Specify this field to get ad quota information in `ad_quota_info` for a specific ad group. If the ID is not for an ad group within a SKAN 4.0 Dedicated Campaign, the returned `ad_quota_info` is `null`.

app_id.description: Application ID of the promoted app.

campaign_id.description: ID of a SKAN Dedicated Campaign. Specify this field to get ad group quota information in `adgroup_quota_info` for a specific campaign. If the ID is not a SKAN Dedicated Campaign ID, an error occurs. To verify that a campaign is a SKAN Dedicated Campaign, call /campaign/get/ and confirm the returned `disable_skan_campaign` is `false`.

has_advertiser_quota.description: Whether to return campaign quota information by advertiser ID under the promoted app. Set to `true` to return campaign quota via different advertiser IDs. Default is `false`.

operations.name: campaign_quota_info_get

operations.description: Enables, pauses, or deletes one or more campaigns via `/v1.3/campaign/status/update/`. Deleted campaigns cannot be modified afterward. In v1.3, `opt_status` was renamed to `operation_status`, `advertiser_id` changed to string, `campaign_ids` changed to string[], and `postback_window_mode` was added. You can use `/campaign/get/` to retrieve a campaign's current `operation_status`. For SKAN 4.0 dedicated campaigns, `postback_window_mode` can be configured only under specific conditions and, once set, cannot be updated.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs to update. Allowed quantity range: `1-20`.

operation_status.description: Operation to apply to the specified campaigns. Enum values: `DELETE` (delete), `DISABLE` (pause), `ENABLE` (enable). Deleted campaigns cannot be modified.

postback_window_mode.description: Valid only when all of the following are true: the campaigns in `campaign_ids` are Dedicated Campaigns (`campaign_type = IOS14_CAMPAIGN`), `operation_status` is `DISABLE`, `postback_window_mode` has not already been configured for the campaign, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app. If `operation_status` is `ENABLE` or omitted and you also pass this field, the request errors. If SKAN 4.0 is not enabled for the app (`app_id`), passing this field causes an error. If omitted while `campaign_type = IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, `operation_status = DISABLE`, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app, it defaults to `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1`. Once set, this field cannot be updated. Configuration may be partially successful: non-Dedicated Campaigns, or Dedicated Campaigns that already have `postback_window_mode` configured, are ignored and not modified. Enum values: `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1` secures the first postback (0-2 day attribution window) and may take up to 4 days, releasing campaign quota after 4 days; `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE2` secures the first two postbacks (3-7 day attribution window) and may take up to 13 days, releasing quota after 13 days; `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE3` secures all three postbacks (8-35 day attribution window) and may take up to 41 days, releasing quota after 41 days. If SKAN 4.0 is enabled, target iOS 16.1+ devices; to do that, set `min_ios_version` to `16.1` at the ad group level.

operations.name: campaign_status_update

operations.description: Updates an existing campaign. Endpoint: /v1.3/campaign/update/. Compared with v1.2, `industry_types` was renamed to `special_industries`, `advertiser_id` and `campaign_id` changed from number to string, `roas_bid` was deprecated, and `po_number` was added. Updating `special_industries` has important restrictions: once special ad categories have been selected for a campaign, you can remove them, but you cannot change them; and if they are currently disabled, you cannot enable them for an existing campaign. Special ad categories for Shopping Ads with campaign product source as Catalog and for Shopping Ads with campaign product source as non-Catalog are separate allowlist-only features. This field is generally available to advertisers registered in America or Canada; advertisers not registered in America or Canada who want to target these countries with special ad categories must apply for an additional allowlist.

budget.description: Campaign budget. The new budget must be at least 105% of the current spend. To determine current spend, use the Basic data metric `spend` from the synchronous report or asynchronous report API.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name. Maximum length is 512 characters. Emoji is not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese character counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one character.

po_number.description: PO (purchase order) number used for invoice tracking and reconciliation.

special_industries.description: Special ad categories for the campaign. Setting this field means the campaign promotes housing, employment, or credit opportunities and must comply with TikTok's special ad category policy; ad group targeting options in the campaign will be restricted accordingly. Enum values: `HOUSING` (real estate listings, homeowners insurance, mortgage loans, or similar opportunities), `EMPLOYMENT` (job offers, internships, professional certification programs, or similar opportunities), `CREDIT` (credit card offers, auto loans, long-term financing, or similar opportunities). Important update rule: if special ad categories are already selected for a campaign, you can remove them, but you cannot change them; if special ad categories are currently disabled, you cannot enable them for an existing campaign. For Shopping Ads, use of special ad categories with campaign product source as Catalog and with non-Catalog campaign product source are separate allowlist-only features. This field is generally available to advertisers registered in America or Canada; advertisers not registered in America or Canada who want to target these countries with special ad categories must apply for an additional allowlist.

operations.description: Returns the country and region codes where ads for a catalog can be delivered. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/catalog/available_country/get/`, `bc_id` is a string, and the response field was renamed from `countries` to `region_codes` from v1.2.

operations.description: Migrates a catalog from an ad account to a Business Center using /open_api/v1.3/catalog/capitalize/. To use this endpoint, you must be the owner of the ad account that the catalog belongs to and an Admin of an existing Business Center; otherwise the request returns an error. If you do not yet have a Business Center, create one in TikTok Ads Manager.

advertiser_id.description: ID of the ad account that currently owns the catalog. You must be the owner of this ad account or the request returns an error.

bc_id.description: ID of the Business Center to migrate the catalog to. You must be an Admin of this existing Business Center or the request returns an error.

catalog_id.description: ID of the catalog to migrate from the specified ad account to the specified Business Center.

catalog_conf.description: Catalog configuration. Must include the primary `region_code` and `currency`. `additional_config_list` is valid only when `catalog_type` is `MINI_SERIES`.

additional_config_list.description: Valid only when `catalog_type` is `MINI_SERIES`. Specifies additional targeting regions for multi-region mini series catalogs. No max size. Once set, this field cannot be updated. If you want to target multiple regions through mini series catalogs, provide those additional regions in `additional_config_list` during catalog creation.

currency.description: Required when `additional_config_list` is specified. Currency for the additional targeting region. Example: `GBP`. Once set, this field cannot be updated. You can specify only one currency for each additional targeting region.

region_code.description: Required when `additional_config_list` is specified. Additional targeting region code. Obtain valid values from /catalog/available_country/get/ and select from the returned `region_codes`. Example: `GB`. Once set, this field cannot be updated. Duplicate region codes are not supported.

channel.description: Channel for creating the catalog. `PARTNER` = partners; `CLIENT` = direct advertisers. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

currency.description: Currency for the primary targeting region. Supported currencies are the Code column of the documentation's "Budget verification ratio and precision of each currency" table. For `AUTO_VEHICLE`, `AUTO_MODEL`, and `ONLINE_TO_OFFLINE` catalogs the `region_code`/`currency` pair is constrained — see the pairs listed under `catalog_type`. Example: `USD`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

region_code.description: Region code of the primary targeting region. Obtain valid values from `catalog_available_country_get` and pick from the returned `region_codes`. For `AUTO_VEHICLE`, `AUTO_MODEL`, and `ONLINE_TO_OFFLINE` catalogs only the documented region codes are supported and the value must match a supported region-currency pair. Example: `US`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

catalog_type.description: Catalog type. `ECOM`: e-commerce. `HOTEL`: hotel. `FLIGHT`: flight. `DESTINATION`: destination. `ENTERTAINMENT`: entertainment. `AUTO_VEHICLE`: Auto-Inventory. `AUTO_MODEL`: Auto-Model. `MINI_SERIES`: mini series. `GENERIC`: generic. `ONLINE_TO_OFFLINE`: online-to-offline. `AUTO_VEHICLE`, `AUTO_MODEL`, and `ONLINE_TO_OFFLINE` each support only a documented set of `region_code`/`currency` pairs. `ENTERTAINMENT` and `MINI_SERIES` are allowlist-only and invitation-only while under testing — contact your TikTok representative, though acceptance is not guaranteed.

name.description: Catalog name. Length limit: 128 characters.

operations.name: catalog_create

operations.description: Deletes an existing catalog via `/v1.3/catalog/delete/`. In v1.3, both `bc_id` and `catalog_id` are strings; in v1.2 they were numbers.

bc_id.description: Required. ID of the Business Center that the catalog belongs to.

catalog_id.description: Required. Catalog ID to delete.

operations.name: catalog_delete

operations.description: Binds an app event source and/or website event source to a catalog in a Business Center using /open_api/v1.3/catalog/eventsource/bind/. You must provide `advertiser_id`, `bc_id`, and `catalog_id`, and specify at least one event source: `app_id` or `pixel_code`. You may provide both to bind both event sources to the same catalog. In v1.3, `bc_id`, `advertiser_id`, and `catalog_id` are string parameters; in v1.2 the endpoint path was /v1.2/catalog/eventsource_bind/create/ and these parameters were numbers.

app_id.description: Mobile application ID. At least one of `app_id` or `pixel_code` is required. Provide both if you want to bind both app events and website events to the same catalog. The app ID can be found in TikTok Ads Manager under Assets > Events > App Events.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID.

interval_type.description: Required when `uri` or `timezone` is provided. Schedule interval type.

minute.description: Minute of the day to fetch the feed. If `interval_type` is `HOURLY`, this is the minute of the first schedule. If `interval_type` is `DAILY` or `MONTHLY`, this is the minute of the schedule. Value range: 0-59. Default value: 0.

password.description: Password for authentication if the feed is password protected.

uri.description: Required when `interval_type` or `timezone` is provided. Data feed URL where the file is hosted. Must start with `http`, `https`, `ftp`, or `sftp`. hour.description: Hour of the day to fetch the feed. If `interval_type` is `HOURLY`, this is the hour of the first schedule. If `interval_type` is `DAILY` or `MONTHLY`, this is the hour of the schedule. Value range: 0-23. Default value: 0.

Catalog Product Insights become available 24 hours after you upload at least 20 products to the E-commerce catalog, and the insights refresh daily at around 4:00 AM UTC. This endpoint requires a valid Business Center and an E-commerce catalog; use `/bc/get/` to find accessible Business Centers, `/catalog/get/` to find `catalog_id` values where `catalog_type` is `ECOM`, and `/catalog/overview/` to verify the catalog contains at least 20 products.

operations.description: Updates catalog products in batch, asynchronously, for a specific catalog/feed. You can update up to 5,000 products per request and up to 1,000 requests per hour per product catalog. The API returns a processing task ID, `feed_log_id`; use `/catalog/product/log/` to check task status. Compared with `/catalog/product/file/`, this endpoint is intended for updating a smaller number of products or only some fields. Incremental updates are supported. For E-commerce catalogs, SKU is unique within the same catalog and belongs to a specific feed, so all SKU operations must be performed under that SKU's feed. The shape of each item in `products` depends on the catalog type; determine the catalog type from `catalog_type` returned by `/catalog/get/`. The entertainment catalog variant is allowlist-only and invitation-only (Alpha Testing); access is not guaranteed and requires contacting a TikTok representative.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID.

feed_id.description: Catalog feed ID. For E-commerce catalogs, SKU operations must be performed under the feed to which the SKU belongs.

room_type.description: Available for: Hotel. Hotel room types. Max size: 3.

series_id.description: Available for: Mini Series. Required for: Mini Series. Unique self-defined ID for the short drama series. Length limit: 100 characters.

series_name.description: Available for: Mini Series. Required for: Mini Series. Name of the short drama series. Length limit: 100 characters.

sku_id.description: Available for: E-commerce. Required for: E-commerce. Unique product ID such as a SKU. Use the same ID to replace the same product in the original feed. Length limit: 100 characters. Duplicate SKU IDs are not supported.

star_rating.description: Available for: Hotel. Hotel star rating.

state_of_vehicle.description: Available for: Auto-Inventory. Current state of the vehicle.

target_config.description: Available for: Mini Series. Targeting details for the short drama series.

region_code.description: Available for: Mini Series. Code of the targeting region for the short drama series.

title.description: Available for: E-commerce, Entertainment, Auto-Inventory, Auto-Model. Required for: E-commerce, Entertainment, Auto-Inventory, Auto-Model. Item title. E-commerce and Auto-Inventory length limit: 500 characters. Entertainment length limit: 150 characters. Auto-Model recommended length: within 40 characters; length limit: 128 characters. Do not include promotional text or emojis.

transmission.description: The transmission type of the vehicle.

trim.description: Available for: Auto-Model. Trim of the vehicle. Length limit: 50 characters.

types.description: Available for: Destination. Required for: Destination. Type or types of destination. Max size: 20.

vehicle_id.description: Available for: Auto-Inventory, Auto-Model. Required for: Auto-Inventory, Auto-Model. Unique ID for the vehicle. Length limit: 100 characters.

video_url.description: Available for: E-commerce, Hotel, Flight, Destination, Entertainment, Auto-Inventory, Auto-Model, Mini Series. Video URL used in the ad. Auto-Inventory, Auto-Model, and Mini Series support `.mp4`, `.mov`, and `.avi`, max file size 100 MB, recommended duration 15-60 seconds.

vin.description: The VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) of the vehicle. According to the ISO 3779 standard, the VIN for a vehicle manufactured since 1981 must be a 17-digit alphanumeric code. Length limit: 17 characters.

year.description: Available for: Auto-Model. Required for: Auto-Model. Year when the vehicle was launched, in `YYYY` format.

operations.name: catalog_product_upload

operations.description: Creates a product set in a catalog under your Business Center using condition-based filters. Endpoint: /open_api/v1.3/catalog/set/create/. Compared with v1.2, this version uses `product_set_name` instead of `name`, accepts `bc_id` and `catalog_id` as strings, and returns `product_set_id`, `product_set_name`, and `product_count`.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID.

conditions.description: Filter conditions. If you pass multiple filter conditions in this object, TikTok recommends limiting the combined total number of expected values across all conditions to 1,024 or fewer; otherwise, the request may time out.

and.description: Intersection of filter conditions. Optional. Use either `and` or `or`, but not both.

field.description: Filter field. See Product set operators and fields - Filter fields for valid enum values.

operation.description: Filter operator. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for valid enum values.

value.description: Expected value. Depending on the operator specified in `operation`, this field can be a single value or multiple values in a list. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for the required value format. If you pass multiple values in this field, the maximum allowed number of values is 1,024.

or.description: Union of filter conditions. Optional. Use either `and` or `or`, but not both.

field.description: Filter field. See Product set operators and fields - Filter fields for valid enum values.

operation.description: Filter operator. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for valid enum values.

value.description: Expected value. Depending on the operator specified in `operation`, this field can be a single value or multiple values in a list. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for the required value format. If you pass multiple values in this field, the maximum allowed number of values is 1,024.

product_set_name.description: Name of the product set. Must be fewer than 28 characters.

operations.name: catalog_set_create

operations.description: Deletes product sets from a product catalog under a Business Center using /open_api/v1.3/catalog/set/delete/. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `catalog_id` are strings instead of numbers, and `product_set_ids` replaces the v1.2 field `set_ids`.

catalog_id.description: Product catalog ID.

product_set_ids.description: List of product set IDs to delete. You can include 1 to 10 IDs in a single request.

operations.name: catalog_set_delete

operations.description: Gets either all product sets in a catalog under your Business Center or one specific product set. If `product_set_id` is omitted, the API returns the full list of product sets for the specified `catalog_id`; if provided, it returns only that product set. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `catalog_id` changed from number to string, `set_id` was renamed to `product_set_id` and changed from number to string, and `return_product_count` was added.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To obtain accessible Business Center IDs, use /bc/get/.

catalog_id.description: ID of the catalog to get product sets from. To obtain accessible catalog IDs, use /bc/asset/get/ and set `asset_type` to `CATALOG`.

product_set_id.description: ID of the product set to retrieve. If omitted, the API returns the complete list of product sets associated with `catalog_id`. If provided, the API returns only the specified product set.

return_product_count.description: Whether to include the `product_count` response field. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default is `true`. If omitted, `product_count` is returned. For product sets with many products, returning `product_count` may cause timeout errors; set this field to `false` to avoid such timeouts.

operations.name: catalog_set_get

operations.description: Gets the products contained in a product set. Endpoint: /v1.3/catalog/set/product/get/. Compared with v1.2, this version changes the path from /v1.2/catalog/set/info/ to /v1.3/catalog/set/product/get/, changes `bc_id` and `catalog_id` from number to string, renames `set_id` to `product_set_id` and changes it from number to string, renames response fields `count` to `product_count` and `list` to `products`, changes response `catalog_id` and `product_id` from number to string, changes response `id` to `product_set_id`, and adds `hotel_id`, `flight_id`, `destination_id`, and `vehicle_id` in the response.

catalog_id.description: ID of the catalog that contains the product set.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20 if omitted.

product_set_id.description: ID of the product set whose products you want to retrieve.

operations.name: catalog_set_product_get

operations.description: Updates a product set's name and/or filter conditions via `/open_api/v1.3/catalog/set/update/`. Only include the fields you want to change. You must provide at least `product_set_name` or `conditions`, or both. In `conditions`, you must use either `and` or `or` as the logical operator. If you pass multiple conditions, TikTok recommends keeping the combined total number of values across the conditions to 1,024 or fewer to avoid timeouts.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID.

conditions.description: Filter conditions for the product set. You must provide at least `product_set_name` or `conditions`, or both. If you pass multiple filter conditions in this object, TikTok recommends limiting the combined total number of expected values across all conditions to 1,024 or fewer; otherwise, the request may time out.

and.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Intersection of filter conditions. Use either `and` or `or`, but not both.

field.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Filter field. See Product set operators and fields - Filter fields for valid enum values.

operation.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Filter operator. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for valid enum values.

value.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Expected value. Depending on the operator specified in `operation`, this field can be a single value or multiple values in a list. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for the required value format. If you pass multiple values in this field, the maximum allowed number of values is 1,024.

or.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Union of filter conditions. Use either `and` or `or`, but not both.

field.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Filter field. See Product set operators and fields - Filter fields for valid enum values.

operation.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Filter operator. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for valid enum values.

value.description: Required when `conditions` is passed. Expected value. Depending on the operator specified in `operation`, this field can be a single value or multiple values in a list. See Product set operators and fields - Operators for the required value format. If you pass multiple values in this field, the maximum allowed number of values is 1,024.

product_set_name.description: Product set name. You must provide at least `product_set_name` or `conditions`, or both. Maximum length: 27 characters.

operations.name: catalog_set_update

operations.description: Updates a catalog's name. The catalog must already be under a Business Center. If the catalog is still under an ad account, migrate it to the Business Center first by calling /catalog/capitalize/. In v1.3, `bc_id` and `catalog_id` are string values.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID. The catalog must belong to the specified Business Center; if it is still under an ad account, migrate it first with /catalog/capitalize/.

name.description: New catalog name. Maximum length is 128 characters.

operations.name: catalog_update

operations.description: Deletes uploaded catalog videos from an E-commerce catalog. This endpoint deletes the videos only from the associated catalog; if a catalog video has already been synced to ad account creative libraries, deleting it here does not remove it from those creative libraries.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. Use /bc/get/ to obtain the list of Business Centers you can access.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID for an E-commerce catalog. Use /catalog/get/ to retrieve catalog_id values where catalog_type is ECOM. You must have Catalog Management permission for the catalog; use /bc/asset/get/ with asset_type set to CATALOG to retrieve asset_id values where catalog_role is ADMIN.

catalog_video_ids.description: List of catalog video IDs to delete. Maximum size: 1. Use /catalog/video/get/ to obtain catalog videos within the catalog. Note: if a catalog video has already been synced to ad account creative libraries, deleting it from the catalog does not remove it from those creative libraries.

operations.name: catalog_video_delete

operations.description: Uploads catalog videos to an E-commerce catalog from a CSV file URL by creating an asynchronous file-processing task at `/open_api/v1.3/catalog/video/file/`. The response returns a `feed_log_id` that you can use to check processing status and final results via `/catalog/video/log/`. This endpoint currently accepts only CSV files that contain video URLs. It can handle only one file task at a time; if a previous file task is still in progress, new tasks fail until the current task completes. Before using this endpoint, you must already have an E-commerce catalog with products available for ad creation. If you do not have one yet, create and populate it first using the product catalog upload flow referenced in "Upload products to different catalog types via JSON schema".

advertiser_ids.description: IDs of ad accounts to sync the uploaded videos to so the videos become available in those accounts' creative libraries. Omit this field if you do not want to sync videos to any ad account. Max size: 100. Each ad account must belong to the same Business Center as `catalog_id` and `bc_id`, and you must have `ADMIN` or `OPERATOR` permission for the ad account. Ineligible ad accounts are ignored.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID for the E-commerce catalog that will receive the uploaded videos. Retrieve `catalog_id` values from `/catalog/get/` where `catalog_type` is `ECOM`. You must have Catalog Management permission for the catalog; to find catalogs where you have that permission, use `/bc/asset/get/` with `asset_type=CATALOG` and use `asset_id` values whose `catalog_role` is `ADMIN`.

file_url.description: Download URL of the CSV file to import. Only CSV files containing video URLs are accepted. The file should follow the catalog video CSV template and include catalog video parameters such as required `video_name`, `video_link`, and `sku_id_list` columns.

operations.name: catalog_video_file_upload

operations.description: Retrieves uploaded catalog videos within an E-commerce catalog via `/open_api/v1.3/catalog/video/get/`. You must provide a Business Center ID and a catalog ID for an E-commerce catalog (`catalog_type=ECOM`). The caller must have Catalog Management or Ad Promotion permission for the catalog. To identify accessible Business Centers and catalogs, use `/bc/get/`, `/catalog/get/`, and `/bc/asset/get/` as applicable.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID for an E-commerce catalog. Use a `catalog_id` from `/catalog/get/` where `catalog_type` is `ECOM`. You must have Catalog Management or Ad Promotion permission for the catalog; to verify eligible catalogs, use `/bc/asset/get/` with `asset_type` set to `CATALOG` and use `asset_id` values whose `catalog_role` is `ADMIN` or `AD_PROMOTE`.

catalog_video_ids.description: List of catalog video IDs to filter by. Maximum 50 IDs. If you specify `catalog_video_ids`, the pagination parameters `page` and `page_size` are ignored.

page.description: Current page number. Value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default is `1`. If you specify `catalog_video_ids`, this field is ignored.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Value range: `1`-`50`. Default is `10`. If you specify `catalog_video_ids`, this field is ignored.

operations.name: catalog_video_get

operations.description: Checks the processing result of a catalog video upload task, including whether catalog videos were uploaded successfully and what actions to take if the upload fails. This endpoint requires the log ID from a previous catalog video handling task; upload catalog videos and obtain that log ID via /catalog/video/file/.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To obtain the list of Business Centers you can access, use /bc/get/.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID for an E-commerce catalog. To obtain valid catalog IDs within a Business Center, use /catalog/get/ and retrieve catalog_id values where catalog_type is ECOM. You must have Catalog Management or Ad Promotion permission for the catalog. To find catalogs for which you have those permissions, use /bc/asset/get/, set asset_type to CATALOG, and retrieve asset_id values where catalog_role is ADMIN or AD_PROMOTE.

feed_log_id.description: Catalog video handling log ID for the upload task whose result you want to check. To upload catalog videos and obtain this log ID, use /catalog/video/file/.

language.description: Language for returned messages. Default value: `en`.

operations.name: catalog_video_log_get

operations.description: Gets information about all catalog video packages, or a specific catalog video package, under a Business Center. In v1.3, the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/catalog/video/get/ to /v1.3/catalog/video_package/get/, the request parameter name changed from `dpa_video_package_id` to `shopping_ads_video_package_id`, and `bc_id` and `catalog_id` changed from number to string.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID.

shopping_ads_video_package_id.description: Catalog video package ID. Specify this field to retrieve a particular video package; omit it to retrieve all video packages under the specified Business Center and catalog.

operations.name: catalog_video_package_get

operations.description: Gets the activity log for a Business Center. The activity log records the Business Center's operation history and supports filtering by date range and activity type, plus pagination and sorting. If no `filtering.start_date` and `filtering.end_date` are provided, the endpoint returns activity logs for the past seven days.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the activity log. If both `start_date` and `end_date` are omitted, the activity log for the past seven days is returned.

activity_type.description: Activity type to query.
