Default value: `ALL`. `ALL` returns all change types. `USER` covers member and organization changes, such as inviting a member, accepting a Business Center invitation, or removing a member. `ACCOUNT` covers ad account creation and access management, such as creating an ad account, assigning or revoking member access, and sharing or revoking partner access. `ASSET` covers asset-related changes, such as creating or deleting a catalog, requesting or approving addition of a TikTok Shop, and assigning or revoking member asset access. `BUSINESS` covers Business Center changes, such as creating the Business Center or changing settings like the name and company name.

end_date.description: Query end date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (UTC+0). You must specify both `start_date` and `end_date`, or neither. If both `start_date` and `end_date` are not specified, the activity log for the past seven days is returned. Recommended date range: six months. Example: `2025-01-01`.

start_date.description: Query start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (UTC+0). You must specify both `start_date` and `end_date`, or neither. If both `start_date` and `end_date` are not specified, the activity log for the past seven days is returned. Recommended date range: six months. Example: `2025-01-01`.

lang.description: Language of the activity log. Default value: `en`.

page.description: Current page number. Value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1-50. Default value: 10.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. `operation_time` sorts by the time when the activity occurred, corresponding to the `time` field in the returned `changelog_list`. Default value: `operation_time`.

sort_type.description: Sorting order. Default value: `DESC`. When `sort_field` is `operation_time` or omitted, `DESC` sorts from most recent to earliest activity, and `ASC` sorts from earliest to most recent activity.

operations.name: changelog_get

operations.description: Checks whether a change log download task has completed. In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/changelog/task/check/ (changed from /v1.2/activities/task/check/ in v1.2). Also in v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string.
operations.name: changelog_task_check

operations.description: Initiates a change log download task for an ad account using the specified filters. Endpoint: /v1.3/changelog/task/create/. Compared with v1.2 (/v1.2/activities/task/create/), v1.3 renames `opt_types` to `operation_types` and `order_field` to `order_fields`, changes `advertiser_id` from number to string, changes `order_fields` from string to string[], and deprecates `page` and `page_size`.

end_time.description: Query end time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. Example: `2025-09-01 00:00:00`. Must be within 30 days after `start_time`; the maximum allowed time gap between `start_time` and `end_time` is 30 days.

start_time.description: Query start time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format. Example: `2025-09-01 00:00:00`.

operations.name: changelog_task_create

operations.description: Downloads the change log file for a previously created change log task from /open_api/v1.3/changelog/task/download/. Version change note: the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/activities/task/download/ to /v1.3/changelog/task/download/, and `advertiser_id` changed from number in v1.2 to string in v1.3.

task_id.description: Task ID of the change log download task to retrieve.

operations.name: changelog_task_download

operations.description: Deletes a comment via `/open_api/v1.3/comment/delete/`. Users can delete their own comments on TikTok ads when the ad was created by a user linked to identity types `CUSTOMIZED_USER` or `TT_USER`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the endpoint path from `/v1.2/comment/delete/` to `/v1.3/comment/delete/`, changes `advertiser_id`, `comment_id`, and `ad_id` from number to string, and renames `item_id` to `tiktok_item_id`.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete.

identity_id.description: Identity ID corresponding to the selected `identity_type`.

identity_type.description: Identity type linked to the user. Supported values are `CUSTOMIZED_USER` (Custom User) and `TT_USER` (TikTok User). Use together with `identity_id` to specify the linked identity. This endpoint is for deleting the user's own comments on TikTok ads created by users linked to these identity types.

tiktok_item_id.description: TikTok video ID for the ad video that the comment belongs to.

operations.name: comment_delete

operations.description: Gets comments under video ads in an ad account for a specified search value and time range. Returns comments for both paid impression ads and Spark Ads. Endpoint: /v1.3/comment/list/. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses string IDs for `advertiser_id` and related ID fields in responses, and response fields were renamed from `is_top` to `is_pinned` and from `list` to `comments`.

comment_type.description: Comment types to return. Allowed values: `ALL`, `COMMENT`, `REPLY`. Default value: `["ALL"]`.

end_time.description: End date of the time range to retrieve comments, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default value: `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Value range: 1-100. Default value: `10`.

search_field.description: Field to search by. Currently only `ADGROUP_ID` is supported, which filters comments by ad group ID.

search_value.description: Value for the selected `search_field`. When `search_field` is `ADGROUP_ID`, set this field to an ad group ID. Example: `1234567891234567`.

sort_field.description: Field used to sort results. Allowed values: `CREATE_TIME`, `LIKES`, `REPLIES`. Default value: `CREATE_TIME`.

sort_type.description: Sorting order. Allowed values: `ASC`, `DESC`. Default value: `DESC`.

start_time.description: Start date of the time range to retrieve comments, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

operations.name: comment_list_get

operations.description: Replies to a comment on a TikTok ad via /v1.3/comment/post/. For TikTok ads created by users linked to TikTok User or Custom User identities (`identity_type` = `TT_USER` or `CUSTOMIZED_USER`), users linked to those identity types who have comment management permissions can reply to first-level comments under the ads. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id`, `comment_id`, and `ad_id` from number to string, and replaces `item_id` with `tiktok_item_id` as a string.

ad_id.description: Ad ID for the ad under which the target comment exists.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment that you want to reply to.

comment_type.description: Comment type. Currently, only `REPLY` is supported.

identity_id.description: Identity ID corresponding to the selected `identity_type`; use the ID of the linked identity that will post the reply.

identity_type.description: Type of identity linked to the user making the reply. Supported values are `CUSTOMIZED_USER` (Custom User) and `TT_USER` (TikTok User). The replying user must be linked to this identity type and have comment management permissions. Use together with `identity_id` to specify the identity used to reply.

tiktok_item_id.description: TikTok video ID for the ad video associated with the comment.

operations.name: comment_post_create

operations.description: Gets comments related to a specified comment. For an original comment, this returns the comment itself and all of its replies. For a reply, this returns the reply and its original comment. Endpoint: `/open_api/v1.3/comment/reference/`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id`, `comment_id`, and `original_comment_id` request parameter types from number to string.

comment_id.description: Comment ID of the target comment. If `comment_type` is `COMMENT`, use the original comment's ID. If `comment_type` is `REPLY`, use the reply's ID.

comment_type.description: Type of the target comment. `COMMENT` means the `comment_id` is an original comment and the endpoint returns that comment plus all of its replies. `REPLY` means the `comment_id` is a reply and the endpoint returns that reply plus its original comment; when `comment_type` is `REPLY`, `original_comment_id` applies.

original_comment_id.description: Original comment ID. Valid only when `comment_type` is `REPLY`.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Value range: 1-1000. Default value: `10`.

operations.name: comment_reference_get

operations.description: Changes the status of a list of comments between public and hidden using /v1.3/comment/status/update/. Compared with v1.2, the request data types changed: `advertiser_id` is now a string instead of a number, and `comment_ids` is now a string array instead of a number array.

comment_ids.description: List of comment IDs to update.

operation.description: Operation to apply to all specified comments: `HIDDEN` hides the comments, and `PUBLIC` makes the comments public.

operations.name: comment_status_update

operations.description: Checks the status of a comment export task. When the task completes, call /comment/task/download/ to download the exported data. In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/comment/task/check/ and `advertiser_id` changed from number in v1.2 to string in v1.3.

task_id.description: Task ID of the comment export task to check.

operations.name: comment_task_check

operations.description: Creates a task to export ad comments. After creating the task, use /comment/task/check/ to check task status, and when the task is complete, use /comment/task/download/ to download the exported file. Exported data headers are Content, Likes, Replies, Comment Type, Create Time, Campaign Name, Ad Group Name, and Ad Name. If a comment contains mentions of user names, the exported table formats them as "@user_name". In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/comment/task/create/; compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string and `comment_ids` changed from number[] to string[].

comment_ids.description: Comment IDs to export. In v1.3, values must be strings; in v1.2, this field used number[].

comment_status.description: Comment statuses to export. Allowed values: `ALL`, `PUBLIC`, `HIDDEN`. Default: `["ALL"]`.

comment_type.description: Comment types to export. Allowed values: `ALL`, `COMMENT`, `REPLY`. Default: `["ALL"]`.

end_time.description: End date of the time range to export, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

lang.description: Language of the exported header names. Allowed values: `EN`, `JA`, `ZH`. Default: `EN`.

search_field.description: Field used for searching. Allowed value: `ADGROUP_ID`.

search_value.description: Value for the selected `search_field`. For example, when `search_field` is `ADGROUP_ID`, provide the ad group ID to search by.

sort_field.description: Field used to sort results. Allowed values: `CREATE_TIME`, `LIKES`, `REPLIES`.

start_time.description: Start date of the time range to export, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

operations.name: comment_task_create

operations.description: Downloads exported ad comments data after an export task completes successfully from /v1.3/comment/task/download/. The export is returned in CSV format with headers: Content, Likes, Replies, Comment Type, Create Time, Campaign Name, Ad Group Name, and Ad Name. User-name mentions in comments are converted to "@user_name" in the exported table. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/comment/task/download/ to /v1.3/comment/task/download/, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and v1.3 adds the `csv` response field.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID for the account whose exported comments file you want to download.

task_id.description: ID of a completed comment export task. Use the task ID returned by the comment export task API after the export finishes successfully.

operations.name: comment_task_download

operations.description: Creates a preview link for an ad or creative using /open_api/v1.3/creative/ads_preview/create/. The endpoint supports multiple preview modes through `preview_type`: ads you plan to create (`ADS_CREATION`), existing ads (`AD`), existing interactive add-ons (`CARD`), existing instant pages (`PAGE`), videos (`SINGLE_VIDEO`), and images (`SINGLE_IMAGE`). It also reflects v1.3 changes from v1.2, including renamed request fields such as `preview_type`, `shopping_ads_video_package_id`, and `placements`, plus additional identity, shopping ads, carousel, and preview-format parameters. Before previewing, the caller may need the proper ad-account or catalog permissions; the docs explicitly direct you to verify ad-account and catalog roles with /bc/asset/get/.

ad_format.description: Ad format. Use `SINGLE_VIDEO` for single video ads, `SINGLE_IMAGE` for single image ads (supported only on Pangle), `CAROUSEL_ADS` for TikTok Standard Carousel ads, `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` for TikTok Catalog Carousel ads, and `LIVE_CONTENT` for Live Shopping Ads. `CAROUSEL_ADS` requires `objective_type` to be `REACH`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, or `TRAFFIC`.

ad_id.description: Required when `preview_type=AD`. ID of the existing ad to preview.

ad_text.description: Ad text shown in the creative. For ad-creation previews, this field is required for non-Spark Ads. Length must be 1-100 characters and cannot contain emoji. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. For ad and ad-creation previews, you must have Operator or Admin permission for the ad account; check /bc/asset/get/ and ensure the returned `advertiser_role` is `ADMIN` or `OPERATOR`. If the ad uses a catalog, you also need catalog permission, and /bc/asset/get/ should return `catalog_role` as `ADMIN` or `AD_PROMOTE`.

auto_disclaimer_types.description: Valid only when `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION`, `catalog_enabled=true`, `catalog_id` points to an Auto-Model catalog, and `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Types of disclaimers shown in Automotive Carousel Ads for Models. Max size: 1.

call_to_action.description: Call-to-action text. For TikTok ads, either this field or `call_to_action_id` must be specified; if both are passed, this field is ignored. For live shopping ads, the CTA must be `WATCH_LIVE`. If `objective_type` is `REACH` or `VIDEO_VIEW` and `landing_page_url` or `page_id` is set, either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id` is required. If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `TRAFFIC`, either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id` is required. If `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`: when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id` is required; when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, this field is required and must be `SEND_MESSAGE`; when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, this field is required and cannot be `CALL_NOW`; when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`, this field is required. If `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`, this field is required.

call_to_action_id.description: CTA portfolio ID for auto-optimized CTAs. If both this field and `call_to_action` are specified, `call_to_action` is ignored. If `objective_type` is `REACH` or `VIDEO_VIEW` and `landing_page_url` or `page_id` is set, either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id` is required. If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `TRAFFIC`, either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id` is required. If `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, this field is not supported. If `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, then when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, either `call_to_action` or `call_to_action_id` is required; when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, or `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`, this field is not supported.

card_id.description: Creative portfolio ID. For `preview_type=CARD`, use the ID of an existing Display Card, Countdown Sticker, or Gift Code Sticker portfolio. In ad-creation previews, this field can also be used with supported portfolio types including Display Card, Website info card, Product Card, Product Tiles, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, Gesture, and Superlike. Supported ad-creation scenarios include: `objective_type=REACH`, `promotion_type=WEBSITE`, `placements=PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `ad_format=SINGLE_VIDEO`; `TRAFFIC` + `WEBSITE` + `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` + `SINGLE_VIDEO`; `VIDEO_VIEWS` + `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` + `SINGLE_VIDEO`; `ENGAGEMENT` where only Countdown Sticker is allowed; `APP_PROMOTION` + `WEBSITE` + `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` + `SINGLE_VIDEO`; `LEAD_GENERATION` where only Display Card is allowed; `WEB_CONVERSIONS` + `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` + `SINGLE_VIDEO`; and `PRODUCT_SALES` + `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` + `SINGLE_VIDEO`.

carousel_image_index.description: Valid only when `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` and additional images have been configured for the specified products. Selects which additional product image index to use in the VSA Carousel ad. If omitted, the main catalog product images are used. Range: 0-9. The index maps to the position within each product's `additional_image_urls`; if the index exceeds the number of additional image URLs for a product, the field is ignored and the product's main `image_url` is used.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Same as `bc_id`. Use this field when previewing catalog items.

catalog_id.description: Product catalog ID supplying the products whose links are shown in the ad. Required when `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. You must have Ad promotion or Catalog management permission for the catalog; verify via /bc/asset/get/ and ensure the returned `catalog_role` is `ADMIN` or `AD_PROMOTE`.

display_name.description: Brand name shown in video or image previews. Allowed length: 1-40 English characters, or 1-20 Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters.

dynamic_destination.description: Dynamic destination strategy. Not supported when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. `DLP` enables Dynamic Landing Page behavior; `UNSET` leaves it unset.

dynamic_format.description: Dynamic format. Not supported when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. `UNSET` leaves it unset; `DYNAMIC_CREATIVE` enables smart creative to show different videos, product cards, and destinations based on purchase intent.

end_card_cta.description: Required when all of the following are true: `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION`, `catalog_enabled=true`, `catalog_id` refers to an Auto-Model catalog, and `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. CTA for the end card (`image_ids`) of an Automotive Carousel Ad for Models.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. If you are not using Spark Ads, use `identity_id` together with `identity_type=CUSTOMIZED_USER` for ad management.

identity_type.description: Identity type. `CUSTOMIZED_USER` is for custom identity; `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, and `BC_AUTH_TT` are for Spark Ads. When `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, this field can only be `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. If `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, Spark Ads must be used and `identity_type` must be `TT_USER` or `BC_AUTH_TT`. If `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and `promotion_type` is not `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, both Spark and non-Spark ads are supported, so any enum value is allowed. If `objective_type` is `ENGAGEMENT`, only Spark Ads are supported and `identity_type` must be `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, or `BC_AUTH_TT`. When `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required.

image_id.description: Required when `preview_type=SINGLE_IMAGE`. Image ID used for image previews. Different placements have different creative specifications.

image_ids.description: List of image IDs used in an ad or as a video cover. Required when `ad_format` is `SINGLE_IMAGE`; when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` and you are creating Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push or Standard Carousel non-Spark Ads; and when `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, `catalog_enabled=true`, and `catalog_id` points to an Auto-Model catalog. When `ad_format=CAROUSEL_ADS`, size must be 1-35 and image order controls carousel order. When `ad_format=CATALOG_CAROUSEL` with `catalog_enabled=true`, only one image is allowed and it is used as the summary photo for Automotive Ads for Models. When `ad_format=SINGLE_IMAGE`, only one image ID is allowed.

instant_product_page_used.description: Whether to use TikTok Instant Product Page. Not supported when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. When `dynamic_destination=DLP`, you do not need this field. When `dynamic_destination=UNSET`, you can set this field to `true` to use TikTok Instant Product Page and then you do not need to pass `page_id`.

item_group_ids.description: Product SPU IDs. If `catalog_id` is specified and `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`, pass either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. This field is also required when `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO` and `product_source=STORE`, and when `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS`, `product_source=STORE`, and `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`.

landing_page_url.description: Landing page URL. If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `TRAFFIC` and `promotion_type` is `WEBSITE`, either `page_id` or `landing_page_url` is required. If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `TRAFFIC` and `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`, neither `page_id` nor `landing_page_url` can be used. If `shopping_ads_fallback_type` is `CUSTOM`, you must also pass `landing_page_url`.

music_id.description: Required when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` and you create Standard Carousel Spark Ads via Spark Ads Push or Standard Carousel non-Spark Ads, or when `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. ID of the music used in the TikTok Carousel Ad.

page_id.description: Instant page ID. For `preview_type=PAGE`, use this field to preview an existing instant page. In ad-creation previews, this field is used to preview a TikTok Instant Page. If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `TRAFFIC` and `promotion_type` is `WEBSITE`, either `page_id` or `landing_page_url` is required. If `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `TRAFFIC` and `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`, neither `page_id` nor `landing_page_url` can be used. If `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, this field is not supported. When `dynamic_destination=UNSET`, setting `instant_product_page_used=true` means you do not need to pass `page_id`.

placement.description: The app where the ad is delivered. For ad-creation previews, when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, set this field to `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` or omit it. Supported values vary by `objective_type`: `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is supported for `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `PRODUCT_SALES`; `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` is supported only for `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `LEAD_GENERATION` when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`; `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE` is supported only when `objective_type` is `REACH`; `ALL` is supported only for `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `LEAD_GENERATION` when `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. For existing-ad previews, pass this field only if you want a non-TikTok placement; otherwise it defaults to `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`.

preview_format.description: Preview format, whose valid values depend on `placement` and `tiktok_subplacement`. Default: `IN_FEED`. When `placement` is `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, allowed values are `IN_FEED`, `SEARCH_RESULTS`, `SEARCH_FEED`, `TIKTOK_LITE`, `PRODUCT_SEARCH`, and `PRODUCT_SHOP_CENTER`. When `placement` is `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` and `tiktok_subplacement` is `LEMON8`, allowed values are `IN_FEED` and `IN_FEED_TWO_COLUMNS`. When `placement` is `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`, allowed values are `APP_OPEN`, `IN_FEED`, and `IN_FEED_TWO_COLUMNS`. `SEARCH_FEED` and `TIKTOK_LITE` are valid only when `objective_type` is `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT` and `placement` is `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. `PRODUCT_SEARCH` and `PRODUCT_SHOP_CENTER` are available only for Video Shopping Ads and Product Shopping Ads. This field is not supported when `placement` is `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`.

preview_type.description: Selects what to preview. Use `ADS_CREATION` to preview ads from creation parameters, `AD` to preview an existing ad, `CARD` to preview an existing interactive add-on, `PAGE` to preview an existing instant page, `SINGLE_VIDEO` to preview a video ad from parameters, and `SINGLE_IMAGE` to preview an image ad from parameters.

product_set_id.description: Product set ID. If `catalog_id` is specified and `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`, pass either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`.

product_source.description: Required only for Video Shopping Ads and Product Shopping Ads. Product source for promoted products. For `shopping_ads_type=VIDEO`, you can use `STORE` or `SHOWCASE`. For `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS`, set this field to `STORE`.

product_specific_type.description: How to choose products. Required when `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`; the product scope must contain at least two products. `ALL` lets TikTok choose from all catalog products and does not require `sku_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or `product_set_id`. `PRODUCT_SET` requires either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` requires `sku_ids` or `vehicle_ids`. When `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source` is `STORE`, allowed values are `ALL` or `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`; with `ALL`, no product ID fields are needed, and with `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`, `item_group_ids` is required. When `shopping_ads_type` is `VIDEO` and `product_source` is `STORE`, specify products through `item_group_ids`. When `shopping_ads_type` is `VIDEO` and `product_source` is `SHOWCASE`, specify products through `showcase_products`. When `shopping_ads_type` is `LIVE`, you do not need to specify products.

profile_image.description: Profile image ID used in video previews.

shopping_ads_type.description: Required when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` and `catalog_id` is not specified. Shopping ads type: `VIDEO` for Video Shopping Ads, `LIVE` for Live Shopping Ads, `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` for Product Shopping Ads. When `ad_format` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, set this field to `VIDEO` or omit it.

showcase_products.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type` is `VIDEO` and `product_source` is `SHOWCASE`. List of Showcase products to use in the ad. Max size: 20.

item_group_id.description: Required when `showcase_products` is passed. SPU ID of the Showcase product.

store_id.description: Required when `showcase_products` is passed. TikTok Shop ID that the `item_group_id` belongs to.

sku_ids.description: SKU IDs. Required when `catalog_id` points to an E-commerce catalog and `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Max size: 20.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `store_id` is passed. Business Center ID authorized to access the TikTok Shop referenced by `store_id`.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID. Required when `shopping_ads_type` is `VIDEO` and `product_source` is `STORE`, or when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT_SHOPPING_ADS` and `product_source` is `STORE`. Optional when `shopping_ads_type` is `LIVE`. If you pass `store_id`, `store_authorized_bc_id` is required.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail ID used in video previews.

tiktok_item_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `AUTH_CODE` or `BC_AUTH_TT` and you want to create Spark Ads through Spark Ads Pull. Not supported when `identity_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. This is the TikTok post ID used as the Spark Ad. Pass the `item_id` returned by /tt_video/info/ or /identity/video/get/. By using Spark Ads, you confirm that you have rights to use the music in the videos for commercial purposes.

tiktok_subplacement.description: Valid only when both `objective_type` is `REACH` and `placement` is `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Selects TikTok subplacements. `LEMON8` enables Lemon8 surfaces; `UNSET` leaves it unset.

vehicle_ids.description: Vehicle IDs. Required when `catalog_id` points to an Auto-Model catalog and `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Max size: 20.

vertical_video_strategy.description: Video strategy. Not supported when `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. `SINGLE_VIDEO` uses a video creative to promote products, `CATALOG_VIDEOS` generates a dynamic video from catalog information, `LIVE_STREAM` uses livestream and is supported only for Live Shopping Ads with ad format as Real-time LIVE, and `UNSET` leaves it unset. If `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`, this field must be `UNSET`.

video_id.description: Video ID. For ad-creation previews, this field is required when `ad_format` is `SINGLE_VIDEO` and is not supported when `ad_format` is `SINGLE_IMAGE`, `CAROUSEL_ADS`, or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. To create video Spark Ads using Spark Ads Push or create video non-Spark Ads, use `video_id`; for Spark Ads Pull, use `tiktok_item_id` instead. Different placements have different creative specifications.

operations.name: creative_ads_preview_create

operations.description: Deletes creative assets for an advertiser via `/open_api/v1.3/creative/asset/delete/`. You can delete assets by supplying video IDs and/or image IDs. Each of `video_ids` and `image_ids` accepts up to 50 IDs per request.

image_ids.description: List of image asset IDs to delete. Maximum 50 IDs per request.

video_ids.description: List of video asset IDs to delete. Maximum 50 IDs per request.

operations.name: creative_asset_delete

operations.description: Shares existing creative assets from one advertiser account to other advertiser accounts via `/open_api/v1.3/creative/asset/share/`. You must be an Admin or Operator for both the source ad account and each target ad account, and you must also own the assets being shared.

advertiser_id.description: Operator advertiser ID for the source account that owns the creative assets.

asset_type.description: Type of creative assets to share. Allowed values: `VIDEO`, `IMAGE`, `MUSIC`. Defaults to `VIDEO`.

material_ids.description: Material IDs to share. Maximum 20 IDs. After a successful share, the shared advertiser account receives copied names for the shared creative materials. Currently, sharing fails only when the target advertiser account already has a creative material with the same name as a material being shared.

shared_advertiser_ids.description: Advertiser IDs of the target accounts to share the creative materials with. Maximum 10 IDs.

operations.name: creative_asset_share_get

operations.description: Creates a welcome message in an ad account using `/open_api/v1.3/creative/auto_message/create/`. The created message is saved to the ad account's welcome message library for future use in TikTok Direct Messaging Ads.

auto_message_type.description: Type of automatic message sent when a person starts a conversation with you. `WELCOME_MESSAGE` creates a welcome message that is automatically sent after a user taps your ad.

welcome_message.description: Required when `auto_message_type` is `WELCOME_MESSAGE`. Contains the welcome message details.

content.description: Required when `welcome_message` is passed. Greeting text in the welcome message. Maximum length: 200 characters.

suggested_questions.description: Required when `welcome_message` is passed. List of suggested questions customers can tap at the start of a chat. When a user selects a suggested question, the corresponding preset answer is sent automatically. Size range: 1-3 items.

answer.description: Required when `welcome_message` is passed. Preset answer automatically sent when a user selects the corresponding question. Maximum length: 500 characters.

question.description: Required when `welcome_message` is passed. Frequently asked question shown to help users start a conversation. Maximum length: 70 characters.

title.description: Required when `welcome_message` is passed. Name of the welcome message. Use a unique name to distinguish it from other welcome messages in the ad account's welcome message library.

operations.name: creative_auto_message_create

operations.description: Retrieves welcome messages from the welcome message library of the specified ad account via `/open_api/v1.3/creative/auto_message/get/`. Use this endpoint to list all welcome messages for an advertiser or filter results by a specific `auto_message_id`.

auto_message_id.description: Automatic message ID to filter results. Valid when `auto_message_type` is `WELCOME_MESSAGE`. If omitted, all messages belonging to the specified automatic message type are returned.

auto_message_type.description: Type of automatic message to retrieve for people who start a conversation with you. Supported value: `WELCOME_MESSAGE`, which returns welcome messages automatically sent after a user taps your ad.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Defaults to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: `1`-`100`. Defaults to `10`.

operations.name: creative_auto_message_get

operations.description: Gets recommended call-to-actions (CTAs) for ad creation or update. This endpoint supports two modes: when `new_version=false` or omitted, you request standard recommendations by `asset_type` and `content_type`; when `new_version=true`, you can retrieve Dynamic CTAs based on ad settings such as `objective_type`, `promotion_type`, `language`, `app_id`, `placements`, `region_codes`, `optimization_goal`, `ad_texts`, and `landing_page_url`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses `/v1.3/creative/cta/recommend/`, replaces `external_type` with `content_type`, changes `advertiser_id` from number to string, adds the ad-setting-based parameters, and returns `asset_ids` as string[]. For background on Standard Recommended CTAs and Dynamic CTAs, see CTA recommendations: https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740307296329730.

ad_texts.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. List of ad texts shown as part of the ad creative. Each ad text must be 1-100 characters and cannot contain emoji. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters, and each English letter counts as one character. Recommended size: 1. Due to limited historical data for generating customized results, you might receive the same recommended CTAs even if you provide a different value for this field.

app_id.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. Application ID of the promoted app. Due to limited historical data for generating customized results, you might receive the same recommended CTAs even if you provide a different value for this field.

asset_type.description: Required when `new_version` is `false` or omitted. Ignored when `new_version` is `true`. Asset type for recommendation retrieval.

content_type.description: Required when `new_version` is `false` or omitted. Ignored when `new_version` is `true`. Ad content type. `MESSAGE` means a Lead Generation ad with promotion type as TikTok direct message; `SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE` means a Lead Generation ad with promotion type as social media app; `PHONE_CALL` means a Lead Generation ad with promotion type as phone call.

landing_page_url.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. Landing page URL that users are redirected to. Due to limited historical data for generating customized results, you might receive the same recommended CTAs even if you provide a different value for this field.

language.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. Language code for the recommended CTAs. Default value: `en`. For example, if set to `fr`, the returned `asset_content` is in French.

new_version.description: Whether to use the new version that supports retrieving Dynamic CTAs based on your ad settings. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

objective_type.description: Required when `new_version` is `true`. Not supported when `new_version` is `false` or omitted. Advertising objective.

optimization_goal.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. The measurable result you want your ads to drive. Due to limited historical data for generating customized results, you might receive the same recommended CTAs even if you provide a different value for this field.

placements.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. Apps where you want to deliver your ads. Due to limited historical data for generating customized results, you might receive the same recommended CTAs even if you provide a different value for this field.

promotion_type.description: Required when `new_version` is `true`. Not supported when `new_version` is `false` or omitted. Promotion type (optimization location).

region_codes.description: Valid only when `new_version` is `true`. Codes of the regions you want to target. Example: `US`. Due to limited historical data for generating customized results, you might receive the same recommended CTAs even if you provide a different value for this field.

operations.name: creative_cta_recommend_get

operations.description: Retrieves Creative Fatigue Detection results for a specific ad over a specified past time range. The time range is provided in `filtering.start_date` and `filtering.end_date`, and both dates must be within the last 60 days. This feature is allowlist-only; contact your TikTok representative for access. If you want fatigue status updates via webhooks for a single ad, all ads in an ad group, or all ads in an advertiser account, use the webhook subscription flow described at https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738964126095362#item-link-Subscribe%20to%20the%20fatigue%20status%20of%20your%20ad.

ad_id.description: ID of the ad to retrieve Creative Fatigue Detection results for.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the query time range.

end_date.description: Query end date, exclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format using the advertiser account time zone. You can specify only a date within the last 60 days. Used together with `start_date` to define the queried time range.

start_date.description: Query start date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format using the advertiser account time zone. You can specify only a date within the last 60 days. Used together with `end_date` to define the queried time range.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `10`. Valid range: `1` to `500`.

operations.name: creative_fatigue_get

operations.description: Edits an existing image from the Asset Library by cropping to a fixed size or applying creative trimming, then automatically uploads the edited result back to the Asset Library and returns the new image ID. This endpoint only supports cropping/trimming images that were previously uploaded to the Asset Library. Supported edit methods are `fix_size` (fixed width/height crop, no trimming), `only_gauss_pad` (Gaussian blur trimming only, no crop), and `gauss_padding_reserve_score` (Gaussian blur catch-all that adjusts the image based on the size of the main subject in the original image). To upload an image before editing, use `/file/image/ad/upload/`. Recommended source image resolution is at least 1200 × 628 px.

edit_method.description: Editing method. Supported values are `fix_size` (fixed width and height crop, no trimming), `only_gauss_pad` (Gaussian blur trimming only, no cropping), and `gauss_padding_reserve_score` (Gaussian blur catch-all that adjusts the image based on the size of the main subject in the original image). Default is `fix_size`.

image_id.description: Image ID of the source image to edit. The image must already exist in the Asset Library because this endpoint only edits previously uploaded Asset Library images.

image_name.description: Name for the edited image after processing. If omitted, a name is generated automatically.

operations.name: creative_image_edit_get

operations.description: Creates a creative portfolio of assets via `/open_api/v1.3/creative/portfolio/create/`. You can create only one portfolio per request, and only one creative portfolio of any type at a time. Availability and valid usage depend on the portfolio type: `WEB_INFO_CARD` is only for auction ads with `objective_type` `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `TRAFFIC` with `promotion_type` `WEBSITE`; `INVENTORY_CARD` is only for Automotive Ads; `PRODUCT_CARD` is only for Video Shopping Ads; `PRODUCT_TILE` is only for Video Shopping Ads with product source catalog, requires a catalog with at least four reviewed products approved in `/catalog/product/get/`, and is allowlist-only; sticker, gesture, and superlike types have objective-specific eligibility, and some combinations are allowlist-only. For Countdown Stickers in Lead Generation ads, optimization location at the ad group level must be Website. Reminder Countdown Stickers (`REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`) are allowlist-only for `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. Gesture portfolios for `APP_PROMOTION`, `TRAFFIC`, or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and Superlike portfolios for `APP_PROMOTION` or `TRAFFIC`, are separate allowlist-only features.

creative_portfolio_type.description: Portfolio type. Default is `CTA`. `CTA` = call-to-action text; `CARD` = Display Card; `WEB_INFO_CARD` = Website info card; `DOWNLOAD_CARD` = Download Card; `INVENTORY_CARD` = Inventory Card; `PRODUCT_CARD` = Product Card; `PRODUCT_TILE` = Product Tiles; `STICKER` = Countdown Sticker or Gift Code Sticker; `PREMIUM_BADGE` = Pop-up Showcase; `GESTURE` = Gesture; `SUPER_LIKE` = Superlike. Usage depends on ad objective and other fields: `WEB_INFO_CARD` is valid only for auction ads with `objective_type` `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `TRAFFIC` with `promotion_type` `WEBSITE`; `INVENTORY_CARD` only for Automotive Ads; `PRODUCT_CARD` only for Video Shopping Ads; `PRODUCT_TILE` only for Video Shopping Ads with `product_source=CATALOG`, requires at least four approved catalog products verified via `/catalog/product/get/`, and is allowlist-only. Countdown Sticker is only for auction ads with `objective_type` `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEW`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or `PRODUCT_SALES`, and R&F ads with `objective_type` `RF_REACH`; for Lead Generation ads, optimization location at the ad group level must be Website. `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` and `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` are allowlist-only for `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. Gesture is only for auction ads with `objective_type` `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS` with `optimization_goal=ENGAGED_VIEW`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and R&F `RF_REACH`; Gesture for `APP_PROMOTION`, `TRAFFIC`, or `WEB_CONVERSIONS` is allowlist-only. Superlike is only for auction ads with `objective_type` `REACH`, `TRAFFIC`, `VIDEO_VIEWS` with `optimization_goal=ENGAGED_VIEW`, `ENGAGEMENT` with `optimization_goal=PAGE_VISIT`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and R&F `RF_REACH`; Superlike for `APP_PROMOTION` or `TRAFFIC` is allowlist-only.

portfolio_content.description: Portfolio content objects. The object shape and required fields depend on `creative_portfolio_type`.

ad_text.description: Valid when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD`. Ad text shown as part of the ad creative. Must be 1-100 characters and cannot contain emoji. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as 2 characters; each English letter counts as 1.

app_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. App ID from Events Manager for the app being promoted.

asset_content.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `CTA`. Call-to-action text, for example `Learn More`.

asset_ids.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `CTA`. List of CTA IDs returned by `/creative/cta/recommend/`. Auto-optimized CTAs can only be used in the advertiser account they were created for.

badge_image_info.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PREMIUM_BADGE`. Badge image info for the Pop-out Showcase.

image_id.description: Required when `badge_image_info` is specified. Badge image ID. Must be 448x448, JPG/JPEG/PNG, within 1 MB.

badge_position.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE` or `PREMIUM_BADGE`. Position info for the Gesture icon or Premium Badge.

angle.description: Required when `badge_position` is specified and either `creative_portfolio_type=PREMIUM_BADGE`, or `creative_portfolio_type=GESTURE` with `gesture_type` `STRAIGHT_SLIDE` or `CURVED_SLIDE`. For Gesture slide types, recommended range is 30-150 or 210-330. For `PREMIUM_BADGE`, range is 0-360.

position_x.description: Required when `badge_position` is specified. Relative X-axis value of the top-left corner. Range: 0-1.

position_y.description: Required when `badge_position` is specified. Relative Y-axis value of the top-left corner. Range: 0-1.

badge_show_time.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE` or `PREMIUM_BADGE`. Time in seconds when the Gesture icon or Premium Badge appears in the video. The first 3 seconds and the last 5 seconds of the video cannot be used as the start time.

call_to_action.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. Call-to-action text shown in the Download Card.

call_to_action_text.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE` or `PREMIUM_BADGE`. For `GESTURE`, this is the interactive guide text; expected text depends on `gesture_type` (for example click vs straight slide vs curved slide). For `PREMIUM_BADGE`, this is the interactive guide text for the Pop-out Showcase. Maximum 27 characters; each English letter counts as 1 character and each Chinese, Japanese, or Korean word counts as 2. Emojis and special characters `{`, `}`, `@`, and `#` are not supported. Do not include bar codes, stock codes, or social media information.

card_image_index.description: Valid when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE`. Image index used to select the image from `additional_image_urls` uploaded via `/catalog/product/upload/`. For example, `1` selects the second image URL. Not required when `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE` because cards are created automatically.

card_show_price.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD`. Whether to show product price on the Product Card. Not required when `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE` because cards are created automatically.

card_tags.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD`. Product tags to show on the Product Card. Not required when `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE` because cards are created automatically.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` with `product_source=CATALOG`, or when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. Business Center ID authorized to access `catalog_id`. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad group level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

catalog_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` with `product_source=CATALOG`, or when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. Catalog ID. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad group level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

category_label.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD` and `tags` includes `CATEGORIES`. Category name of the app to show in the Download Card. Pass the enum value as a string.

country_code.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. Target country or location codes.

description.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD` and `layouts` includes `TYPE_1`, or when `creative_portfolio_type` is `INVENTORY_CARD`. For `DOWNLOAD_CARD`, this is the app description. For `INVENTORY_CARD`, this is the card text and has a 40-character limit.

dynamic_format.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=CATALOG`; not supported when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. If `creative_portfolio_type=PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=STORE`, you cannot set this to `DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`; omit it or set `UNSET`. `dynamic_format` cannot be enabled for retargeting ads where ad-group `shopping_ads_retargeting_type` is not `OFF`. When `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`, cards are created automatically, so you do not need to send `card_show_price`, `card_tags`, or `card_image_index`. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad level.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE` and `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the Business Center TikTok account identity.

identity_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE`. Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE`. Identity type. When `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source` is `STORE`, supported values are only `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, and `BC_AUTH_TT`. If `identity_type=BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required.

image_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `CARD`, `WEB_INFO_CARD`, `INVENTORY_CARD`, or `SUPER_LIKE`. Image ID. Size/spec requirements depend on `creative_portfolio_type`: `CARD` must be 750x421; `WEB_INFO_CARD` recommended 800x800; `INVENTORY_CARD` must be 800x600; `SUPER_LIKE` uses a floating custom icon, recommended 200x200, JPG/JPEG/PNG, within 50 KB.

interactive_music_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE`. URL of the Gesture background music. Must be MP3, within 1 MB, recommended duration 6 seconds. To keep the ad experience smooth, use the video ad background music as the Gesture background music.

item_group_ids.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=STORE`. Also, when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE` and `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`, provide either `product_set_id` or `item_group_ids`. Product SPU IDs. Maximum 20. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

layouts.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. Download Card layout type. You can pass one or two values; if both `TYPE_1` and `TYPE_2` are provided, one Type 1 card and one Type 2 card are created. `TYPE_1` shows app description, `TYPE_2` does not. If `layouts` includes `TYPE_1`, `description` is required.

mobile_app_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. Mobile app identifier used to extract tag information from Google Play or the App Store. For iOS, use the numeric string after `id` in the App Store URL. For Android, use the package name after `id` in the Google Play URL.

pop_up_window_image_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE`; optional when `creative_portfolio_type` is `SUPER_LIKE`. For `GESTURE`, this is the gesture pop-up card shown after the viewer follows the gesture. For `SUPER_LIKE`, this is the pop-up window shown after the floating effect ends and clicking it takes the audience to the ad landing page. Supported specs: recommended 620x788, JPG/JPEG/PNG/GIF, within 3 MB.

product_set_id.description: When `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE` and `product_specific_type=PRODUCT_SET`, provide either `product_set_id` or `item_group_ids`. Product Set ID. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

product_source.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE`. When `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`, this field must be `CATALOG`. `UNSET`, `CATALOG`, `STORE`, `SHOWCASE`. If `product_source=STORE`, `item_group_ids` is required. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value for this field at the ad group level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

product_specific_type.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` with `product_source=CATALOG`, or when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. Defines how products are selected. `ALL` means TikTok may choose from all catalog products and you should not send `sku_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or `product_set_id`. `PRODUCT_SET` means TikTok chooses from a product set and you must send either `item_group_ids` or `product_set_id`. `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` means choose specific products and you must send `sku_ids`. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

profile_image.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. Profile image URL.

selling_points.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `WEB_INFO_CARD`. Reasons the product is worth buying. Maximum 5 items; each item maximum 25 characters.

showcase_products.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=SHOWCASE`. List of Showcase products to use in the ad. Maximum 20.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID the product belongs to.

item_group_id.description: SPU ID of the Showcase product.

store_id.description: Store ID the product belongs to. Only TikTok Shop is supported.

sku_ids.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` or `PRODUCT_TILE` and `product_specific_type=CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Product SKU IDs. Maximum 20. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

slide_dimension.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE` and `gesture_type` is `CURVED_SLIDE`. Dimensions of the Curved Slide Gesture.

dimension_height.description: Required when `slide_dimension` is specified. Height of the Curved Slide Gesture.

dimension_width.description: Required when `slide_dimension` is specified. Width of the Curved Slide Gesture.

slide_length.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `GESTURE` and `gesture_type` is `STRAIGHT_SLIDE`. Length of the Straight Slide Gesture.

sticker_param.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `STICKER`. Details for a Countdown Sticker or Gift Code Sticker. You can create only one Countdown Sticker or Gift Code Sticker at a time.

color.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `STICKER`. Sticker background color. Supported values depend on `sticker_type`: countdown types support `ORANGE`, `BLACK`, `RED`, `BLUE`; `GIFTCODE` supports only `BLACK` and `BLUE`.

cutoff_time.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `COUNTDOWN`, `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, or `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`; not supported when `sticker_type` is `GIFTCODE`. Countdown deadline for `COUNTDOWN`/`REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, or LIVE start time for `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, in format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The time is always interpreted as UTC+0 and the time zone cannot be changed.

display_angle.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `COUNTDOWN`, `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, or `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`; not supported when `sticker_type` is `GIFTCODE`. Sticker display angle. Range `[-180, +180]`; `+90` rotates clockwise by 90 degrees.

giftcode.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `GIFTCODE`; not supported otherwise. Gift code text. Maximum 10 UTF-8 bytes.

landing_page_url.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`. Landing page URL opened when the reminder is clicked after the non-LIVE countdown ends.

live_tiktok_user_id.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`. TikTok user ID of the LIVE host. After this is set, clicking the reminder opens the host's LIVE room.

opacity.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `COUNTDOWN`, `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, or `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`; not supported when `sticker_type` is `GIFTCODE`. Lower values are more transparent.

position_x.description: For countdown types, provide either `predefined_placement` or all of `position_x`, `position_y`, and `size`. For `GIFTCODE`, provide either `predefined_placement` or both `position_x` and `position_y`. Relative x-coordinate from the top-left corner. For countdown types, valid range depends on `size`: `0.6` => [50,301], `0.7` => [50,253], `0.8` => [50,205], `0.9` => [50,157], `1` => [50,109], `1.1` => [50,61]. For `GIFTCODE`, range is [79,145]. If `predefined_placement` is also set, this field is ignored.

position_y.description: For countdown types, provide either `predefined_placement` or all of `position_x`, `position_y`, and `size`. For `GIFTCODE`, provide either `predefined_placement` or both `position_x` and `position_y`. Relative y-coordinate from the top-left corner. For countdown types, valid range depends on `size`: `0.6` => [141,639], `0.7` => [141,606], `0.8` => [141,573], `0.9` => [141,540], `1` => [141,506], `1.1` => [141,473]. For `GIFTCODE`, range is [169,683]. If `predefined_placement` is also set, this field is ignored.

predefined_placement.description: Placement preset. For countdown types, you must provide either `predefined_placement` or all of `position_x`, `position_y`, and `size`. For `GIFTCODE`, you must provide either `predefined_placement` or both `position_x` and `position_y`. If `predefined_placement` is set, overlapping manual placement fields are ignored: for countdown types, `position_x`, `position_y`, and `size` are ignored; for `GIFTCODE`, `position_x` and `position_y` are ignored. For countdown stickers this preset encodes x, y, and size; for gift code stickers it encodes x and y.

reminder_time.description: Required when `sticker_type` is `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` or `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`. Enum values depend on `sticker_type`: for `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, use `ONE_MINUTE_EARLIER`, `ONE_HOUR_EARLIER`, or `ONE_DAY_EARLIER`; for `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN`, use `ONE_MINUTE_AFTER`, `FIVE_MINUTES_AFTER`, or `TEN_MINUTES_AFTER`.

size.description: For countdown types, provide either `predefined_placement` or all of `position_x`, `position_y`, and `size`. Not supported when `sticker_type` is `GIFTCODE`. Sticker size percentage. If `predefined_placement` is also set, this field is ignored.

sticker_type.description: Sticker type. Default is `COUNTDOWN`. `COUNTDOWN` = countdown without reminder; `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` = countdown with reminder for a non-LIVE event; `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` = countdown with reminder for a LIVE event; `GIFTCODE` = gift code sticker. The selected value controls other required fields: `GIFTCODE` requires `giftcode` and does not support `cutoff_time`, `display_angle`, `size`, or `opacity`; countdown types require `cutoff_time`, `display_angle`, and `opacity`; reminder types additionally require `reminder_time`; `REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` requires `landing_page_url`; `LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN` requires `live_tiktok_user_id`.

title.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `STICKER`. Sticker title. For Countdown Sticker, maximum 54 UTF-8 bytes and `#` is not supported. For Gift Code Sticker, maximum 20 UTF-8 bytes.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=STORE`; not supported when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. Business Center ID authorized to access `store_id`. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad group level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

store_id.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=STORE`; not supported when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. TikTok Shop ID. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad group level; otherwise the delivered product thumbnail may not match the promoted product.

tags.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `DOWNLOAD_CARD`. Download Card tags. You can pass multiple values, but if you pass more than two, only two are shown in priority order `CATEGORIES` > `FILESIZE` > `RATING` > `RANKING` > `COMMENT_VOLUME`. If `layouts` includes `TYPE_1`, pass at least one tag. If `layouts` includes `TYPE_2`, pass at least two tags. If `tags` includes `CATEGORIES`, `category_label` is required.

title.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `WEB_INFO_CARD`. Card title. Maximum 25 characters.

vertical_video_strategy.description: Required when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=CATALOG`; not supported when `creative_portfolio_type` is `PRODUCT_TILE`. If `creative_portfolio_type=PRODUCT_CARD` and `product_source=STORE`, you may omit it or set `SINGLE_VIDEO`. Must be `UNSET` if `dynamic_format=DYNAMIC_CREATIVE`. If you later use a Product Card during ad creation, pass the same value at the ad level.

operations.name: creative_portfolio_create

operations.description: Bulk deletes creative portfolios (interactive add-ons) for an advertiser. This endpoint deletes multiple portfolios in one request. Product Card portfolios, Product Tile portfolios, and CTA (Call-to-action) portfolios cannot be deleted with this endpoint. If any provided creative portfolio ID is invalid, the entire deletion request fails; invalid IDs include IDs that do not exist or have already been deleted.

creative_portfolio_ids.description: List of creative portfolio IDs to delete. Maximum 100 IDs. To obtain creative portfolio IDs within an ad account, use /creative/portfolio/list/. You cannot use this field to delete Product Card portfolios, Product Tile portfolios, or CTA (Call-to-action) portfolios. If any ID in the list is invalid, the entire deletion process fails. Invalid IDs include portfolio IDs that do not exist or have already been deleted.

operations.name: creative_portfolio_delete

operations.description: Gets an existing creative portfolio by ID from /open_api/v1.3/creative/portfolio/get/. The portfolio can be one created with /creative/portfolio/create/. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the endpoint path from /v1.2/creative/portfolio/get/ to /v1.3/creative/portfolio/get/ and changes request parameter types for `advertiser_id` and `creative_portfolio_id` from number to string.

creative_portfolio_id.description: ID of the creative portfolio to retrieve. You can get `creative_portfolio_id` from the response of /creative/portfolio/create/.

operations.name: creative_portfolio_get

operations.description: Retrieves creative portfolios created under an ad account. You can filter by creative portfolio type or by creative portfolio ID. If `filtering` is omitted, the endpoint returns all creative portfolio types under the advertiser except CTA portfolios. Supported portfolio types include Display Card, Website info card, Download Card, Inventory Card, Product Card, Product Tiles, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, Pop-up Showcase, Gesture, and Superlike portfolios.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. If omitted, all creative portfolio types except CTA portfolios under the specified advertiser are returned.

creative_portfolio_ids.description: Creative portfolio IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs. CTA portfolio ID filtering is not supported. Use this field, rather than `creative_portfolio_types`, to filter Product Card and Product Tiles portfolios.

creative_portfolio_types.description: Creative portfolio types to filter by. CTA portfolio type filtering is not supported. You cannot use this field to filter Product Card (`PRODUCT_CARD`) or Product Tiles (`PRODUCT_TILE`) portfolios; to filter those two types, use `creative_portfolio_ids` instead.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: >= 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default value: 20. Value range: [1, 100].

operations.name: creative_portfolio_list_get

operations.description: Generates Smart Text ad title recommendations with the `/open_api/v1.3/creative/smart_text/generate/` endpoint. Smart Text automatically suggests ad title copy relevant to your industry and product to help create captions more efficiently. It supports English, Japanese, Vietnamese, and Russian, and is not available to ad accounts in the United States and Canada.

industry_id.description: Industry ID. If provided, it specifies the industry used for recommendation generation.

keywords.description: Keywords used to generate recommendations. Required when `param_type` = `CUSTOMIZED`.

language.description: Language for generated text. Enum values: `EN`, `JA`, `RU`, `VI`. Required when `param_type` = `CUSTOMIZED`.

limit.description: Number of texts to generate. Valid range: 1 to 20. Default is 10.

param_type.description: How parameters are provided. Enum values: `RECOMMENDED`, `CUSTOMIZED`. Default is `CUSTOMIZED`. When set to `RECOMMENDED`, the system predicts parameters such as `language`, `industry_id`, and `keywords` for you. When set to `CUSTOMIZED`, you provide the relevant parameters yourself for more accurate results; in this mode, `language` and `keywords` are required.

operations.name: creative_smart_text_get

operations.description: Runs a basic report on creative assets using /open_api/v1.3/creative/report/get/. Reports can include both undeleted and deleted creative assets. To generate creative-level cost data, first create ads or campaigns through /ad/create/, /ad/aco/create/, or /campaign/spc/create/; if no ads or campaigns were created, or they have generated no cost, the report may return empty results.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser account ID to run the report for. Either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` must be set.

advertiser_ids.description: Either advertiser_id or advertiser_ids has to be set.

end_date.description: Required when `lifetime` is `false`. End date in closed interval format, for example `2020-01-01`, in the advertiser time zone.

filtering.description: Filtering criteria for the report.

ad_id.description: Filter by ad IDs. Bulk query is supported.

ad_name.description: Filter by ad name. Fuzzy search is supported.

adgroup_id.description: Filter by ad group IDs. Bulk query is supported.

adgroup_name.description: Filter by ad group name. Fuzzy search is supported.

app_profile_country.description: Codes of the countries or locations that the instant page is deployed to. Valid when `instant_page_biz_type` includes `APP_PROFILE`.

app_profile_external_app_id.description: App IDs that the instant page directs to. Valid when `instant_page_biz_type` includes `APP_PROFILE`.

campaign_id.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Bulk query is supported.

campaign_name.description: Filter by campaign name. Fuzzy search is supported.

max.description: Maximum value, open interval. If omitted, there is no maximum.

min.description: Minimum value, open interval. If omitted, there is no minimum.

customized_page_external_action.description: Conversion events specific to TikTok instant pages.

identities.description: dentity types that were used for the delivery of the videos. Enum values: SPARK_ADS: Spark Ads identities, including Authorized User, TikTok User, and TikTok Account User in Business Center identities. NON_SPARK_ADS: Non-Spark Ads identities, that is, Custom User identities. To learn more about identity types, see Identities.

material_id.description: Filter by material ID. Maximum 10 material IDs.

material_name.description: Filter by material name. Fuzzy search is supported.

page_biz_type.description: Filter by instant page business type.

page_template_type.description: Filter by instant page template type. When `page_biz_type` includes `CUSTOM`, allowed values are `CUSTOMIZED`, `INTRODUCTION`, `BRAND_SAFETY`, `SALES_PRODUCT`, and `MOVIE_TRAILER`. When `page_biz_type` includes `INSTANT_FORM`, allowed values are `NORMAL_FORM` and `ADVANCED_FORM`.

max.description: Maximum value, open interval. If omitted, there is no maximum.

min.description: Minimum value, open interval. If omitted, there is no minimum.

tiktok_item_ids.description: An ID list of TikTok Spark Ads posts that the video or videos were used to create. Max size: 20. To obtain TikTok post IDs, use /tt_video/info/ or /identity/video/get/.

info_fields.description: Creative info fields to return. Default: [`material_id`, `video_id`, `image_id`, `page_id`]. Allowed values are all fields shown under `info` in the response.

lifetime.description: Whether to query all data. If `true`, you do not need to specify `start_date` and `end_date`. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

metrics_fields.description: Metrics or dimension fields to return. Default: [`impressions`, `spend`]. Allowed values are all fields under `metrics` in the response.

page.description: Page number. Default value: 1. Range: >= 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default value: 10. Range: 1-1000.

report_type.description: Report type. Enum values: VIDEO_INSIGHT: a Video Insights report for one or more advertiser accounts.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. Supports sorting by material creation time and all metrics fields. By default, results are not sorted.

start_date.description: Required when `lifetime` is `false`. Start date in closed interval format, for example `2020-01-01`, in the advertiser time zone.

operations.name: creative_report_get

operations.description: Creates a CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Event Set within an advertiser account. The maximum number of CRM Event Sets allowed per advertiser account is 50. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms (https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and must not share sensitive data with TikTok.

name.description: Name of the CRM Event Set to create in the advertiser account. Maximum length is 40 characters. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed, and the resulting value must not be empty. Duplicate CRM Event Set names are not allowed.

operations.name: crm_create

operations.description: Gets the list of CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Event Sets in an advertiser account. You can filter results by CRM Event Set ID or exact name. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms (https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. This endpoint requires existing CRM Event Sets in the advertiser account; if none exist, create them first with /crm/create/.

event_set_ids.description: List of CRM Event Set IDs to filter by. Maximum 50 IDs. Exact match only. If omitted, all CRM Event Sets in the advertiser account are returned. Only CRM Event Sets whose IDs match values in this field are returned; unmatched IDs are ignored. If both `event_set_ids` and `name` are provided, the result is either the single event set that matches the exact name and has an ID in `event_set_ids`, or empty if no event set meets both conditions. Note: An advertiser account can have at most 50 CRM Event Sets.

name.description: CRM Event Set name to filter by. Length limit: 1-40 characters. Exact match only. If omitted, all CRM Event Sets in the advertiser account are returned. If the provided name does not match any CRM Event Set, the result is empty.

operations.name: crm_list_get

operations.description: Retrieves message event sets in an ad account that can be used to create TikTok Instant Messaging Ads. Before using this endpoint, make sure the ad account already has message event sets; if not, create them in TikTok Events Manager. The endpoint can also filter by messaging app account and returns the event set associated with the specified `messaging_app_account_id` when applicable. For Instant Messaging Ads usage details, see https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1774482999036930.

message_event_name.description: Filter results by message event set name. Exact match only.

message_event_set_ids.description: Filter results by message event set IDs. Maximum 10 IDs.

messaging_app_account_id.description: ID of the instant messaging app account. Its required value depends on `messaging_app_type`: if `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER`, provide a Facebook Page ID containing numbers only; if `WHATSAPP`, provide the WhatsApp phone number as region calling code plus phone number with no special symbols (for example, `15555551234`); if `ZALO`, provide the Zalo Official Account ID.

messaging_app_type.description: Type of instant messaging app. Valid values: `MESSENGER` for Messenger, `WHATSAPP` for WhatsApp, and `ZALO` for Zalo. This field determines the required format and source of `messaging_app_account_id`.

operations.name: ctm_message_event_set_get

operations.description: Creates a Custom Conversion for a Pixel or an App using rule-based conditions. You can create up to 1,000 Custom Conversions per ad account, and up to 100 per Pixel or per App. App-based custom conversions depend on app setup from /app/list/ and, for app event sources, the App must be a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App with `self_attribution_enabled=true`. Mapping App Custom Events to Standard Events during creation requires allowlist access; if `event_source_type` is `APP`, you are using a Custom Event, and the app is not allowlisted for Custom Event to Standard Event mapping, `optimization_event` is not supported.

custom_event_type.description: Custom Event to associate with the Custom Conversion. Valid only when the Custom Event has been configured for the App or Pixel identified by `event_source_id`. When you specify `custom_event_type`, you must specify `optimization_event` at the same time to map the Custom Event to a Standard Event. For app event sources, if you create a custom conversion using a Custom Event, postbacks for the specified App Custom Event must already have been received or the request will fail.

description.description: Description of the Custom Conversion. Maximum 500 characters and cannot contain emoji.

event_source_id.description: Event source ID. When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`, specify a Pixel ID. When `event_source_type` is `APP`, specify the `app_platform_id` of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App, and confirm the App returned by /app/list/ has `self_attribution_enabled=true`. The app can only be used with the TikTok App Events SDK.

event_source_type.description: Event source type. Determines how `event_source_id` is interpreted and when `optimization_event` is required or supported.

name.description: Name of the Custom Conversion. Must start with a letter and may include letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, or hyphens. Maximum 50 characters, no emoji. Do not use the name of a standard event. Duplicate Custom Conversion names within the same ad account are not allowed.

optimization_event.description: Standard Event to associate with the Custom Conversion. Required when `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`; required when `event_source_type` is `APP` and you are creating the custom conversion using a standard event; and required when `event_source_type` is `APP`, you are using a Custom Event through `custom_event_type`, and the app is allowlisted for mapping Custom Events to Standard Events. Not supported when all of the following are true: `event_source_type` is `APP`, you are creating the custom conversion using a Custom Event, and the app is not allowlisted for Custom Event to Standard Event mapping. When you specify `custom_event_type`, you must also specify `optimization_event` simultaneously. Mapping App Custom Events to Standard Events is currently an allowlist-only feature.

rules.description: Conversion rule definitions for the Custom Conversion. Only actions that satisfy these rules are counted as the Custom Conversion. Provide 1 to 10 rule objects.

operator.description: Operator for the rule. Valid values depend on `parameter`: for `BRAND`, `CONTENT_CATEGORY`, `CONTENT_ID`, `CONTENT_NAME`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EVENT_ID`, `SEARCH_STRING`, `STATUS`, and `URL`, use `CONTAIN`, `NOT_CONTAIN`, `START_WITH`, `EQUAL`, or `NOT_EQUAL`; for `NUM_ITEMS`, `PRICE`, and `VALUE`, use `EQUAL`, `NOT_EQUAL`, `LT`, `GT`, `LTE`, or `GTE`; for `CURRENCY`, use `EQUAL` or `NOT_EQUAL`.

parameter.description: Rule parameter. This field determines which `operator` values are valid and what data format `values` must use.

values.description: Rule values. The accepted format depends on `parameter`: when `parameter` is `BRAND`, `CONTENT_CATEGORY`, `CONTENT_ID`, `CONTENT_NAME`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EVENT_ID`, `SEARCH_STRING`, `STATUS`, or `URL`, provide an array of up to 100 strings, each with a maximum length of 100 characters; when `parameter` is `NUM_ITEMS`, provide an integer from 0 to 1,000,000,000; when `parameter` is `PRICE` or `VALUE`, provide a float with up to two decimal places in the range 0.00 to 1,000,000,000.00; when `parameter` is `CURRENCY`, provide an array of currency codes.

operations.name: custom_conversion_create

operations.description: Deletes a Custom Conversion for a Pixel or an App.

custom_conversion_id.description: ID of the Custom Conversion to delete. To obtain valid Custom Conversion IDs associated with a Pixel or an App, use /custom_conversion/list/.

operations.name: custom_conversion_delete

operations.description: Retrieves the details of a Custom Conversion associated with a Pixel or an App. The Custom Conversion must be identified by `custom_conversion_id`, and the request must also specify the matching event source context: `event_source_type=PIXEL` with a Pixel ID, or `event_source_type=APP` with the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App. To obtain valid IDs, use `/custom_conversion/list/`, `/pixel/list/`, and `/app/list/` as applicable; for APP sources, confirm the app's `self_attribution_enabled` is `true` and use its `app_platform_id`.

custom_conversion_id.description: ID of the Custom Conversion to retrieve. To obtain Custom Conversion IDs associated with a Pixel or an App, use `/custom_conversion/list/`.

event_source_id.description: Event source ID. Required with a value that matches `event_source_type`. When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`, specify a Pixel ID; obtain valid IDs from `/pixel/list/` and use the returned `pixel_id`. When `event_source_type` is `APP`, specify the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App; obtain valid IDs from `/app/list/`, confirm the app's `self_attribution_enabled` is `true`, and use the returned `app_platform_id`.
