event_source_type.description: Event source type. This determines how to interpret `event_source_id`: `PIXEL` means `event_source_id` must be a Pixel ID; `APP` means `event_source_id` must be the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App.

operations.name: custom_conversion_get

operations.description: Retrieves the Custom Conversions associated with an event source, which can be either a Pixel or an App, via `/open_api/v1.3/custom_conversion/list/`.

event_source_id.description: Event source ID. When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`, specify a Pixel ID; obtain valid IDs from `/pixel/list/` and use the returned `pixel_id`. When `event_source_type` is `APP`, specify the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App; obtain valid IDs from `/app/list/`, confirm the returned `self_attribution_enabled` is `true`, and use the returned `app_platform_id`.

event_source_type.description: Event source type. Enum values: `PIXEL` for Pixel, `APP` for App.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1-1,000. Default value: 10.

search_keyword.description: Keyword used to search Custom Conversions by name or Custom Conversion ID. Name searches support fuzzy matching; Custom Conversion ID searches support exact matching.

sort_field.description: Sorting field. Enum values: `CREATE_TIME` for the Custom Conversion creation time, `TOTAL_COUNT` for the total conversion count. Default value: `CREATE_TIME`.

sort_type.description: Sorting type. Enum values: `DESC` for descending, `ASC` for ascending. Default value: `DESC`.

operations.name: custom_conversion_list_get

operations.description: Updates an existing Custom Conversion for a Pixel or an App.

custom_conversion_id.description: ID of the Custom Conversion to update. To get Custom Conversion IDs associated with a Pixel or an App, use /custom_conversion/list/.

description.description: New description for the Custom Conversion. Maximum 500 characters. Cannot contain emoji.

name.description: New name for the Custom Conversion. Must start with a letter and may contain letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, or hyphens. Maximum 50 characters. Cannot contain emoji. Do not use the name of a standard event, and duplicate Custom Conversion names within the same ad account are not allowed.

operations.name: custom_conversion_update

operations.description: Retrieves diagnostic information for event sources bound to a catalog. Before using this endpoint, bind an event source to the catalog in Business Center using /catalog/eventsource/bind/ or in TikTok Ads Manager. To verify which event sources are bound to the catalog, use /catalog/eventsource_bind/get/.

app_id.description: Required when `event_source_type` is `APP`. App ID bound to the specified `catalog_id`. To retrieve App IDs bound to the catalog, use /catalog/eventsource_bind/get/.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To get the list of Business Centers you can access, use /bc/get/.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID. To get the catalogs under a Business Center, use /catalog/get/.

event_source_type.description: Event source type. If set to `APP`, you must also pass `app_id`. If set to `PIXEL`, you must also pass `pixel_code`.

event_type.description: Event type to retrieve diagnostic data for. Default is `VIEW_CONTENT`.

pixel_code.description: Required when `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`. Pixel code bound to the specified `catalog_id`. To retrieve Pixel codes bound to the catalog, use /catalog/eventsource_bind/get/.

time_range.description: Time range to retrieve diagnostic data for. Default is `LAST_7_DAYS`.

operations.name: diagnostic_catalog_eventsource_issue_get

operations.description: Retrieves app-event or pixel-event trend metrics for a catalog, including the number of events available for retargeting and the catalog match rate. Before using this endpoint, bind an event source to the catalog in a Business Center with /catalog/eventsource/bind/ or in TikTok Ads Manager. To verify whether an event source is already bound to a catalog, use /catalog/eventsource_bind/get/.

app_id.description: Required when `event_source_type` is `APP`. App ID bound to the specified `catalog_id`.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID.

event_source_type.description: Event source type. If set to `APP`, you must also pass `app_id`. If set to `PIXEL`, you must also pass `pixel_code`.

event_type.description: Event type to retrieve metrics for. Defaults to `VIEW_CONTENT` if omitted.

pixel_code.description: Required when `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`. Pixel code bound to the specified `catalog_id`.

time_range.description: Time range for the metrics. Defaults to `LAST_7_DAYS` if omitted.

operations.name: diagnostic_catalog_eventsource_metric_get

operations.description: Retrieves catalog product diagnostic information synchronously for a catalog. If issues are detected, the most recent diagnostic data may be from the previous day because catalog diagnostics have a one-day delay based on UTC+0 time. If no issues are detected, the returned diagnostic information is empty. For an asynchronous download option, use /diagnostic/catalog/product/task/create/; note that the async task returns less detailed diagnostic information than this endpoint and only includes Product ID (`product_id`), SKU ID (`sku_id` / `hotel_id` / `flight_id` / `destination_id`), item title (`title`), issue title (`issue_title`), severity (`issue_level`), and source (feed name) for each issue.

bc_id.description: ID of a Business Center that either owns the catalog or has been granted access to it as an asset.

catalog_id.description: ID of a catalog that you have permission to access.

feed_id.description: Feed ID. If omitted, the default feed ID for the catalog is used. To retrieve diagnostics for all feeds in the catalog, set this field to `ALL`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for narrowing diagnostic issues.

lang.description: Language for returned `issue_title` and `reason_and_suggestion`. Defaults to `en`.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: `10`. Value range: `[1, 20]`.

operations.name: diagnostic_catalog_get

operations.description: Creates an asynchronous download task for catalog product diagnostic information. After the task is created, use /diagnostic/catalog/product/task/get/ to download the resulting CSV file. Compared with the synchronous diagnostics endpoint /diagnostic/catalog/, this async task returns a less detailed result and only includes Product ID (`product_id`), SKU ID (`sku_id` / `hotel_id` / `flight_id` / `destination_id`), Item title (`title`), Issue title (`issue_title`), Severity (`issue_level`), and Source (feed name) for each issue.

bc_id.description: ID of a Business Center that either owns the catalog or has been granted access to it as an asset.

catalog_id.description: ID of a catalog that you have permission to access.

feed_id.description: Feed ID. If omitted, the default feed ID for the catalog is used. Set to `ALL` to retrieve diagnostics for all feeds in the catalog.

issue_id.description: Issue ID to download diagnostic information for. Must be one of the downloadable issue IDs: `1101`, `1102`, `1103`, `1105`, `1106`, `1107`, `1108`, `1109`, `1110`, `1111`, `1112`, `1113`, `2001`, `2002`, `2003`, `2004`, `3001`, `4001`, `4002`, `4003`, `4005`, `4006`, `4007`, `4008`, or `4009`. If omitted, diagnostics for all detected issues are returned.

lang.description: Language for the returned catalog diagnostic information. Defaults to `en` if omitted.

operations.name: diagnostic_catalog_product_task_create

operations.description: Gets the status and downloadable CSV URL for an asynchronous catalog product diagnostic export task created with /diagnostic/catalog/product/task/create/. The CSV only includes Product ID (`product_id`), SKU ID (`sku_id` / `hotel_id` / `flight_id` / `destination_id`), item title (`title`), issue title (`issue_title`), severity (`issue_level`), and source (feed name) for each issue. For more detailed synchronous catalog diagnostic information, use /diagnostic/catalog/.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID used when you created the catalog diagnostic download task.

catalog_id.description: Catalog ID used when you created the catalog diagnostic download task.

task_id.description: ID of the catalog diagnostic download task. Obtain this ID from /diagnostic/catalog/product/task/create/.

operations.name: diagnostic_catalog_product_task_get

operations.description: Gets information about images stored in the Asset Library. Endpoint: /v1.3/file/image/ad/info/. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and v1.3 adds the response field `is_carousel_usable` while deprecating response field `id`.

image_ids.description: List of image IDs to query. Maximum 100 IDs per request. IDs for thumbnails returned by `/ad/get/` for ads created in TikTok Ads Manager are not supported, because those thumbnails were not uploaded to the Asset Library and linked to the ad account.

operations.name: file_image_ad_info_get

operations.description: Search image creatives in an advertising account's Asset Library via /v1.3/file/image/ad/search/. Results are limited to the first 10,000 images, ordered by `modify_time`. Compared with v1.2, this v1.3 endpoint changes `advertiser_id` from number to string.

filtering.description: Filters applied to the image search. Supports `height`, `image_ids`, `material_ids`, `ratio`, `width`, and `displayable`.

displayable.description: Whether to search only materials displayed on the platform. `false` (default) searches all materials; `true` searches only materials displayed on the platform.

image_ids.description: Filter by image IDs. Maximum 100 IDs.

material_ids.description: Filter by material IDs. Maximum 100 IDs.

ratio.description: Filter by image aspect ratio, for example `[1.7, 2.5]`. A value such as `1.7` matches images with ratio between 1.65 and 1.75, using 0.05 precision.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `20`. Valid range: `1`-`100`.

operations.name: file_image_ad_search

operations.description: Updates the name of an existing image. Endpoint path: /v1.3/file/image/ad/update/. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string.

file_name.description: New image name. Length limit: 1-100 characters. If another image under the same `advertiser_id` already uses the same file name, a millisecond timestamp is appended to the end. If the name exceeds 100 characters, only the first 100 characters are used.

image_id.description: ID of the image to rename.

operations.name: file_image_ad_update

operations.description: Uploads an image to the Asset Library and returns an image ID for ad creation. Request timeout is 10 seconds, and upload speed depends on network bandwidth, so keep file sizes reasonable. This endpoint can be used for standard ad image assets and, if the uploaded asset qualifies, for Carousel Ads.

file_id.description: Required when `upload_type` is `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`. ID of an image file already uploaded to the file repository.

file_name.description: Image name. Length limit: 1-100 characters. If omitted, the default is the original file name; if the final file name exceeds 100 characters, it is truncated. Under the same `advertiser_id`, file names must be unique. You can call `/file/name/check/` to verify whether the name has already been used. If you get a duplicate file name error, rename the file or append a timestamp such as `<original_filename>_<timestamp>` and upload again.

image_url.description: Required when `upload_type` is `UPLOAD_BY_URL`. Public URL of the image to upload, for example `http://xxx.xxx`.

upload_type.description: Image upload method. When `UPLOAD_BY_URL`, you must provide `image_url`. When `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`, you must provide `file_id`.

operations.name: file_image_ad_upload

operations.description: Gets the list of music available for video creation or Carousel Ads creation from both the advertiser's uploaded music and the Audio Library (Commercial Music Library) at /open_api/v1.3/file/music/get/. For Audio Library music, TikTok recommends caching results and refreshing monthly because the library does not update frequently. Copyright notice: music provided by TikTok can only be used for creatives served on TikTok; you must not download, distribute, make available, or perform the video or embedded music on other media unless you separately obtain permission from the rights holders.

filtering.description: Filter conditions for music search. Which nested fields are valid or required depends on `music_scene` and `search_type`.

carousel_image_index.description: Valid only when `music_scene` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, and additional images are configured for the specified products. Selects which additional product image position to use in the VSA Carousel Ad. If omitted, the main product images are used. Range: [0, 9]. The value is the zero-based position in each product's `additional_image_urls`; for example, `1` uses the second additional image URL for each product. If the index is greater than the number of additional image URLs for a product, this field is ignored for that product and its main `image_url` is used. You can retrieve `additional_image_urls` and `image_url` from `/catalog/product/get/`.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `music_scene` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` and `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`. Business Center ID that has permission to access the catalog. For a catalog in Business Center, specify the ID of the Business Center that the catalog belongs to.

catalog_id.description: Required when `music_scene` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` and `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`. Catalog ID.

image_urls.description: Required when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` and `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`; invalid when `search_type` is not `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`. List of image URLs used to get recommended music. Size range: [2, 35]. Provide at least 2 image URLs obtained from `/file/image/ad/upload/` or `/file/image/ad/search/`. Each image must be JPG, JPEG, or PNG; at most 1242×2340 px or 2340×1242 px; aspect ratio at most 9:20 or 20:9; file size below 50 MB; and `is_carousel_usable` returned by `/file/image/ad/search/` must be `true`. If you use the recommended music to create non-VSA Carousel Ads, you must use the same images in the ad.

item_group_ids.description: If `music_scene` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, and you want recommended music for a VSA Carousel Ad with products dynamically selected from a product set, you must specify either `product_set_id` or `item_group_ids`. Do not pass this field when you want recommendations for all products in the catalog. Product SPU IDs. Max size: 20.

keyword.description: Required when `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_KEYWORD`. Invalid for any other `search_type`. Keyword used for music search.

material_ids.description: Not supported when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Material IDs. Max size: 100.

music_ids.description: Required when `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_MUSIC_ID`. Music IDs to look up. Max size: 100.

product_set_id.description: If `music_scene` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, and you want recommended music for a VSA Carousel Ad with products dynamically selected from a product set, you must specify either `product_set_id` or `item_group_ids`. Do not pass this field when you want recommendations for all products in the catalog. Product set ID.

sku_ids.description: Required if `music_scene` is `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, and you want recommended music for a VSA Carousel Ad with specific catalog products. Do not pass this field when you want recommendations for all products in the catalog. SKU IDs. Min size: 2. Max size: 20.

sources.description: Optional when `music_scene` is `CREATIVE_ASSET` or omitted. Required when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` and `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_SOURCE`; in that case it can only be `USER` to filter user-uploaded music for Carousel Ads. Music source: `USER` = advertiser-uploaded music, `SYSTEM` = system music. Max size: 1.

styles.description: Not supported when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`. Music style. Max size: 1.

music_scene.description: Scenario where the music will be used. `CREATIVE_ASSET` = Creative Tools; `CAROUSEL_ADS` = non-shopping Carousel Ads; `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` = Shopping Ads (VSA) Carousel. Default is `CREATIVE_ASSET`.

page.description: Current page number. Default: 1. Must be >= 1. The product of `page` and `page_size` cannot exceed 100,000. When `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, `SEARCH_BY_LIKED`, or `SEARCH_BY_MUSIC_ID`, pagination is not supported and `page` and `page_size` are ignored.

page_size.description: Page size. Default: 1,000. General range: 1-1,000. The product of `page` and `page_size` cannot exceed 100,000. When `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, `SEARCH_BY_LIKED`, or `SEARCH_BY_MUSIC_ID`, pagination is not supported and `page` and `page_size` are ignored. When `search_type` is `SEARCH_BY_KEYWORD` or `SEARCH_BY_HISTORY`, the default is 200 and the allowed range is [1,200].

search_type.description: Required when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`; not supported when `music_scene` is `CREATIVE_ASSET` or omitted. `SEARCH_BY_KEYWORD` requires `filtering.keyword` and cannot search user-uploaded music. `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`: when `music_scene=CAROUSEL_ADS`, requires `filtering.image_urls` and returns up to 500 recommended tracks; when `music_scene=CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, requires `filtering.catalog_id` and `filtering.catalog_authorized_bc_id`, then choose one product scope: pass none of `filtering.product_set_id`, `filtering.item_group_ids`, and `filtering.sku_ids` for all products, pass either `filtering.product_set_id` or `filtering.item_group_ids` for a product set, or pass `filtering.sku_ids` for specific products. Recommended search cannot search user-uploaded music. `SEARCH_BY_LIKED` searches the Liked list and returns up to 1,000 tracks. `SEARCH_BY_HISTORY` searches the History list. `SEARCH_BY_MUSIC_ID` requires `filtering.music_ids`. `SEARCH_BY_SOURCE` requires `filtering.sources`; for Carousel Ads, only user-uploaded music can be filtered. When set to `SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND`, `SEARCH_BY_LIKED`, or `SEARCH_BY_MUSIC_ID`, pagination is not supported and `page` and `page_size` are ignored.

operations.name: file_music_get

operations.description: Uploads music and returns a music ID, or performs music-list actions for Carousel Ads by adding music to the Liked list or History list, or removing music from the Liked list. Copyright notice: you must have the right to use the music; any copyright infringement is your responsibility. Header usage depends on upload mode: use  `application/json` when `upload_type` is `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`. Version note: in v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, request parameters `music_scene`, `material_action`, and `material_id` were added, and response field `name` was deprecated.

file_id.description: File repository ID of the music file. Required when `upload_type` is `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`. Obtain this value from the Upload Files endpoints. When `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, the referenced file must be a customized MP3 no larger than 10 MB.

file_name.description: Music name. Valid only when `upload_type` is provided. Length: 1-100 characters. Defaults to the local file name if omitted.

material_action.description: Operation to perform on an existing piece of music. Supported only when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`; when those scenes are used, you must provide either `upload_type` or `material_action`. Not supported when `music_scene` is `CREATIVE_ASSET` or omitted. If this field is provided, `material_id` is also required. Enum values: `ADD_TO_LIKED`, `ADD_TO_HISTORY`, `REMOVE_FROM_LIKED`. The ad account's Liked list can contain up to 1,000 pieces of music; once the limit is reached, `ADD_TO_LIKED` cannot be used to add more.

material_id.description: Material ID of the music used for list operations. Required when `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` and `material_action` is provided. Not supported when `music_scene` is `CREATIVE_ASSET` or omitted. Use this for adding music to the Liked list or History list, or removing music from the Liked list. You can obtain a valid value either by uploading customized music for Carousel Ads through this endpoint, or from the `material_id` returned by `/file/music/get/`.

music_scene.description: Scenario where the music is used. Enum values: `CREATIVE_ASSET` for Creative Tools, `CAROUSEL_ADS` for non-shopping carousel ads, and `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` for shopping ads (VSA) carousel format. Default is `CREATIVE_ASSET`.

upload_type.description: Upload method. When `music_scene` is `CAROUSEL_ADS` or `CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, you must provide either `upload_type` or `material_action`. If set to `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`, provide `file_id`.

operations.name: file_music_upload

operations.description: Checks whether one or more image or video file names have already been used under the same ad account (`advertiser_id`). File names must be unique within an advertiser account for ad images and videos. If you skip this check and later get a duplicate-name error when uploading via `/file/image/ad/upload/` or `/file/video/ad/upload/`, you must upload the file again.

file_name.description: Use this top-level field when checking a single file name. In that case, `file_type` is also required. If checking multiple file names, use `files` instead.

file_type.description: Use this top-level field when checking a single file name. In that case, `file_name` is also required. If checking multiple file names, use `files` instead. Enum values: `VIDEO` (video), `IMAGE` (image). Default value: `VIDEO`.

files.description: Use this field to check multiple file names at once. If checking multiple names, `files` is required. Each item should include `file_name` and may include `file_type`; if omitted, `file_type` defaults to `VIDEO`. If checking a single file name instead, use top-level `file_name` and `file_type`. Maximum 20 items.

file_name.description: Required when `files` is passed. File name.

file_type.description: File type. Enum values: `VIDEO` (video), `IMAGE` (image). Default value: `VIDEO`.

operations.name: file_name_check

operations.description: Uploads a file to TikTok's temporary file repository via POST /open_api/v1.3/file/temporarily/upload/. Upload speed depends on network bandwidth. The maximum upload size is 100 MB. A successful upload returns a `file_id`, which can then be used to retrieve the file from the repository and transfer it to the Asset Library. Uploaded files remain in the repository for 24 hours only; after expiration, you must upload the file again before using it in ads.

name.description: File name. Maximum 100 characters. Each Chinese or Japanese character counts as three characters; each English letter counts as one character.

upload_type.description: Upload method. `URL` means you provide the source in the `url` field. Required companion fields depend on this value: `URL` requires `url`.

url.description: Source URL of the file, in the format `http://xxx.xxx`. Required when `upload_type` is `URL`.

operations.name: file_temporarily_upload

operations.description: Retrieves information for a list of Asset Library videos that can be used in ads. Request up to 60 `video_ids`; any video ID that cannot be used in ads is ignored. Version note: in v1.3 the endpoint path is `/v1.3/file/video/ad/info/`, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and response fields changed from `poster_url` to `video_cover_url` and `url` to `preview_url`; `id` is deprecated and `preview_url_expire_time` was added.

video_ids.description: List of video IDs to query. Maximum 60 items per request. If a video cannot be used in ads, that video ID is ignored.

operations.name: file_video_ad_info_get

operations.description: Searches video creatives in an ad account's Asset Library that can be used in ads. Only the 10,000 most recently modified videos are included in the results. v1.3 uses `advertiser_id` as a string, deprecates request parameters `height`, `ratio`, `width`, and `displayable`, and adds `video_name` and `video_material_sources`.

filtering.description: Filters used to narrow the video search.

material_ids.description: List of material IDs. Maximum 20 items.

video_ids.description: List of video IDs to search for. Maximum 100 items. If a video cannot be used in ads, that video ID is ignored. If `video_ids` is omitted and multiple video IDs were generated for the same video due to multiple uploads, only one valid video ID is returned for that video.

video_material_sources.description: List of video material sources to filter by.

video_name.description: Video name for fuzzy matching search.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `20`. Valid range: `1` to `100`.

operations.name: file_video_ad_search

operations.description: Updates the name of a video at /v1.3/file/video/ad/update/. Compared with v1.2, the v1.3 endpoint changes `advertiser_id` from number to string.

file_name.description: New video name. Length limit: 1-100 characters. If another video under the same `advertiser_id` already uses the same file name, a millisecond timestamp is appended to the end. If the name exceeds 100 characters, only the first 100 characters are used.

operations.name: file_video_ad_update

operations.description: Uploads a video to the Asset Library so the returned `video_id` can be used for ad creation. Request timeout is 10 seconds, and upload speed depends on network bandwidth, so keep file sizes reasonable. If the uploaded video already exists in the advertiser account, the API returns the existing video's information. Smart Fix is recommended when uploading videos. Starting April 24th, 2025, Smart Fix automatically fixes only `LOW_RESOLUTION` and `ILLEGAL_VIDEO_SIZE`; `LOW_RESOLUTION` is enhanced to 1280x720 (720p), `ILLEGAL_VIDEO_SIZE` is adjusted to 1:1, 9:16, or 16:9, only one fixed version is returned, and the fixed video's name follows `file_name` or the default naming convention. Before use in ads, the video must meet creative delivery requirements. Related endpoints referenced by this workflow include /file/name/check/ for duplicate-name checks and /file/video/ad/search/ for retrieving video details when processing is delayed.

auto_bind_enabled.description: Valid only when `flaw_detect=true` and `auto_fix_enabled=true`. Whether to automatically upload the fixed video to your creative library. Default value: `false`.

auto_fix_enabled.description: Whether to automatically fix detected video issues. Default value: `false`. Behavior depends on this field and `flaw_detect`: if issues are detected and `auto_fix_enabled=false`, the API returns an error with flaw types; if `flaw_detect=true` and `auto_fix_enabled=true`, the API automatically fixes `LOW_RESOLUTION` and `ILLEGAL_VIDEO_SIZE` and returns `fix_task_id` and `flaw_types`. `LOW_RESOLUTION` is enhanced to 1280x720 (720p). `ILLEGAL_VIDEO_SIZE` is adjusted to one of the standard aspect ratios: 1:1, 9:16, or 16:9.

file_id.description: Required when `upload_type=UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`. ID of a file already uploaded to the file repository.

file_name.description: Video name. Length limit: 1-100 characters. Default behavior depends on Smart Fix: when `flaw_detect=false` and `auto_fix_enabled=false`, the default is the original local file name or the filename part of the URL path; if that source name exceeds 100 characters, only the first 100 characters are used. When `flaw_detect=true` and `auto_fix_enabled=true`, the default is still the original file name or URL filename, and if you provide `file_name`, that value becomes the fixed video's name. Videos under the same `advertiser_id` cannot have duplicate file names; use /file/name/check/ to verify availability before upload. If you get a duplicate-name error, rename the file or append a timestamp and upload again.

flaw_detect.description: Whether to automatically detect issues in the video. Default value: `false`. When used together with `auto_fix_enabled=true`, issue detection can lead to automatic fixes and fixed-video retrieval behavior.

is_third_party.description: Whether the video is third-party content.

upload_type.description: Video upload method. `Content-Type` also depends on this field: use `application/json` when `upload_type=UPLOAD_BY_URL` or `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`. Companion-field requirements: `UPLOAD_BY_URL` requires `video_url`; `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID` requires `file_id`; `UPLOAD_BY_VIDEO_ID` requires `video_id`. If set to `UPLOAD_BY_URL`, or `UPLOAD_BY_FILE_ID`, the API returns a new `video_id`; uploading the same video multiple times with any of those three modes still generates a new `video_id` each time.

video_id.description: Required when `upload_type=UPLOAD_BY_VIDEO_ID`. Existing video ID. Pass only a `video_id` created in TikTok Ads Manager or via API; values from other sources may fail or produce a video that cannot be used for ad creation. You can obtain valid `video_id` values from this endpoint's response or from /file/video/ad/search/.

video_url.description: Required when `upload_type=UPLOAD_BY_URL`. Public video URL, such as `http://xxx.xxx`. Recommended file size is within 10 MB. The URL must be browser-valid and properly encoded, for example spaces must be encoded as `%20`. The server verifies the response `Content-Type`; text media types such as `text/html` or `text/plain` are invalid. If the source response includes `Content-MD5`, the data is also verified against it. Ratio, format, resolution, and bitrate limits are the same as for `video_file`. Before uploading, make sure the URL is playable and in a supported format; invalid or unsupported URLs can cause an error or produce an unusable `video_id` for ad creation.

operations.name: file_video_ad_upload

operations.description: Gets a list of suggested thumbnail images for a video creative from `GET /open_api/v1.3/file/video/suggestcover/`. Use the returned image URLs to preview candidates, then choose one to set as the thumbnail for your video ad. For recently uploaded videos, wait 30 seconds to 5 minutes before calling this endpoint so the video can finish transcoding and processing; calling earlier may return an `Insufficient permissions for some videos` error.

poster_number.description: Number of thumbnail candidates to return. Range: `1-10`. Default: `10`. If fewer candidates exist than requested, all available candidates are returned.

video_id.description: Video ID of the uploaded video creative to generate thumbnail suggestions for.

operations.name: file_video_suggestcover_get

operations.description: Creates a GMV Max campaign at `/campaign/gmv_max/create/`. Before creating a campaign, verify that the TikTok Shop is GMV Max-eligible via `/gmv_max/store/list/` (`is_gmv_max_available=true`). Also confirm the selected ad account has exclusive GMV Max authorization for the shop by checking `exclusive_authorized_advertiser_info.advertiser_id` from `/gmv_max/store/list/`; if it does not match, grant authorization first with `/gmv_max/exclusive_authorization/create/`. Product campaigns may also require checking `/gmv_max/store/shop_ad_usage_check/` to confirm whether promoting all products is allowed. For product campaigns, recommended `roas_bid` and `budget` can be fetched from `/gmv_max/bid/recommend/`. If you create campaigns with customized posts, note that `custom_anchor_video_list` can include up to 200 items at creation time, and additional items can later be added incrementally through `/campaign/gmv_max/update/` in batches of up to 200, up to 2,000 customized posts per Product GMV Max campaign. Promotion-days ROI calculation changes described for `promotion_days.roas_bid_multiplier` are allowlist-only.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID for the campaign. Before use, call `/gmv_max/store/list/` and confirm that `exclusive_authorized_advertiser_info.advertiser_id` matches this ad account; if it does not, grant exclusive GMV Max authorization for the shop with `/gmv_max/exclusive_authorization/create/` before creating the campaign.

affiliate_posts_enabled.description: Valid only when both `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT` and `product_video_specific_type=AUTO_SELECTION`. In that case, the field defaults to `true`. Whether to enable affiliate posts for the Product GMV Max campaign. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

auto_budget.description: Automatic budget settings for non-promotion days.

auto_budget_enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic budget increase during non-promotion days. When enabled, daily budget can increase to optimize for more sales on days where the campaign has reached at least 90% of its ROI target and at least 80% of its budget has been used. The daily budget resets to its original amount each day. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default is `false`.

budget_increase_percentage.description: Budget increase percentage during non-promotion days. Value range: 50-300. For example, `50` means a 50% budget increase when automatic budget increase is triggered. Default is `50`.

increase_limit.description: Maximum number of daily budget increases during non-promotion days. Value range: 1-10. For example, `10` allows up to 10 budget increases per day. Default is `10`.

budget.description: Daily budget. Recommended values can be obtained from `/gmv_max/bid/recommend/`.

campaign_name.description: Name of the GMV Max campaign.

deep_bid_type.description: Bid strategy. Only `VO_MIN_ROAS` is supported, which bids with an ROI target. When `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`, `roas_bid` is required.

identity_list.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type` is `LIVE`. Optional when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT` and `product_video_specific_type` is `AUTO_SELECTION`. For Product + `AUTO_SELECTION`, specify 0-20 identities as video-creative sources; obtain eligible identities from `/gmv_max/identity/get/` where `product_gmv_max_available=true`. If you omit `identity_list` in this mode, product images are used as ad creatives. For `shopping_ads_type=LIVE`, specify exactly one identity as the LIVE source; obtain an eligible identity from `/gmv_max/identity/get/` where `live_gmv_max_available=true`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the identity.

identity_authorized_shop_id.description: Required only when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT` and `/gmv_max/identity/get/` returns `identity_authorized_shop_id` for the selected identity. TikTok Shop ID associated with the Business Center TikTok account identity.

identity_id.description: Required when `identity_list` is passed. Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Required when `identity_list` is passed. Identity type. `AUTH_CODE` is an authorized user created by using an authorization code to access a TikTok account or post. `TT_USER` is a TikTok user identity created by account binding. `BC_AUTH_TT` is a TikTok account user in Business Center. `TTS_TT` is a TikTok account user for TikTok Shop. If `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required. If `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT` and `/gmv_max/identity/get/` returns `identity_authorized_shop_id` for that identity, you must also pass `identity_authorized_shop_id`. If `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`, `store_id` is required.

store_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`. TikTok Shop ID associated with the TikTok Shop identity.

item_group_ids.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT` and `product_specific_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Product SPU IDs to promote. Maximum 400 items. Obtain eligible values from `/store/product/get/` by setting `ad_creation_eligible=GMV_MAX` and selecting `item_group_id` values where `status` is `AVAILABLE` and `gmv_max_ads_status` is `UNOCCUPIED`.

item_list.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT` and `product_video_specific_type` is `CUSTOM_SELECTION`. List of authorized TikTok posts or customized TikTok posts to associate with the Product GMV Max campaign. If you want manually selected authorized posts only, provide `item_list` and do not provide `custom_anchor_video_list`. If you want manually selected customized posts, provide `item_list` and `custom_anchor_video_list` together. Maximum 50 items. Obtain eligible TikTok posts from `/gmv_max/video/get/`.

identity_info.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. Identity associated, or to be associated, with the TikTok post.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the identity.

identity_authorized_shop_id.description: Required only when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT` and `/gmv_max/identity/get/` returns `identity_authorized_shop_id` for the selected identity.

identity_id.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. Identity type. `AUTH_CODE` is an authorized user created by using an authorization code to access a TikTok account or post. `TT_USER` is a TikTok user identity created by account binding. `BC_AUTH_TT` is a TikTok account user in Business Center. `TTS_TT` is a TikTok account user for TikTok Shop. If `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required. If `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT` and `/gmv_max/identity/get/` returns `identity_authorized_shop_id` for that identity, you must also pass `identity_authorized_shop_id`. If `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`, `store_id` is required.

store_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`. TikTok Shop ID associated with the identity.

item_id.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. TikTok post ID.

spu_id_list.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. Product SPU IDs associated, or to be associated, with the TikTok post.

video_info.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. Video details for the post.

video_id.description: Required when `item_list` is passed. Video ID.

optimization_goal.description: Optimization goal. Only `VALUE` is supported for GMV Max campaign creation.

product_specific_type.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT`. Controls how products are selected: `ALL` lets TikTok dynamically choose from all products in the shop, while `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` requires `item_group_ids`. To verify whether `ALL` is allowed for the shop, call `/gmv_max/store/shop_ad_usage_check/` and check `promote_all_products_allowed`.

product_video_specific_type.description: Required when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT`. Video selection mode. `AUTO_SELECTION` lets TikTok auto-select videos; you may provide `identity_list` or omit it, and if `identity_list` is omitted product images are used as ad creatives. `CUSTOM_SELECTION` requires `item_list`.

promotion_days.description: Promotion-days settings for automatically optimizing for higher GMV during high-intent shopping dates. To customize budget increases during promotion days, use `budget_increase_percentage` and `increase_limit` inside this object.

auto_schedule_enabled.description: Valid only when `is_enabled` is `true`. Whether to use the TikTok Shop promotion-days schedule. Supported values: `true`, `false`. When `is_enabled` is `true`, this field is automatically set to `true`.

budget_increase_percentage.description: Budget increase percentage during promotion days. Value range: 50-300. For example, `50` means a 50% budget increase when automatic budget increase is triggered. Default is `50`.

custom_schedule_list.description: Custom promotion-days schedules. If `auto_schedule_enabled` is `false`, you must provide at least one `start_date`/`end_date` pair. If `auto_schedule_enabled` is `true`, this field is optional. Maximum 50 items.

end_date.description: End date for a custom promotion-days schedule in `YYYY-MM-DD` format using the ad account time zone. `end_date` cannot be earlier than the current time. The custom schedule ends automatically at `00:00:00` on the end date.

start_date.description: Start date for a custom promotion-days schedule in `YYYY-MM-DD` format using the ad account time zone. `start_date` cannot be after `end_date`, cannot be earlier than the current date, and must be on or after the campaign `schedule_start_time`. The custom schedule starts automatically at `00:00:00` on the start date.

increase_limit.description: Maximum number of daily budget increases during promotion days. Value range: 1-10. For example, `10` allows up to 10 budget increases per day. Default is `10`.

is_enabled.description: Whether to enable promotion days. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default is `false`. If `promotion_days` is specified, this field is automatically set to `true`.

roas_bid_multiplier.description: Promotion-days ROI reduction setting. `90` reduces target ROI by 10%, `80` by 20%, and `70` by 30%. Default is `90`. Note: TikTok will update how promotional ROI goals are calculated by using the lower of recent campaign performance from the last 7 non-promotion days or your entered ROI, then applying the selected reduction. This is an allowlist-only feature, and the returned ROI goal value may differ without requiring code changes.

request_id.description: Idempotency key for the create request. If you retry with the same `request_id` within the 10-second cache window, only one request succeeds; after the cache expires, the same value is treated as a new request. This is different from the response `request_id`, which identifies the HTTP request. Must be a string representation of a 64-bit integer, for example `"123456789"`.

roas_bid.description: Required when `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`. ROI target, with up to one decimal place, for example `3.2` or `3`. Recommended values can be obtained from `/gmv_max/bid/recommend/`.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Not supported when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. Campaign delivery end time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format, UTC+0. The end time cannot be later than `2038-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_start_time.description: Campaign delivery start time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format, UTC+0. The start time can be up to 12 hours earlier than the current time, but cannot be later than `2028-01-01 00:00:00`.

schedule_type.description: Campaign schedule mode. `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` runs continuously after the scheduled start time. `SCHEDULE_START_END` runs between the scheduled start and end times and requires `schedule_end_time`.

shopping_ads_type.description: GMV Max campaign type. Use `PRODUCT` for Product GMV Max campaigns or `LIVE` for LIVE GMV Max campaigns. This field controls other requirements: `product_specific_type` and `product_video_specific_type` are only used for `PRODUCT`, while `identity_list` is required for `LIVE`.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: Business Center ID that is authorized to access the selected `store_id`.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID for the campaign. Obtain a shop from `/gmv_max/store/list/` and use one where `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_create

operations.description: Retrieves the details of a GMV Max Campaign. You must provide the GMV Max campaign ID. To obtain a campaign ID, create a campaign with /campaign/gmv_max/create/ or list existing GMV Max campaigns with /gmv_max/campaign/get/.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the GMV Max Campaign to retrieve. To create a GMV Max campaign and obtain its ID, use /campaign/gmv_max/create/. To filter existing GMV Max campaigns within your ad account, use /gmv_max/campaign/get/.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_info_get

operations.description: Creates a session in a Product GMV Max Campaign for either max delivery on a specific product or creative boost on a specific video. Max delivery uses additional budget to maximize gross revenue for selected products over a selected period. Creative boost lets sellers manually promote specific videos with extra daily budget. Prerequisites vary by `session.bid_type`: for max delivery (`NO_BID`), verify the campaign uses Target ROI by calling `/gmv_max/report/get/` and confirming `bid_type` is `CUSTOM`; obtain a valid Product GMV Max `campaign_id` from `/campaign/gmv_max/create/` with `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT` or `/gmv_max/campaign/get/` filtered to `gmv_max_promotion_types=["PRODUCT_GMV_MAX"]`. For creative boost (`CREATIVE_NO_BID`), the campaign must be active, there must be no max delivery session already set for the product, there can be at most 100 creative boost videos per Product GMV Max Campaign, the new session must not overlap any existing creative boost session for the same video, and the video must not have `creative_delivery_status` of `AUTHORIZATION_NEEDED`, `EXCLUDED`, `REJECTED`, or `UNAVAILABLE`. Use `/campaign/gmv_max/session/list/` to check existing sessions and `/gmv_max/report/get/` to check creative-level status.

campaign_id.description: ID of the Product GMV Max Campaign. To create and obtain a campaign ID, use `/campaign/gmv_max/create/` with `shopping_ads_type` set to `PRODUCT`. To find existing Product GMV Max campaigns, use `/gmv_max/campaign/get/` with `filtering={"gmv_max_promotion_types":["PRODUCT_GMV_MAX"]}`.

session.description: Session details for either max delivery or creative boost. The required and supported nested fields depend on `bid_type`: use `NO_BID` or omit `bid_type` for a max delivery session, and use `CREATIVE_NO_BID` for a creative boost session.

bid_type.description: Session type. `NO_BID` creates a max delivery session and is also the default if omitted. `CREATIVE_NO_BID` creates a creative boost session. When `bid_type` is `NO_BID`, use the max delivery field semantics: `product_list`, `budget`, optional `schedule_type`, optional `schedule_start_time`, and conditional `schedule_end_time`. When `bid_type` is `CREATIVE_NO_BID`, use the creative boost field semantics: `product_list`, required `item_id`, `budget`, required `schedule_type`, and conditional `schedule_end_time`.

budget.description: Daily budget for the session. For max delivery, this is the additional max delivery budget, separate from the Target ROI optimization budget; the Target ROI budget will not be used for products while max delivery is active. For creative boost, this is separate from campaign budget and is paced across the schedule; it is not included in campaign ROI protection calculations. Value range: >= 10 (USD).

item_id.description: ID of the video to enable creative boost for. Required when `bid_type` is `CREATIVE_NO_BID`. To get valid video IDs in an existing GMV Max campaign, use `/gmv_max/report/get/` and retrieve creative-level data, then use the `item_id` metric. The video's `creative_delivery_status` must not be `AUTHORIZATION_NEEDED`, `EXCLUDED`, `REJECTED`, or `UNAVAILABLE`.

product_list.description: Details of the specific product to target. Max size: 1. Required for both max delivery and creative boost.

spu_id.description: Product SPU (standard product unit) ID. To get valid SPU IDs for products in a TikTok Shop, use `/store/product/get/` with `ad_creation_eligible=GMV_MAX` and select `item_group_id` values whose `status` is `AVAILABLE`.

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Not supported when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. End time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format (UTC+0). The end time cannot be earlier than the current time and must be earlier than or equal to the campaign end time.

schedule_start_time.description:
The start time for the max delivery mode, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC+0).
If not specified, this field will default to the current time.
Note:
The start time cannot be earlier than the current time. The start time should be later than or equal to the campaign start time. Your daily budget will be spent evenly throughout the day. If your max delivery duration is less than 24 hours in a given day, your full budget will still be spent. Max delivery will be active between your set start and end times for your selected products. If your campaign is still active when max delivery ends, the optimization mode for those products will automatically change to target ROI.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type. For max delivery: `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` enables max delivery continuously after `schedule_start_time` until the campaign scheduled end time; `SCHEDULE_START_END` enables max delivery between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`. For creative boost: `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` enables creative boost from the current time until the campaign scheduled end time; `SCHEDULE_START_END` enables creative boost between the current time and `schedule_end_time`. Default value: `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`.

store_id.description: ID of the TikTok Shop associated with the GMV Max campaign. Obtain this ID using `/campaign/gmv_max/info/`.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_session_create

operations.description: Deletes a session in an active Product GMV Max Campaign. Use it to delete either a max delivery session for a specific product or a creative boost session for a specific video.

session_id.description: ID of the session to delete in a Product GMV Max Campaign. To get active max delivery session IDs, call /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select sessions whose `bid_type` is `NO_BID`. To get active creative boost session IDs, call /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select sessions whose `bid_type` is `CREATIVE_NO_BID`.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_session_delete

operations.description: Retrieves details for max delivery or creative boost sessions for the specified session IDs in a Product GMV Max Campaign. To obtain valid session IDs, use /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select sessions where `bid_type` is `NO_BID` for max delivery sessions or `CREATIVE_NO_BID` for creative boost sessions.

session_ids.description: List of max delivery or creative boost session IDs for products in a Product GMV Max Campaign. Maximum 20 IDs. To obtain active max delivery session IDs, call /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select sessions where `bid_type` is `NO_BID`. To obtain active creative boost session IDs, call /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select sessions where `bid_type` is `CREATIVE_NO_BID`.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_session_get

operations.description: Retrieves all active max delivery sessions for products and creative boost sessions for videos within a Product GMV Max Campaign. Ended sessions cannot be accessed with `/campaign/gmv_max/session/list/`; use `/campaign/gmv_max/session/get/` to retrieve details for ended sessions.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the Product GMV Max Campaign. To create a Product GMV Max Campaign and obtain this ID, use `/campaign/gmv_max/create/` with `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT`. To find existing eligible campaigns in the ad account, use `/gmv_max/campaign/get/` with `filtering` set to `{"gmv_max_promotion_types":["PRODUCT_GMV_MAX"]}`.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_session_list_get

operations.description: Updates an active max delivery session for a specific product or an active creative boost session for a specific video within a Product GMV Max Campaign. You cannot update max delivery or creative boost sessions that have ended. This endpoint is used with Product GMV Max Campaigns only; obtain or validate the campaign via /campaign/gmv_max/create/ (with `shopping_ads_type=PRODUCT`) or /gmv_max/campaign/get/ (filter `{"gmv_max_promotion_types":["PRODUCT_GMV_MAX"]}`), get the associated TikTok Shop via /campaign/gmv_max/info/, and retrieve active session IDs via /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the Product GMV Max Campaign. To create a Product GMV Max Campaign and obtain this ID, use /campaign/gmv_max/create/ and set `shopping_ads_type` to `PRODUCT`. To find existing Product GMV Max Campaigns in the ad account, use /gmv_max/campaign/get/ and set `filtering` to `{"gmv_max_promotion_types":["PRODUCT_GMV_MAX"]}`.

session.description: Details for the session being updated. The accepted behavior depends on whether `session_id` refers to a max delivery session or a creative boost session. For max delivery sessions, you can update `budget`, `schedule_type`, `schedule_start_time`, and `schedule_end_time` subject to the max delivery rules below. For creative boost sessions, you can update `budget`, `schedule_type`, and `schedule_end_time`; `schedule_start_time` is not documented for creative boost updates.

budget.description: Daily session budget. For max delivery sessions, this is the daily max delivery budget; it uses additional budget separate from target ROI optimization budget, and target ROI budget will not be used for products using max delivery while max delivery is active. For creative boost sessions, this is the daily creative boost budget; it is separate from campaign budget, paced throughout the schedule, and is not included in campaign ROI protection calculations. Value range: ≥ 10 (USD).

schedule_end_time.description: Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Not supported when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. The end time for the session, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). The end time cannot be earlier than the current time and must be earlier than or equal to the campaign end time.

schedule_start_time.description:
The start time for the max delivery mode, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC+0).
Note:
The start time cannot be earlier than the current time + 5 minutes. The start time should be later than or equal to the campaign start time. Your daily budget will be spent evenly throughout the day. If your max delivery duration is less than 24 hours in a given day, your full budget will still be spent. Max delivery will be active between your set start and end times for your selected products. If your campaign is still active when max delivery ends, the optimization mode for those products will automatically change to target ROI.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type for the session. For max delivery: `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` enables max delivery continuously after `schedule_start_time` until the campaign scheduled end time; `SCHEDULE_START_END` enables max delivery between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time`. For creative boost: `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` enables creative boost continuously after the current time until the campaign scheduled end time; `SCHEDULE_START_END` enables creative boost between the current time and `schedule_end_time`. `schedule_end_time` is required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END` and not supported when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`. For creative boost, the default value is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`.

session_id.description: The ID of the session to update in the Product GMV Max Campaign. For a max delivery session, use /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select an active session whose `bid_type` is `NO_BID`. For a creative boost session, use /campaign/gmv_max/session/list/ and select an active session whose `bid_type` is `CREATIVE_NO_BID`.

store_id.description: The ID of the TikTok Shop associated with the GMV Max Campaign. Obtain this ID with /campaign/gmv_max/info/.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_session_update

operations.description: Updates a GMV Max campaign via `/campaign/gmv_max/update/`. This endpoint supports incremental updates. To change only the campaign on/off status, use `/campaign/status/update/` instead. Before using this endpoint, ensure the ad account has exclusive GMV Max authorization for the TikTok Shop: check `/gmv_max/store/list/`, and if needed grant authorization with `/gmv_max/exclusive_authorization/create/`. The promotion-days ROI calculation update described for `promotion_days.roas_bid_multiplier` is an allowlist-only feature: the promotional ROI goal may be calculated from the lower of recent campaign performance over the last 7 non-promotion days or your entered ROI, then reduced by the selected percentage.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. To ensure the ad account has exclusive GMV Max authorization for the TikTok Shop you want to promote, call `/gmv_max/store/list/` and confirm the returned `advertiser_id` in `exclusive_authorized_advertiser_info` matches the ad account you are using. If it does not match, use `/gmv_max/exclusive_authorization/create/` to grant exclusive GMV Max authorization for the TikTok Shop.

affiliate_posts_enabled.description: Whether to enable affiliate posts for a Product GMV Max campaign. Valid only when both `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT` and `product_video_specific_type` is `AUTO_SELECTION`. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

auto_budget.description: Automatic budget settings for non-promotion days.

auto_budget_enabled.description: Whether to enable automatic budget increase during non-promotion days. When enabled, the daily budget may automatically increase to optimize for more sales on days when the campaign has reached at least 90% of its ROI target and at least 80% of its budget has been used. The daily budget resets to its original amount each day. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

budget_increase_percentage.description: Budget increase percentage during non-promotion days. Value range: 50-300. For example, `50` means the budget increases by 50% when automatic budget increase is triggered.

increase_limit.description: Maximum number of budget increases during non-promotion days. Value range: 1-10. For example, `10` allows up to 10 budget increases per day when automatic increases are triggered.

budget.description: Daily budget. To obtain a recommended budget, use `/gmv_max/bid/recommend/` and read the returned `budget`.

campaign_id.description: ID of the GMV Max campaign to update. To obtain a campaign ID, create a campaign with `/campaign/gmv_max/create/` or list/filter existing GMV Max campaigns with `/gmv_max/campaign/get/`.

item_group_ids.description: Product SPU IDs. Valid when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT` and `product_specific_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Max size: 400. To get eligible SPU IDs for products in a TikTok Shop, use `/store/product/get/`, set `ad_creation_eligible` to `GMV_MAX`, and choose `item_group_id` values where `status` is `AVAILABLE` and `gmv_max_ads_status` is `UNOCCUPIED`.

item_list.description: List of TikTok posts to associate with a Product GMV Max campaign. Valid when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT` and `product_video_specific_type` is `CUSTOM_SELECTION`. If you want to manually select authorized TikTok posts only, provide `item_list` and do not provide `custom_anchor_video_list`. If you want to manually select customized TikTok posts, provide the videos in `item_list` and specify `custom_anchor_video_list` at the same time. Max size: 50. To retrieve available TikTok posts for a Product GMV Max campaign using the same TikTok Shop, use `/gmv_max/video/get/`.

identity_info.description: Identity information associated with the TikTok post. Required when `item_list` is passed.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Business Center ID associated with the identity. Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.

identity_authorized_shop_id.description: TikTok Shop ID associated with the identity. Required only when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT` and `identity_authorized_shop_id` is returned for that identity by `/gmv_max/identity/get/`.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. Required when `item_list` is passed.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Required when `item_list` is passed. If `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, also provide `identity_authorized_bc_id`, and provide `identity_authorized_shop_id` only if that field is returned for the identity by `/gmv_max/identity/get/`. If `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`, also provide `store_id`.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID associated with the identity. Required when `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`.

item_id.description: TikTok post ID. Required when `item_list` is passed.

spu_id_list.description: Product SPU IDs associated with the TikTok post. Required when `item_list` is passed.

video_info.description: Video details for the post. Required when `item_list` is passed.

video_id.description: Video ID. Required when `item_list` is passed.

promotion_days.description: Promotion-days settings. Use `budget_increase_percentage` and `increase_limit` in this object to customize the budget increase percentage and the maximum number of budget increases per day during promotion days.

auto_schedule_enabled.description: Whether to use the TikTok Shop promotion-days schedule. Valid only when `is_enabled` is `true`. Supported values: `true`, `false`. When `is_enabled` is `true`, this field is automatically set to `true`.

budget_increase_percentage.description: Budget increase percentage during promotion days. Value range: 50-300. For example, `50` means the budget increases by 50% when automatic budget increase is triggered.

custom_schedule_list.description: Custom promotion-day schedules. If `auto_schedule_enabled` is `false`, specify at least one `start_date`/`end_date` pair here. If `auto_schedule_enabled` is `true`, this field is optional. Max size: 50.

end_date.description: End date of the custom promotion-day schedule in `YYYY-MM-DD` using the ad account time zone. `end_date` cannot be earlier than the current time. The custom promotion-day schedule automatically ends at `00:00:00` on this date in the ad account time zone.

start_date.description: Start date of the custom promotion-day schedule in `YYYY-MM-DD` using the ad account time zone. `start_date` cannot be after `end_date`, cannot be earlier than the current date, and must be the same day as or after the campaign `schedule_start_time`. The custom promotion-day schedule automatically starts at `00:00:00` on this date in the ad account time zone.

increase_limit.description: Maximum number of daily budget increases during promotion days. Value range: 1-10. For example, `10` allows up to 10 budget increases per day when automatic increases are triggered.

is_enabled.description: Whether to enable promotion days so the campaign can optimize for higher GMV during high-intent shopping dates in regions where ads are delivering. Supported values: `true`, `false`. If `promotion_days` is specified, this field is automatically set to `true`.

roas_bid_multiplier.description: Target ROI reduction index used during promotion days; changes to target ROI may drive higher GMV. Supported values: `90` (-10%), `80` (-20%), `70` (-30%). Allowlist-only update: the system may calculate the promotional ROI goal using the lower of recent campaign performance over the last 7 non-promotion days or your entered ROI, then apply the selected reduction. You might not need code changes, but the returned ROI goal value will differ.

roas_bid.description: ROI target, valid only when the campaign `deep_bid_type` is `VO_MIN_ROAS`. Keep up to one decimal place, for example `3.2` or `3`. To obtain a recommended ROI target, use `/gmv_max/bid/recommend/` and read the returned `roas_bid`.

schedule_end_time.description: Campaign delivery end time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). Required when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_START_END`. Not supported when `schedule_type` is `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW`.

schedule_type.description: Campaign schedule type. `SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW` runs continuously after the scheduled start time. `SCHEDULE_START_END` runs between the scheduled start and end times.

operations.name: campaign_gmv_max_update

operations.description: Gets the recommended ROI target and daily budget for a Product GMV Max or LIVE GMV Max campaign for a specific TikTok Shop. Before calling this endpoint, use /gmv_max/store/list/ to find a TikTok Shop eligible for GMV Max and confirm `is_gmv_max_available=true`.

identity_id.description: Required and valid only when `shopping_ads_type` is `LIVE`. The LIVE source identity to use in a LIVE GMV Max campaign. To obtain valid identities, use /gmv_max/identity/get/ and select identities where `live_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

item_group_ids.description: Valid only when `shopping_ads_type` is `PRODUCT`. List of SPU (standard product unit) IDs for specific products to promote in a Product GMV Max campaign. If omitted, all products from the TikTok Shop are promoted. If you want to promote only specific products, pass them in this field. Maximum 50 items. To obtain eligible SPU IDs, use /store/product/get/, set `ad_creation_eligible` to `GMV_MAX`, and use `item_group_id` values where `status` is `AVAILABLE` and `gmv_max_ads_status` is `UNOCCUPIED`.

optimization_goal.description: Optimization goal. Only `VALUE` is supported, meaning gross revenue.

shopping_ads_type.description: Type of GMV Max campaign. `PRODUCT` is for Product GMV Max campaigns. `LIVE` is for LIVE GMV Max campaigns and requires `identity_id`.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID. To obtain a shop available for GMV Max campaigns, use /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm the returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: gmv_max_bid_recommend_get

operations.description: Retrieves GMV Max campaigns in an ad account from `/open_api/v1.3/gmv_max/campaign/get/`. Use `filtering.gmv_max_promotion_types` to query Product GMV Max or Live GMV Max campaigns. You can also filter by TikTok Shop IDs, campaign IDs, campaign name, primary status, and campaign creation time. If `fields` is omitted, all available campaign fields are returned by default.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the field names available under the response `list` object.

filtering.description: Filters applied to the campaign query. Example: `filtering={"gmv_max_promotion_types":["PRODUCT_GMV_MAX"]}`.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs to filter by. Maximum 100 IDs.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Latest campaign creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC format. Returns campaigns created before this time. Example: `2025-02-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, campaigns created at any time are included. For efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within 6 months.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Earliest campaign creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC format. Returns campaigns created after this time. Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, campaigns created at any time are included. For efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within 6 months.

gmv_max_promotion_types.description: GMV Max campaign types to retrieve. Required. Supported values: `PRODUCT_GMV_MAX` for Product GMV Max campaigns and `LIVE_GMV_MAX` for Live GMV Max campaigns.

primary_status.description: Primary campaign status to filter by: `STATUS_DELIVERY_OK` for active, `STATUS_DISABLE` for inactive, or `STATUS_DELETE` for deleted.

store_ids.description: List of TikTok Shop IDs to filter by. Maximum 10 IDs. To obtain shops that are available for GMV Max campaigns, call `/gmv_max/store/list/` and use only shops where `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default is `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Range: `1`-`100`. Default is `10`.

operations.name: gmv_max_campaign_get

operations.description: Removes creatives (TikTok posts/videos) from a Product or Live GMV Max Campaign, or adds back creatives that were previously removed. The campaign must be active; to find active GMV Max campaigns, use /gmv_max/report/get/ with `filtering` set to `{"campaign_statuses":["STATUS_DELIVERY_OK"]}`. For Product GMV Max Campaigns, the campaign's `product_video_specific_type` must be `AUTO_SELECTION`. After submitting `REMOVE` or `ADD`, wait 20 minutes before checking updated statuses in /gmv_max/report/get/. If a creative is successfully removed from a Product GMV Max Campaign, its `creative_delivery_status` in /gmv_max/report/get/ becomes `EXCLUDED`.

action.description: Action to perform on the listed creatives. `REMOVE` removes creatives from the GMV Max Campaign. `ADD` adds back creatives that were previously removed. After the action is performed, wait 20 minutes before verifying the updated statuses using /gmv_max/report/get/. If a creative is successfully removed from a Product GMV Max Campaign, its `creative_delivery_status` in /gmv_max/report/get/ will be `EXCLUDED`.

campaign_id.description: ID of the GMV Max campaign to update. The campaign must be in active status. To retrieve active GMV Max Campaigns, use /gmv_max/report/get/ with `filtering` set to `{"campaign_statuses":["STATUS_DELIVERY_OK"]}`. If this is a Product GMV Max Campaign, the campaign's `product_video_specific_type` must be `AUTO_SELECTION`.

item_list.description: List of TikTok posts (videos) to remove or add back. Maximum 400 items per request. This endpoint allows removal of up to 10,000 posts from a GMV Max Campaign, with a limit of 400 posts per request. For example, to exclude 800 posts, send two requests with 400 posts each.

item_id.description: ID of the TikTok post to operate on. When `action` is `REMOVE`, use /gmv_max/report/get/ with `filtering` set to `{"creative_delivery_statuses":["IN_QUEUE","LEARNING","DELIVERING","NOT_DELIVERYING","UNAVAILABLE","NOT_ACTIVE"]}` to retrieve eligible creatives. When `action` is `ADD`, use /gmv_max/report/get/ with `filtering` set to `{"creative_delivery_statuses":["EXCLUDED"]}` to retrieve previously removed creatives. Currently, you can only obtain the `item_id` of TikTok posts in Live GMV Max Campaigns on TikTok Ads Manager.

spu_id_list.description: Required when the campaign is a Product GMV Max Campaign. List of Product SPU IDs associated with the TikTok post.

operations.name: gmv_max_creative_update

operations.description: Authorizes one ad account to exclusively create GMV Max Campaigns for a specific TikTok Shop. For each TikTok Shop, only one ad account can be authorized to create GMV Max Campaigns for optimized revenue and sales campaigns. By using this endpoint, you agree to and acknowledge the potential impacts listed in the GMV Max Guidelines: https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/gmv-max-guidelines

advertiser_id.description: ID of the ad account to exclusively authorize to create GMV Max Campaigns for the TikTok Shop. To obtain valid ad account IDs within the relevant Business Center, call /bc/asset/get/ with `asset_type` set to `ADVERTISER`.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: ID of the Business Center that owns the TikTok Shop specified by `store_id`. To validate this value, call /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm that `is_owner_bc` is `true` for this Business Center ID and shop.

store_id.description: ID of the TikTok Shop to authorize for GMV Max. To obtain a shop that is available for GMV Max Campaigns, call /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm that `is_gmv_max_available` is `true` for this `store_id`.

operations.name: gmv_max_exclusive_authorization_create

operations.description: Checks whether an ad account is exclusively authorized to create GMV Max Campaigns for a specific TikTok Shop. To use this endpoint, you need a TikTok Shop that is available for GMV Max Campaigns; obtain eligible shops from /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm the returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

advertiser_id.description: ID of the ad account whose GMV Max exclusive authorization status you want to check.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: ID of the Business Center that is authorized to access the specified TikTok Shop (`store_id`).

store_id.description: ID of the TikTok Shop. To obtain a TikTok Shop that is available for GMV Max Campaigns, call /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm the returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: gmv_max_exclusive_authorization_get

operations.description: Returns the list of identities associated with a TikTok Shop and indicates whether each identity is available for GMV Max Campaigns. To obtain a TikTok Shop that is available for GMV Max Campaigns before calling this endpoint, use /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm that the returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: Business Center ID that is authorized to access the TikTok Shop specified by `store_id`.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID. Obtain it from /gmv_max/store/list/ and use a shop whose returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: gmv_max_identity_get

operations.description: Checks whether an identity or product is already occupied by enabled Shopping Ads, including Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, and Live Shopping Ads. Requires a TikTok Shop that is available for GMV Max; obtain eligible shops from /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

asset_ids.description: Asset IDs to check. Maximum size: 1. The required ID type depends on `occupied_asset_type`: when `occupied_asset_type` is `IDENTITY_TT_USER`, provide one `TT_USER` identity ID; when `IDENTITY_BC_AUTH_TT`, provide one `BC_AUTH_TT` identity ID; when `IDENTITY_TTS_TT`, provide one `TTS_TT` identity ID; when `SPU`, provide the SPU ID of a product within the TikTok Shop. To obtain identity IDs, use /gmv_max/identity/get/. To obtain SPU IDs for products within a TikTok Shop, use /store/product/get/, set `ad_creation_eligible` to `GMV_MAX`, and use the returned `item_group_id`.

occupied_asset_type.description: Type of asset to check for occupancy in enabled Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, or Live Shopping Ads. Determines what value must be provided in `asset_ids`: `IDENTITY_TT_USER` requires one `TT_USER` identity ID, `IDENTITY_BC_AUTH_TT` requires one `BC_AUTH_TT` identity ID, `IDENTITY_TTS_TT` requires one `TTS_TT` identity ID, and `SPU` requires one product SPU ID from the TikTok Shop.

store_id.description: ID of the TikTok Shop. Use /gmv_max/store/list/ to obtain a TikTok Shop that is available for GMV Max Campaigns, and confirm the returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: gmv_max_occupied_custom_shop_ads_list_check

operations.description: Runs a report for GMV Max Campaigns (Product or LIVE). By default, the response only includes undeleted campaigns. Returns e-commerce outcomes only. GMV Max campaigns do NOT appear in /report/integrated/get — use this endpoint only. Non-delivering campaigns return all-zero rows: zero means "did not deliver", not "performed poorly". Access depends on the GMV Max Campaign type and the metric level you want to query; ensure you meet the prerequisites and permissions for Product GMV Max Campaigns or LIVE GMV Max Campaigns. Use /gmv_max/store/list/ to get TikTok Shop IDs that are available for GMV Max Campaigns.

dimensions.description: Hierarchy — lower levels need anchoring filters, else 40002: - advertiser_id, campaign_id — usable alone - item_group_id, room_id — need filtering.campaign_ids - item_id — needs filtering.campaign_ids AND filtering.item_group_ids - duration — needs filtering.room_ids (LIVE) or filtering.item_group_ids (Product) - stat_time_day, stat_time_hour — time splits, never alone Dimension groupings for the report. Supported values: `advertiser_id` (group by advertiser ID), `campaign_id` (group by campaign ID), `stat_time_day` (group by day; time-split dimension, cannot be used alone), `stat_time_hour` (group by hour; time-split dimension, cannot be used alone), `item_group_id` (group by SPU ID), `item_id` (group by post ID), `room_id` (group by room ID), and `duration` (group by duration). Example: `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]` groups by campaign and day. Available dimensions vary by the metric type you query.

enable_total_metrics.description: Whether to return total added-up values for the requested metrics across all pages. When `true`, the response includes aggregate metric data for all pages as you query different pages. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

end_date.description: Query end date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format and based on the ad account time zone. Example: `2025-02-01`. The allowed date range depends on `dimensions`: if `dimensions` does not include `stat_time_day` or `stat_time_hour`, the range can be up to 365 days; if `dimensions` includes `stat_time_day`, the range can be up to 30 days; if `dimensions` includes `stat_time_hour`, the range can be up to one day.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Available filters vary by the metric type you want to query.Some filters are required as anchors for lower-level dimensions — see `dimensions`.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by a list of GMV Max Campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_name.description: Filter by GMV Max Campaign name. Fuzzy match is supported.

campaign_statuses.description: Filter by campaign status. By default, the response only includes undeleted campaigns.

creative_delivery_statuses.description: Filter by creative status. You can use this filter only in any of these scenarios: when you specify multiple IDs in `campaign_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or both; when you specify one ID in `campaign_ids`, `item_group_ids`, or both; or when you specify multiple ID dimensions. This filter cannot be used together with `creative_types`.

gmv_max_promotion_types.description: Filter by GMV Max Campaign type.Enum differs from /gmv_max/campaign/get/ (PRODUCT_GMV_MAX / LIVE_GMV_MAX) — do not copy across endpoints.

item_group_ids.description: Filter by a list of product SPU IDs. Max size: 100.

room_ids.description: Filter by a list of livestream room IDs. Max size: 100.

search_word.description: Filter by a search keyword such as a video title, TikTok post ID, or TikTok account name. Fuzzy match is supported.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. E-commerce outcomes only; no traffic metrics. Valid: gross_revenue, cost, net_cost, roi, orders, cost_per_order Use `cost`, not `spend` (`spend` works in /report/integrated/get, not here). `roi` returns 0.00 when cost is 0 — placeholder, not a real ratio.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: >= 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1-1,000. Default value: 10.

sort_field.description: Sorting field. Not sorted by default. We recommend setting this field so results are returned in a logical order. Supported sort fields differ for Product GMV Max Campaigns and LIVE GMV Max Campaigns.

start_date.description: Query start date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format and based on the ad account time zone. Example: `2025-01-01`.

store_ids.description: List of TikTok Shop IDs to query. Max size: 1. Obtain valid shop IDs from /gmv_max/store/list/ and use only shops where `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: gmv_max_report_get
