operations.description: Returns the list of TikTok Shops that the specified ad account can access and indicates whether each shop can be used to create GMV Max campaigns.
operations.name: gmv_max_store_list_get

operations.description: Checks whether a TikTok Shop is already occupied by enabled Video Shopping Ads or Product Shopping Ads, and whether the shop can be used to create Product GMV Max Campaigns that promote all products in the TikTok Shop.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID. To obtain a TikTok Shop that is available for GMV Max Campaigns, call /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm the returned `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

operations.name: gmv_max_store_shop_ad_usage_check_check

operations.description: Retrieves TikTok posts (videos) that are available for a Product GMV Max campaign for a specific TikTok Shop. To use this endpoint, first obtain a GMV Max-eligible shop from /gmv_max/store/list/ and confirm `is_gmv_max_available=true`. Depending on your use case, you can query authorized posts for all products, authorized posts for specific products, or customized-post-eligible videos for one specific product. Also note: if `need_auth_code_video` is `false` or omitted and `identity_list` is not provided, the API returns an empty post list.

custom_posts_eligible.description: Whether to query videos that can be used in customized posts for a specific product. If `true`, you must simultaneously provide exactly one product in `spu_id_list`. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

identity_list.description: List of identities to filter results by. Supported identity types are `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, and `TTS_TT`. Obtain available identities from /gmv_max/identity/get/ and use identities where `product_gmv_max_available` is `true`. Max size: 20. If `need_auth_code_video` is `false` or omitted and `identity_list` is not provided, the API returns an empty post list.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. The Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_authorized_shop_id.description: Required only when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT` and `identity_authorized_shop_id` is returned for that identity by /gmv_max/identity/get/. The TikTok Shop ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Identity type. `TT_USER` is a TikTok User identity created when you bind your TikTok For Business account with your TikTok Business Account, or bind with a regular TikTok account and then upgrade it to a Business Account. `BC_AUTH_TT` is a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity created when a TikTok account is added to your Business Center and the account owner approves the request; when `identity_type=BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required, and `identity_authorized_shop_id` is additionally required if that field is returned for the identity by /gmv_max/identity/get/. `TTS_TT` is a TikTok Account User for TikTok Shop identity created when an official TikTok account is set for the shop; when `identity_type=TTS_TT`, the nested `store_id` is required.

store_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `TTS_TT`. The TikTok Shop ID associated with the TikTok Account User for TikTok Shop identity.

keyword.description: Search keyword to filter posts. You can search by post caption (`text`) using a text string, which supports multilingual and fuzzy matching, or by post ID (`item_id`) using a numeric string of at least 19 characters, which supports exact matching.

need_auth_code_video.description: Whether to include posts associated with `AUTH_CODE` identities. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`. If `need_auth_code_video` is `false` or omitted and `identity_list` is not provided, the API returns an empty post list.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: >= 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1-50. Default value: 10.

sort_field.description: Sorting field for videos available for authorized posts. Valid only when `custom_posts_eligible` is `false` or omitted. Enum values: `GMV`, `POST_TIME`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `VIDEO_LIKES`, `CLICK_THROUGH_RATE`, `PRODUCT_CLICKS`. Default value: `GMV`.

sort_type.description: Sorting order for videos available for authorized posts or customized posts. Enum values: `ASC`, `DESC`. Default value: `DESC`. If `custom_posts_eligible` is `false` or omitted, sort authorized-post videos by specifying both `sort_field` and `sort_type`. If `custom_posts_eligible` is `true`, do not specify `sort_field`; customized-post videos are sorted by post time descending by default, and set `sort_type=ASC` if you want earliest posts first.

spu_id_list.description: List of product SPU IDs used to filter results. If you want to promote all products from the shop using authorized posts, omit both `spu_id_list` and `custom_posts_eligible`. If you want to promote specific products using authorized posts, provide `spu_id_list` and do not provide `custom_posts_eligible`. If you want to promote a specific product using customized posts, provide `spu_id_list` and set `custom_posts_eligible=true`. Max size: 50 when `custom_posts_eligible` is `false` or omitted; 1 when `custom_posts_eligible` is `true`. To obtain valid SPU IDs, use /store/product/get/, set `ad_creation_eligible=GMV_MAX`, and use `item_group_id` values where `status` is `AVAILABLE` and `gmv_max_ads_status` is `UNOCCUPIED`.

store_authorized_bc_id.description: ID of the Business Center authorized to access the TikTok Shop specified in `store_id`.

store_id.description: The TikTok Shop ID. Obtain it from /gmv_max/store/list/ and use a shop where `is_gmv_max_available` is `true`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Valid only when `identity_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_USER` or when `identity_type` is omitted.

keyword.description: Keyword to filter by. When `identity_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`, this supports fuzzy matching against the display name.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID for the associated TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_type.description: Identity type. If omitted, all identities are returned. When set to `BC_AUTH_TT` and `identity_authorized_bc_id` is also specified, all identities linked to the ad account (`advertiser_id`) are returned.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Range: `1`-`100`. Default is `20`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: ID of the Business Center that a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity is associated with. Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Supported values: `CUSTOMIZED_USER`, `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`.

For pagination, start with `cursor=0`; the response returns `has_more` and `cursor`, and when `has_more` is `true`, use the returned `cursor` to request the next page.

cursor.description: Timestamp cursor. Live videos before this timestamp are returned in reverse chronological order. In the initial request, set it to `0`. The response includes `has_more` and a `cursor`; if `has_more` is `true`, use the returned `cursor` in the next request to get the following page of data.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. ID of the Business Center associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Enum values: `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`. When `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required. See the Identity documentation for valid identity types and usage.

end_time.description: Ad deployment end time in UTC, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Business Center ID associated with a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity. Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.

locations.description: List of targeting locations. You must use the same set of locations as when you create the ad.

start_time.description: Ad deployment start time in UTC, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

count.description: Maximum number of Series to return. Value range: 1-100. Default value: 10.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. If `has_more` in the response is `true`, use the returned cursor in the next request to fetch the next page. Default value: 0.

operations.description: Gets all TikTok posts under an identity through `/open_api/v1.3/identity/video/get/`. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` and `cursor` are strings, `item_type` was added, and response fields changed from v1.2 including `list` to `video_list`, `id` to `anchor_id`, string `item_id`, and new `carousel_info`. Depending on the identity type, pagination behavior differs: for `TT_USER` and `BC_AUTH_TT`, the response `cursor` is the time value of the last returned item; for `AUTH_CODE`, the response `cursor` is a pagination cursor used when `has_more` is `true`.

count.description: Number of TikTok posts to return. Value range: 1-20. If a value greater than 20 is specified, this field is ignored and at most 20 posts are returned.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. The corresponding response cursor behaves differently by `identity_type`: for `TT_USER` and `BC_AUTH_TT`, it is the time value of the last returned item; for `AUTH_CODE`, it is a pagination cursor to use for the next page when more data is available.

exclude_adsonly.description: Whether to exclude ads only posts from the results. Ads-only posts are those you publish from a TikTok account as ads, which remain hidden from the public on the account's profile page. Supported values: false: To retrieve both organic and ads only posts. true: To retrieve a maximum of 500 most recent organic posts. Default value: false.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Business Center ID associated with a TikTok Account User in Business Center identity. Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`.

identity_id.description: Identity ID.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Valid values are `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, and `BC_AUTH_TT`. When `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, you must also provide `identity_authorized_bc_id`. The `keyword` field is valid only when `identity_type` is `AUTH_CODE`; otherwise an error will occur.

item_type.description: Type of TikTok posts to retrieve. `VIDEO` returns video posts. `CAROUSEL` returns photo posts. Default value: `VIDEO`.

keyword.description: Valid only when `identity_type` is `AUTH_CODE`; otherwise, an error will occur. Use this field to search posts by text or by TikTok post ID. For text search, provide a string up to 500 characters; this supports multiple languages and fuzzy matching. For item ID search, provide a numeric string with a minimum length of 19 characters; this supports exact matching.

operations.description: Gets information for one or more TikTok posts published using the `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, or `BC_AUTH_TT` identity. Use `item_id` to retrieve a single post or `item_ids` to retrieve multiple posts. Endpoint path: `/v1.3/identity/video/info/`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id` and `item_id` from number to string, adds request parameters `item_ids` and `item_type`, renames response field `item_info` to `video_detail`, changes response `id` to string field `anchor_id`, and adds response fields `video_details`, `item_type`, and `carousel_info`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. ID of the Business Center associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID for the selected `identity_type`. To get identities within an ad account, use `/identity/get/`.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Enum values: `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`. When `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, `identity_authorized_bc_id` is required.

item_id.description: Either `item_id` or `item_ids` must be specified. Use `item_id` to retrieve a single TikTok post. The post must be associated with the provided `identity_id`. To get valid post IDs, use `/identity/video/get/` and extract `item_id` from the response.

item_ids.description: Either `item_id` or `item_ids` must be specified. Use `item_ids` to retrieve multiple TikTok posts. Each post ID must be associated with the provided `identity_id`. Max size: 20. To get valid post IDs, use `/identity/video/get/` and extract `item_id` from the response.

The source is controlled by `lead_source`: `INSTANT_FORM` returns fields for an Instant Form, and `DIRECT_MESSAGE` returns fields for leads generated from direct messages of the associated Business Account. Depending on where the leads are stored, you may need an ad account `advertiser_id` or a Business Center form library `library_id`. To look up required IDs, use /page/library/get/ for form libraries and /page/get/ with `business_type=LEAD_GEN` for Instant Form pages.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. Required when the leads are under an ad account.

lead_source.description: Source of the leads. `INSTANT_FORM` means leads generated through an Instant Form; when set to `INSTANT_FORM`, `page_id` is required. `DIRECT_MESSAGE` means leads generated from direct messages of the associated Business Account; when set to `DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `page_id` is not supported.

library_id.description: ID of a form library. Required when the leads are under a form library of a Business Center. To obtain valid library IDs, use /page/library/get/.

page_id.description: Page ID of an Instant Form. Required when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`. Not supported when `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`. To obtain valid Instant Form page IDs, use /page/get/ and set `business_type` to `LEAD_GEN`.

operations.name: lead_field_get

operations.description: Retrieves a single lead generated either from an Instant Form or from direct messages of the associated Business Account. Request requirements depend on where the lead is stored: provide `page_id` when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`, and do not send `page_id` when `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`. If the lead is under a Business Center form library, use `library_id`; to obtain valid library IDs, call `/page/library/get/`. To obtain valid Instant Form page IDs, call `/page/get/` with `business_type=LEAD_GEN`.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. Required when the lead is under an ad account.

lead_source.description: Source of the lead. `INSTANT_FORM` means the lead was generated through an Instant Form and requires `page_id`. `DIRECT_MESSAGE` means the lead was generated from direct messages of the associated Business Account and does not support `page_id`.

library_id.description: ID of a form library. Required when the lead is under a form library of a Business Center. To obtain valid library IDs, use `/page/library/get/`.

page_id.description: Page ID of an Instant Form. Required when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`. Not supported when `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`. To obtain valid Instant Form page IDs, use `/page/get/` and set `business_type` to `LEAD_GEN`.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: greater than or equal to 1.

name.description: Offline Event set name. Maximum length: 40 characters. Example: `in_store_purchases`. The name must be unique across event sets; if you use a name that has already been used by another event set, the request fails.

If using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms at https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok.

event_set_ids.description: List of Offline Event set IDs to filter by. If omitted, all Offline Event sets under the advertiser account are returned.

name.description: Offline Event set name to filter by. Maximum length: 40 characters. If both `event_set_ids` and `name` are provided, the API returns one result only when an event set matches the specified name and its ID is included in `event_set_ids`; otherwise it returns zero results.

auto_tracking.description: Whether to enable Auto Tracking for the Offline Event set.

event_set_id.description: ID of the Offline Event set to update. Get valid Offline Event set IDs for an advertiser via `/offline/get/`.

name.description: New name for the Offline Event set. Maximum length: 40 characters. Example: `in_store_purchases`. The name must be unique across event sets; using a name already used by another event set causes an error.

operations.description: Binds objects to an existing automated rule or unbinds objects that were previously bound to that rule. Endpoint: /open_api/v1.3/optimizer/rule/batch_bind/. In v1.3, `advertiser_id`, `rule_id`, and `dimension_ids` use string/string[] types.

bind_info.description: List of binding operations. Each item specifies the target `rule_id`, the object category in `dimension`, the matching object IDs in `dimension_ids`, and whether to `BIND` or `UNBIND` them.

bind_type.description: Whether to bind or unbind the specified objects. `BIND` binds the objects in `dimension_ids` to `rule_id`; `UNBIND` removes the existing binding for those objects from `rule_id`.

dimension.description: Category of the object being bound or unbound. Determines what IDs you must provide in `dimension_ids`: `CAMPAIGN` for campaign IDs, `ADGROUP` for ad group IDs, and `AD` for ad IDs.

dimension_ids.description: IDs of the objects to bind to the rule or unbind from the rule. The IDs must match the object type selected in `dimension`: campaign IDs when `dimension=CAMPAIGN`, ad group IDs when `dimension=ADGROUP`, and ad IDs when `dimension=AD`.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to bind objects to or unbind objects from.

lang.description: Language for returned messages. Defaults to `EN` if omitted.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_batch_bind_get

operations.description: Creates automated rules. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/optimizer/rule/create/` (previously `/v1.2/optimizer/rule/create/`), and the data types changed as follows: `advertiser_id` from number to string, `dimension_ids` from number[] to string[], and response `rule_ids` from number[] to string[].

lang.description: Language for error messages. Defaults to `EN` if omitted.

actions.description: Actions to take when the condition is met.

action_type.description: Adjustment mode for budget or bid actions.

custom_frequency_type.description: Custom frequency unit. Valid only when `type=CUSTOM`.

subject_type.description: Action to take when conditions are met. If `subject_type` is `DAILY_BUDGET`, `LIFETIME_BUDGET`, or `BID`, the `value` object is required and `frequency_info` can be used. If `subject_type=MESSAGE`, `notification.notification_type=TASK_FINISH` is supported for task-finished notifications.

value.description: Budget or bid adjustment payload. Required when `subject_type=DAILY_BUDGET`, `LIFETIME_BUDGET`, or `BID`.

limit.description: Maximum cap when `action_type=INCREASE`, or minimum budget when `action_type=DECREASE`. Required when `action_type=INCREASE` or `DECREASE`. Range depends on the apply object `dimension`: for `CAMPAIGN`, [50, 1000000000000]; for `ADGROUP`, [20, 1000000000000]. If `action_type=ADJUST_TO`, do not pass this field.

value.description: Target adjustment amount. If `action_type=INCREASE` or `DECREASE`, range is [0.01, 1000000000000]. If `action_type=ADJUST_TO`, range depends on the apply object `dimension`: for `CAMPAIGN`, [50, 1000000000000]; for `ADGROUP`, [20, 1000000000000].

value_type.description: How to interpret the action value.

apply_objects.description: Objects that the rule applies to. These can be campaigns, ad groups, or ads.

dimension.description: Object category to which the rule applies.

dimension_ids.description: IDs of the selected objects. Used with `pre_condition_type=SELECTED`, `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_GROUP_UNDER_SELECTED`, `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED`, `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_GROUP_UNDER_SELECTED`, or `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED`. For `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED`, the selected campaign or ad group is determined by `dimension` and `dimension_ids`.

pre_condition_type.description: Filter used to determine which objects are included. `SELECTED` includes only the objects in `dimension_ids`. `ALL_ACTIVE_CAMPAIGN`, `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_GROUP`, and `ALL_ACTIVE_AD` select all active objects of that type. `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_GROUP_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all active ad groups under the selected campaign. `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all active ads under the selected dimensions. `ALL_INACTIVE_CAMPAIGN`, `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_GROUP`, and `ALL_INACTIVE_AD` select all inactive objects of that type. `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_GROUP_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all inactive ad groups under the selected campaign. `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all inactive ads under the selected campaign or ad group specified by `dimension` and `dimension_ids`.

calculation_type.description: Applies only when `subject_type=COST`. If omitted, defaults to `OF_EACH_OBJECT`.

match_type.description: Operator used to compare the condition against `values`. Standard operators are `GT`, `LT`, `BETWEEN`, and `MATCH`. Only when `subject_type=NAME`, you can also use `CONTAINS`, `NOT_CONTAINS`, `START_WITH`, `END_WITH`, or `STRING_EQUAL`.

range_type.description: Time range for evaluating the condition.

subject_type.description: Metric or attribute used for the condition. Cross-field rules: if `subject_type=BID_STRATEGY`, `values` must be one of `COST_CAP`, `BID_CAP`, `MAX_CONVERSION`, or `LOWEST_COST`. If `subject_type=OPTIMIZATION_GOAL`, `values` must be one of `CONVERT`, `CLICK`, `SHOW`, `REACH`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `TWO_SECOND_VIDEO_VIEW`, or `SIX_SECOND_VIDEO_VIEW`. If `subject_type=OBJECTIVE`, `values` must be one of `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `REACH`, or `LEAD_GENERATION`. If `subject_type=DAYS_SINCE_CREATION`, `match_type` must be `GT`, `LT`, `BETWEEN`, or `MATCH`. If `subject_type=NO_CONDITION`, use caution because the rule will have no condition filter. If `subject_type=COST`, `calculation_type` is applicable.

values.description: Values used by the condition. If `match_type=BETWEEN`, provide exactly two values. Validation depends on `subject_type`: `NAME` length range is (0,512]; `COST`, `CPA`, `NOT_REAL_TIME_CPA`, `CPM`, `CPC`, and `COST_PER_RESULT` use advertiser-currency precision and range [0,100000000]; `DAILY_BUDGET_SPENDING_RATE`, `LIFETIME_BUDGET_SPENDING_RATE`, `CVR`, `CVR_SKAN`, `NOT_REAL_TIME_CVR`, `CTR`, and `RESULT_RATE` require precision 0.01 and range [0,100]; `IMPRESSION`, `CLICK`, `CONVERSION`, `CONVERSION_SKAN`, `NOT_REAL_TIME_CONVERSION`, and `RESULT` require precision 1 and range [0,10000000000]; `ROAS_PURCHASE`, `ROAS_IMPRESSION_ADS`, `ROAS_PURCHASE_SKAN`, `ROAS_COMPLETE_PAYMENT`, and `ROAS_PURCHASES_ONSITE` require precision 0.01 and range [0,100000].

name.description: Rule name.

email_exec_time.description: Notification send times such as `12:00`. Required when `notification_period=TIME_SCHEDULE`.

mute_option.description: Mute or unmute email notifications for the day. In create/update rules, this is used together with `tzone`.

no_result_notification.description: If omitted, defaults to `false`, meaning no notification is sent when there is no result.

notification_period.description: Email notification schedule. If `notification_period=TIME_SCHEDULE`, `email_exec_time` is required.

notification_type.description: Notification behavior. `TASK_FINISH` sends a notification when the task is finished and is only for `MESSAGE` action subject type. If the action `subject_type` is not `MESSAGE` but you still want email notifications, use `ANY_CHANGES`. `NOT_NOTIFICATION` disables notifications.

exec_time.description: Exact execution time. Required when `exec_time_type=CUSTOM` or `SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`. Format is `HH:MM` for `CUSTOM` and `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` for `SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`. If `exec_time_type=SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`, the time cannot exceed one year from the current time.

exec_time_type.description: When the rule runs. If `exec_time_type=CUSTOM` or `SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`, use `exec_time`. If `exec_time_type=HALF_HOUR_IN_SPECIFIC_TIME_PERIOD`, use `time_period_info`.

time_period_info.description: Valid when `exec_time_type=HALF_HOUR_IN_SPECIFIC_TIME_PERIOD`. Use `start_time`, `end_time`, `date_type`, and `num` to define the run periods.

date_type.description: Date grouping used by the time period. `num` is required when `date_type=WEEK` or `MONTH`.

end_time.description: End time of the time period, for example `12:00`.

num.description: Required when `date_type` is `WEEK` or `MONTH`. Each number represents a day in the week or month. When `date_type=WEEK`, allowed values are [1,7] for Monday through Sunday. When `date_type=MONTH`, allowed values are [1,28] for the 1st through 28th day of the month.

start_time.description: Start time of the time period, for example `12:00`.

tzone.description: User time zone. In create/update rules, this is used together with `notification.email_setting.mute_option`.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_create

operations.description: Retrieves automated rules by rule ID from /open_api/v1.3/optimizer/rule/get/. In v1.3, request IDs are strings: `advertiser_id` changed from number to string and `rule_ids` changed from number[] to string[] compared with v1.2. The v1.3 response also changed `dimension_ids`, `task_exec_id`, and `rule_id` from numeric types to strings, and deprecated the `recipients` response parameter.

rule_ids.description: List of rule IDs to retrieve.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_get

operations.description: Gets automated rules for an advertiser that match the provided filters. Use GET /open_api/v1.3/optimizer/rule/list/. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string. The request supports filtering by rule status, rule IDs or names, and data dimension.

filtering.description: Optional filters used to narrow returned rules.

data_dimension.description: Filter by the object level the rule applies to.

rule_info.description: Filter by rule IDs or rule names.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10 if omitted.

tzone.description: If provided, response time fields including `create_datetime`, `email_exec_time`, `check_datetime`, and `exec_datetime` are returned in the specified timezone. Use an acceptable timezone code from the Time Zone documentation.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_list_get

operations.description: Gets automated rule execution result details for the specified execution IDs and rule IDs. Endpoint: /open_api/v1.3/optimizer/rule/result/get/. In v1.3, `advertiser_id`, `exec_id`, and `rule_id` use string data types instead of number, and the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/optimizer/rule/result/get/ to /v1.3/optimizer/rule/result/get/.

lang.description: Language of the execution results. If omitted, defaults to `EN`. Valid values: `ZH` for Simplified Chinese, `EN` for English, and `JA` for Japanese.

result_detail.description: List of result detail queries. Each item must include both `exec_id` and `rule_id` to retrieve the corresponding automated rule execution result.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_result_get

operations.description: Returns automated rule execution results, filtered by rule status, rule ID or name, action, time range, and data dimension. This endpoint is available at /open_api/v1.3/optimizer/rule/result/list/. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` is a string, and returned `dimension_ids`, `task_exec_id`, and `rule_id` are also strings. The response field `recipients` is deprecated in v1.3.

filtering.description: Filters for narrowing rule results by status, rule ID or name, action, execution time range, and data dimension.

action.description: Filter by the rule action type.

rule_info.description: Filter by rule IDs or rule names.

time.description: UTC+0 time range filter. Provide an array of exactly 2 values: the first is the start datetime and the second is the end datetime.

lang.description: Language for error messages. Defaults to `EN`.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_result_list_get

operations.description: Updates automated rule details for an advertiser via `/v1.3/optimizer/rule/update/`. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id`, `dimension_ids`, and `rule_id` use string types in v1.3 instead of number types.

lang.description: Language for error messages. Defaults to `EN` if omitted.

actions.description: Actions to take when the conditions are met.

action_type.description: Adjustment mode for budget or bid actions.

frequency_info.description: Frequency settings for repeated action execution. Applicable when action `subject_type` is `DAILY_BUDGET`, `LIFERIME_BUDGET`, or `BID`.

custom_frequency_type.description: Custom frequency unit. Valid only when `type=CUSTOM`.

subject_type.description: Action to take when the conditions are met.

value.description: Adjustment details. When `action_type` is `INCREASE` or `DECREASE`, you can optionally cap the result with `use_limit` and `limit`; for `INCREASE`, `limit` is the maximum, and for `DECREASE`, it is the minimum. When `action_type` is `ADJUST_TO`, do not provide `use_limit` or `limit`.

limit.description: Valid when `action_type` is `INCREASE` or `DECREASE`. Maximum allowed value for `INCREASE`, or minimum allowed value for `DECREASE`. If you set this field, you must also set `use_limit=true`.

use_limit.description: Valid when `action_type` is `INCREASE` or `DECREASE`. Whether to enforce the `limit` value.

value.description: Valid when `action_type=ADJUST_TO`. Exact value to adjust to.

value_type.description: How to interpret the adjustment value.

apply_objects.description: Objects that the rule applies to. Objects can be campaigns, ad groups, or ads.

dimension.description: Object category to which the rule applies.

dimension_ids.description: IDs of the selected objects. Used with `pre_condition_type=SELECTED`, and also referenced by `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED` and `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED` based on `dimension`.

pre_condition_type.description: Filter for which objects to include. `SELECTED` includes only the IDs in `dimension_ids`. `ALL_ACTIVE_CAMPAIGN`, `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_GROUP`, and `ALL_ACTIVE_AD` select all active objects of that type. `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_GROUP_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all active ad groups under selected campaigns. `ALL_ACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all active ads under the selected dimensions. `ALL_INACTIVE_CAMPAIGN`, `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_GROUP`, and `ALL_INACTIVE_AD` select all inactive objects of that type. `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_GROUP_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all inactive ad groups under the selected campaign. `ALL_INACTIVE_AD_UNDER_SELECTED` selects all inactive ads under the selected campaign or ad group specified by `dimension` and `dimension_ids`.

calculation_type.description: Valid only when `subject_type=COST`. Defaults to `OF_EACH_OBJECT` if omitted.

match_type.description: Operator used to compare the condition against `values`. Supported values are `GT`, `LT`, `BETWEEN`, and `MATCH`. When `subject_type=NAME`, you can also use `CONTAINS`, `NOT_CONTAINS`, `START_WITH`, `END_WITH`, or `STRING_EQUAL`.

subject_type.description: Metric or attribute used to evaluate the condition. For `BID_STRATEGY`, `values` must be one of `COST_CAP`, `BID_CAP`, `MAX_CONVERSION`, `LOWEST_COST`. For `OPTIMIZATION_GOAL`, `values` must be one of `CONVERT`, `CLICK`, `SHOW`, `REACH`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `TWO_SECOND_VIDEO_VIEW`, `SIX_SECOND_VIDEO_VIEW`. For `OBJECTIVE`, `values` must be one of `TRAFFIC`, `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, `REACH`, `LEAD_GENERATION`. For `DAYS_SINCE_CREATION`, `match_type` must be `GT`, `LT`, `BETWEEN`, or `MATCH`. `NO_CONDITION` creates a rule without conditions, which can cause unintended changes if used carelessly.

values.description: Values for the condition. If `match_type=BETWEEN`, provide exactly two values. Validation rules vary by `subject_type`; see the Verification Rules for values documentation for subject-specific requirements.

name.description: Rule name.

notification.description: Notification settings for rule execution results.

email_exec_time.description: Required when `notification_period=TIME_SCHEDULE`. Email notification send times in `HH:MM` format, for example `12:00`.

mute_option.description: Whether to mute or unmute email notifications for the day.

no_result_notification.description: Defaults to `false` if omitted, meaning no notification is sent when there is no result.

notification_period.description: Email send schedule. `TIME_SCHEDULE` sends notifications together around a specified time.

notification_type.description: Notification behavior. `TASK_FINISH` sends a notification when the task finishes and is only valid for action `subject_type=MESSAGE`. `ANY_CHANGES` sends emails for non-`MESSAGE` action types when changes occur. `NOT_NOTIFICATION` disables notifications.

exec_time.description: Required when `exec_time_type` is `CUSTOM` or `SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`. Use `HH:MM` format for `CUSTOM`, and `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` for `SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`. If `exec_time_type=SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE`, the time cannot exceed one year from the current time.

exec_time_type.description: When the rule runs. `PER_HALF_HOUR` runs every 30 minutes. `CUSTOM` runs at the time in `exec_time`. `HALF_HOUR_IN_SPECIFIC_TIME_PERIOD` runs every 30 minutes during the time ranges defined in `time_period_info`. `SPECIFIC_TIME_ACCURATE_ONCE` runs once at the time in `exec_time`.

time_period_info.description: Valid when `exec_time_type=HALF_HOUR_IN_SPECIFIC_TIME_PERIOD`. Specifies the time periods using `start_time`, `end_time`, `date_type`, and `num`.

date_type.description: Date grouping for the time period.

end_time.description: End time of the period, for example `12:00`.

num.description: Required when `date_type` is `WEEK` or `MONTH`. Each value identifies a day: for `WEEK`, allowed range is `1` to `7` for Monday to Sunday; for `MONTH`, allowed range is `1` to `28`.

start_time.description: Start time of the period, for example `12:00`.

tzone.description: User time zone. In create/update rules, this is used with `notification.email_setting.mute_option`. For acceptable time zone codes, see the Time Zone documentation.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_update

operations.description: Turns on, turns off, or deletes a group of automated rules via /open_api/v1.3/optimizer/rule/update/status/. This operation is atomic: if updating the status of any one rule fails, the entire request fails and no rules are updated.

lang.description: Language for error messages in the response. Defaults to `EN` if omitted. Allowed values: `ZH` (Simplified Chinese), `EN` (English), `JA` (Japanese).

operate_type.description: Operation to perform on all specified rules. Allowed values are `TURN_ON`, `TURN_OFF`, and `DELETE`.

rule_ids.description: IDs of the rules whose statuses you want to update. If any one rule update fails, the entire request fails and no rule statuses are changed.

operations.name: optimizer_rule_update_status_update

operations.description: Retrieves the fields of an Instant Form (lead form). This is the recommended way to get Instant Form fields directly. As an alternative, you can create a mock lead with /page/lead/mock/create/ and extract the field names from that result. Version note: compared with v1.2, v1.3 uses /v1.3/page/field/get/ instead of /v1.2/pages/fields/get/, and the request parameter types for `advertiser_id` and `page_id` changed from number to string.

page_id.description: The ID of the Instant Form.

operations.name: page_field_get

operations.description: Gets page IDs and page records from /open_api/v1.3/page/get/ so you can use the returned `page_id` in ads. Retrieve pages either under an ad account by passing `advertiser_id`, or under a Business Center form library by passing `library_id`. This page also notes the v1.2 to v1.3 migration changes: the endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/pages/get/` to `/v1.3/page/get/`, and several request and response ID/time fields changed from number to string types in v1.3.

advertiser_id.description: Either `advertiser_id` or `library_id` must be set. Use this field to get pages under an ad account.

business_type.description: Filter by a single page type. Default value: `LEAD_GEN`. Enum values: `LEAD_GEN` (Instant Form), `STORE_FRONT` (Storefront Page), `APP_PROFILE_PAGE` (App Profile Page), `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE` (Custom Page or Custom TikTok Instant Page), `SHOP_ADS_PLP` (Shop Ads Product List Page), `SHOP_ADS_PDP` (Shop Ads Product Detail Page), `POP_UP_FORM` (Direct Message Page). If `business_types` is also passed, `business_type` is ignored.

business_types.description: Filter by multiple page types. Enum values: `LEAD_GEN` (Instant Form), `STORE_FRONT` (Storefront Page), `APP_PROFILE_PAGE` (App Profile Page), `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE` (Custom Page or Custom TikTok Instant Page), `SHOP_ADS_PLP` (Shop Ads Product List Page), `SHOP_ADS_PDP` (Shop Ads Product Detail Page), `POP_UP_FORM` (Direct Message Page). If passed together with `business_type`, `business_type` is ignored.

library_id.description: Either `advertiser_id` or `library_id` has to be set. To get pages under a Business Center, specify the ID of the form library that contains the page and leads. Pages and leads can be migrated from an ad account to a Business Center.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Default value: `1`. Value range: `>= 1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: `10`. Value range: `1-100`.

status.description: Filter by page status. Enum values: `EDITED` (draft), `PUBLISHED` (ready).

title.description: Page name filter. Supports exact matches only.

update_time_range.description: Filter pages by update time range. When `update_time_range` is passed, both `start` and `end` must be provided.

end.description: Required when `update_time_range` is passed. End time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format, UTC. Example: `2024-01-01 00:00:00`.

start.description: Required when `update_time_range` is passed. Start time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format, UTC. Example: `2024-01-01 00:00:00`.

operations.name: page_get

operations.description: Creates an asynchronous lead download task for all leads associated with the specified `page_id` or `ad_id`. If you later call `/page/lead/task/` with `task_id`, the same endpoint polls task status until `status = SUCCEED`; once complete, use `/page/lead/task/download/` to download the leads file. Leads are regionally stored, so you must use the correct base URL and `x-lead-region` header: for EEA/CH/UK use `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/` with `x-lead-region: eu`; for US use `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/` with `x-lead-region: us` (recommended) or `https://ads.us.tiktok.com/open_api/` (planned to be deprecated in future versions); for other countries/regions use `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/` without `x-lead-region`. To determine which regional endpoint to use, check the ad's targeted locations via `/adgroup/get/`; the relevant regions are returned in `location_ids`, `zipcode_ids`, or both. Effective from July 13th (UTC+0), 2023, if you continue using the old URL `https://ads.us.tiktok.com/open_api/`, you will only receive US leads; if you use `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/` without specifying the region in the header, you will only receive leads from other countries/regions. Only ad account admins can create/query lead download tasks or download leads; ad account roles are configured in Business Center. The generated leads file expires 10 minutes after generation, after which downloading returns a `file not exist` error.

ad_id.description: Either `ad_id` or `page_id` must be set. If you specify `ad_id`, the task is created for a specific ad; if you specify `page_id`, the task is created for a specific Instant Form. Provide the ID of an ad that uses an Instant Form to collect leads.

advertiser_id.description: Either `advertiser_id` or `library_id` must be set. If the ad account's leads have not been migrated to a Business Center via `/page/library/transfer/`, specify `advertiser_id`; if the leads have been migrated, specify `library_id` instead. Advertiser ID.

library_id.description: Either `advertiser_id` or `library_id` must be set. If the ad account's leads have not been migrated to a Business Center via `/page/library/transfer/`, specify `advertiser_id`; if the leads have been migrated, specify `library_id`. Form library ID.

page_id.description: Either `ad_id` or `page_id` must be set. If you specify `ad_id`, the task is created for a specific ad; if you specify `page_id`, the task is created for a specific Instant Form. Instant Form ID.

task_id.description: Task ID. If omitted, the request creates a new lead download task and returns `task_id` in the response. If provided, the request polls the existing task status so you can check whether it has completed (`status = SUCCEED`).

operations.name: page_lead_task_create

operations.description: Downloads leads for a completed lead download task created through `/page/lead/task/`. You must create the task first and wait until its `status` is `SUCCEED` before calling this endpoint. On success, the response is lead data in UTC+0 as a CSV file when the original CSV is <= 10MB, or a ZIP file when the original CSV is > 10MB, rather than JSON. On error, the endpoint may return JSON or may write an error message into the returned CSV file, depending on the error type. To protect customer information, only ad account admins can create/query lead download tasks or download leads; ad account roles are configured in the Business Center. If leads are migrated to a Business Center, only Business Center Admins can download them. Only support returning data from regions other than EEA/CH/UK/US.

advertiser_id.description: Required when the leads are under an ad account. Provide the advertiser ID in this case.

library_id.description: Required when the leads are under a Business Center. Provide the ID of the form library that contains the leads.

task_id.description: Required task ID of the lead download task. The task must be created through `/page/lead/task/`, and you should call this endpoint only after that task reaches `status = SUCCEED`.

operations.name: page_lead_task_download

operations.description: Gets the form libraries you have access to. A form library is a container for leads under a Business Center. Endpoint path: /v1.3/page/library/get/. Compared with v1.2 (/v1.2/pages/library/get/), v1.3 changes the path to /v1.3/page/library/get/, adds the request parameters `page` and `page_size`, and changes response field types such as `library_id` and `advertiser_id` from number to string and `create_time` and `update_time` from number to datetime.

page.description: Page number to return in the paginated response.

page_size.description: Number of records to return per page.

operations.name: page_library_get

operations.description: Migrates leads from an ad account to a Business Center by creating a form library to hold the ad account's leads. Endpoint path: /v1.3/page/library/transfer/. Compared with v1.2 (/v1.2/pages/library/transfer/), v1.3 uses string data types for `advertiser_id`, `bc_id`, and the returned `library_id`.

advertiser_id.description: ID of the advertiser that owns the leads.

bc_id.description: ID of the Business Center to migrate the leads to.

operations.name: page_library_transfer

operations.description: Retrieves the list of ad accounts linked to a Payment Portfolio, with paginated results. Requires a valid `payment_portfolio_id`; to obtain Payment Portfolio IDs, use `/payment_portfolio/get/`.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `10`. Valid range is `1` to `50`.

payment_portfolio_id.description: ID of the Payment Portfolio whose linked ad accounts you want to retrieve.

operations.name: payment_portfolio_advertiser_get

operations.description: Links one or more ad accounts to an Advanced Payment Portfolio using `/payment_portfolio/advertiser/update/`. Use this endpoint to attach ad accounts to a shared Payment Portfolio. The `payment_portfolio_id` must be an Advanced Payment Portfolio whose `payment_portfolio_type` is `SHARED`, and the ad accounts must belong to the same client as the Payment Portfolio.

advertiser_ids.description: List of ad account IDs to link to the Payment Portfolio. You can link only ad accounts that belong to the same client as the Payment Portfolio. Maximum size: 20. If an ad account belongs to a Business Center, you must have Finance Manager or Admin access to that Business Center; confirm this with `/bc/get/` by checking `user_role` and `finance_role`. If an ad account does not belong to a Business Center, you must have Admin or Operator access to the ad account. If `advertiser_ids` contains any invalid ID, the entire request fails.

payment_portfolio_id.description: ID of the Advanced Payment Portfolio to link ad accounts to. Obtain valid IDs from `/payment_portfolio/get/`, and use a Payment Portfolio whose `payment_portfolio_type` is `SHARED`.

operations.name: payment_portfolio_advertiser_update

operations.description: Creates a Payment Portfolio and links eligible ad accounts to it. Linked `advertiser_ids` must belong to the same client as the Payment Portfolio. To link an ad account that belongs to a Business Center, you must have Finance Manager or Admin access to that Business Center; verify this with `/bc/get/` by checking `user_role` and `finance_role`. If the ad account does not belong to a Business Center, you must have Admin or Operator access to the ad account.

advertiser_ids.description: List of ad account IDs to link to the Payment Portfolio. You can only link ad accounts that belong to the same client as the Payment Portfolio. Maximum 20 IDs. If an ad account belongs to a Business Center, you must have Finance Manager or Admin access to that Business Center; verify this with `/bc/get/` by checking `user_role` and `finance_role`. If an ad account does not belong to a Business Center, you must have Admin or Operator access to the ad account. If `advertiser_ids` contains any invalid ID, the entire request fails.

payment_portfolio_type.description: Type of Payment Portfolio. `SHARED` creates an Advanced Payment Portfolio, where funds are centrally managed and jointly used by all linked ad accounts. Defaults to `SHARED` if omitted.

operations.name: payment_portfolio_create

operations.description: Allocates a client's credit line across one or more Payment Portfolios using percentage-based allocation. Send `allocation_details` with up to 10 target portfolios. Each portfolio's credit line is then adjusted based on its configured percentage, so if the total credit line changes later, each portfolio's credit line changes proportionally. A portfolio's available credit line is automatically restored when outstanding bills are settled, so no manual reallocation is needed for that case.

allocation_details.description: List of credit line allocation entries. Maximum size: 10.

allocation_percentage.description: Percentage of credit line to allocate to this Payment Portfolio, with up to four decimal places. Value range: 0 to 1. The percentage for each portfolio must be greater than that portfolio's used percentage; check `min_allocation_percentage` from `/payment_portfolio/get/` for the portfolio identified by `payment_portfolio_id`. If the total credit line changes later, the portfolio's credit line changes based on this percentage. The portfolio's available credit line is automatically restored when outstanding bills are settled, so manual reallocation is not required in that case.

payment_portfolio_id.description: ID of the Advanced Payment Portfolio to receive part of the credit line. To obtain valid IDs, call `/payment_portfolio/get/` and use portfolios whose `payment_portfolio_type` is `SHARED`.

operations.name: payment_portfolio_credit_line_update

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: >= 1.

operations.description: Creates a TikTok Pixel for a website at `/open_api/v1.3/pixel/create/`. Use it to create a pixel and then install it on your website. Preconditions: you must own a business website and have permission to edit the website's code. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. Recommended usage: use one pixel per website, and choose a pixel name that matches the website or domain. Version note: compared with v1.2, this v1.3 endpoint changes `advertiser_id` from number to string and returns `pixel_id` as a string. Installation help: https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=717665906670358459

pixel_name.description: Name of the pixel. Maximum 40 characters, cannot contain emojis, and must be unique; duplicate pixel names are not supported. It is recommended to use a name that corresponds to your website or domain.

operations.name: pixel_create

operations.description: Creates Pixel events for a website pixel so you can measure customer actions on your site. Pixel events can be defined from an industry or custom template after the pixel is created, and can represent paid or organic user actions such as add-to-cart. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms (https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/pixel/event/create/; compared with v1.2, request field `name` changed to `event_name`, and `advertiser_id`, `event_id`, and `pixel_id` changed from number to string.

pixel_events.description: List of Pixel events to create.

currency.description: Currency for the conversion value. Used together with `currency_value`. Default: `USD`.

currency_value.description: Event conversion value. When combined with `currency`, it represents the business value of the event. For example, if `currency` is `USD` and `currency_value` is `5.5`, the conversion event generates 5.5 USD for the business.

event_name.description: Event name. Maximum 40 characters in any language and cannot contain emoji. Default: empty string (`""`).

event_type.description: Pixel event type. Supported values are listed in the "Event name for ad creation (`optimization_event`)" column of Supported Pixel events - Pixel events.

rules.description: Event data connection rules that define the conditions under which the Pixel event is recorded. Rule fields are interdependent: `TRIGGERTYPE_CLICK` represents an element click and must use `operator=OPERATORTYPE_EQUALS`, `variable=ELEMENT`, and a CSS selector in `value`; `TRIGGERTYPE_PAGEVIEW` represents web browsing and uses `variable` as `PAGE_HOSTNAME`, `PAGE_PATH`, or `PAGE_URL`, with `operator` set to `OPERATORTYPE_CONTAINS`, `OPERATORTYPE_EQUALS`, or `OPERATORTYPE_DOES_NOT_EQUAL`.

operator.description: Rule operator. Must match the selected `trigger`: `TRIGGERTYPE_CLICK` supports only `OPERATORTYPE_EQUALS`; `TRIGGERTYPE_PAGEVIEW` supports `OPERATORTYPE_CONTAINS`, `OPERATORTYPE_EQUALS`, and `OPERATORTYPE_DOES_NOT_EQUAL`.

trigger.description: Event trigger type. Valid combinations depend on `operator`, `variable`, and `value`: for `TRIGGERTYPE_CLICK`, use `operator=OPERATORTYPE_EQUALS`, `variable=ELEMENT`, and set `value` to the CSS selector such as `#my-element`; for `TRIGGERTYPE_PAGEVIEW`, use `variable` as `PAGE_HOSTNAME`, `PAGE_PATH`, or `PAGE_URL`, `operator` as `OPERATORTYPE_CONTAINS`, `OPERATORTYPE_EQUALS`, or `OPERATORTYPE_DOES_NOT_EQUAL`, and set `value` to the domain, path, or URL to match.

value.description: Value to match for the rule. Its meaning depends on `trigger` and `variable`: for `TRIGGERTYPE_CLICK` with `variable=ELEMENT`, provide a CSS selector such as `#my-element`; for `TRIGGERTYPE_PAGEVIEW`, provide the domain name, path, or URL corresponding to `PAGE_HOSTNAME`, `PAGE_PATH`, or `PAGE_URL`.

variable.description: Variable type. Must match the selected `trigger`: `TRIGGERTYPE_CLICK` requires `ELEMENT`; `TRIGGERTYPE_PAGEVIEW` requires one of `PAGE_HOSTNAME`, `PAGE_PATH`, or `PAGE_URL`.

statistic_type.description: How conversions are counted. Default: `EVERY_TIME`. If a user generates two conversions through the same ad, `EVERY_TIME` counts 2 and `ONCE` counts 1.

operations.name: pixel_event_create

operations.description: Deletes a Pixel event via /v1.3/pixel/event/delete/. You cannot delete Pixel events that are bound to ad groups. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms (https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and must not share sensitive data with TikTok.

event_id.description: Event ID to delete. Obtain this value from the `event_id` field returned by the /pixel/list/ endpoint.

operations.description: Updates a Pixel event's name and conversion value via `/v1.3/pixel/event/update/`. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id` and `event_id` from number to string.

currency.description: Currency for `currency_value`. Optional values are `INR` (Indian Rupee), `JPY` (Japanese Yen), and `USD` (US Dollar). Defaults to `USD` if omitted.

event_id.description: Event ID to update. Get this from the `event_id` field in the response of the `/pixel/list/` endpoint.

event_name.description: New event name. Maximum 40 characters across all languages and must not contain emoji.

operations.name: pixel_event_update

operations.description: Returns the supported Instant Page events for the specified objective type and optimization goal. Use this endpoint to determine which Instant Page events are available for your setup. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms at https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. Compared with v1.2, this v1.3 endpoint uses /v1.3/pixel/instant_page/event/, changes `advertiser_id` from number to string, renames request parameter `optimize_goal` to `optimization_goal`, renames response fields `optimize_goals` to `optimization_goals` and `external_actions` to `optimization_events`, and changes `business_type` enum from `CUSTOM_INSTANT_PAGE` to `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE`.

is_retargeting.description: Whether the request is for retargeting.

objective_type.description: Objective type. Must be either `CONVERSIONS` or `APP_PROMOTION`.

operations.description: Gets a paginated list of pixels for an advertiser, with optional filtering by pixel code, pixel ID, name, sort order, and catalog-bindable status. The returned data includes pixel information and Pixel Events. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. This is the v1.3 endpoint `/open_api/v1.3/pixel/list/`; compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` and `pixel_id` are strings, and v1.3 adds the `filtering` and `available_for_catalog_only` request parameters. If you need to bind a pixel to a catalog as an event source, use `/catalog/eventsource/bind/`.

code.description: Pixel Code. If specified, only pixels matching this Pixel Code are returned.

filtering.description: Filter conditions.

available_for_catalog_only.description: Whether the pixel can be bound to a catalog as an event source. Default is `false`. To bind a pixel to a catalog, use `/catalog/eventsource/bind/`.

name.description: Pixel name filter. Supports fuzzy matching; returns pixels whose names contain the provided value.

order_by.description: Sort order for returned pixels. Default is `EARLIEST_CREATE`.

page.description: Page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `10`. Valid range is 1-20.

pixel_id.description: Pixel ID. If specified, only the matching pixel is returned.

operations.name: pixel_list_get

operations.description: Updates a pixel's name and optional matching/cookie/data-sharing settings via `/open_api/v1.3/pixel/update/`. Pixel names should correspond to your website or domain name, must be unique, and must not exceed 40 characters. By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms at https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms and must not share sensitive data with TikTok. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id` from number to string and adds `automatic_advanced_matching_fields`, `enable_first_party_cookies`, and `enable_expanded_data_sharing`.

advanced_matching_fields.description: Manual Advanced Matching settings for the pixel. This object is only applicable to pixels generated through partner integrations and does not apply to manually configured pixels. When `advanced_matching_fields` is specified, both `phone_number` and `email` are required.

email.description: Required when `advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether email is enabled for Manual Advanced Matching. Default value: `true`.

phone_number.description: Required when `advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether phone number is enabled for Manual Advanced Matching. Default value: `true`.

automatic_advanced_matching_fields.description: Automatic Advanced Matching settings for the pixel. Automatic Advanced Matching uses customer information collected through your TikTok Pixel, such as email, name, and phone number, to improve match rates, conversion tracking, and retargeting. Sensitive information is hashed before it is shared with TikTok. If you operate in a more regulated or sensitive industry such as financial services or health care, consider using Manual Advanced Matching instead. When `automatic_advanced_matching_fields` is specified, all of `phone_number`, `email`, `name`, `address`, and `external_id` are required.

address.description: Required when `automatic_advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether address is enabled for Automatic Advanced Matching. Address includes basic location details such as city, state, zip code, and country; street-level information is not collected. Sharing this helps TikTok match users more accurately.

email.description: Required when `automatic_advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether email is enabled for Automatic Advanced Matching.

external_id.description: Required when `automatic_advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether external ID is enabled for Automatic Advanced Matching. External ID is an identifier on the advertiser's platform, such as a customer ID, order ID, or loyalty card number. Sharing it helps TikTok match users more accurately.

name.description: Required when `automatic_advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether name is enabled for Automatic Advanced Matching.

phone_number.description: Required when `automatic_advanced_matching_fields` is specified. Whether phone number is enabled for Automatic Advanced Matching.

enable_expanded_data_sharing.description: Whether to enable expanded data sharing. When enabled, this pixel can collect more information from your website, including page content such as meta tags and product details, visitor actions such as clicks, button interactions, and time spent, and website performance such as page load speed and responsiveness. This data may be used to improve ad delivery and campaign performance on TikTok. You can view collected data in TikTok Pixel Helper.

enable_first_party_cookies.description: Whether to allow first-party cookies. When enabled, the system can share data from your website's first-party cookies with TikTok to improve measurement and help reach more users.

pixel_name.description: Pixel name. Must be unique, should correspond to your website/domain name, must be 40 characters or fewer, and cannot contain emojis. If you want to keep the name unchanged, set this field to an empty string (`""`).

operation_status.description: Filters results by playable creative operation status. Default value: `SAVED`.

page.description: Page number. Default value: 1. Range: greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: 10. Range: 1-100.

playable_id.description: Playable creative ID. If provided, only the playable creative with the matching ID is returned.

playable_name.description: Filters results by playable creative name.

playable_url.description: Filters results by playable creative URL.

status.description: Filters results by playable creative audit or validation status.

operations.description: Gets benchmark performance data for ads, ad groups, or campaigns, comparing them against other ads by the requested dimensions. Returned data has a latency of 30-48 hours. Each ad being compared must have accumulated at least 1,000 impressions within the selected comparison window; otherwise its benchmark result is empty. To verify impressions for a time range before calling this endpoint, use `/report/integrated/get/` with `start_date`, `end_date`, and the `impressions` metric. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/report/ad_benchmark/get/`, `sort_field`/`sort_type` replace v1.2 `order_field`/`order_type`, and `advertiser_id`, `ad_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, and `campaign_ids` are strings.

compare_time_window.description: Comparison window in days. Default is `7` if omitted.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to compare against. You can specify 1 to 4 dimensions.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. You must provide one and only one of `ad_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, or `campaign_ids`.

ad_ids.description: IDs of the ads to get benchmark results for. Valid only when `filtering` uses ad-level filtering, and you must not send `adgroup_ids` or `campaign_ids` in the same request.

adgroup_ids.description: IDs of the ad groups to get benchmark results for. Valid only when `filtering` uses ad-group-level filtering, and you must not send `ad_ids` or `campaign_ids` in the same request.

campaign_ids.description: IDs of the campaigns to get benchmark results for. Valid only when `filtering` uses campaign-level filtering, and you must not send `ad_ids` or `adgroup_ids` in the same request.

metrics_fields.description: Metrics to return. If omitted, all supported metrics are returned.

page.description: Page number.

page_size.description: Page size.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. If omitted, results are sorted by `CREATE_TIME`.

operations.name: report_ad_benchmark_get

operations.description: Run a synchronous integrated report and return report data immediately from `/open_api/v1.3/report/integrated/get/`. This endpoint can return reporting data for up to 20,000 advertisements. If the advertiser has more than 20,000 ads, use `campaign_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, or `ad_ids` as filters to retrieve all data in batches; you can pass up to 100 IDs at a time when using those filters. If you compare this synchronous report with a report downloaded from TTAM (TikTok Ads Manager), data may be inconsistent because TTAM downloaded reports should be compared with asynchronous reports instead; TTAM downloaded reports and the API asynchronous report do not implement the 20,000-truncation for ads.

advertiser_id.description: Pass either `advertiser_id`/`advertiser_ids` or `bc_id`. When `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`, pass `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids`; if both are provided, `advertiser_id` is ignored. When `report_type` is `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, or `TT_SHOP`, pass `advertiser_id`. When `report_type` is `BC`, pass `bc_id` instead. Advertiser ID.

advertiser_ids.description: Valid only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`. You must pass either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids`; if both are provided, `advertiser_id` is ignored. List of advertiser IDs, maximum size 5. When `advertiser_ids` is used, the response can include up to 20,000 IDs; cutoff is based on campaign, ad group, or ad creation time in descending order, and IDs may not be evenly distributed across advertisers. Returned `metrics` will include `currency`, `timezone`, and `advertiser_id`. Because advertisers can use different time zones, use `multi_adv_report_in_utc_time=true` to return all advertisers in UTC+0; otherwise data is returned in each advertiser's local time zone. Because advertisers can use different currencies, returned metric values use each advertiser's currency and are presented without a decimal point. To get total aggregated metrics across all advertiser IDs, enable `enable_total_metrics`; returned `total_metrics` will include `currency`, `timezone`, and `advertiser_id`, all set to `-`. If you use `advertiser_ids` but do not include any ID dimensions in `dimensions`, the response returns `0` for `currency`, `timezone`, and `advertiser_id`, and `-` for cost-related metrics such as `spend`. All advertisers in `advertiser_ids` must belong to the same TikTok for Business user or the request fails.

bc_id.description: Pass either `advertiser_id`/`advertiser_ids` or `bc_id`. When `report_type` is `BC`, pass `bc_id`. When `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`, use `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` instead. When `report_type` is `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, or `TT_SHOP`, use `advertiser_id`. ID of a Business Center you have access to.

data_level.description: Data level to query. Not supported when `report_type` is `BC`. Required when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`. If set to `AUCTION_ADVERTISER`, data for all Auction Ads and Reservation Ads under the advertiser is returned. When `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`: `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN` returns data for all ads under undeleted auction campaigns because the default `campaign_status` filter is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`; `AUCTION_ADGROUP` returns data for all ads under undeleted auction ad groups because the default `adgroup_status` filter is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`; `AUCTION_AD` returns only undeleted ads under all auction campaigns because the default `ad_status` filter is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`. To get data for all ads under all auction campaigns, set the `ad_status` filter to `STATUS_ALL` in `filtering`. When `report_type` is `TT_SHOP`, only `AUCTION_ADVERTISER` and `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN` are allowed.

dimensions.description: Grouping dimensions, for example `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]`. Supported dimensions vary by `report_type`. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` contains `stat_time_day`, the query time range cannot exceed 30 days. If `dimensions` contains `stat_time_hour`, the query time range cannot exceed 1 day. If `dimensions` contains more than `xx_id` and there is no ads reporting within the time range, an empty list is returned.

enable_total_metrics.description: Whether to return total aggregated values for the requested metrics. When enabled, aggregate data across all pages is returned, so you only need to specify this field on the first page request. Because of the 20,000 truncation limit, totals are provided for up to 20,000 IDs. Supported only for auction basic reports and GMV max ads reports. Valid only when `dimensions` contains one ID dimension and optionally `stat_time_day`, for example `["campaign_id"]` or `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]`. Not supported in the sandbox environment.

end_date.description: Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or omitted. Query end date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, using the ad account time zone. When `query_lifetime=true`, this field is ignored. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` does not include `stat_time_day`, the maximum range between `start_date` and `end_date` is 365 days. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` includes `stat_time_day`, the maximum range is 30 days. If `report_type` is `BC`, the maximum range is 365 days.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Supported when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, or `BC`; not supported when `report_type` is `TT_SHOP`. Supported filters vary by `service_type` and `data_level`. When you provide `filtering`, each object in the list must include `field_name`, `filter_type`, and `filter_value` together. If you want to use `country_code` as a grouping filter, you must also include `country_code` in `dimensions`. `country_code` works with basic report (sync and async), audience report (sync and async), playable ad report (sync only), and Business Center report (sync only).

filter_type.description: Filter operator. When `filter_type` is `IN`, `CONTAIN_ANY_OF`, or `NOT_IN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string. When `filter_type` is `BETWEEN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string containing exactly two string values.

filter_value.description: Value to filter by. When `filter_type` is `IN`, `CONTAIN_ANY_OF`, or `NOT_IN`, this must be a valid JSON array string.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. Supported metrics vary by `report_type`. Default is `["spend", "impressions"]` when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, or `CATALOG`; all metrics supported by the selected `dimensions` when `report_type` is `BC`; and `["spend", "billed_cost"]` when `report_type` is `TT_SHOP`. Currency metrics are based on the advertiser account currency.

multi_adv_report_in_utc_time.description: Supported only when `advertiser_ids` is used. Default is `false`. If `true`, returned metrics for all advertisers use UTC+0. If `false`, returned metrics use each advertiser's local time zone.

order_field.description: Sorting field. All supported metrics except attribute metrics can be used for sorting. By default, results are not sorted.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`.

page_size.description: Pagination size. Range: 1-1000. Default is `10`.

query_lifetime.description: Whether to request lifetime metrics. Supported only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`. Default is `false`. If `true`, `start_date` and `end_date` are ignored, and lifetime metrics use the same metric names as normal metrics. Breakdown by time, audience, or location code `country_code` is not supported for lifetime queries. Audience reports, DSA reports, Business Center reports, and GMV max ads reports do not support lifetime metrics.

report_type.description: Report type. When `service_type` is `AUCTION`, `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, and `TT_SHOP` are supported. When `report_type` is `BC`, do not pass `service_type`. `BASIC` and `AUDIENCE` require `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids`; `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, and `TT_SHOP` use `advertiser_id`; `BC` uses `bc_id`.

service_type.description: Ad service type. Not supported when `report_type` is `BC`. Default is `AUCTION` when `report_type` is not `BC`. To retrieve TopView reporting data, use basic or audience reports and set the `buying_type` filter to `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW`.

start_date.description: Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or omitted. Query start date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, using the ad account time zone. When `query_lifetime=true`, this field is ignored. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` does not include `stat_time_day`, the maximum range between `start_date` and `end_date` is 365 days. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` includes `stat_time_day`, the maximum range is 30 days. If `report_type` is `BC`, the maximum range is 365 days.
