operations.description: Cancels an asynchronous report task that is currently queued or being processed. This is useful for stopping incorrect or long-running tasks so other queued tasks can proceed. Use /report/task/create/ to create the task first, and use /report/task/check/ to confirm the task status is `QUEUING` or `PROCESSING` before canceling it.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. If you used `advertiser_ids` when calling /report/task/create/ (POST), this field must be set to one of the advertiser IDs included in that `advertiser_ids` list.

task_id.description: ID of an asynchronous report task that is currently in `QUEUING` or `PROCESSING` status. Obtain this ID by first calling /report/task/create/ to create the task, then call /report/task/check/ to confirm the task is still `QUEUING` or `PROCESSING` before attempting to cancel it.

operations.name: report_task_cancel

operations.description: Checks the status of an asynchronous report task at /v1.3/report/task/check/. Use the same Access-Token that was used with /report/task/create/. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from /v1.2/reports/task/check/ to /v1.3/report/task/check/, and `advertiser_id` changed from number to string.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. If you used `advertiser_ids` when calling /report/task/create/ (POST), this field must be set to one of the advertiser IDs included in that `advertiser_ids` list.

task_id.description: ID of the asynchronous report task. Obtain this value from the response of /report/task/create/.

operations.name: report_task_check

operations.description: Creates an asynchronous report task for TikTok Ads reporting via `POST /open_api/v1.3/report/task/create/`. Use this endpoint instead of the synchronous report endpoints when you want async report generation. Important operational notes: rate limit is 1 QPS per app, and the user associated with the access token has a separate limit of 500 async report creations per ad account per hour. Playable ads reports are not supported in asynchronous reports. Asynchronous reports support no pagination, are valid for 30 days after creation, and data is refreshed every several hours, so current-day data may be inaccurate. Asynchronous filtering supports only `campaign_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, `ad_ids`, or `country_code`, with up to 20000 IDs total; if `country_code` is used as a grouping filter, include `country_code` in `dimensions`. Dimension/metric compatibility differs from synchronous reports: a valid sync combination may be unsupported in async reports, and UV metrics cannot be queried together with audience dimensions in async reports. CHUNK mode only supports synchronous basic reports. Known issue: async reports currently return the dimension `country_code` (for example `US`) as `country_name` (for example `United States`). In v1.3, this endpoint replaces `/v1.2/reports/integrated/get/` for async creation; `filters` was renamed to `filtering`, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, `lifetime` was deprecated in favor of `query_lifetime`, and new parameters include `output_format`, `file_name`, `query_lifetime`, `advertiser_ids`, and `enable_report_title_translation`.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. Either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` must be set. If both `advertiser_id` and `advertiser_ids` are provided, `advertiser_id` is ignored.

advertiser_ids.description: List of advertiser IDs. Either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` must be set. If both are provided, `advertiser_id` is ignored. Max size: 5. Valid only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`. All advertisers in `advertiser_ids` must belong to the same TikTok for Business user or an error occurs. If `start_date` and `end_date` are specified, data is pulled according to each ad account's timezone. When passing multiple advertiser IDs, you can specify up to two ID dimensions in `dimensions` (`advertiser_id` plus one other ID dimension). Many metrics do not support the `advertiser_id` dimension. It is recommended to include `currency` in `metrics` because ad accounts may use different currencies.

data_level.description: Report aggregation level. Required when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`.

dimensions.description: Grouping dimensions, for example `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]`. Supported dimensions vary by `report_type`. If `country_code` is used as a grouping filter in `filtering`, you must also include `country_code` in `dimensions`. If your `dimensions` contain more than `xx_id` and there is no ads reporting in the query time range, an empty list is returned. Dimension/metric combinations supported in synchronous reports may not be supported in asynchronous reports. The dimension `ad_id_v2` is available only when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`; it cannot be used together with the dimension `ad_id` or the filter `ad_ids`. `ad_id_v2` can return ad-level data for Manual Ads, Smart+ Campaigns, and Upgraded Smart+ Ads.

enable_report_title_translation.description: Whether to translate the title row of the asynchronous report, including dimension and metric names. Default is `true`. Valid only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`. If set to `false`, titles remain untranslated, for example `ad_id` instead of `AD ID`. Starting November 15th, 2024, translations of certain metrics in async report title rows will change. This does not affect metric field names. TikTok strongly recommends setting this field to `false` to avoid code dependencies on translations that may change over time.

end_date.description: Query end date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, based on the ad account time zone. Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or omitted. If `query_lifetime` is `true`, this field is ignored. Asynchronous reports have no time range limitations.

file_name.description: Custom download file name. Optional when `output_format` is `CSV_DOWNLOAD` or `XLSX_DOWNLOAD`. Maximum length is 255 characters. Must not contain any of these characters: `/`, `\t`, `\b`, `@`, `#`, `$`, `%`, `^`, `&`, `*`, `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Supported filters vary by `service_type` and `data_level`. When you include `filtering`, each object in the list must include `field_name`, `filter_type`, and `filter_value` together. If you want to use `country_code` as a grouping filter, you must also include `country_code` in `dimensions`. In asynchronous mode, for basic, audience, and DSA reports, the only supported filter fields are `campaign_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, and `ad_ids`.

field_name.description: Filter field name. If `field_name` is `ad_id_v2`, you cannot use it together with the dimension `ad_id` or the filter `ad_ids`. For `ad_id_v2`, you must set `data_level` to `AUCTION_AD` and include `ad_id_v2` in `dimensions`. `ad_id_v2` can filter Manual Ad IDs, Smart+ Campaign ad IDs, and Upgraded Smart+ Ad IDs. You can specify up to 100 values when using `ad_id_v2`.

filter_type.description: Filter operator. When `filter_type` is `IN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string. When `filter_type` is `BETWEEN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string containing 2 string elements. When `field_name` is `ad_id_v2`, `filter_type` must be `IN`.

filter_value.description: Filter value. When `filter_type` is `IN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string. When `filter_type` is `BETWEEN`, it must be a valid JSON array string of 2 string elements.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. Supported metrics vary by `report_type`. Default is `["spend", "impressions"]`. In async reports, UV metrics cannot be queried together with audience dimensions. Supported dimension/metric combinations may differ from synchronous reports.

order_field.description: Field to sort by. All supported metrics except attribute metrics support sorting. By default, no sorting is applied.

output_format.description: Output format. Default is `CSV_STRING`. If `output_format` is `CSV_DOWNLOAD` or `XLSX_DOWNLOAD`, you may optionally provide `file_name`.

query_lifetime.description: Whether to request lifetime metrics. Default is `false`. If `true`, `start_date` and `end_date` are ignored. Lifetime metric names are the same as the normal metric names. Breakdown by time, audience, or location code (`country_code`) is not supported for lifetime metrics. DSA reports do not support lifetime metrics. Audience reports do not support lifetime metrics at this time.

report_type.description: Report type. When `service_type` is `AUCTION`, supported values are `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, and `CATALOG`. `data_level` is required when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`. `advertiser_ids` is valid only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`. `enable_report_title_translation` is valid only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`. You can retrieve creative-level data for Upgraded Smart+ Ads when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`.

service_type.description: Ad service type. Default is `AUCTION`. To retrieve TopView ad reporting data, use basic or audience reports and set the `buying_type` filter to `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW`.

start_date.description: Query start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, based on the ad account time zone. Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or omitted. If `query_lifetime` is `true`, this field is ignored. Asynchronous reports have no time range limitations.

operations.name: report_task_create

operations.description: Downloads the output of a completed asynchronous report task from /v1.3/report/task/download/. Use the same Access-Token used for the related report task creation request. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` is a string. This endpoint is used after creating an async task via /report/task/create/; if that task was created with `output_format` set to `CSV_DOWNLOAD` or `XLSX_DOWNLOAD`, this endpoint returns JSON containing a downloadable file URL rather than the file stream directly.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. If you used `advertiser_ids` when calling /report/task/create/ (POST), this must be set to one of the advertiser IDs included in that `advertiser_ids` list.

task_id.description: ID of the asynchronous report task to download.

operations.name: report_task_download

operations.description: Gets in-second performance data for ads or Video Insights data for a video from `/open_api/v1.3/report/video_performance/get/`. Performance is provided for the first 60 seconds of a video; if a video is longer than 60 seconds, all data after the 60th second is attributed to the 60th second. All data returned by this endpoint has a one-hour latency. `report_type=AD` returns ad in-second performance data, but `AD` will be deprecated in the next API version; use `VIDEO` when possible.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. When `report_type` is `AD` or omitted, you must specify at least one of `ad_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, or `campaign_ids`. When `report_type` is `VIDEO`, you must specify either `material_ids` or `video_ids`. `start_time`, `end_time`, and `lifetime` are valid only when `report_type` is `VIDEO`.

ad_ids.description: Required as one of `ad_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, or `campaign_ids` when `report_type` is `AD` or omitted. IDs of the ads to get in-second performance data for. Maximum 200 IDs.

adgroup_ids.description: Required as one of `ad_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, or `campaign_ids` when `report_type` is `AD` or omitted. IDs of the ad groups to get in-second performance data for.

campaign_ids.description: Required as one of `ad_ids`, `adgroup_ids`, or `campaign_ids` when `report_type` is `AD` or omitted. IDs of the campaigns to get in-second performance data for.

end_time.description: Valid only when `report_type` is `VIDEO`. To query a time range for Video Insights data, you must provide both `start_time` and `end_time`, and set `lifetime` to `false`. Query end time, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss` format (UTC+0).

lifetime.description: Valid only when `report_type` is `VIDEO`. Whether to request lifetime metric data. Default is `true`. To query a time range instead of lifetime data, you must provide both `start_time` and `end_time`, and set `lifetime` to `false`.

material_ids.description: Required as either `material_ids` or `video_ids` when `report_type` is `VIDEO`. Material IDs of the videos to get Video Insights data for. Maximum size: 1.

start_time.description: Valid only when `report_type` is `VIDEO`. To query a time range for Video Insights data, you must provide both `start_time` and `end_time`, and set `lifetime` to `false`. Query start time, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss` format (UTC+0).

video_ids.description: Required as either `material_ids` or `video_ids` when `report_type` is `VIDEO`. Video IDs of the videos to get Video Insights data for. Maximum size: 1.

metrics_fields.description: Metrics to return. Supported values depend on `report_type`. If omitted, all metrics supported for the specified `report_type` are returned. For `AD`, supported metrics are `view_count`, `click_count`, `slide_count`, `convert_count`, `break_count`, `like_count`, `share_count`, and `comment_count`. For `VIDEO`, supported metrics are `clicks`, `conversions`, `drop_off`, `retain`, `ctr`, and `cvr`.

page.description: Page number. Default is 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Range: 1-500. Default is 10.

report_type.description: Report type. `AD` returns in-second performance data for ads and is the default if omitted. `VIDEO` returns Video Insights data for a video. Note: `AD` will be deprecated in the next API version, and `VIDEO` is recommended instead.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. If omitted, results are sorted by `CREATE_TIME`.

sort_type.description: Sorting type: `ASC` starts from the one created earliest; `DES` starts from the one created latest.

operations.name: report_video_performance_get

operations.description: Queries Reach & Frequency contracts for an advertiser and checks whether a specified date falls within a valid contract period. Provide `included_date` to verify the contract validity window covering that date and return the relevant start and end dates. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string and `rf_campaign_type` was added. If `rf_campaign_type` is used to query TikTok Pulse contracts, this is an allowlist-only feature and requires access from your TikTok representative. The response is also used with `/campaign/create/`: when creating an R&F campaign with `rf_campaign_type=PULSE`, the ad group schedule window (`schedule_start_time`, `schedule_end_time`) must fall within the intersection of the returned `[start_date, end_date]` and `[pulse_start_date, pulse_end_date]`.

included_date.description: A date that must fall within the contract validity window, or the start/end date corresponding to an ad group's delivery period. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`, for example `2020-09-18`.

rf_campaign_type.description: Specifies which contract type to query. `STANDARD` queries Reach & Frequency contracts; `PULSE` queries TikTok Pulse contracts. If omitted, contract validity is evaluated against the Reach & Frequency contract period (`start_date` to `end_date`). This field is allowlist-only for TikTok Pulse access; contact your TikTok representative to enable it.

operations.name: rf_contract_query_get

operations.description: Gets the Reach & Frequency (R&F) delivery time zones for the specified locations. This endpoint is for R&F advertising only. In v1.3, use `/open_api/v1.3/rf/delivery/timezone/`; compared with v1.2, the request parameter changed from `country_codes` to `region_codes`, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, and the response field changed from `country_code` to `region_code`.

region_codes.description: List of region codes to query, for example `US`. In v1.3, this field replaces `country_codes` used in v1.2.

operations.name: rf_delivery_timezone_get

operations.description: Get inventory estimates for Reach & Frequency ads via /open_api/v1.3/rf/inventory/estimate/. Use this endpoint to estimate inventory for planned R&F delivery and compare the prediction results with TikTok Ads Manager. In v1.3, `reach_percentage` is deprecated, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, several targeting parameter names changed, and new request parameters include `rf_purchased_type`, `budget`, `purchased_impression`, `purchased_reach`, `rf_campaign_type`, and `contextual_tag_ids`. Contextual tags and pre-bid third-party brand safety are allowlist-only features. If `rf_campaign_type` is `PULSE`, you must later pass the `location_id` returned by this endpoint to `location_ids` when creating the ad group with /adgroup/rf/create/. See https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1744571201117186 for inventory-estimate details and result mapping.

audience_info.description: Audience targeting rules used for the inventory estimate.

age_groups.description: Target age ranges. If `location_ids` include Israel or Brazil, `AGE_13_17` cannot be used.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to target. For an audience to be targeted or excluded in Reach & Frequency ads, you must set `audience_sub_type` to `REACH_FREQUENCY` when creating or updating the audience.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety type for Reach & Frequency ads. Default: `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` uses full inventory and ads may appear next to some content featuring mature themes. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` uses TikTok brand safety with most inappropriate content removed and no mature themes; in the next API version it will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` as the default. `STANDARD_INVENTORY` shows ads next to content appropriate for most brands. `LIMITED_INVENTORY` avoids content with mature themes. `THIRD_PARTY` uses a third-party brand safety solution. Pre-bid third-party brand safety is allowlist-only.

contextual_tag_ids.description: Contextual tag IDs. This is an allowlist-only feature. Valid only when the campaign objective is `RF_REACH`. Not supported when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`. Not supported when `feed_type` is `TOP_FEED`. If `rf_campaign_type` is `PULSE` in /campaign/create/, you must provide contextual tags of `PREMIUM` type; in that case the ad group's CPM (`cpm`) is fixed.

device_model_ids.description: Device model IDs to target. Only brand-level model IDs are currently supported. When this field is specified, `device_price_ranges` must not be specified. Only active devices (`is_active = true` in /tool/device_model/) can be used.

device_price_ranges.description: Target device price range. `10000` means 1000+. Values must be multiples of 50. When `device_model_ids` is specified, this field must not be specified. The upper limit you set is increased by 50 and that adjusted value is used as the actual upper limit. For example, a range of `[0, 250]` actually means `[0, 300]`.

excluded_audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to exclude. For an audience to be targeted or excluded in Reach & Frequency ads, you must set `audience_sub_type` to `REACH_FREQUENCY` when creating or updating the audience.

interest_category_ids.description: Interest category IDs. If specified, users who do not meet the interest target are excluded during delivery. Omit this field if you want to target everyone.

location_ids.description: Targeted location IDs. Locations can be country/region, province, DMA or metropolitan area, or city level. Only a single country or region is supported; if multiple IDs are specified, they must all belong to the same country or region. See Reach & Frequency supported locations and the Location IDs reference for valid IDs.

budget.description: Budget amount. Required when `rf_purchased_type` = `FIXED_BUDGET`. Based on the budget you specify, the endpoint returns estimated values for the other fields.

feed_type.description: Feed type. `STANDARD_FEED` provides larger inventory with normal CPM pricing. `TOP_FEED` provides more limited inventory with higher CPM pricing.

frequency.description: Frequency cap count. Together with `frequency_schedule`, this sets the maximum ad exposure rate for Reach & Frequency ads. Example: `frequency = 2` and `frequency_schedule = 3` means the ad is shown at most twice every 3 days. Constraints: `1 ≤ frequency ≤ frequency_schedule`; `1 ≤ frequency_schedule ≤ min(schedule_end_time - schedule_start_time, 30)`; and the cap derived from `frequency` plus `frequency_schedule` must not exceed four times per day.

frequency_schedule.description: Frequency cycle in days. Together with `frequency`, this sets the maximum ad exposure rate for Reach & Frequency ads. See the `frequency` rules and limits.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective.

purchased_impression.description: Impressions to purchase, in units of 1,000. Required when `rf_purchased_type` = `FIXED_SHOW`. Based on the impression amount you specify, the endpoint returns estimated values for the other fields.

purchased_reach.description: Users reached to purchase, in units of 1,000. Required when `rf_purchased_type` = `FIXED_REACH`. Based on the reach amount you specify, the endpoint returns estimated values for the other fields.

rf_campaign_type.description: Use this field with `objective_type = RF_REACH` to mark the campaign as TikTok Pulse and obtain available premium contextual tags. Enum values: `STANDARD` for a standard Reach & Frequency campaign, or `PULSE` for a TikTok Pulse campaign. If set to `PULSE`, only one `location_id` is returned. Do not pass this field when `objective_type` is not `RF_REACH`. If `PULSE` is used, you must pass the `location_id` returned by this endpoint to `location_ids` in /adgroup/rf/create/ when creating the TikTok Pulse ad group.

rf_purchased_type.description: Buying type. `FIXED_SHOW` purchases a fixed number of impressions. `FIXED_REACH` purchases a fixed number of reached users. `FIXED_BUDGET` purchases against a fixed budget. This field determines which companion field is required: `budget` for `FIXED_BUDGET`, `purchased_impression` for `FIXED_SHOW`, or `purchased_reach` for `FIXED_REACH`.

schedule_end_time.description: End time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The `HH:MM:SS` portion must equal `23:59:59` for the target region. The interval between `schedule_end_time` and `schedule_start_time` must not exceed 30 days. If `location_ids` observe Daylight Saving Time, ignore DST and pass Standard Time instead.

schedule_start_time.description: Start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. The `HH:MM:SS` portion must equal `00:00:00` for the target region. If `location_ids` observe Daylight Saving Time, ignore DST and pass Standard Time instead.

operations.description: Withdraws a Reach & Frequency (R&F) ad order to suspend delivery. After an order is withdrawn, the corresponding ad group's status changes to "Closed". Ad groups whose status is "Deliverying" cannot be withdrawn.

adgroup_ids.description: IDs of the ad groups to withdraw. Each ID must correspond to an R&F ad group. Ad groups whose status is "Deliverying" cannot be withdrawn.

operations.name: rf_order_cancel

operations.description: Returns the locations your ads can be delivered to for a given advertiser ID. To get available locations based on objectives, placements, and optionally targeting operating systems and brand safety settings instead, use /tool/region/.

language.description: Language for translating returned region names. Defaults to `en`. Supported values: `zh`, `fr`, `es`, `ko`, `vi`, `en`, `hi`, `it`, `tr`, `ru`, `ja`, `id`, `de`, `ms`, `ar`, and `th`. If you pass an unsupported value, the API returns results in the default `en`.

operations.name: search_region_get

operations.description: Creates Search Ads negative keywords for campaigns or ad groups. If a user's search term matches a negative keyword, the ad in that campaign or ad group will not be shown. Before using this endpoint, Automatic Search Placement must already be enabled: for ad-group negative keywords, it must be enabled on the target ad group; for campaign negative keywords, it must be enabled for at least one ad group in the target campaign. See Create Search Ads: https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1780164603696130.

keywords.description: List of negative keywords to create. Max size: 1,000. For each ad group, you can configure a maximum of 10,000 negative keywords.

match_type.description: Match type for the negative keyword. Default value: `BROAD_WORD`.

name.description: Negative keyword text to create. Length limit: 80 characters. Must not contain these special characters: `!`, `@`, `%`, `^`, `(`, `)`, `=`, `{`, `}`, `;`, `~`, `` ` ``, `<`, `>`, `?`, `\`, `|`; otherwise an error occurs. Duplicate names are de-duplicated to one unique name, and each unique name can have only one `match_type`.

object_ids.description: Campaign IDs or ad group IDs to which the negative keywords will be applied. Max size: 50. Specify values according to `object_type`: if `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, provide campaign IDs; if `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, provide ad group IDs.

object_type.description: Specifies whether to create negative keywords for campaigns or ad groups. Use `CAMPAIGN` for campaigns or `ADGROUP` for ad groups. This value determines what IDs must be provided in `object_ids`.

replace.description: Whether to replace all existing negative keywords on the specified campaign or ad group with the values in `keywords`. `true` replaces all existing negative keywords; `false` adds new negative keywords. Default value: `false`.

operations.name: search_ad_negative_keyword_add

operations.description: Deletes Search Ads negative keywords for a campaign or ad group via /open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/delete/. Set `object_type` to specify whether the target object is a campaign or ad group, then provide the matching `object_id`. To obtain valid negative keyword IDs before deletion, use /search_ad/negative_word/get/.

keyword_ids.description: IDs of the negative keywords to delete. Maximum 1,000 IDs. To obtain valid negative keyword IDs, use /search_ad/negative_word/get/. If any specified negative keyword ID does not exist, the request returns an error.

object_id.description: ID of the object whose negative keywords you want to delete. Provide this value according to `object_type`: if `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, pass a campaign ID; if `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, pass an ad group ID.

object_type.description: Specifies whether to delete negative keywords at the campaign level or ad group level. This field determines the required ID type for `object_id`: `CAMPAIGN` requires a campaign ID, and `ADGROUP` requires an ad group ID.

operations.name: search_ad_negative_keyword_delete

operations.description: Gets the list of Search Ads negative keywords for a campaign or ad group via `/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/get/`.

object_id.description: The campaign ID or ad group ID whose negative keywords you want to retrieve. Specify this field according to `object_type`: if `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, pass a campaign ID; if `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, pass an ad group ID.

object_type.description: Specifies whether to get negative keywords for a campaign or an ad group. If `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, `object_id` must be a campaign ID. If `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, `object_id` must be an ad group ID.

page.description: Page number to return. Default value: 1. Value range: >= 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: 10. Value range: [1,50].

operations.name: search_ad_negative_keyword_get

operations.description: Updates a Search Ads negative keyword at the campaign or ad group level via `/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/update/`. Set `object_type` to identify whether the negative keyword belongs to a campaign or an ad group, provide the corresponding `object_id`, and specify the existing negative keyword with `old_keyword_id`.

keyword.description: Updated values for the original negative keyword.

match_type.description: Match type for the negative keyword. If omitted, the default is `BROAD_WORD`.

name.description: New name for the negative keyword identified by `old_keyword_id`. Maximum length is 80 characters. The name must not contain these special characters: `!`, `@`, `%`, `^`, `(`, `)`, `=`, `{`, `}`, `;`, `~`, `` ` ``, `<`, `>`, `?`, `\`, `|`; otherwise an error occurs. Duplicate negative keyword names are de-duplicated to one unique name, and each unique name can have only one match type. To update only the match type, you can send the same `name` and set a different `match_type`.

object_id.description: Campaign ID or ad group ID for the object whose negative keyword you want to update. This field depends on `object_type`: if `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, pass a campaign ID; if `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, pass an ad group ID.

object_type.description: Specifies whether to update a negative keyword for a campaign or an ad group. This field determines what ID must be passed in `object_id`: `CAMPAIGN` requires a campaign ID, and `ADGROUP` requires an ad group ID.

old_keyword_id.description: ID of the existing negative keyword to update. Obtain this ID from `/search_ad/negative_word/get/`. If the specified negative keyword ID does not exist, the request returns an error.

operations.name: search_ad_negative_keyword_update

operations.name: showcase_identity_get

operations.description: Gets the Showcase products that are available for targeting the specified countries or regions. The request must use an identity bound to the Showcase and that identity must have permission to access the Showcase.

filtering.description: Optional filtering conditions for narrowing the returned Showcase products.

item_group_ids.description: Product SPU IDs to filter by. Maximum size: 10.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: ID of the identity bound to the Showcase. The identity must have permission for the Showcase.

identity_type.description: Type of identity. Enum values: `TT_USER` for a TikTok User; `BC_AUTH_TT` for a TikTok Account User in Business Center. Required companion field: when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, you must also provide `identity_authorized_bc_id`.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1` if omitted. Value range: >= 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `10` if omitted. Value range: `1` to `1000`.

region_codes.description: List of country or region codes for which you want to retrieve Showcase products that can be used for targeting.

operations.name: showcase_product_get

operations.description: Gets the country or region codes that a Showcase can target for a specified bound identity. The identity must be bound to the Showcase and have permission to access the Showcase.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: ID of the identity that is bound to the Showcase and has permission for the Showcase.

identity_type.description: Identity type. Supported values: `TT_USER` for a TikTok user, or `BC_AUTH_TT` for a TikTok Account User in Business Center. When `identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`, you must also provide `identity_authorized_bc_id`.

operations.description: Appeals the rejection of an Upgraded Smart+ Ad so the ad can be re-evaluated after failing review. After submitting an appeal, wait for processing and then call /smart_plus/ad/review_info/ to check the appeal outcome and updated review status.

attachment_list.description: List of attachment links to include with the appeal. Maximum 100 items.

smart_plus_ad_id.description: Upgraded Smart+ Ad ID to appeal. To obtain valid ad IDs, use /smart_plus/ad/get/.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_appeal

operations.description:
Creates an Upgraded Smart+ ad with creatives, text, landing destinations, catalog settings, and tracking settings via /open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/ad/create/. You can create at most 30 ads within one Upgraded Smart+ Ad Group. Important deprecation: creating non-Spark Ads using Custom Identities in ad groups that deliver to Automatic Placement or Select Placement when TikTok is included is no longer supported for existing ad accounts. All new ad accounts created on or after January 15, 2026 cannot create non-Spark Ads using Custom Identities for these placements. Existing ads remain unaffected and editable. Campaigns delivering only to Pangle or Global App Bundle placements are not affected. Relevant prerequisites and dependent resources may need to be obtained from /smart_plus/adgroup/get/, /app/list/, /app/info/, /offline/get/, and other referenced endpoints.

The Ad creation mode must match its parent Campaign and Ad Group creation mode:
- In review-first mode, create every planned Ad with status DISABLE. Do not enable any Ad before user approval. After all planned Ads across the Campaign have been created, call review_smart_plus_campaign to present the complete Campaign, Ad Group, and Ad setup for review.
- In direct-enable mode, create Ads with status ENABLE. Direct-enable mode is allowed only when the user explicitly asks to skip review and launch immediately, or requests multiple campaigns in the same operation.

auto_disclaimer_types.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and `catalog_creative_toggle=true` at the ad level. Disclaimer type to show in an Automotive Carousel Ad for Models. Max size: 1. Before using `EMISSION`, each vehicle must include `emission_disclaimer`, `emission_disclaimer_url`, `emission_overlay_disclaimer`, and `emission_image_link`. Before using `DISCOUNT`, each vehicle must include `offer_disclaimer` and `offer_disclaimer_url`.

call_to_action_id.description: Required in either of these scenarios: (1) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and the ad group uses TikTok placement (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`); (2) campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses TikTok placement, and `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`. CTA portfolio ID (dynamic CTA) used in the ad.

catalog_creative_info.description: Additional settings for catalog creatives. Valid only when the ad is an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Ad and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`.

catalog_media_settings.description: Types of creatives from the E-commerce catalog to use. If this list includes `TEMPLATE_VIDEO`, you may also provide `catalog_template_video_id`. If `catalog_template_video_id` is omitted, all video templates and video URLs in the catalog are used to generate the ad. If `catalog_template_video_id` is provided, the selected template is used. If you specify `catalog_media_settings`, you cannot later update `catalog_creative_toggle` to `false` or update `catalog_media_settings` to an empty list.

catalog_template_video_id.description: Valid only when `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included in `catalog_media_settings`. Video template ID from your catalog, obtainable from `/catalog/video_package/get/`.

catalog_creative_toggle.description: Valid only when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Enables auto-selection of creatives from the catalog. Defaults to `false`. If set to `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Web Ads using catalog carousel format, provide `creative_info` containing only `music_info`. If set to `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads using catalog carousel format, provide `creative_info` with one image in `image_info` plus `music_info` for the end card image and music.

creative_auto_add_toggle.description: Valid only when either (1) campaign `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `sales_destination=WEBSITE`, or (2) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GENERATION` with `promotion_target_type=INSTANT_PAGE` or `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE`. Enables automatic addition of newly generated assets during delivery. Default depends on allowlist status: `true` if allowlisted for default-on behavior, otherwise `false`. The feature is available to all advertisers, but default-on behavior is allowlist-only.

creative_auto_enhancement_strategy_list.description: List of automatic enhancement strategies to apply during delivery. Default depends on allowlist status: if allowlisted for specific strategies by default, the field defaults to those strategies; otherwise it defaults to an empty list. Each enhancement's default-on behavior is separately allowlist-only.

dark_post_status.description: Valid only for Spark Ads created through Spark Ads Push. Controls Ads-only mode for the creative. Defaults to `ON`. You can set `OFF` only if the identity's "Show through ads only" mode is disabled and the ad account does not have mandatory Ads-only mode enabled. If the ad account enforces mandatory Ads-only mode, this field can only be `ON`. Check the identity `ads_only_mode` via `/identity/info/` and the ad account `ads_only_mode` via `/advertiser/info/`. Mandatory Ads-only mode at the ad-account level is currently allowlist-only.

deeplink_utm_params.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `sales_destination=APP`, and at the ad level `deeplink` is specified and `deeplink_type=DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`. List of deeplink URL parameters as key-value pairs. Max size: 14. This is currently an allowlist-only feature.

key.description: Deeplink URL parameter key. Can be a custom parameter or one of these supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Length limit for a custom parameter: 100 characters.

value.description: Deeplink URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of these macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Length limit for a custom value: 600 characters.

end_card_cta.description: Required when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and `catalog_creative_toggle=true` at the ad level. CTA for the end card (`image_info`) of an Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Carousel Ad for Inventory, Automotive Carousel Ad for Models, or the catalog solution for Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Direct Messaging Ads. `SEND_MESSAGE` is available only for the catalog solution for Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Direct Messaging Ads.

fallback_type.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE` and `messaging_app_type=IM_URL`, and a custom URL scheme for an instant messaging app is specified through `deeplink` at the ad level. Controls the destination when the app is not installed. `WEBSITE` requires that you also provide the fallback URL in `landing_page_url_list`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required in the same scenarios as `ad_configuration.identity_type`. Identity ID for the selected identity.

identity_type.description: Required when creating non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, or when creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog. Non-Spark Ads on TikTok placement are no longer supported. For non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, the only supported value is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. For Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Spark Ads with `catalog_creative_toggle=true`, supported values are `TT_USER` and `BC_AUTH_TT`.

phone_info.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`. Phone number details that users can call from the ad.

phone_number.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Phone number users can call from the ad, for example `12638282`.

phone_region_calling_code.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Region calling code, for example `+1`. Obtain the region code and region calling code from `/tool/phone_region_code/`.

phone_region_code.description: Required when `phone_info` is specified. Region code for the phone number, for example `US`. Obtain the region code and region calling code from `/tool/phone_region_code/`.

product_display_field_list.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory catalog through `catalog_id`, and `catalog_creative_toggle=true` at the ad level. Product detail fields to display in an Automotive Carousel Ad for Inventory. Max size: 2. The title is displayed automatically. For example, if set to `["MILEAGE","YEAR"]`, the ad displays the `mileage`, `price`, and `title` fields. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

product_ids.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. Catalog product IDs. Max size: 20. Retrieve `product_id` values with `/catalog/product/get/`.

product_info.description: Product information used to generate personalized ad variations. All fields in `product_info` are optional. More complete information may improve generated variations and ad performance.

catalog_tag_list.description: Catalog product information to display. Valid in either of these scenarios: (1) campaign `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `catalog_type=ECOMMERCE`; (2) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled=true`, and the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory catalog through `catalog_id`. In scenario 1, supported values are `PRICE`, `STRIKETHROUGH_PRICE`, `DISCOUNT`, and `FREE_SHIPPING`, defaulting to `["PRICE","STRIKETHROUGH_PRICE","DISCOUNT","FREE_SHIPPING"]`, max size 4. In scenario 2, supported values are `DEALER_NAME`, `CURRENT_MILEAGE`, `LEAD_PRICE`, `LEAD_SALE_PRICE`, `EXTERIOR_COLOR`, `TRIM`, `ADDRESS_CITY`, `VEHICLE_STATE`; max size is 2 primary tags (`DEALER_NAME`,`CURRENT_MILEAGE`,`EXTERIOR_COLOR`,`TRIM`,`ADDRESS_CITY`,`VEHICLE_STATE`) and 2 secondary tags (`LEAD_PRICE`,`LEAD_SALE_PRICE`).

product_card_type.description: The product card display type. Enum values: PRODUCT_CARD: Product Card. PRODUCT_TILE: Product Tiles. PRODUCT_INFO_CARD: Info Card. PRODUCT_SHOWCASE_TILE: Showcase Tiles. ANCHOR: Anchor. CAROUSEL_LABEL: Carousel label.

product_image_list.description: List of product images. Size range: 0-10. If omitted, a generic image is used so the image does not appear blank.

web_uri.description: Image ID for a product image. Supported formats: `.jpg`, `.png`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`; file size up to 5 MB; recommended resolution 800x800. Obtain image IDs from `/file/image/ad/search/` or `/file/image/ad/upload/`.

product_titles.description: List of product names. Size range: 0-1. Each name can be up to 40 characters, cannot contain emoji, and counts Chinese or Japanese words as two characters and English letters as one. If omitted, a default name is used so the field does not appear blank.

promo_info_list.description: Promo code and offer details. Valid only for regular Upgraded Smart+ Web Campaigns. Highlights offers, promo codes, or events in the ad. Promo codes require shoppers to enter a code at checkout; offers apply automatically. Max size: 10.

discount_type.description: Required when `promo_info_list` is specified. Discount type.

discount_value.description: Required when `promo_info_list` is specified. If `discount_type` is `PERCENTAGE`, provide an integer from 1 to 100. If `discount_type` is `CASH`, provide a float greater than 0.

minimum_purchase_currency.description: Required when `minimum_purchase_type` is `SUBTOTAL`. Minimum purchase currency.

minimum_purchase_value.description: Required when `minimum_purchase_type` is specified. If `minimum_purchase_type` is `QUANTITY`, provide an integer greater than or equal to 0. If `minimum_purchase_type` is `SUBTOTAL`, provide a float greater than 0.

promo_code.description: Promo code. If shoppers must enter a code at checkout, provide it here. For automatically applied offers, omit this field. Length limit: 30 characters, no emoji. Chinese or Japanese words count as two characters; English letters count as one.

valid_end_time.description: Promo code or offer end time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Must be later than the current time. If you specify `valid_end_time`, you must also provide `valid_start_time`.

valid_start_time.description: Promo code or offer start time in UTC+0, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

selling_points.description: List of selling points. Max size: 15. Each selling point must be 1-25 characters and cannot contain emoji. Chinese or Japanese words count as two characters; English letters count as one.

product_info_enabled.description: Product information mode. Defaults to `UNSET`. This field is automatically set to `CATALOG` when campaign `app_promotion_type=MINIS` and `catalog_enabled=true`. This field can only be set to `UNSET` when an Inventory Card portfolio is specified through `card_id` in Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads.

product_set_id.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `PRODUCT_SET`. Product set ID. Retrieve sets with `/catalog/set/get/` or create one with `/catalog/set/create/`.

product_specific_type.description: Required when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Controls how products are selected. If `ALL`, do not provide `product_set_id` or `product_ids`. If `PRODUCT_SET`, you must provide `product_set_id`. If `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`, you must provide `product_ids`.

app_tracking_info_list.description: Valid only when campaign `sales_destination=WEB_AND_APP`. Third-party tracking settings. Max size: 4.

app_id.description: Required when `app_tracking_info_list` is specified. App ID for the app type selected: Android when `app_type=APP_ANDROID`, iOS when `app_type=APP_IOS`.

app_type.description: Required when `app_tracking_info_list` is specified. App platform type.

click_tracking_url.description: When `app_type` is specified, provide either `impression_tracking_url` or `click_tracking_url` or both. Click tracking URL for the specified app platform.

impression_tracking_url.description: When `app_type` is specified, provide either `impression_tracking_url` or `click_tracking_url` or both. Impression tracking URL for the specified app platform.

brand_safety_postbid_partner.description: Post-bid third-party brand safety measurement partner.

brand_safety_vast_url.description: Returned when brand_safety_postbid_partner is IAS. The wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid third-party partner to measure brand safety. You need to get the URL from the measurement partner IAS.

click_tracking_url.description: Click tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the app specified at the ad group level has `partner_id` 44 (TikTok Business SDK) or 49 (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field; if you do, it is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for that app and the partner is not 44 or 49, this field defaults to the app's configured Click Tracking URL and updates are not supported. Check `partner_id` and `self_attribution_enabled` via `/app/list/` or `/app/info/`. Pangle currently does not support DCM, Sizmek, or Flashtalking.

impression_tracking_url.description: Default impression tracking URL from your measurement partner. If the app specified at the ad group level has `partner_id` 44 (TikTok Business SDK) or 49 (TikTok App API), you do not need to pass this field; if you do, it is ignored. If self-attribution is enabled for that app and the partner is not 44 or 49, this field defaults to the app's configured Default Impression Tracking URL and updates are not supported. Check `partner_id` and `self_attribution_enabled` via `/app/list/` or `/app/info/`.

tracking_app_id.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `LEAD_GENERATION`. App ID to track offsite app events. If ad group `app_id` is specified and you want to track offsite app events, `tracking_app_id` must match that same app ID; otherwise you may pass any app ID you want to track. Get app IDs from `/app/list/`.

tracking_message_event_set_id.description: Valid when ad group `promotion_type=LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, `optimization_goal=CLICK`, and `messaging_app_type` is `MESSENGER` or `WHATSAPP`, and `page_list` is not specified at the ad level. Message event set ID used to measure conversation starts in the instant messaging app. Once set, this field cannot be updated. Obtain IDs from `/ctm/message_event_set/get/`.

tracking_offline_event_set_ids.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`. Offline Event Set IDs to track in-person actions. Max size: 50. For a new ad, existing auto-tracking Offline Event Sets must be tracked. If you omit this field, all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs in the ad account are included automatically. If you provide this field, you must include all existing auto-tracking Offline Event Set IDs; adding non-auto-tracking set IDs is optional. Find existing auto-tracking sets via `/offline/get/` where `auto_tracking=true`.

tracking_pixel_id.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL` or `APP_RETARGETING`. Pixel ID for tracking website events. If ad group `pixel_id` is already set, `tracking_pixel_id` must match it. If ad group `pixel_id` is not set, you may specify any pixel ID for website event tracking.

viewability_vast_url.description: Required when viewability_postbid_partner is IAS. The wrapped VAST URL used by the post-bid third-party partner to measure viewability. You need to get the URL from the measurement partner IAS. Note: Post-bid third-party viewability measurement is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. When you set both brand_safety_postbid_partner and viewability_postbid_partner as IAS, brand_safety_vast_url should be the same as viewability_vast_url.

utm_params.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. List of URL parameters as key-value pairs. Max size: 14. If `landing_page_url` already contains URL parameters, you may also pass `utm_params`, but it must exactly match the parameters used in the URL. The parameters are not automatically appended to `landing_page_url` during delivery.

key.description: URL parameter key. Supported UTM parameters: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Length limit for a custom parameter: 100 characters.

value.description: URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of these macros: `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, `__PLACEMENT__`. Length limit for a custom value: 600 characters.

ad_name.description: Ad name. To auto-generate the name, set this field to an empty string (`""`); the generated name format is the ad ID (`ad_id`). Length limit: 512 characters, no emojis. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters; each English letter counts as one.

ad_text_list.description: Required when `tiktok_item_id` is not specified. List of ad texts shown with the ad creative. Max size: 5.

ad_text.description: Required when `ad_text_list` is specified. Ad text shown as part of the creative.

adgroup_id.description: Ad group ID. Obtain valid IDs from `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`.

auto_message_list.description: Required when ad group `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`. Automatic message details for TikTok Direct Messaging Ads. Max size: 1.

auto_message_id.description: Required when `auto_message_list` is specified. ID of the automatic message used in a TikTok Direct Messaging Ad. Currently only welcome messages are supported. Use `/creative/auto_message/get/` to list welcome messages or `/creative/auto_message/create/` to create one.

call_to_action_list.description: Call-to-action list. Max size: 3. Not supported in certain TikTok-placement scenarios where you must use `call_to_action_id` instead.

call_to_action.description: Required when `call_to_action_list` is specified. Call-to-action text value. Do not use this field in these scenarios; use `ad_configuration.call_to_action_id` instead: (1) campaign `objective_type=LEAD_GENERATION` and ad group uses TikTok placement (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`); (2) campaign `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses TikTok placement, and `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`.

creative_info.description: Creative configuration for this ad variation.

ad_format.description: Ad format. `SINGLE_VIDEO` requires either `video_info.video_id` plus `image_info.web_uri` as the cover, or `tiktok_item_id`. `CAROUSEL_ADS` requires either carousel images in `image_info.web_uri` plus `music_info.music_id`, or a TikTok photo post via `tiktok_item_id`. `CATALOG_CAROUSEL` requires `music_info.music_id` for Upgraded Smart+ Web Catalog Carousel Ads, and requires both `music_info.music_id` and an end card in `image_info.web_uri` for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Catalog Carousel Ads.

aigc_disclosure_type.description: Valid only when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Controls whether the ad is labeled as AI-generated when viewed in full. Defaults to `NOT_DECLARED`.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `creative_info.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, provide the identity in `ad_configuration` instead.

identity_type.description: Required when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, instead provide `identity_type` and `identity_id` in `ad_configuration`. If this field is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`, and campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and the ad group uses TikTok placement (`placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`), then you must also provide dynamic CTA `call_to_action_id` in `ad_configuration`.

image_info.description: Required for: non-Spark Single Video ads and Spark Single Video ads through Spark Ads Push as the video cover; non-Spark Standard Carousel ads and Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Push as 1-35 carousel images; and Catalog Carousel ads in Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads as one end card image. Not supported for Catalog Carousel ads in Upgraded Smart+ Web Ads.

web_uri.description: Required when `image_info` is specified. Image ID. Upload images with `/file/image/ad/upload/` or search existing images with `/file/image/ad/search/`.

music_info.description: Required when creating Standard Carousel Ads, including non-Spark Standard Carousel ads, Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Push, and Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Pull. Also required when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` or `LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`, because the system automatically generates catalog carousel ads.

music_id.description: Required when `music_info` is specified. ID of the music used in carousel ads.

tiktok_item_id.description: Required for Spark Ads created through Spark Ads Pull: use a TikTok video post for Spark Single Video ads or a TikTok photo post for Spark Standard Carousel ads. Not supported when `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. Pass the `item_id` returned by `/tt_video/info/` or `/identity/video/get/`. When you provide `tiktok_item_id`, you do not need to provide `image_info`, `video_info`, or `title_list`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm you have commercial rights to use the music in the videos.

video_info.description: Required for non-Spark Single Video ads and Spark Single Video ads created through Spark Ads Push.

video_id.description: Required when `video_info` is specified. Video ID. Upload videos with `/file/video/ad/upload/` or search existing videos with `/file/video/ad/search/`.

custom_product_page_list.description: Custom product page details. Valid only for iOS app retargeting campaigns as documented. Size range: 0-1.

custom_product_page_url.description: Custom Product Page (CPP) URL. Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `app_promotion_type` is `APP_RETARGETING`, and an iOS `app_id` is set at the ad group level. The URL must match that promoted app. Only users on iOS 15+ can open a CPP. Format: `https://apps.apple.com/{region}/app/{app_name}/id{app_id}?ppid={ppid}`. Length limit: 512 characters.

deeplink.description: Deeplink destination for users who have the app installed.

deeplink_type.description: Required when `deeplink` is specified. If you pass this field, also provide `deeplink`.

disclaimer.description: Disclaimer information. Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, or when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and `catalog_enabled` is `false` or omitted; and the ad group includes TikTok placement either by leaving placement fields unspecified for automatic placement or by setting `placement_type=PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in `placements`. Once added to the ad, the disclaimer cannot be deleted.

disclaimer_clickable_texts.description: Required when `disclaimer_type` is `TEXT_LINK`. Clickable disclaimer entries. Max size: 3. If you use multiple clickable disclaimers, both the total combined text length and each individual text length must be no more than 40 characters.

text.description: Required when `disclaimer_clickable_texts` is specified. Disclaimer text. Length limit: 40 characters.

url.description: Required when `disclaimer_clickable_texts` is specified. URL opened when users tap the disclaimer text.

text.description: Required when `disclaimer_text` is specified. Disclaimer text. Length limit: 90 characters.

disclaimer_type.description: Required when `disclaimer` is specified. Disclaimer type. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

interactive_add_on_list.description: List of interactive add-on (creative portfolio) IDs. Size range: 0-1.

card_id.description: ID of an interactive add-on creative portfolio. Supported portfolio types: Display Card, Countdown Sticker, Gift Code Sticker, or Inventory Card for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads. Create portfolios with `/creative/portfolio/create/`.

landing_page_url_list.description: Landing page URL list. Size range: 0-1.

landing_page_url.description: Required when `landing_page_url_list` is specified. Landing page URL.

operation_status.description: Status to apply when the ad is created. Defaults to `ENABLE`.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_create

operations.description: Retrieves Upgraded Smart+ ads in an ad account from `/open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/ad/get/`. Important: this endpoint returns only creatives that you explicitly selected. Automatically added creatives are not included, including TikTok creator content, creator content from TikTok One, Content Suite, authorized TikTok posts, your own content or previously used content from linked TikTok accounts and Creative Library, and content generated for you such as remixed app store page images. To retrieve all creatives in a campaign, including automatically added creatives, use `/ad/get/`.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the response fields under `list` and under `ad_configuration`, except `advertiser_id` and `smart_plus_ad_id`, which are returned by default.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Example: `filtering={"objective_type":"APP_PROMOTION"}`.

adgroup_ids.description: Filter by ad group IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Latest ad creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads created before this time. Example: `2025-02-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, ads created at any time are included. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within six months.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Earliest ad creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads created after this time. Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, ads created at any time are included. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within six months.

modified_after.description: Latest ad modification time lower bound, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads last modified after this time. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a time range within six months for the creation time filters.

objective_type.description: Filter by advertising objective. Supported values for this endpoint are `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination to drive toward. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales in your app and requires a product catalog. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both your website and app.

secondary_status.description: Filter by ad secondary status. Includes the following Upgraded Smart+ statuses: `AD_STATUS_DELIVERY_AND_REAUDIT` (review of modifications in progress), `AD_STATUS_DELIVERY_AND_TRANSCODING_FAIL` (video transcoding failed), `AD_STATUS_REVIEW_PARTIALLY_APPROVED` (ad is partially reviewed and delivering), `AD_STATUS_COLLECTION_TOGGLED_OFF` (lead collection has ended), `AD_STATUS_PRIVACY_POLICY_REJECTED` (rejected due to privacy policy violations), and `AD_STATUS_PRIVACY_POLICY_AUDIT` (in privacy policy review).

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: Filter by ad IDs. Max size: 100.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1 to 100. Default: 10.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_get

operations.description: Disables or enables one or more creatives in an Upgraded Smart+ Ad via `/smart_plus/ad/material_status/update/`. You must provide the target ad and the ad-specific material IDs associated with that ad. Ad IDs and associated ad material IDs can be obtained from `/smart_plus/ad/get/`.

ad_material_ids.description: List of ad material IDs for the creatives to operate on. An ad material ID is an ad-specific material ID generated when a particular creative is used in an ad, and it differs from the creative ID from the ad account Creative Library. To obtain ad material IDs associated with the specified ad, use `/smart_plus/ad/get/`. Max size: 20. Supported creative types are: carousels from Standard Carousel Spark Ads (via Spark Ads Push), carousels from non-Spark Ad Standard Carousels, videos from non-Spark Ads, videos from Spark Ads (via Spark Ads Push), TikTok video posts used as Spark Ad Videos (via Spark Ads Pull), and TikTok photo posts used as Standard Carousel Spark Ads (via Spark Ads Pull). You cannot mix carousel and non-carousel creative types in the same request.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the specified creatives: `DISABLE` pauses them, and `ENABLE` enables them.

smart_plus_ad_id.description: Ad ID for the Upgraded Smart+ Ad whose creatives you want to enable or disable. To obtain valid ad IDs, use `/smart_plus/ad/get/`.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_material_status_update

operations.description: Previews an Upgraded Smart+ ad before creation or previews an existing Upgraded Smart+ ad. Use `preview_type=ADS_CREATION` to preview from ad-creation parameters, or `preview_type=AD` to preview an existing ad by `smart_plus_ad_id`. This endpoint depends on assets and IDs from other APIs, including catalog, product set, product, video, image, TikTok post, and existing Smart+ ad lookup endpoints.

call_to_action_id.description: The ID of the call-to-action portfolio to use in your ad.

catalog_creative_info.description: Valid only when the ad is an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Ad and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. Contains additional settings for catalog creatives used in the ad.

catalog_media_settings.description: Types of creatives from the E-commerce catalog to use in the ad. `VIDEO` uses video creatives. `IMAGE` uses image creatives. `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` uses video templates; if `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included, you may also specify `catalog_template_video_id`. If `catalog_template_video_id` is omitted, all video templates and video URLs from the catalog are used to generate the ad. If provided, the selected video template is used.

catalog_template_video_id.description: Valid only when `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included in `catalog_media_settings`. Video template ID from the catalog to use in the ad.

catalog_creative_toggle.description: Valid only when `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Whether to enable automatic selection of creatives from the catalog. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`. If set to `true`, you must provide `creative_info` containing only `music_info` to specify the music for Catalog Carousel.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` within `ad_configuration` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required when creating non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, or when creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog. Non-Spark Ads on the TikTok placement are no longer supported.

identity_type.description: Required when creating non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, or when creating Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog. Non-Spark Ads on the TikTok placement are no longer supported. Enum values for non-TikTok-placement non-Spark Ads: `CUSTOMIZED_USER`. Enum values for Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Spark Ads when `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`: `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`.

product_ids.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS`. List of catalog product IDs. Max size: 20.

product_set_id.description: Required when `product_specific_type` is `PRODUCT_SET`. Product set ID.

product_specific_type.description: Required when `catalog_enabled` is `true` at the campaign level. Controls how products are selected. `ALL` lets TikTok dynamically choose from all products, and you do not need `product_set_id` or `product_ids`. `PRODUCT_SET` requires `product_set_id`. `CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS` requires `product_ids`.

ad_text_list.description: Required when `tiktok_item_id` is not specified. List of ad texts shown to the audience as part of the creative. Max size: 5.

ad_text.description: Required when `ad_text_list` is specified. Ad text shown as part of the ad creative.

call_to_action_list.description: Call-to-action list. Max size: 3. Not supported for Upgraded Smart+ Lead Generation Campaigns. The preview link displays only the first call-to-action in the list.

call_to_action.description: Required when `call_to_action_list` is specified. Call-to-action value. This field uses the Call-to-action enumeration.

catalog_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Business Center ID that owns `catalog_id`.

catalog_enabled.description: Whether to use catalog in the campaign. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

catalog_id.description: Required when `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Catalog ID to use in the ad group.

creative_list.description: List of creatives to preview. Size range: 1 to 31.

creative_info.description: Creative information for each creative variant.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `identity_type` within `creative_info` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Required when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. If you want to create Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, specify `identity_type` and `identity_id` in `ad_configuration` instead.

identity_type.description: Required when creating Spark Ads without catalog creatives. Enum values: `AUTH_CODE`, `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`. If you want to create Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog, specify `identity_type` and `identity_id` in `ad_configuration` instead. If this field is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`, and both of the following are true, you must specify a dynamic CTA via `call_to_action_id`: campaign-level `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`; and ad-group-level `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `placements` including `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, or `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`.

image_info.description: Required for: Non-Spark Ads Single Video ads and Spark Ads Single Video ads through Spark Ads Push, where you must provide a video cover; and Non-Spark or Spark Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Push, where you must provide 1 to 35 carousel images. Not supported for Catalog Carousel ads.

web_uri.description: Required when `image_info` is specified. Image ID.

music_info.description: Required when creating Standard Carousel Ads, including Non-Spark Ads Standard Carousel ads, Spark Ads Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Push, and Spark Ads Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Pull. Also required when `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`, because the system automatically generates Catalog Carousel ads.

music_id.description: Required when `music_info` is specified. Music ID used in carousel ads.

tiktok_item_id.description: Required when creating Spark Ads through Spark Ads Pull, including Spark Ads Single Video ads through Spark Ads Pull and Spark Ads Standard Carousel ads through Spark Ads Pull. Not supported when `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. Pass the `item_id` returned by `/tt_video/info/` or `/identity/video/get/`. When `tiktok_item_id` is provided, you do not need to provide `image_info`, `video_info`, or `title_list`. By using Spark Ads, you confirm that you have rights to use the music in the videos for commercial purposes.

video_info.description: Required for Non-Spark Ads Single Video ads and Spark Ads Single Video ads through Spark Ads Push. Contains the video to preview.

video_id.description: Required when `video_info` is specified. Video ID.

preview_type.description: Preview mode. `ADS_CREATION` previews an ad from creation parameters. `AD` previews an existing ad and requires `smart_plus_ad_id`.

smart_plus_ad_id.description: Required when `preview_type` is `AD`. Upgraded Smart+ ad ID to preview.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_preview

operations.description: Retrieves the review results for Upgraded Smart+ Ads, including review details for creatives within those ads. Use the returned rejection reasons, suggestions, and specifications to diagnose why an ad or creative was rejected, such as placement or targeting issues, and update the ad accordingly using /smart_plus/ad/update/.

include_reject_info.description: Whether to include rejection reasons in the response. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

include_violation_frame.description: Whether to include video frames flagged for violations. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`. You can set this field to `true` only when `include_reject_info` is `true`.

lang.description: Language code used for the returned `reasons`, `suggestion`, and `specification` fields inside each `reject_info` object. Default value: `en`.

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: List of Smart+ Ad IDs to query. Maximum 100 IDs per request.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_review_info_get

operations.description: Enables, pauses, or deletes Upgraded Smart+ Ads by updating their operation status. Use POST /open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/ad/status/update/. Deleted ads, or ads that belong to deleted campaigns or deleted ad groups, cannot have their status modified.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the specified ads. Allowed values: `DISABLE` (pause), `ENABLE` (enable), `DELETE` (delete). Deleted ads, or ads in deleted campaigns or deleted ad groups, cannot be modified.

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: List of Upgraded Smart+ Ad IDs to update. Maximum 20 IDs per request. To obtain valid ad IDs, use /smart_plus/ad/get/.

operations.name: smart_plus_ad_status_update

operations.description: Updates an Upgraded Smart+ Ad via `/open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/ad/update/`. This endpoint supports incremental updates overall, but `creative_list`, `ad_configuration.product_info`, and `ad_configuration.product_info.promo_info_list` use full-replacement update mode, so when updating any field inside them you must resubmit the complete value or sibling data will be lost. Updating `product_info` or `promo_info_list` triggers ad review again. Important deprecation notice: creating non-Spark Ads using Custom Identities in ad groups that deliver to Automatic Placement or Select Placement when TikTok is included is no longer supported for existing ad accounts. All new ad accounts created on or after January 15, 2026 cannot create non-Spark Ads using Custom Identities for these placements. Existing ads remain unaffected and editable. Ad campaigns that deliver only to Pangle or Global App Bundle placements are not affected by this Custom Identity deprecation. Migrate guidance: https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1848048566169730

auto_disclaimer_types.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and ad-level `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. Max size: 1. Before using `EMISSION`, each vehicle must include `emission_disclaimer`, `emission_disclaimer_url`, `emission_overlay_disclaimer`, and `emission_image_link`. Before using `DISCOUNT`, each vehicle must include `offer_disclaimer` and `offer_disclaimer_url`.

call_to_action_id.description: Dynamic CTA portfolio ID. Required when either: 1) campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`; or 2) campaign `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` or `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, the ad group uses `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` with `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, and ad-level `creative_info.identity_type` is `TT_USER`, `BC_AUTH_TT`, or `AUTH_CODE`.

catalog_creative_info.description: Additional settings for catalog creatives. Valid only when the ad is an Upgraded Smart+ E-commerce Catalog Ad and `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`.

catalog_media_settings.description: Creative types from the E-commerce catalog to use. If `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included, you may optionally provide `catalog_template_video_id`. If `catalog_template_video_id` is omitted, all catalog video templates and video URLs are used; if provided, the selected template is used. If `catalog_media_settings` was specified during ad creation, you cannot later update `catalog_creative_toggle` to `false` or update `catalog_media_settings` to an empty list.

catalog_template_video_id.description: Valid only when `TEMPLATE_VIDEO` is included in `catalog_media_settings`. Video template ID from the catalog.

catalog_creative_toggle.description: Valid only when campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`. Whether to auto-select creatives from the catalog. If `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Web Ads using catalog carousel format, you must provide `creative_info` containing only `music_info`. If `true` for Upgraded Smart+ Automotive Ads using catalog carousel format, you must provide `creative_info` containing one image in `image_info` and `music_info` for the end card image and music.

creative_auto_add_toggle.description: Valid only when either: 1) campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS` and `sales_destination` is `WEBSITE`; or 2) campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` and ad group `promotion_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION` with `promotion_target_type` equal to `INSTANT_PAGE` or `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE`. When `true`, newly generated assets can be auto-added during delivery. Supported values: `true`, `false`.

creative_auto_enhancement_strategy_list.description: Automatic enhancement strategies to apply during delivery. Once an ad group is created, `TRANSLATE_AND_DUB` cannot be changed: you cannot add it if initially excluded, or remove it if initially included. `IMAGE_QUALITY` and `IMAGE_RESIZE` only take effect when the ad contains image creatives.

dark_post_status.description: Valid only when creating Spark Ads through Spark Ads Push. Controls ads-only mode for creatives. `OFF` is allowed only if both the identity's ads-only mode is disabled and the ad account does not enforce mandatory ads-only mode. If the ad account enforces mandatory ads-only mode, you can set only `ON`. Mandatory ads-only mode for an ad account is an allowlist-only feature.

deeplink_utm_params.description: Valid only when campaign `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, campaign `sales_destination` is `APP`, ad-level `deeplink` is specified, and `deeplink_type` is `DEFERRED_DEEPLINK`. Max size: 14. This is an allowlist-only feature.

key.description: Deeplink URL parameter key. Can be a custom parameter or one of the supported UTM parameters `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_content`, or `utm_campaign`. UTM parameters are case-sensitive. Custom key max length: 100 characters.

value.description: Deeplink URL parameter value. Can be a custom value or one of the macros `__CAMPAIGN_NAME__`, `__CAMPAIGN_ID__`, `__AID_NAME__`, `__AID__`, `__CID_NAME__`, `__CID__`, or `__PLACEMENT__`. Custom value max length: 600 characters.

end_card_cta.description: Valid when campaign `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, campaign `catalog_enabled` is `true`, the ad group specifies an Auto-Inventory or Auto-Model catalog through `catalog_id`, and ad-level `catalog_creative_toggle` is `true`. CTA for the end card in supported automotive carousel or catalog direct messaging scenarios. `SEND_MESSAGE` is available only for the catalog solution for Upgraded Smart+ TikTok Direct Messaging Ads.

identity_authorized_bc_id.description: Required when `ad_configuration.identity_type` is `BC_AUTH_TT`. Business Center ID associated with the TikTok Account User in Business Center identity.

identity_id.description: Identity ID. Valid for non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements or Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog.

identity_type.description: Valid for non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, or for Spark Ads using catalog creatives from an E-commerce catalog. Non-Spark Ads on TikTok placement are no longer supported. For non-Spark Ads on non-TikTok placements, the only supported value is `CUSTOMIZED_USER`.
