You can set this field when creating a disabled campaign or when disabling an existing campaign with `/smart_plus/campaign/status/update/`; the recommended practice is to specify it when disabling an existing campaign. It determines which SKAN 4.0 postback window to secure. Once set, this field cannot be updated. If `operation_status=ENABLE` or is omitted, this field is ignored. If provided when SKAN 4.0 is not enabled for `app_id`, an error occurs. If omitted while `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, `operation_status=DISABLE`, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app, it defaults to `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1`. If SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app, target iOS 16.1+ devices at the ad group level by setting `min_ios_version` to `16.1`.

request_id.description: Client-supplied request ID used for idempotency and to allow campaigns with duplicate names. If you retry the same request with the same `request_id`, only one request succeeds. This is different from the response `request_id`, which identifies the HTTP request. Must be a string representation of a 64-bit integer, for example `123456789`.

rta_bid_enabled.description: Whether to use RTA bid. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default is `false`. You can set this field to `true` only in either of these scenarios: (1) `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `sales_destination=APP`, and `rta_id` is passed; or (2) `objective_type=APP_PROMOTION`, `app_promotion_type=APP_RETARGETING`, and `rta_id` is passed. This is an allowlist-only feature. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

rta_id.description: Realtime API (RTA) strategy identifier. RTA lets you integrate real-time audience data to customize auction and targeting. This is an allowlist-only feature and requires onboarding to receive and respond to RTA requests. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

rta_product_selection_enabled.description: Whether to use RTA to automatically select products. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default is `false`. You can set this field to `true` only when `objective_type=WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `sales_destination=APP`, and `rta_id` is specified. Once set, this field cannot be updated. When `rta_product_selection_enabled=true`, you can only set `product_specific_type` to `ALL` at the ad level.

sales_destination.description: Required when `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales in your app and requires `catalog_enabled=true` plus `catalog_type` set to `ECOMMERCE` or `TRAVEL_ENTERTAINMENT`; if `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, `app_id` is also required. When `sales_destination` is `APP`, the allowed ad-group `catalog_id` types depend on `rta_id`: if `rta_id` is not specified, ad group `catalog_id` may reference catalogs with type `ECOM`, `HOTEL`, `FLIGHT`, `DESTINATION`, or `ENTERTAINMENT`; if `rta_id` is specified, ad group `catalog_id` may reference catalogs with type `ECOM` or `ENTERTAINMENT`. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both website and app. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

special_industries.description: Ad categories. Once specified, the system adjusts targeting options to help comply with advertising policies. Supported only for advertisers registered in the US or Canada.

operations.name: smart_plus_campaign_create

operations.description: Retrieves Upgraded Smart+ campaigns in an ad account from `/open_api/v1.3/smart_plus/campaign/get/`, with optional pagination, field selection, and filtering.

fields.description: List of campaign fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the field names under the response `list` object.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the campaign query. Example: `filtering={"objective_type":"APP_PROMOTION"}`.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Maximum 100 IDs.

campaign_name.description: Filter by campaign name. Fuzzy match is supported.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Latest campaign creation time, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC format. Returns campaigns created before this time. Example: `2025-02-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, campaigns from any creation time are included. For efficiency and speed, TikTok recommends using a creation-time range within 6 months.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Earliest campaign creation time, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC format. Returns campaigns created after this time. Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, campaigns from any creation time are included. For efficiency and speed, TikTok recommends using a creation-time range within 6 months.

objective_type.description: Filter by advertising objective.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination to filter by. `WEBSITE`: drive sales on your website. `APP`: drive sales on your app; product catalog required. `WEB_AND_APP`: drive sales on both your website and your app.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: 10. Value range: 1-1,000.

operations.name: smart_plus_campaign_get

operations.description: Enables, pauses, or deletes Upgraded Smart+ campaigns through `/smart_plus/campaign/status/update/`. For Dedicated Campaigns (`campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`), you can also configure `postback_window_mode` when disabling campaigns to secure SKAN 4.0 postbacks. This SKAN setting applies only if the campaign is a Dedicated Campaign, `operation_status` is `DISABLE`, `postback_window_mode` has not already been configured for the campaign, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app. If eligible Dedicated Campaigns are mixed with ineligible campaigns, the postback window configuration can be partially successful: ineligible campaigns are ignored and their `postback_window_mode` is not changed. Deleted campaigns cannot be modified.

campaign_ids.description: IDs of the campaigns to operate on. Size range: 1-20.

operation_status.description: Operation to perform on the campaigns. `DELETE` deletes campaigns, `DISABLE` pauses campaigns, and `ENABLE` enables campaigns. Deleted campaigns cannot be modified.

postback_window_mode.description: Valid only when all of the following are true: the campaigns in `campaign_ids` are Dedicated Campaigns (`campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`), `operation_status` is `DISABLE`, `postback_window_mode` has not already been configured for the campaign, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app (`app_id`). If `operation_status` is `ENABLE` or this field is passed without meeting the SKAN 4.0 requirement, an error occurs. If omitted while `campaign_type=IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, `operation_status=DISABLE`, and SKAN 4.0 is enabled for the app, it defaults to `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1`. Configuration can be partially successful: non-Dedicated Campaigns and Dedicated Campaigns that already have `postback_window_mode` configured are ignored and not modified. To receive SKAN 4.0 postbacks, target iOS 16.1+ devices by setting ad-group-level `min_ios_version` to `16.1`. `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE1` secures the first postback (0-2 day attribution window) and may delay quota release up to 4 days. `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE2` secures the first two postbacks (3-7 day attribution window) and may delay quota release up to 13 days. `POSTBACK_WINDOW_MODE3` secures all three postbacks (8-35 day attribution window) and may delay quota release up to 41 days.

operations.name: smart_plus_campaign_status_update

operations.description: Updates an Upgraded Smart+ campaign via `/smart_plus/campaign/update/`. This endpoint supports incremental updates. Goal-based budget increase (`budget_auto_adjust_strategy=AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE`) is allowlist-only; contact your TikTok representative for access. To obtain campaign IDs before updating, use `/smart_plus/campaign/get/`.

budget.description: Fixed campaign budget or initial campaign budget. When `budget_auto_adjust_strategy=UNSET`, this is the fixed campaign budget. When `budget_auto_adjust_strategy=AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE`, this is the initial campaign budget; to retrieve the current campaign budget, check the returned `current_budget`.

budget_auto_adjust_strategy.description: Campaign budget strategy for automatic daily campaign budget. Valid only when all of the following are true: `budget_optimize_on=true`, `budget_mode=BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET`, and `app_promotion_type` is not `MINIS`. When set to `AUTO_BUDGET_INCREASE`, Goal-based budget increase is enabled; the specified `budget` becomes the initial daily budget, and the daily budget can automatically increase by 20%, up to 10 times per day, when budget utilization reaches 90% or more. The daily budget resets to the original daily budget each day. `UNSET` disables Goal-based budget increase. This feature is allowlist-only; contact your TikTok representative for access.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to update. To obtain valid campaign IDs, use `/smart_plus/campaign/get/`.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name. Maximum length is 512 characters. Emoji is not supported. Each Chinese or Japanese word counts as two characters, and each English letter counts as one character.

po_number.description: PO (purchase order) number used for invoice tracking and reconciliation.

operations.name: smart_plus_campaign_update

operations.description: Retrieves an Upgraded Smart+ Creative Breakdown Report for creatives within Upgraded Smart+ Ads. The report supports time-based breakdowns by hour, day, week, or month. Use `dimensions` to choose the grouping fields and `metrics` to choose returned metrics.

dimensions.description: Dimension grouping conditions. For example, `["main_material_id","stat_time_day"]` groups by both `main_material_id` and `stat_time_day`. Available dimensions and supported dimension groupings are documented in Supported dimensions.

end_date.description: Query end date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The date is based on the ad account time zone. The difference between `start_date` and `end_date` must be 365 days or less. If `dimensions` contains `stat_time_hour`, the difference must be 7 days or less.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions.

ad_text_entity_ids.description: List of ad text entity IDs. Each ID is a system-generated unique identifier for an ad text. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs. Max size: 200. To obtain ad group IDs, use `/smart_plus/adgroup/get/`. You cannot combine `adgroup_ids` with `campaign_ids` or `smart_plus_ad_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

call_to_action_entity_ids.description: List of call-to-action entity IDs. Each ID is a system-generated unique identifier for a call-to-action. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs. Max size: 200. To obtain campaign IDs, use `/smart_plus/campaign/get/`. You cannot combine `campaign_ids` with `adgroup_ids` or `smart_plus_ad_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

interactive_add_on_entity_ids.description: List of interactive add-on entity IDs. Each ID is a system-generated unique identifier for an interactive add-on. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

main_material_ids.description: List of main creative IDs. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

main_material_types.description: List of main creative types. This filter can be used alone. It can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: List of ad IDs. Max size: 200. To obtain ad IDs, use `/smart_plus/ad/get/`. You cannot combine `smart_plus_ad_ids` with `campaign_ids` or `adgroup_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id` and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. Default value: `["spend", "impressions"]`. Currency metric amounts use the currency of the ad account identified by `advertiser_id`. Supported ad-level metrics are documented separately.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1-100. Default value: 10.

sort_field.description: Sorting field. Default sorting field: `spend`. All supported metrics except attribute metrics can be used for sorting.

start_date.description: Query start date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The date is based on the ad account time zone.

operations.name: smart_plus_material_report_breakdown_run

operations.description: Retrieves an Upgraded Smart+ Creative Overview Report with reporting data for creatives in Upgraded Smart+ Ads. This report does not support time-range breakdowns by hour, day, week, or month.

dimensions.description: Dimension grouping conditions. For example, `["campaign_id", "main_material_id"]` groups by both `campaign_id` and `main_material_id`. Use only supported dimensions and supported dimension groupings.

end_date.description: Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or not specified. Query end date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The date uses the ad account time zone. The difference between `start_date` and `end_date` must be 365 days or less.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the report.

ad_text_entity_ids.description: List of ad text entity IDs. This is a system-generated unique identifier for an ad text. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

adgroup_ids.description: List of ad group IDs. Maximum 200 IDs. You cannot combine `adgroup_ids` with `campaign_ids` or `smart_plus_ad_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

call_to_action_entity_ids.description: List of call-to-action entity IDs. This is a system-generated unique identifier for a call to action. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

campaign_ids.description: List of campaign IDs. Maximum 200 IDs. You cannot combine `campaign_ids` with `adgroup_ids` or `smart_plus_ad_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

interactive_add_on_entity_ids.description: List of interactive add-on entity IDs. This is a system-generated unique identifier for an interactive add-on. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

main_material_ids.description: List of main creative IDs. When you use this filter, you can specify up to 400 IDs in total across `main_material_ids`, `ad_text_entity_ids`, `call_to_action_entity_ids`, and `interactive_add_on_entity_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`. When you use `main_material_ids`, you must also specify `main_material_types` and filter only one material type.

main_material_types.description: List of main creative types. This filter can be used alone. It can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id`, `campaign_id`, `adgroup_id`, and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: List of ad IDs. Maximum 200 IDs. You cannot combine `smart_plus_ad_ids` with `campaign_ids` or `adgroup_ids`. This filter can be combined only with the dimensions `advertiser_id` and `smart_plus_ad_id`.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. Default value: `["spend", "impressions"]`. Currency metrics are returned in the currency of the ad account identified by `advertiser_id`. All supported metrics except attribute metrics can be used for sorting.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Range: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

query_lifetime.description: Whether to request lifetime metrics. Supported values: `true` or `false`. Default value: `false`. If `query_lifetime` is `true`, `start_date` and `end_date` are ignored.

sort_field.description: Sorting field. Default is `spend`. You can sort by supported metrics only; attribute metrics do not support sorting.

start_date.description: Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or not specified. Query start date, inclusive, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The date uses the ad account time zone.

operations.name: smart_plus_material_report_overview_run

operations.description: Retrieves review results for creatives used in Upgraded Smart+ Ads. Creatives must be approved before delivery and may be rejected for reasons such as incorrect placement or targeting selections. Use the returned rejection reasons and suggestions to update creatives via /smart_plus/ad/update/.

ad_material_ids.description: List of ad material IDs for the creatives to query. An ad material ID is an ad-specific material ID generated when a particular creative is used in an ad, and it differs from the creative ID from the account Creative Library. Maximum 100 IDs. To obtain ad material IDs associated with an ad, use /smart_plus/ad/get/. For images within a carousel, provide the `ad_material_id` from /smart_plus/ad/review_info/, not the one from /smart_plus/ad/get/ that identifies the entire carousel.

extra_info_setting.description: Additional settings for whether rejection details and flagged violation frames are returned.

include_reject_info.description: Whether to include rejection reasons. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

include_violation_frame.description: Whether to include video frames flagged for violations. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`. You can set this field to `true` only when `include_reject_info` is `true`.

lang.description: Language code for the returned `reasons`, `suggestion`, and `specification` fields within the `reject_info` object array. Default value: `en`.

operations.name: smart_plus_material_review_info_get

operations.description: Returns Spark Ads recommendation results for up to 100 video posts associated with a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. The endpoint analyzes videos associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace account in the past year and assigns recommendation scores and levels based on audience interactions, preferences, video attributes such as genre and length, and historical performance. For meaningful results, TikTok recommends using a TTO Creator Marketplace account associated with at least 10 video posts in the past year. If the account has more than 100 associated video posts in the past year, only the top 100 videos with the highest Spark Ads potential are returned. This endpoint requires an Access-Token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account; to obtain one, see https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825117875361793.

exclude_video_ids.description: List of video post IDs to exclude from analysis. To analyze all video posts associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace account in the past year, do not pass `video_ids` or `exclude_video_ids`. To narrow the analysis scope, pass either `video_ids` or `exclude_video_ids`. Specify IDs of video posts belonging to TTO campaigns associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace account. Max size: 100.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective to use when generating recommendations. If omitted, advertising objectives are not factored into recommendation results. If specified, you can create a campaign with the same `objective_type` via `/campaign/create/` and use a recommended post in ads by setting `tiktok_item_id` to a recommended `item_id` in `/ad/create/`.

tcm_account_id.description: The ID of a TTO Creator Marketplace account. Required to receive Spark Ads recommendations for videos associated with that account.

time.description: Filters videos by publish time. If omitted, all videos published at any time are analyzed. If `video_ids` and `time` are passed together, `time` is ignored. You can use `exclude_video_ids` and `time` together.

video_ids.description: List of video post IDs to analyze exclusively. To analyze all video posts associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace account in the past year, do not pass `video_ids` or `exclude_video_ids`. To narrow the analysis scope, pass either `video_ids` or `exclude_video_ids`. The returned `recommendation_level` for each video is relative to the provided video set, so the same video can receive different recommendation levels under different input sets. Specify IDs of video posts belonging to TTO campaigns associated with the TTO Creator Marketplace account. Max size: 100.

operations.name: spark_ad_recommend_get

operations.description: Creates a split test group. Split tests are supported at ad group level and campaign level. For ad group-level split tests, the total budget is evenly distributed to each group; for campaign-level split tests, each campaign keeps its existing budget. Campaign-level split tests are allowlist-only, and comparing two ad groups from different campaigns in a split test is also allowlist-only. Before using this endpoint, review the split test prerequisites and setup guidance in the related Super Split Test documentation.

budget.description: Total split test budget. Required when `split_test_level=ADGROUP`. Do not specify this field when `split_test_level=CAMPAIGN`, or an error will occur. For ad group-level split tests, this amount is evenly distributed and overwrites the existing budgets of the two ad groups. If you change the total budget after the test starts, TikTok recommends updating the two ad groups to the same budget value. For campaign-level split tests, budget follows each campaign's existing budget.

cells.description: Required when `split_test_level` is `CAMPAIGN`. List of cells in the split test. The array length must be 2.

object_ids.description: IDs included in this cell. If `split_test_level=ADGROUP`, pass ad group IDs and each cell must contain exactly 1 ID. If `split_test_level=CAMPAIGN`, pass campaign IDs; each cell can contain 1 to 10 IDs.

end_time.description: Split test end time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). Example: `2022-01-01 00:00:00`. When `split_test_level=CAMPAIGN`, time can only be set to the hour, so any minute and second values default to `00`. For campaign-level split tests, this does not overwrite the end times of the campaigns or ad groups in the test.

key_metric.description: Key metric to monitor. Supported values depend on optimization goal. If omitted, defaults are: for ad group-level split tests, `COST_PER_REACH` when both ad groups use the `REACH` optimization goal, otherwise `COST_PER_SHOW`; for campaign-level split tests, `UNSET`. Deprecated values are `CLICK`, `REACH`, `SHOW`, `CONVERT`, and `COST`.

object_ids.description: Object IDs bound to the split test. When `split_test_level=ADGROUP`, provide either this field or `cells`. When `split_test_level=CAMPAIGN`, do not use this field; provide `cells` instead.

split_test_level.description: Split test level. `ADGROUP` creates an ad group-level split test; `CAMPAIGN` creates a campaign-level split test. Default is `ADGROUP`. Campaign-level split tests are allowlist-only. Comparing two ad groups from different campaigns in a split test is also allowlist-only; those campaigns may have different advertising objectives.

start_time.description: Split test start time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0). Example: `2022-01-01 00:00:00`. When `split_test_level=CAMPAIGN`, time can only be set to the hour, so any minute and second values default to `00`. For campaign-level split tests, this does not overwrite the start times of the campaigns or ad groups in the test.

test_variable.description: Variable being tested. `BIDDING_OPTIMIZATION` compares bidding and optimization settings, `TARGTING` compares ad group targeting settings, `CREATIVE` compares creatives, and `CUSTOM` compares multiple variables. `CUSTOM` is available only for campaign-level split tests. Defaults: `BIDDING_OPTIMIZATION` for ad group-level split tests and `CUSTOM` for campaign-level split tests. Once specified, `test_variable` cannot be updated.

operations.name: split_test_create

operations.description: Stops an ad group-level or campaign-level split test. For an ad group-level split test, stopping the test makes both ad groups inactive. For a campaign-level split test, campaigns and ad groups continue to follow their own schedules independently of the split test schedule. If you stop a campaign-level split test before its start time, `split_test_status` is changed to `CANCELED`.

split_test_group_id.description: Split test group ID of the split test to stop.

operations.name: split_test_end_get

operations.description: Runs the winning ad group for an ad group-level split test. After this call, the losing ad group is paused and becomes inactive, and the winning ad group's budget is doubled. Before calling this endpoint, use /split_test/result/get/ to retrieve the test `metric` and corresponding `p_value`; a winning ad group exists when `p_value` <= 0.1. This endpoint currently does not support campaign-level split tests.

winning_object_id.description: Winning ad group ID for an ad group-level split test. Use /split_test/result/get/ to retrieve the test `metric` and corresponding `p_value`; a winning ad group exists when `p_value` <= 0.1. Do not specify this field for a campaign-level split test, or the request will fail.

operations.name: split_test_promote_run

operations.description: Retrieves the results of a split test, including p-values for each metric. Use this endpoint at least 24 hours after the test ends to get the test results.
operations.name: split_test_result_get

operations.description: Updates the start_time and end_time of a split test. For campaign-level split tests, time is applied at hour granularity only, so any minute or second values are defaulted to 00; the split test's start_time and end_time do not overwrite the start or end times of the campaigns and ad groups in the test. For ad group-level split tests, the test start_time and end_time are applied to both ad groups under the split test group. Once a split test has started, start_time cannot be updated for either campaign-level or ad group-level split tests.

end_time.description: End time of the split test in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC+0), for example 2022-01-01 00:00:00. For campaign-level split tests, time can only be set to the hour, so any MM and SS values default to 00, and this value does not overwrite the end times of campaigns or ad groups in the test. For ad group-level split tests, this end time is applied to both ad groups under the split test group.

start_time.description: Start time of the split test in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC+0), for example 2022-01-01 00:00:00. For campaign-level split tests, time can only be set to the hour, so any MM and SS values default to 00, and this value does not overwrite the start times of campaigns or ad groups in the test. For ad group-level split tests, this start time is applied to both ad groups under the split test group. Once the test has started, this field cannot be updated for either campaign-level or ad group-level split tests.

operations.name: split_test_update

operations.description: Gets the list of available first-party stores (TikTok Shops) under an ad account. You can optionally filter by `store_id` or `store_type`. This endpoint is useful for discovering TikTok Shop IDs available to an advertiser account.

store_id.description: Filter by a specific first-party store (TikTok Shop) ID. If omitted, the endpoint returns all available `store_id` values under the specified advertiser account. To get a TikTok Shop ID, call /bc/asset/get/ and use the returned `asset_id` where `asset_type` is `TIKTOK_SHOP`.

store_type.description: Filter by store type. If omitted, the endpoint returns all store types under the specified advertiser account.

operations.name: store_list_get

operations.description: Retrieves products in a first-party store (TikTok Shop) from /open_api/v1.3/store/product/get/. You can filter by product SPU IDs, product name, and ad or campaign eligibility. If `filtering.ad_creation_eligible` is provided, `advertiser_id` is required. If `filtering.ad_creation_eligible` is omitted, the response will not include product eligibility for Product GMV Max Campaigns.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. Required when `filtering.ad_creation_eligible` is passed.

bc_id.description: Business Center ID. To obtain the list of Business Centers you have access to, use /bc/get/.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the returned products. If `ad_creation_eligible` is specified in this object, `advertiser_id` is required. If `ad_creation_eligible` is not specified, the response will not include product eligibility for Product GMV Max Campaigns.

ad_creation_eligible.description: Filters products by the ad or campaign type they are eligible for. Enum values: `CUSTOM_SHOP_ADS` for Shopping Ads, including Video Shopping Ads and Product Shopping Ads; `GMV_MAX` for Product GMV Max Campaigns. When this field is passed, `advertiser_id` is required. If this field is omitted, the response will not include the eligibility of products for Product GMV Max Campaigns.

item_group_ids.description: Product SPU (standard product unit) IDs to filter by. Maximum 10 IDs.

page.description: Page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Page size. Default is `10`. Valid range: `1` to `100`.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. `min_price` sorts by the returned `min_price` field. `historical_sales` sorts by the returned `historical_sales` field.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID. To obtain the list of TikTok Shops associated with an ad account, use /store/list/.

operations.name: store_product_get

operations.description: Gets the subscription details configured for a developer app from /v1.3/subscription/get/. Compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes the request parameter name from `object` to `subscribe_entity`, changes `app_id` from number to string, and renames response fields including `list` to `subscriptions`, `url` to `callback_url`, and `object` to `subscribe_entity`. In v1.3, `tcm_account_id` is deprecated in the response, and new response fields include `tto_tcm_account_id`, `lead_source`, `product_filters`, and `notify_frequency`.

app_id.description: ID of your developer application.

page.description: Current page number. Defaults to `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Defaults to `10`. Valid range: 1-1000.

subscribe_entity.description: The object type to filter subscriptions by. Enum values: `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE` for changes in reporting metrics `spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, and `video_play_actions` for one or more ad accounts; `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION` for ad account suspension status updates; `LEAD` for leads; `AD_GROUP` for ad group review status; `AD` for ad review status; `TCM_VIDEOS` for linking a TikTok video to a TTO campaign; `CREATIVE_FATIGUE` for fatigue status of an ad, ads in an ad group, or ads in an advertiser account; `API_SERVICE_STATUS` for API service status.

operations.name: subscription_get

operations.description: Creates a webhook subscription for reporting metric data changes, ad account suspension status changes, leads, ad group or ad review status, creative fatigue, TCM video linking, or API service status updates. Notifications are sent when the subscribed event occurs, including changes to reporting metrics (`spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, `video_play_actions`), ad account suspension or unsuspension, new leads, ad rejection during review, creative fatigue, TikTok video linking to a TTO campaign, or API incidents being created, updated, or resolved. For lead generation ads using Instant Forms, subscriptions are based on `subscription_id`, not `page_id`, and a page can belong to multiple subscriptions. `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE` and `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION` subscriptions are allowlist-only features. If the `access_token` used to configure the webhook is revoked by the developer or advertiser, the subscription stops working; generate a new token and reconfigure the webhook.

app_id.description: ID of your developer application.

callback_url.description: Callback URL that receives webhook notifications.

subscribe_entity.description: Object to subscribe to. `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE` subscribes to changes in `spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, and `video_play_actions` for one or more ad accounts and requires `advertiser_ids`; using this value also requires the developer app to have the Reporting > Consolidated Report permission enabled. `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION` subscribes to ad account suspension status changes. `LEAD` subscribes to leads; webhook delivery is at least once, so duplicate events are possible and handlers should be idempotent. `AD_GROUP` subscribes to ad group review status. `AD` subscribes to ad review status. `TCM_VIDEOS` subscribes to TikTok video linking to a TTO campaign. `CREATIVE_FATIGUE` subscribes to fatigue status for an ad, an ad group's ads, or an advertiser account's ads. `API_SERVICE_STATUS` subscribes to API service status updates.

subscription_detail.description: Subscription configuration details. Required companion fields depend on `subscribe_entity`: for `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`, include `advertiser_ids` and optionally `notify_frequency`; for `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`, include either `bc_id` or `advertiser_ids`; for `LEAD`, use `advertiser_id` or `library_id` depending on the lead source, with `page_id` allowed only for Instant Form leads; for `AD_GROUP`, include `advertiser_id` and `adgroup_id`; for `AD`, include `advertiser_id` and `ad_id`; for `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`, include `advertiser_id` and optionally `adgroup_id` or `ad_id`; for `TCM_VIDEOS`, include `tto_tcm_account_id`; for `API_SERVICE_STATUS`, optionally include `product_filters`.

access_token.description: Authorized access token used to configure the webhook. If this token is revoked by the developer or advertiser, the webhook subscription stops working and no further events are delivered; generate a new token and reconfigure the webhook.

ad_id.description: Valid when `subscribe_entity` is `AD` or `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`. Ad ID. Required when `subscribe_entity` is `AD`. When `subscribe_entity` is `CREATIVE_FATIGUE` and both `advertiser_id` and `ad_id` are provided, the subscription covers the specified ad's fatigue status.

adgroup_id.description: Valid when `subscribe_entity` is `AD_GROUP` or `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`. Ad group ID. Required when `subscribe_entity` is `AD_GROUP`. When `subscribe_entity` is `CREATIVE_FATIGUE` and both `advertiser_id` and `adgroup_id` are provided, the subscription covers the specified ad group's fatigue status.

advertiser_id.description: Valid when `subscribe_entity` is `AD_GROUP`, `AD`, `LEAD`, or `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`. Required for `AD_GROUP` and `AD`. For `LEAD`, if `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM` or omitted, provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`; `page_id` is optional. If `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`, provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`; `page_id` is not supported. For `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`, `advertiser_id` is required; you may also provide `adgroup_id`, `ad_id`, or neither. If only `advertiser_id` is provided for `CREATIVE_FATIGUE`, the subscription covers all ads under the advertiser account. If `subscribe_entity` is `LEAD` and `advertiser_id` is specified, you must have Admin access to the ad account.

advertiser_ids.description: List of advertiser IDs. Required when `subscribe_entity` is `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`. When `subscribe_entity` is `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`, provide either `bc_id` or `advertiser_ids`. For `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`, subscribes to changes in `spend`, `impressions`, `clicks`, and `video_play_actions` for the specified ad accounts. For `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`, subscribes to suspension status changes for the specified ad accounts, which may belong to different Business Centers. Maximum 100 IDs. You must have access to these ad accounts.

bc_id.description: Valid only when `subscribe_entity` is `AD_ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION`. You must provide either `bc_id` or `advertiser_ids`. Business Center ID whose owned ad accounts' suspension status you want to subscribe to. You must have admin access to the Business Center.

lead_source.description: Valid only when `subscribe_entity` is `LEAD`. Source of leads to subscribe to. `INSTANT_FORM` subscribes to leads generated through Instant Forms and allows `page_id`; you must provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`, and `page_id` is optional. `DIRECT_MESSAGE` subscribes to leads from direct messages of the associated Business Account; you must provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`, and `page_id` is not supported. Default value: `INSTANT_FORM`.

library_id.description: Valid when `subscribe_entity` is `LEAD`. Form library ID that contains the leads to subscribe to. If `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM` or omitted, provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`; `page_id` is optional. If only `advertiser_id` is provided, the subscription covers all `page_id` under that advertiser account. If `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`, provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`; `page_id` is not supported.

notify_frequency.description: Valid when `subscribe_entity` is `REPORT_DATA_CHANGE`. Notification frequency. If any subscribed ad account's reporting metrics changed during the last notification timeframe, you receive at most one webhook notification for that timeframe. Default value: `5_MINUTE`.

page_id.description: Valid when `subscribe_entity` is `LEAD` and `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM` or omitted. Not supported when `subscribe_entity` is `LEAD` and `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`. Instant Form page ID to subscribe to. For Instant Form leads, provide either `advertiser_id` or `library_id`; `page_id` is optional. If only `advertiser_id` is provided, the subscription covers all `page_id` under that advertiser account.

product_filters.description: Valid only when `subscribe_entity` is `API_SERVICE_STATUS`. List of API products to subscribe to. If omitted, the subscription covers all API products.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: Required when `subscribe_entity` is `TCM_VIDEOS`. ID of a TTO Creator Marketplace account.

operations.name: subscription_subscribe_create

operations.description: Cancels a subscription via `/v1.3/subscription/unsubscribe/`. Compared with v1.2, the endpoint path changed from `/v1.2/subscription/unsubscribe/` to `/v1.3/subscription/unsubscribe/`, and `app_id` and `subscription_id` changed from number to string in the request; `subscription_id` also changed from number to string in the response.

app_id.description: Developer application ID for the app that owns the subscription.

secret.description: Developer application secret for the app that owns the subscription.

subscription_id.description: ID of the subscription to cancel. Obtain this value from the `subscription_id` returned by `/subscription/get/` for subscriptions under the app.

operations.name: subscription_unsubscribe_cancel

operations.description: Applies for a creator's authorization to boost a TikTok video for a TikTok Creator Marketplace (TTCM) order or a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign. The request must use an Access-Token authorized by a TikTok Creator Marketplace account or TTO Creator Marketplace account. This endpoint depends on prior TTCM or TTO Creator Marketplace setup: the video must already be linked to a TTCM order created via /tcm/order/create/v2/ or to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign created via /tto/tcm/campaign/create/. Relevant video and account IDs can be obtained from related TTCM/TTO endpoints.

action.description: Action to take. `EXTEND` requests that an approved authorization be extended by the number of days in `authorization_days`; for example, if `authorization_days` is 30, the request asks to extend the authorization by 30 days.

authorization_days.description: Requested authorization validity period in days. Value range: 1-365. Default is 30. Use this field either to specify the validity period for a new authorization request or, when `action` is `EXTEND`, to request extending an approved authorization by the given number of days. The creator chooses the final approved validity period, so the actual validity period can differ from the requested value.

tcm_account_id.description: TikTok Creator Marketplace account ID or TTO Creator Marketplace account ID. To obtain the TTO Creator Marketplace account IDs accessible with the provided `Access-Token`, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

video_id.description: ID of a video created under the creator account. The video must be uploaded, tagged as branded content, and linked either to a TTCM order via the `invite_link` or `campaign_code` created through /tcm/order/create/v2/, or to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign via the `invite_link` created through /tto/tcm/campaign/create/. You can obtain `video_id` from /tcm/order/get/v2/ or /tcm/report/get/v2/ for TTCM flows, and from /tto/tcm/campaign/ or /tto/tcm/report/ for TTO flows.

operations.name: tcm_tt_video_apply

operations.description: Gets the Spark Ads authorization status for a TikTok Creator Marketplace (TTCM) order video or a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign video. The video must be branded content linked either to a TTCM order created via /tcm/order/create/v2/ or to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign created via /tto/tcm/campaign/create/.

tcm_account_id.description: TikTok Creator Marketplace account ID or TTO Creator Marketplace account ID. For TTO, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/ to obtain the account IDs accessible with the provided `Access-Token`.

video_id.description: ID of a video created under the creator account. The video must be uploaded as branded content and linked either to a TTCM order via the `invite_link` or `campaign_code` created through /tcm/order/create/v2/, or to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign via the `invite_link` created through /tto/tcm/campaign/create/. You can obtain valid `video_id` values from /tcm/order/get/v2/ or /tcm/report/get/v2/ for TTCM videos, and from /tto/tcm/campaign/ or /tto/tcm/report/ for TTO campaign videos.

operations.name: tcm_tt_video_status_get

operations.description: Checks whether an agreement has been signed for the specified advertiser and term type. If the agreement has been signed, you can retrieve the agreement with /term/get/. In v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/term/check/ and `advertiser_id` changed from number in v1.2 to string in v1.3.
operations.name: term_check

operations.description: Signs an agreement for the Lead Generation Ads feature for the specified advertiser. After signing, use /term/check/ to check the agreement status. For v1.3, the endpoint path is /v1.3/term/confirm/ and `advertiser_id` is a string (it was a number in v1.2).

term_type.description: Agreement type to sign. Allowed value: `LeadAds`.

operations.name: term_confirm

operations.description: Gets the agreement text for a specified feature, currently the Lead Generation Ads feature, from `/open_api/v1.3/term/get/`. You must specify which agreement to retrieve using `term_type`. Compared with v1.2 (`/v1.2/term/get/`), v1.3 changes the `advertiser_id` request parameter type from number to string.

lang.description: Language of the agreement. Accepted values are `EN`, `JA`, and `ZH`. Defaults to `EN` if omitted.

term_type.description: Type of agreement to retrieve. Currently only `LeadAds` is supported.

operations.description: Retrieves the list of campaign labels in an ad account from `/open_api/v1.3/campaign_label/get/`. Supports filtering by label IDs, label names, and label types, plus pagination.

campaign_label_ids.description: List of campaign label IDs to filter by. Maximum 50 IDs. Each ID must be a 19-digit numeric string. Note: this filter is only supported in synchronous basic reports.

campaign_label_names.description: List of campaign label names to filter by. Fuzzy matching is supported. Maximum 10 names.

campaign_label_types.description: List of campaign label types to filter by.

page.description: Current page number. Default is 1. Value must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is 10. Allowed range: 1-1000.

operations.name: campaign_label_get

operations.description: Get a recommended bid value for an ad group based on basic campaign and ad group settings such as objective, conversion event, and target locations. The suggested bid can only be used with the Cost Cap bidding strategy (`bid_type = BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`). This endpoint currently supports only Traffic and Website conversions objectives. This API is being revamped to support a larger function scope and more accurate results; please stay tuned for updates.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID.

external_action.description: Conversion event for the ad group.

location_ids.description: IDs of the locations you want to target.

objective_type.description: Campaign objective. Only Traffic and Website conversions objectives are supported by this endpoint. For valid enum values and their meanings, see Objectives. Note: this API is being revamped to support a larger function scope and more accurate results; please stay tuned for updates.

operations.name: tool_bid_recommend

operations.description: Gets diagnoses for active ad groups, including possible issues and suggested corrections or improvements. Only ad groups with suggestions are returned. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/tool/diagnosis/get/`; request parameter `filtering` replaces `filters`, `advertiser_id` and `adgroup_ids` are strings, and `issue_category` is newly added.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for which ad groups and issue categories to diagnose.

adgroup_ids.description: IDs of the ad groups to get diagnoses for. Maximum 20 IDs.

issue_category.description: Issue categories to return. Allowed values: `CREATIVE` for creative-related issues, `BID_AND_BUDGET` for bid and budget issues, and `EVENT_TRACK` for event tracking issues. If multiple values are specified, diagnoses in any of the specified categories are returned. If omitted, diagnoses in all issue categories are returned.

operations.name: tool_diagnosis_get

operations.description: Gets the corresponding TikTok in-app link for an open TikTok URL. The returned in-app link can be passed to the `deeplink` field when creating or updating a Reach & Frequency ad. TikTok in-app links is currently an allowlist-only feature; contact your TikTok representative for access. This endpoint is `/open_api/v1.3/tool/open_url/`. Compared with v1.2 (`/v1.2/tools/open_url/`), v1.3 uses `/v1.3/tool/open_url/` and changes `advertiser_id` from number to string.

url.description: Open TikTok URL to convert into a TikTok internal link.

url_type.description: Type of the open TikTok URL. Supported values: `USER_PROFILE`; `VIDEO` for a video detail page; `HASHTAG_CHALLENGE` for a hashtag challenge page; `MUSIC` for a music page; `STICKER` for a sticker (special effect) page; `STICKER_SHOOTER` to shoot a video with a sticker (special effect).

operations.name: tool_open_url_get

operations.description: Retrieves Search Ads Campaign health diagnoses for existing ad groups or ads, including search volume, keyword relevance, and bid/budget recommendations. Use `adgroup_id` to diagnose one existing ad group, or `ad_ids` to diagnose existing ads. If both `adgroup_id` and `ad_ids` are provided, `adgroup_id` is ignored.

ad_ids.description: List of ad IDs to diagnose existing ads. All ad IDs must belong to the same ad group. Maximum 50 IDs. If both `adgroup_id` and `ad_ids` are specified, `adgroup_id` is ignored.

adgroup_id.description: Ad group ID. Specify this field to get diagnoses for one existing ad group. If both `adgroup_id` and `ad_ids` are specified, `adgroup_id` is ignored.

operations.name: tool_search_diagnosis_health_get

operations.description: Discover new keywords and keyword ideas to help reach people interested in your business. This endpoint returns suggested keywords relevant to the provided keywords for a target country or region. Discovering new keywords for supported non-US locations outside of your home country is currently an allowlist-only feature; contact your TikTok representative for access.

brand_type.description: Brand filter. `BRAND` returns brand keywords, `NON_BRAND` returns non-brand keywords, and `ALL` returns all keywords. Defaults to `ALL`. This filter is only available when `country_codes` is set to `["US"]`. For all other countries or regions, `ALL` is the default and the only allowed value.

country_codes.description: Target country or region code for keyword discovery. Maximum size: 1. Defaults to `US`. Supported values are `AU`, `BR`, `CA`, `FR`, `DE`, `IT`, `MX`, `SA`, `ES`, `AE`, `GB`, and `US`. Discovering new keywords for supported non-US locations outside of your home country is currently an allowlist-only feature; contact your TikTok representative for access.

keywords.description: List of keywords describing products or services closely related to your business. Maximum 10 keywords per request. Each keyword can be up to 80 characters. Only English words are supported; emojis and special symbols such as `#` are not supported. For optimal results, provide all keywords in lowercase; uppercase keywords are not recommended.

order_field.description: Sort field for returned keyword ideas. `AVG_MONTHLY_SEARCHES` sorts by the average monthly search range indicated by `avg_monthly_searches_lower` and `avg_monthly_searches_upper`; `THREE_MONTH_CHANGE` sorts by `three_month_change`; `YEAR_OVER_YEAR_CHANGE` sorts by `year_over_year_change`; `COMPETITION` sorts by `competition`. Defaults to `AVG_MONTHLY_SEARCHES`.

order_type.description: Sort order for the returned keyword ideas. Defaults to `DESC`.

operations.name: tool_search_keyword_idea_get

operations.description: Returns recommended search keywords and predicted monthly searches for Search Ads Campaigns. Recommendations can be generated from exactly one source: `search_queries`, `ad_ids`, or `landing_page_urls`. Using `ad_ids` or `landing_page_urls` is currently allowlist-only; contact your TikTok representative for access.

ad_ids.description: Required when you want recommended search keywords based on specific ads. You can specify only one of `search_queries`, `ad_ids`, or `landing_page_urls`. Maximum 1 ad ID. This is currently an allowlist-only feature; contact your TikTok representative for access.

landing_page_urls.description: Required when you want recommended search keywords based on URLs. You can specify only one of `search_queries`, `ad_ids`, or `landing_page_urls`. Maximum 5 landing page URLs. There is no length limit for each URL. This is currently an allowlist-only feature; contact your TikTok representative for access.

order_field.description: Sorting logic. `RELEVANCE` sorts by relevance. `MONTHLY_SEARCHES` sorts by the `monthly_searches` result field. Default when `search_queries` is specified: `RELEVANCE`. When `ad_ids` or `landing_page_urls` is specified, this field can only be `MONTHLY_SEARCHES`.

order_type.description: Sorting order. Valid only when `order_field` is `MONTHLY_SEARCHES`. `ASC` means ascending and `DESC` means descending. Default value: `DESC`. When `ad_ids` or `landing_page_urls` is specified, this field can only be `DESC`.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1-1,000. Default value: 50.

regions.description: List of country or region codes. Currently, the only supported value is `US`.

search_queries.description: Required when you want recommended search keywords based on search queries. You can specify only one of `search_queries`, `ad_ids`, or `landing_page_urls`. Provide products, services, or brands as queries. Maximum 5 items; each query can be up to 80 characters. Only English words are supported; emojis and special symbols such as `#` are not supported.

total_size.description: Total number of recommended keywords to return. Value range: 1-1,000. Default value: 1,000.

operations.name: tool_search_keyword_recommend

operations.description: Returns available time zone enumeration values and their GMT offsets for the advertiser. The returned `gmt_offset` values are fixed and do not account for daylight saving time changes; for example, `America/New_York` is always returned as `GMT-05:00` even when daylight saving time is in effect. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/open_api/v1.3/tool/timezone/`; compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string and the response field changed from `time_zone_list` to `timezones`.
operations.name: tool_timezone_get

operations.description: Checks whether a URL is a custom URL scheme, Apple's universal link, or Android App Link, and verifies whether the URL is valid.

url.description: URL to validate. The endpoint checks whether it is a custom URL scheme, an Apple universal link, or an Android App Link, and whether it is valid.

operations.name: tool_url_validate

operations.description: Checks whether the specified campaign settings are eligible for Value-Based Optimization (VBO) and returns the available VBO bidding strategies for those settings. If you specify an allowlist-only VBO feature and the advertiser is not allowlisted, the settings are treated as ineligible and `vo_status` returns `NOT_SUPPORT`.

app_id.description: Promoted app ID. Not supported when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` and `promotion_type` is `LIVE_SHOPPING` or `VIDEO_SHOPPING`, or when `app_promotion_type` is `MINIS`. Otherwise, pass either `pixel_id` or `app_id`.

app_promotion_type.description: Required when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`. App promotion type: `APP_INSTALL` for acquiring new app installs, `APP_RETARGETING` for re-engaging existing users in your app, and `MINIS` for TikTok Minis. Only `APP_INSTALL` can be used in an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign.

bid_align_type.description: Attribution type for the Dedicated Campaign; determines whether ad-group target CPA or ROAS is based on SAN or SKAN. Valid only when all of the following are true: `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL`, `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, and `app_id` is an eligible iOS app ID. Check app eligibility with `/app/list/` and the returned `advanced_dedicated_campaign_allowed` field. Set this field as follows: when `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign` is `true` and you are not allowlisted for disabling SKAN attribution, use `SKAN`; when `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign` is `true`, you are allowlisted for disabling SKAN attribution, and `disable_skan_campaign` is `false`, use `SAN`; when `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign` is `true` and `disable_skan_campaign` is `true`, use `SAN`; when `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign` is `false` and `disable_skan_campaign` is `false`, use `SKAN`.

budget_optimize_on.description: Whether to enable Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO).

campaign_app_profile_page_state.description: Whether to use App Profile Page at the campaign level to optimize delivery. Valid only when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and the campaign is an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign (`ios14_quota_type` = `OCCUPIED`); otherwise an error occurs.

campaign_type.description: Campaign type. Do not pass `campaign_type` and `ios14_quota_type` together; if both are provided, `ios14_quota_type` is ignored. `IOS14_CAMPAIGN` is valid only when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`, or when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL`.

disable_skan_campaign.description: Whether to disable SKAN attribution for an iOS Dedicated Campaign. Valid only when all of the following are true: `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION`, `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTALL`, `campaign_type` is `IOS14_CAMPAIGN`, and `app_id` is an eligible iOS app ID. Check app eligibility with `/app/list/` and the returned `advanced_dedicated_campaign_allowed` field. If `true`, SKAN attribution is disabled, Dedicated Campaign quota limits do not apply, and SAN metrics are available, but SKAN reporting metrics are not. If the app is eligible for Advanced Dedicated Campaigns, you cannot disable both SKAN attribution and Advanced Dedicated Campaign at the same time. If `false`, SKAN attribution is enabled; quota limits apply and SKAN metrics are available. If `false` and `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign` is also `true`, both SAN and SKAN reporting metrics are available. Disabling SKAN attribution for Dedicated Campaigns is an allowlist-only feature. If you are allowlisted for this feature, you still cannot set ad-group-level `bid_type` to `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` when campaign-level `is_advanced_dedicated_campaign` is `false`, campaign-level `disable_skan_campaign` is `false`, and ad-group-level `optimization_goal` is `INSTALL` or `IN_APP_EVENT`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

is_advanced_dedicated_campaign.description: Whether the campaign is an Advanced Dedicated Campaign. Default is `false`. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. Supported VBO objectives are `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `PRODUCT_SALES`; any other value causes `vo_status` to return `NOT_SUPPORT`. When `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` and `promotion_type` is `LIVE_SHOPPING` or `VIDEO_SHOPPING`, do not pass `pixel_id` or `app_id`; otherwise, pass either `pixel_id` or `app_id`.

optimization_event.description: Conversion event for the ad group. Required when `pixel_id` is passed and ignored when `app_id` is passed.

pixel_id.description: Pixel ID. Not supported when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` and `promotion_type` is `LIVE_SHOPPING` or `VIDEO_SHOPPING`, or when `app_promotion_type` is `MINIS`. Otherwise, pass either `pixel_id` or `app_id`. If you pass `pixel_id`, you must also pass `optimization_event`.

placements.description: Apps where ads will be delivered. Supported values are `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `PLACEMENT_PANGLE`, and `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`. When `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`, only `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is supported.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type that determines where products are promoted. When `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES` and `promotion_type` is `LIVE_SHOPPING` or `VIDEO_SHOPPING`, do not pass `pixel_id` or `app_id`; otherwise, pass either `pixel_id` or `app_id`.

store_id.description: TikTok Shop ID. Valid only when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`.
