Endpoint path in v1.3 is `/v1.3/tool/language/`; compared with v1.2 `/v1.2/tools/language/`, the `advertiser_id` parameter type changed from number to string.
operations.name: tool_language_get

operations.description: Returns the enumeration values for operating system versions. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/tool/os_version/` (changed from `/v1.2/tools/os_version/` in v1.2). This version also changes `advertiser_id` from number to string, and the response field from `id` to `os_id`.
operations.name: tool_os_version_get

operations.description: Retrieves the phone number region code list, including each region's code, name, and calling code, from /open_api/v1.3/tool/phone_region_code/.
operations.name: tool_phone_region_code_get

operations.description: Gets available ad delivery locations based on objective, placements, and optional targeting constraints such as operating system and brand safety settings. Use this endpoint when availability depends on delivery settings; if you need locations based on advertiser IDs, use /search/region/. Some newly available countries or regions are allowlist-only depending on objective and placement: for `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, or `WEB_CONVERSIONS` with TikTok placement, and for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT` with TikTok placement, access is gated separately per country or region. For those newly available countries or regions with `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, pre-bid third-party brand safety is not supported, so `brand_safety_type` cannot be `THIRD_PARTY`. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` in Auction ads, and pre-bid third-party brand safety solutions, are also allowlist-only features.

brand_safety_partner.description: Brand safety partner. Required when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`, and `placements` must be `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Pre-bid third-party brand safety is allowlist-only.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety setting. Valid only when `placements` is `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Default is `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. If set to `THIRD_PARTY`, you must also provide `brand_safety_partner`. For newly available countries or regions targeted with `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, `THIRD_PARTY` is not supported. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` in Auction ads, and pre-bid third-party brand safety, are allowlist-only. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` and become the default in the next API version.

language.description: Language for the returned location name (`name`). Default is `en`. If the specified language is unsupported, it is ignored and `en` is used. If you specify a supported non-English language, locations outside that language's native country or region might not be translated.

level_range.description: Maximum location level to return. `ALL`: all levels. `TO_COUNTRY`: only country or region. `TO_PROVINCE`: country and province; DMA and Metropolitan are treated as province level. `TO_CITY`: country, province, and city. `TO_DISTRICT`: country, province, city, and district.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. This field controls other parameters: `shopping_ads_type` is valid only when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`; `promotion_target_type` is valid only when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`; `rf_campaign_type` must be used only when `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Newly available countries or regions are allowlist-only for `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS` with TikTok placement, and separately allowlist-only for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT` with TikTok placement. For those newly available countries or regions with `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, `brand_safety_type` cannot be `THIRD_PARTY`.

placements.description: Apps where you want to deliver ads. `brand_safety_type` and `brand_safety_partner` are valid only when `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`.

promotion_target_type.description: Promotion target type for Lead Generation. Valid only when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. `INSTANT_PAGE` uses an in-app TikTok Instant Form. `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE` uses a landing page with a Website Form or a TikTok Instant Page that redirects to a website form.

rf_campaign_type.description: Used only when `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Set to `PULSE` to get available premium contextual tags for a TikTok Pulse campaign; when `PULSE` is used, only one `location_id` is returned. Do not pass this field when `objective_type` is not `RF_REACH`. The returned `location_id` must be passed as `location_ids` to /adgroup/rf/create/ when creating a TikTok Pulse ad group.

shopping_ads_type.description: Shopping ads type. Valid only when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`.

operations.name: tool_region_get

operations.description: Applies a creator-provided authorization code to connect an ad account with a Spark Ads post. Getting a code from the post owner does not automatically enable authorization; you must call this endpoint to put the authorization into effect. If the post is a duet or stitch of another post, or mentions another video, you must obtain authorization from both post owners before promoting it: use `auth_code` for the promoted post and `original_post_auth_code` for the original post. In v1.3, the endpoint path is `/v1.3/tt_video/authorize/`; compared with v1.2, the request parameter `from_auth_code` was renamed to `original_post_auth_code`, and `advertiser_id` changed from number to string.

auth_code.description: Authorization code for the Spark Ads post. Replace any `+` characters in the code with `%2B`; otherwise you may get an invalid authorization code error. When the post is a duet, stitch, or mentions another video, this field is still used for the promoted post's authorization code, while `original_post_auth_code` must contain the original post owner's authorization code.

original_post_auth_code.description: Authorization code for the original post owner. Required when the post is a duet or stitch of another post, or when it mentions another video. The post can currently mention at most one video.

operations.name: tt_video_authorize_apply

operations.description: Gets information about a Spark Ads post that the advertiser is authorized to use as an ad via /open_api/v1.3/tt_video/info/. You must first obtain an authorization code from the TikTok post owner in the TikTok app by enabling Ad authorization and generating a code. Pass that authorization code in this request. In v1.3, `advertiser_id` is a string, and several IDs and authorization times in the response changed from numeric/datetime types in v1.2 to strings in v1.3.

auth_code.description: Authorization code for the Spark Ads post, obtained from the TikTok post owner after they enable Ad authorization in the TikTok app. Replace every `+` in the code with `%2B`; otherwise the request may fail with an invalid authorization code error.

operations.name: tt_video_info_get

operations.description: Gets a list of Spark Ads posts that have been authorized to an ad account. Endpoint path: /v1.3/tt_video/list/. Compared with v1.2, `advertiser_id` changed from number to string, `item_types` was added, and response fields changed including `video_info.url` renamed to `video_info.preview_url` and several IDs/timestamps changed to string types.

item_types.description: Filters by Spark Ads post type. Allowed values: `VIDEO` for video posts and `CAROUSEL` for photo posts. If omitted, the default is `["VIDEO", "CAROUSEL"]`.

keyword.description: Search keyword for TikTok posts. To search by post text, provide a string up to 500 characters; this supports multilingual and fuzzy matching. To search by `item_id`, provide a numeric string with a minimum length of 19 characters; this supports exact matching.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default is `20`. Must be between 1 and 50.

operations.name: tt_video_list_get

operations.description: Unbinds a Spark Ad post after its authorization has expired or been revoked. This removes the post from the ad account's list of authorized Spark Ad posts. Endpoint: /v1.3/tt_video/unbind/. Note: compared with v1.2, v1.3 changes `advertiser_id` and `item_id` from number to string.

item_id.description: The ID of the Spark Ad post to unbind from the advertiser's authorized Spark Ad post list.

operations.name: tt_video_unbind

operations.description: Retrieves the details of a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. The request must be authorized with an Access-Token granted by a TTO Creator Marketplace account. To get accessible TTO Creator Marketplace account IDs for the current Access-Token before calling this endpoint, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account to retrieve. To obtain account IDs that are accessible with the current Access-Token, call /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

operations.name: tto_oauth2_info_get

operations.description: Get authorized TTO Creator Marketplace accounts.
operations.name: tto_oauth2_tcm_get

operations.description: Creates a TikTok One webpage anchor for the web destination link type via `/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/create/`. This endpoint creates a `WEB_ANCHOR` with `anchor_sub_type=DESTINATION`, which displays a website link above a creator's video description and in the comment section. The destination subtype is available only in countries where TikTok Shop is not yet available; TikTok Shop is currently available in Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, United States, United Kingdom, and Saudi Arabia. To use this endpoint, you need a TTO Creator Marketplace account ID associated with the authorized `Access-Token`; retrieve accessible account IDs from `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

anchor_name.description: The internal name of the anchor. Maximum length: 32 characters. This value is not shown to users in the TikTok app.

anchor_sub_type.description: Required when `anchor_type` is `WEB_ANCHOR`. The specific webpage anchor type. Supported value: `DESTINATION`, which directs viewers to a web destination link that opens in TikTok and appears both in the creator's video and the comment section. When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, you must also provide `category_label_id` and `call_to_action.landing_page_url`. This subtype is available only in countries where TikTok Shop is not yet available; TikTok Shop is currently available in Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, United States, United Kingdom, and Saudi Arabia.

anchor_title.description: The anchor title. When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, supported values are `WATCH_NOW`, `LISTEN_NOW`, `READ_MORE`, `SHOW_NOW`, `GET_OFFER`, `LEARN_MORE`, `CONTACT_US`, `JOIN_NOW`, and `APPLY_NOW`.

anchor_type.description: The anchor type. Supported value: `WEB_ANCHOR`, which creates a webpage anchor that displays your website link above the creator's video description.

call_to_action.description: Anchor link information. When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, you must provide `landing_page_url` in this object.

landing_page_url.description: Required when `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`. The URL that the anchor redirects viewers to. It should be a product or service detail page that provides more information about what you are promoting; otherwise, the anchor may be rejected during review.

category_label_id.description: Required when `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`. The category ID for your product or service. Supported documented values are: `1` Furniture, `2` Kid's Fashion, `3` Automotive & Motorcycle, `4` Womenswear & Underwear, `5` Home Supplies, `6` Virtual Products, `7` Computers & Office Equipment, `8` Menswear & Underwear, `9` Pet Supplies, `10` Food & Beverages, `11` Pre-Owned, `12` Service, `13` Baby & Nursery, `14` Household Appliances, `15` Textiles & Soft Furnishings, `16` Beauty & Personal Care, `17` Shoes, `18` Toys & Hobbies, `19` Tools & Hardware, `20` Finance, `21` Kitchenware, `22` Phones & Electronics, `23` Fashion Accessories, `24` Home Improvement, `25` Health, `26` Restaurant & bar, `27` Entertainment & media, `28` Travel & hotel, `29` Others, `30` Luggage & Bags, `31` Books, Magazines & Audio, `32` Jewelry Accessories & Derivatives, `33` Collectibles, `34` Muslim Fashion, `35` Sports & Outdoor. When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, the allowed `country_code` values depend on this category.

country_code.description: The country or region code for the anchor. The app information from that country or region's app store is used, and the anchor is not available in other countries or regions. When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, supported `country_code` values vary by `category_label_id`, so the selected code must be valid for the chosen category. Example: `AU`.

thumbnail_url.description: Required when `upload_type` is `UPLOAD_BY_URL`. A publicly accessible thumbnail URL for the anchor. Requirements: file size within 2 MB; format must be JPEG, PNG, or GIF; resolution must be 210 x 375 pixels. This value is not shown to users in the TikTok app.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. Use an account ID that is accessible through the authorized `Access-Token`; obtain valid IDs from `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

upload_type.description: The thumbnail upload method. If `UPLOAD_BY_URL`, you must provide `thumbnail_url` and send the request with `Content-Type: application/json`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_anchor_create

operations.description: Deletes an anchor in draft mode that was created on the TikTok One platform. This endpoint only applies to anchors whose `status` is `DRAFT` and uses `POST` at `/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/delete/`.

anchor_id.description: ID of the anchor to delete. The anchor must belong to the specified TikTok One Creator Marketplace account, and you should first use `/tto/tcm/anchor/get/` to obtain the ID and confirm the anchor `status` is `DRAFT` before deletion.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. Use an account that is accessible with the provided `Access-Token`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_anchor_delete

operations.description: Retrieves existing webpage anchors in a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account from /open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/get/. To use this endpoint, you need a Creator Marketplace account access token and a valid `tto_tcm_account_id`; account IDs accessible by the token can be obtained from /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

anchor_ids.description: List of anchor IDs to retrieve. Maximum 100 IDs. If omitted, all anchors in the specified TTO Creator Marketplace account are returned.

page.description: Page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Defaults to `1` if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: 1-50. Defaults to `10` if omitted.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. To obtain account IDs that are accessible with the provided `Access-Token`, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

operations.name: tto_tcm_anchor_get

operations.description: Creates a Brand Profile for a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account at `/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/brand/profile/create/`. The request must use an Access-Token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account. Some fields are immutable after creation: `brand_name`, `brand_industry_id`, and `logo_url` cannot be updated once set.

brand_industry_id.description: ID of the brand industry. Use a valid Brand Profile industry ID. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

brand_name.description: Brand name. Maximum length is 60 characters. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

brand_website.description: Brand website URL. The link must start with `https://`.

logo_url.description: URL of the brand logo image. The image must be JPG, PNG, or GIF, have a 1:1 aspect ratio, and be no larger than 5 MB. Once set, this field cannot be updated.

tiktok_account_url.description: The URL of your TikTok account. The URL should start with https://www.tiktok.com/@. If you provide this URL when creating a Brand Profile, creators can view your linked account directly on your profile. This improves brand authenticity and transparency before you collaborate. To find the URL of your TikTok account, navigate to your TikTok profile, click the Share button, and copy the link.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. To obtain the account IDs accessible by the current `Access-Token`, use `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_brand_profile_create

operations.description: Retrieves the existing Brand Profiles for your TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. The request requires an Access-Token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account and a `tto_tcm_account_id`. To obtain accessible TTO Creator Marketplace account IDs for the token, use `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

brand_profile_ids.description: List of existing Brand Profile IDs to filter results by. Maximum 20 IDs.

page.description: Current page number. Value must be greater than or equal to 1. If omitted, the default is `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Value range: 1-100. If omitted, the default is `10`.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. To obtain the account IDs that are accessible with the current `Access-Token`, use `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_brand_profile_get

operations.description: Creates a new TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign or updates an existing one by adding more creators. The endpoint supports two invite-link modes: `CAMPAIGN` for a campaign-level invite link that associates videos with a specific campaign, and `BRAND_LINK` for a brand-level invite link that associates videos with your brand account. Orders and campaign codes are deprecated and no longer used. Campaigns created here appear on the TTO Creator Marketplace platform. After creation, creators can directly link a video to the campaign during publication by specifying `tto_invite_link` in `/business/video/publish/`. For updates, pass `campaign_id`; then all other fields except `tto_tcm_account_id` and `handle_names` are ignored, and `handle_names` adds creators to the existing list rather than replacing it. Associating `business_account_handle` during campaign creation is currently an allowlist-only feature and is only applicable for non-EU Business Accounts.

advertiser_ids.description: List of ad account IDs to associate with the campaign. When a creator's video is linked to the campaign, these ad accounts are automatically granted Spark Ads authorization for the video. For `CAMPAIGN` campaigns, the video is also automatically synced to the creative library of these ad accounts. When `advertiser_ids` is specified, `default_spark_ads_requested_authorization_days` is required. Maximum 50 IDs. For `BRAND_LINK` campaigns, you can specify ad accounts that share the same business center, legal entity, or logged-in email.

anchor_id.description: ID of the anchor to associate with the campaign. The anchor is visible only to audiences in the anchor's target country. Anchor performance can be measured only when the creator's country matches the anchor's target country; the video remains visible to the creator's audience, but the attached anchor is shown only in the anchor's country.

brand_name.description: Brand name. For campaign-level invite-link creation, either `brand_profile_id` or `brand_name` is required. Length limit: 60 characters. If `campaign_id` is provided to update an existing campaign, the current campaign `brand_name` is used regardless of the value passed here.

brand_profile_id.description: ID of a Brand Profile within the TTO Creator Marketplace account to associate with the campaign. Required when `campaign_type=BRAND_LINK`. For campaign-level invite-link creation, either `brand_profile_id` or `brand_name` is required.

business_account_handle.description: Handle (username) of the Business Account. When included during campaign creation, creators can choose to message the brand directly when they open the generated invite link. Applicable only when the handle is a non-EU Business Account. This is currently an allowlist-only feature.

campaign_description.description: Campaign description, such as product positioning, target audience, and core features. Length limit: 1,000 characters. If `campaign_id` is provided to update an existing campaign, the current campaign `campaign_description` is used regardless of the value passed here.

campaign_id.description: ID of an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. Valid only when updating an existing campaign. If this field is provided, all other request fields except `tto_tcm_account_id` and `handle_names` are ignored. When you pass `campaign_id`, you must also pass `handle_names` to add new creators to the existing campaign.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name. Length limit: 120 characters. If `campaign_id` is provided to update an existing campaign, the current campaign `campaign_name` is used regardless of the value passed here.

campaign_type.description: Type of TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. If omitted for campaign-level invite-link creation, the default is `CAMPAIGN`. Use `CAMPAIGN` for a campaign-level invite link. Use `BRAND_LINK` for a brand-level invite link; in that mode, `brand_profile_id` is required. For campaign-level invite-link creation, either `brand_profile_id` or `brand_name` is required.

default_spark_ads_requested_authorizatio.description: Valid only when creating a new campaign. Required when `advertiser_ids` is specified and optional when `advertiser_ids` is not specified. Ignored when updating an existing campaign with `campaign_id`. Sets the default number of days of Spark Ads authorization to request for all videos uploaded to the campaign. Range: 0-365. Default: 0. Once set to a value other than 0, when a creator accepts the invitation and uploads videos to the campaign, the creator automatically grants Spark Ads authorization for the specified number of days.

handle_names.description: List of TikTok creator handles to invite. Maximum 100 handles. For new campaigns, provide the creators to invite. When updating an existing campaign with `campaign_id`, provide additional handles to invite; these are added to the existing list rather than replacing it. When `campaign_id` is passed, you must pass `handle_names` at the same time to add new creators.

send_notification.description: Whether to send campaign invitation notifications to the inboxes of creators listed in `handle_names`. Creators can open the notification to join the campaign. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default: `false`.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. To obtain accessible account IDs for the current `Access-Token`, use `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_campaign_create

operations.description: Retrieves TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign information from /open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/. This endpoint replaces the older TCM get endpoint /v1.3/tcm/order/get/v2/ for TTO Creator Marketplace use cases. Compared with the legacy endpoint, `tto_tcm_account_id`, `campaign_ids`, and `campaign_type` are used here, while `tcm_account_id`, `query_type`, `order_ids`, `campaign_code`, `invite_link`, and `fields` are deprecated.

campaign_ids.description: List of TikTok One Creator Marketplace campaign IDs to filter by. Maximum 5 items. To create a campaign and obtain campaign IDs, use `/tto/tcm/campaign/create/`.

campaign_type.description: Type of TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. `CAMPAIGN` means a campaign with a campaign-level invite link. `BRAND_LINK` means a campaign with a brand-level invite link. Default value: `CAMPAIGN`.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Valid range: 1-5. Default value: 5.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To obtain account IDs accessible by the current `Access-Token`, call `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_campaign_get

operations.description: Sends a request to link a creator's public video to a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign, or revokes an existing linking request. This endpoint requires an Access-Token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To use it, you need a TTO Creator Marketplace account ID from `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`, a campaign ID from `/tto/tcm/campaign/`, and a creator video ID from `/tcm/creator/authorized/video/list/`.

action.description: Action to perform. `LINK`: send a linking request to the creator for the specified `video_id` and `campaign_id`. If a request was already sent, using `LINK` sends a reminder notification instead. After sending a linking request, you must wait 24 hours before sending a reminder, or an error occurs. You can send up to two reminder notifications for one linking request. `REVOKE`: revoke the linking request for the specified `video_id` and `campaign_id`. Valid only when the creator has not accepted or rejected the request. Each linking request can be revoked only once.

campaign_id.description: ID of an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. To obtain campaign IDs, use `/tto/tcm/campaign/`.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To obtain the account IDs accessible by the `Access-Token`, use `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

video_id.description: ID of the creator's public video to link to the campaign. To obtain video IDs, use `/tcm/creator/authorized/video/list/`. Videos already linked to any other TikTok Creator Marketplace campaign or TTO Creator Marketplace campaign are not supported. The video's creator must already have been invited to the specified campaign.

operations.name: tto_tcm_campaign_link

operations.description: Retrieves video linking requests for a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account, so a brand can view requests to link creators' public videos to TTO Creator Marketplace campaigns. Requires an Access-Token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To obtain accessible TTO Creator Marketplace account IDs, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/. To obtain TTO Creator Marketplace campaign IDs for filtering, use /tto/tcm/campaign/.

campaign_ids.description: Filters results to specific existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign IDs. Maximum 50 IDs. To obtain campaign IDs, use /tto/tcm/campaign/.

campaign_type.description: Filters results by TTO Creator Marketplace campaign type. `CAMPAIGN` means a campaign with a campaign-level invite link. `BRAND_LINK` means a campaign with a brand-level invite link. If omitted, campaigns of all types are returned.

handle_names.description: Filters results by creator handle names. Maximum 50 handle names.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: 1-50. Default value: 10.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account whose video linking requests you want to retrieve. To obtain account IDs accessible by the current Access-Token, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

operations.name: tto_tcm_campaign_link_status_get

operations.description: Updates a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign at `/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/campaign/update/`. This endpoint appends supported list values rather than replacing them: `handle_names` adds new creators to the existing invited-creator list for campaign-level invite-link campaigns, and `advertiser_ids` adds new ad accounts to the existing associated-account list. `handle_names` and `send_notification` are only applicable to campaigns whose `campaign_type` is `CAMPAIGN` (campaign-level invite link). `handle_names` is not supported for `BRAND_LINK` campaigns.

advertiser_ids.description: List of additional ad account IDs to associate with the campaign. When a creator's video is linked to the campaign, these ad accounts are automatically granted Spark Ads authorization for the video. You can specify ad accounts that share the same business center, legal entity, or logged-in email. New ad accounts are added to the existing list rather than replacing it. Max size: 50.

campaign_id.description: The ID of an existing TTO Creator Marketplace campaign to update. To retrieve existing campaigns for the specified TTO Creator Marketplace account, use `/tto/tcm/campaign/`.

campaign_type.description: The type of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. Use `CAMPAIGN` for a campaign with a campaign-level invite link, or `BRAND_LINK` for a campaign with a brand-level invite link. This value determines which other fields are valid: `handle_names` and `send_notification` are valid only for `CAMPAIGN` campaigns.

handle_names.description: List of additional TikTok creator handle names to invite. Valid only when the campaign identified by `campaign_id` is a campaign-level invite-link campaign (`campaign_type=CAMPAIGN`); not supported for brand-level invite-link campaigns (`campaign_type=BRAND_LINK`). New creators are added to the existing list rather than replacing it. Max size: 100.

send_notification.description: Whether to send invitation notifications to the inboxes of the creators listed in `handle_names`. Valid only for a campaign with a campaign-level invite link (`campaign_type=CAMPAIGN`). To identify such a campaign, use `/tto/tcm/campaign/` and select one with `campaign_type` equal to `CAMPAIGN`. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account. To obtain account IDs accessible by the `Access-Token`, use `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_campaign_update

operations.description: Retrieves creator industry labels or content tag labels associated with TikTok One (TTO) creators. Depending on `label_type`, the returned labels are used differently: `RANKING` labels can be used with `/tto/tcm/rank/` to obtain up to 100 US creators who rank highest for that label, while `SEARCH` labels can be used with `/tto/tcm/creator/discover/` to discover creators.

label_type.description: Type of label to retrieve. `RANKING` returns ranking labels, which are used with `/tto/tcm/rank/` to rank creators. `SEARCH` returns search labels, which are used with `/tto/tcm/creator/discover/` to discover creators.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To obtain account IDs accessible through the provided `Access-Token`, call `/tto/oauth2/tcm/`.

operations.name: tto_tcm_category_label_get

operations.description: Gets a paginated list of up to 100 US creators who rank highest for a specified ranking label on the TikTok One (TTO) Creator Leaderboard. Before calling this endpoint, obtain ranking labels from /tto/tcm/category/label/ with `label_type` set to `RANKING`.

country_code.description: Country or region code for the creator ranking. Currently only `US` is supported because ranking data is available only for the United States.

label_id.description: Creator label ID to rank by. When `ranking_type` is `BRANDED_CONTENT`, provide a creator industry label ID from `/tto/tcm/category/label/` returned in `industry_labels`. When `ranking_type` is `ORGANIC_CONTENT`, provide a content tag label ID from `/tto/tcm/category/label/` returned in `content_labels`.

page.description: Current page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Valid range: 1-100. Defaults to 20 if omitted.

ranking_type.description: Type of ranking. `BRANDED_CONTENT` ranks creators by branded content. `ORGANIC_CONTENT` ranks creators by organic content. This value also determines which kind of label must be provided in `label_id`.

time_period.description: Time period used for the ranking.

time_period_lookback.description: Specific lookback period for the selected `time_period`. `ONE` means the most recent available period, `TWO` the second most recent, and `THREE` the third most recent. For example, if the most recent available monthly period is October and you set `time_period` to `MONTH` and `time_period_lookback` to `TWO`, the API returns ranking data for September.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The ID of the TikTok One Creator Marketplace account. To obtain account IDs accessible by the current `Access-Token`, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

operations.name: tto_tcm_rank_get

operations.description: Retrieves reporting data for videos linked to a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign via /v1.3/tto/tcm/report/. Reporting data is available as soon as the video is uploaded to TikTok; if a creator later tags a video using an invite link, the reporting data is backfilled. For campaigns created via API, reporting data is not accessible in the TTO Creator Marketplace platform. This endpoint replaces TCM reporting for TTO Creator Marketplace: use `tto_tcm_account_id` and `campaign_id` instead of deprecated TCM request parameters such as `tcm_account_id`, `order_ids`, `need_daily_stats`, and `metrics`. The required `Country-Code` header must be a country or region associated with the campaign and can be obtained from /tto/tcm/campaign/.

campaign_id.description: The ID of a TikTok One Creator Marketplace campaign that uses a campaign-level invite link or brand-level invite link. To create a campaign and obtain its ID, use /tto/tcm/campaign/create/.

end_date.description: Required when `start_date` is passed. If both `start_date` and `end_date` are provided, the response includes `daily_stats` for the specified range; if either is omitted, `daily_stats` is not returned. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC+0. Example: `2024-02-01`.

page.description: Current page number to retrieve. Pagination is based on the total number of records and `page_size`. Default: `1`. Minimum value: `1`.

page_size.description: Number of records to return per request for video performance metrics linked to the specified `campaign_id`. Default: `25`. Range: `1`-`100`.

start_date.description: Required when `end_date` is passed. If both `start_date` and `end_date` are provided, the response includes `daily_stats` for the specified range; if either is omitted, `daily_stats` is not returned. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC+0. `start_date` must not be earlier than the campaign creation time. You can get the campaign `create_time` from /tto/tcm/campaign/create/ or /tto/tcm/campaign/. Example: `2024-01-01`.

tto_tcm_account_id.description: The TikTok One Creator Marketplace account ID. To obtain the account IDs accessible by the current `Access-Token`, use /tto/oauth2/tcm/.

operations.name: tto_tcm_report

operations.description: Retrieves information about the TikTok for Business user authorized to access the developer app. This v1.3 endpoint is `https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/user/info/`. Compared with v1.2 (`/v1.2/user/info/`), the user ID in the response changed from `id` (number) to `core_user_id` (string), and `avatar_url` was added.
operations.name: user_info_get

operations.description: Creates one or more Smart Fix tasks to automatically detect and fix video issues for an advertiser. Submit up to 10 task objects per request.

tasks.description: List of task objects to create. Maximum 10 tasks per request.

auto_bind_enabled.description: Whether to automatically upload the fixed video to your creative library. Defaults to `false` if omitted.

video_id.description: ID of the video to fix.

operations.name: video_fix_task_create

operations.description: Gets the status and results of a Smart Fix task for a video. Use this endpoint to retrieve a task created by `/video/fix/task/create/` or triggered via `/file/video/ad/upload/`. The returned task can be in `PROCESSING`, `FAILED`, or `SUCCESS` status.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. It must match the specified `task_id`; if `task_id` and `advertiser_id` do not match, the API returns an error.

task_id.description: Smart Fix task ID. Pass the `fix_task_id` returned by `/video/fix/task/create/` or `/file/video/ad/upload/`.

operations.name: video_fix_task_get
